Here, we introduce JAREX (Joint Acceptable Region EXploration), a Bayesian active-learning acquisition function for multi-objective process characterization. JAREX formulates characterization as a joint boundary-learning problem and adaptively selects experiments to recover the joint pass region defined by simultaneous satisfaction of threshold criteria across multiple objectives. JAREX combines an optimistic joint-feasibility mask with a multi-objective extension of randomized straddle, focusing sampling on the joint edge of failure. Our benchmark study suggests that JAREX provides more accurate and sample-efficient recovery of the joint pass region than factorial DOE, space-filling designs, and greedy objective-wise strategies over the full experimental budget range. For batched experimentation, it reduces the number of iterative process characterization experiments by more than half while preserving high accuracy for the boundary-identification task. Implemented in the open-source obsidian package, JAREX provides a modular framework for adaptive, data-efficient multi-objective algorithmic process characterization, supporting sample-efficient range finding in high-dimensional spaces.

</details>


<div id='cs.RO'></div>

# cs.RO [[Back]](#toc)

### [535] [AffordanceWAM: Affordance-Aware Joint World-Action Modeling for Robot Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22332)
*Jiadi You,Qize Yu,Yue Chen,Minghong Cai,Zhide Zhong,Yuran Wang,Bowen Ping,Jiaqi Liang,Zhenhao Shen,Haodong Yan,Yinchuan Li,Ruihai Wu,Xiaojuan Qi,Yingcong Chen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: AffordanceWAM 是一个以 affordance 为共享界面的生成式 World Action Model，用 Scalar Affordance 与 Affordance Heatmap 表示物体中心的时空可供性，统一预测未来 RGB、可供性场、可供性热图与连续机器人动作，实现无需人类动作标签的人到机器人迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用机器人操作需同时预测场景演化、识别可交互位置并决定动作。带动作标注的机器人视频监督直接但昂贵且多样性有限；自我中心人类视频交互多样却缺少机器人动作，且存在具身与外观差异。因此需要一个能跨人类与机器人视频共享的中间表示来桥接二者。

Method: 提出 AffordanceWAM：在生成式未来世界内，以 Scalar Affordance 与 Affordance Heatmap 表示物体中心的时空可供性。基于预训练视频扩散 Transformer，采用分别参数化的 World Expert 与 Action Expert，通过 Masked Joint Self-Attention 耦合，在统一 flow-matching 目标下联合预测未来 RGB 观测、Scalar Affordance 场、Affordance Heatmap 与连续机器人动作。人类视频监督全部三个未来世界流，机器人轨迹额外提供动作监督，从而无需人类动作标签或重定向即可迁移。

Result: 在 RoboCasa、CALVIN ABC→D 及真实世界操作任务上，一致优于仅 RGB 与仅机器人数据的基线。在固定机器人监督下，随着带可供性标注的人类视频规模增加，RoboCasa 性能单调提升。

Conclusion: 结果支持 affordance 作为视觉-语言-动作学习与人到机器人迁移的有效接口。

Abstract: Generalizable robot manipulation requires predicting how a scene will evolve, identifying where interactions are feasible, and determining how to act. Action-labeled robot videos directly supervise control but are costly and limited in diversity, whereas egocentric human videos capture diverse interactions but lack robot actions and differ in embodiment and appearance. We introduce AffordanceWAM, an affordance-aware generative World Action Model that represents object-centric spatiotemporal affordance through Scalar Affordance and Affordance Heatmap, within the generated future World. This representation grounds visual prediction in task-relevant objects and interaction regions for action generation, and provides shared interaction targets across human and robot videos. Built on a pretrained video diffusion Transformer, AffordanceWAM uses separately parameterized World and Action Experts, coupled through Masked Joint Self-Attention, to jointly predict future RGB observations, Scalar Affordance fields, Affordance Heatmaps, and continuous robot actions under a unified flow-matching objective. Human videos supervise all three future-World streams, whereas robot trajectories additionally provide action supervision, enabling transfer without human action labels or retargeting. Experiments on RoboCasa, CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D, and real-world manipulation demonstrate consistent gains over RGB-only and robot-data-only baselines. Under fixed robot supervision, RoboCasa performance improves monotonically as affordance-annotated human video scales. These results support affordance as an effective interface for both vision-language-action learning and human-to-robot transfer.

</details>


### [536] [Active Spatial Inspection for Effective and Efficient Embodied Exploration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22385)
*Wenbin Wang,Xiang Bai,Yizhao Wang,Hang Sun,Dong Ren,Jie Qin,Qingquan Li,Bing Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出空间显式引导的主动探索框架ACE，通过证据驱动的感知与曝光感知的运动，缓解早停与过度持续的张力，导航成功率提升18.0%，效率提升10.3%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有具身探索框架依赖空间上粗糙且间接的线索与方向评估，难以判断线索充分性及是否需进一步检查，导致过早终止或过度持续，降低任务成功率与效率。

Method: 从空间显式视角重构具身探索，提出ACE框架：证据驱动的感知整合细粒度定位与聚焦验证，将暗示性线索转为精确的决定性视觉证据；曝光感知的运动通过前瞻性优先级排序与回溯性抑制进行方向判断，选择有前景的方向以高效推进。

Result: 实验表明，ACE相较此前最优基线在导航任务成功率上高18.0%，问答探索效率高10.3%。

Conclusion: ACE建立了空间分辨的决策范式，缓解了防止过早终止与避免不必要持续之间的张力，推进了有效且高效的具身探索。

Abstract: Achieving high task success and efficiency remains a central pursuit in embodied exploration. Existing frameworks typically guide agent behavior through a spatially coarse and indirect assessment of suggestive cues and directions, yet such designs may struggle to judge cue sufficiency and the need for further inspection, leading to early termination or excessive continuation and ultimately reducing task success and efficiency. This work rethinks embodied exploration from a spatially explicit standpoint and introduces the spatial-inspection-guided ACtive Exploration (ACE) framework coupling evidence-grounded perception with exposure-informed movement and establishing a spatially resolved decision paradigm. Evidence-grounded perception strengthens inferential validity by integrating granular localization with focused verification, turning suggestive cues into precise decisive visual support. Exposure-informed movement promotes directional judgment through prospective prioritization and retrospective suppression, selecting promising directions for efficient spatial progress. ACE alleviates the tension between preventing early termination and avoiding unnecessary continuation. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ACE achieves 18.0% higher navigation task success and 10.3% higher exploration efficiency for question answering than prior state-of-the-art baselines, advancing effective and efficient embodied exploration.

</details>


### [537] [SmoLSTM: A Compact Vision-Language-Action Model with Recurrent Memory that Persists](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22854)
*Jan-Gerrit Habekost,Parsa Mastouri Kashani,Connor Gäde,Matthias Kerzel,Philipp Allgeuer,Cornelius Weber,Stefan Wermter,Jae Hee Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SmoLSTM将冻结的SmolVLM主干与矩阵记忆LSTM控制层耦合，把整段episode压缩进递归状态（存储O(1)），在LIBERO-Mem上取得85.1%子目标覆盖与77.5%全任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉-语言-动作模型通常仅依据当前观测预测动作，在存在物体遮挡或视觉上相同物体的任务中会因缺乏episode历史而产生歧义。常见对策是扩大观测窗口，但这会把时间窗变成超参数，并使单步计算代价随窗口增长。

Method: 提出SmoLSTM：冻结的256M参数SmolVLM主干 + 矩阵记忆LSTM控制层；观测token与动作查询统一在单一因果流中，且整个episode内不重置。递归状态存储相对episode长度为O(1)。采用流匹配动作头，每个控制步预测10个末端执行器位姿增量与夹爪命令的动作块。

Result: 单一策略在140个任务、7,461条演示上联合训练，并在留出初始状态上评估：在LIBERO-Mem上达到85.1%子目标覆盖率与77.5%全任务成功率，仅0.04B可训练参数，优于该基准自身的以物体为中心基线及近期基于记忆的方法。若每个控制步重置递归状态，全任务成功率降至7.0%。同一模型在标准LIBERO上平均成功率为79.6%。

Conclusion: 以递归状态承载episode历史可避免窗口超参数与逐步开销增长，显著提升存在遮挡或视觉歧义任务的表现；消融表明策略确实依赖决策间传递的上下文信息，且该设计在标准LIBERO上亦保持良好泛化。

Abstract: Vision-language-action models often predict actions from only the current observation, which can leave tasks involving object occlusion or visually identical objects ambiguous without episode history. The usual countermeasure, widening the observation window, turns the horizon into a hyperparameter and lets per-step cost grow with it. We instead capture the episode in a recurrent state. SmoLSTM couples a frozen 256M-parameter SmolVLM backbone to a matrix-memory LSTM control layer in which observation tokens and action queries are unified in a single causal stream that is never reset throughout the entire episode. Recurrent-state storage is therefore O(1) in episode length. A flow-matching action head predicts chunks of 10 end-effector pose deltas and gripper commands at each control step. Our single policy, trained jointly on 7,461 demonstrations across 140 tasks and evaluated on held-out initial states, performs best, reaching 85.1% subgoal coverage and 77.5% full-task success on LIBERO-Mem with 0.04B trainable parameters, surpassing both the benchmark's own object-centric baseline and recent memory-based approaches. Resetting the recurrent state at every control step reduces full-task success to 7.0%, showing that the trained policy relies on context carried between decisions. The same model achieves 79.6% average success on standard LIBERO.

</details>


### [538] [Cognitive Action Reasoning for Proactive Robots from Human-Centered Multimodal Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23486)
*Zhihao Gu,Kechao Zhu,Yuanfeng Wu,Mohan Liu,Ankit Kumar Shaw,ChenDong Hong,Xuanyu Chen,Dengchen Mei,Xu Tianyi,Lin Wang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出主动机器人动作推理（ProRobo）问题，并构建真实世界多模态数据集 ProAction（10K样本、12类场景），提出参考模型 MMC2Act，验证通用MLLM在主动高层动作推理上的不足及在该数据集上训练的显著提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人机中心环境中的机器人与多数机器人学习数据集依赖显式指令或低层动作配对；虽已有主动具身辅助研究，但资源面向不同设定与动作层级，真实世界人本多模态决策仍缺乏探索。

Method: 将问题形式化为 ProRobo：无显式动作指令下，依据多模态人类与环境线索决定动作。构建 ProAction 数据集，含视觉、音频、文本，覆盖5类场景、12种日常情境，共10K样本。采用两阶段 human-in-the-loop 流程：评价引导的候选生成 + 情感心理理论引导的人工精修，将人类状态、紧迫性、可行性与潜在风险的语境判断纳入动作标注。基于该监督基准测试代表性 MLLM，并提出参考模型 MMC2Act，隐式学习多模态观察到认知基础高层动作的映射。

Result: 在模态设置、主体不相交泛化、跨数据集迁移与人工评估等实验中，通用 MLLM 难以从多模态线索主动推理高层动作，而在 ProAction 上训练可显著提升性能。

Conclusion: ProAction 与 MMC2Act 为主动人本机器人高层动作推理提供了数据与模型基础，表明通用MLLM在该任务上存在明显短板，任务专用训练是有效路径。

Abstract: Robots operating in human-centered environments are typically designed to execute explicit instructions, and most robot-learning datasets likewise pair observations with task instructions or low-level actions. Although recent work has begun to explore proactive embodied assistance, existing resources target different settings and action levels, leaving real-world human-centered multimodal decision-making underexplored. We formulate this problem as \textit{Proactive Robot Action Reasoning} (\textit{ProRobo}), an upstream cognitive decision problem in which a robot must determine which action to take based on multimodal human and environmental cues without explicit action instructions. To support ProRobo, we introduce \textit{ProAction}, a real-world multimodal dataset containing 10K samples of visual observations, audio signals, and text inputs across 12 daily-life scenarios in five common scenes. To construct cognitively grounded high-level action supervision, we develop a two-stage human-in-the-loop pipeline that combines appraisal-guided candidate generation with Affective Theory-of-Mind-guided human refinement, explicitly incorporating contextual judgment about human states, urgency, feasibility, and potential risk into action annotation. Based on this supervision, we benchmark representative Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and introduce \textit{MMC2Act}, a reference model that implicitly learns the mapping from multimodal observations to cognitively grounded high-level actions. Experiments across modality settings, subject-disjoint generalization, cross-dataset transfer, and human evaluation show that general-purpose MLLMs struggle with proactively reasoning high-level actions from multimodal cues, whereas training on \textit{ProAction} substantially improves performance.

</details>


### [539] [StenoVLA-3D: 3D-Aware Reasoning VLA for Navigation Through Gastrointestinal Stenoses](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24187)
*Tamima Tabassum,Yiming Huang,Tianchun Wu,Changjing Liu,Zhiqing Tang,Chikit Ng,Beilei Cui,Liangjing Shao,Jiewen Lai,Hongliang Ren*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: StenoVLA-3D 是一个面向狭窄区域自主内镜导航的 3D 感知 VLA 框架，通过将点图与几何门控融合接入 Cosmos-Reason 2 主干，并引入时序状态分支建模穿越进度，同时预测推理、动作、狭窄形状并生成病灶报告。在 40 个留出测试回合上达到 95.2% 语义准确率与 83.4% 动作准确率；在物理 3-DoF 内镜的食管与结肠体模（各 36 次试验）上分别取得 88.9% 与 77.8% 的任务成功率，显著优于所评估的基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自主内镜导航要求策略模型在纹理贫乏的单目观测下预测动作、做出安全控制决策，并在病灶离开视野后仍保留其证据。现有 vision-language-action（VLA）模型主要依赖视觉外观与短期上下文，限制了其几何 grounding 能力与回合级报告能力。

Method: 提出 StenoVLA-3D：将 point-maps 通过可学习的 geometry-gated fusion 集成到 Cosmos-Reason 2 主干；引入 temporal state branch 建模穿越进度；reasoning-and-action 主干联合预测 grounded reasoning 与动作；专用 head 估计狭窄形状并生成最终病灶报告；同时构建 EndoCausal 回合级数据集，含病灶标注、动作与时序 grounded reasoning。

Result: 在 40 个留出录制的测试回合上，达到 95.2% 语义准确率与 83.4% 动作准确率。在物理 3-DoF 内镜上，食管与结肠体模（各 36 次试验）任务成功率分别为 88.9% 与 77.8%，显著优于所评估的基线。

Conclusion: StenoVLA-3D 通过 3D 感知融合与回合级时序建模，提升了纹理贫乏单目观测下的几何 grounding、安全控制与病灶报告能力，在录制测试与物理内镜体模上均取得优于基线的表现。

Abstract: Autonomous endoscopic navigation requires the policy model to predict actions from texture-poor monocular observations, make safe control decisions, and retain evidence of lesions after they leave the field of view. Existing vision-language-action (VLA) models primarily rely on visual appearance and short-term context, limiting geometric grounding and episode-level reporting. We introduce StenoVLA-3D, a 3D-aware VLA framework for navigating through stenotic regions. We integrate point-maps into the Cosmos-Reason 2 backbone through learned geometry-gated fusion, and also propose a temporal state branch to model traversal progress. Our reasoning-and-action backbone predicts grounded reasoning with actions, while dedicated heads estimate stenosis shape and generate the final lesion report. We further introduce EndoCausal, an episode-level dataset with lesion annotations, actions, and temporally grounded reasoning. On 40 held-out recorded test episodes, StenoVLA-3D reaches 95.2\% semantic accuracy and 83.4\% action accuracy. On the physical 3-DoF endoscope, it attains 88.9\% and 77.8\% task success in esophageal and colonic phantoms (36 trials each), substantially outperforming the evaluated baselines.

</details>


### [540] [OpenFlyScan: A Quality-Guided Aerial Reconstruction System for Consumer Drones](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24253)
*Zhongrui You,Zhen Li,Junli Liu,Zhigang Wang,Bin Zhao*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OpenFlyScan是一个面向消费级无人机的质量引导航拍重建系统，通过GS质量模型预测重建质量并规划补采航线，结合移动App实现采集、定向补采与重建一体化，在实地实验中显著提升额外视角PSNR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模城市资产的三维高斯泼溅（3DGS）构建受限于昂贵设备与滞后的质量反馈：预设航线可能对复杂表面观测不足，缺陷往往在重建后才发现，导致返航重采与重复处理，成本与周期高。

Method: 系统由三部分组成：(1) GS质量模型，从3DGS渲染误差中学习，预测区域级重建质量；(2) 再采集规划器，依据质量预测生成互补的补采航带（reacquisition strips）；(3) 定制移动App，执行规划航线并支持自动倾斜摄影与数据传输，无需机载额外硬件。

Result: 在真实航拍场景中，质量模型能有效识别可能重建较差的区域；在Expo West实地实验中，定向再采集使额外视角的PSNR提升10.95 dB。

Conclusion: OpenFlyScan以消费级无人机为平台，将采集、定向再采集与重建集成于一体，支持快速、低成本的城市资产生成；代码与模型将在项目主页公开。

Abstract: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) provides high-fidelity scenes for large-scale embodied simulation, but constructing large-scale urban assets remains constrained by expensive equipment and delayed quality feedback. Preset surveys can leave complex surfaces insufficiently observed, with defects discovered only after reconstruction, requiring return visits and repeated processing. We present OpenFlyScan, a quality-guided aerial reconstruction system for consumer drones that integrates a GS quality model, a reacquisition planner, and a custom-designed mobile app. The model learns from GS rendering errors to predict regional reconstruction quality. Based on these predictions, the planner then generates complementary reacquisition strips to be executed through the app, which also supports automated oblique surveys and data transfer without additional hardware on board. Across real aerial scenes, the model effectively identifies regions that are likely to be poorly reconstructed. In the Expo West field experiment, targeted reacquisition improves PSNR at additional views by 10.95 dB. With consumer drones, OpenFlyScan integrates capture, targeted reacquisition, and reconstruction to support rapid, low-cost urban asset creation. Code and models will be made publicly available at https://openflyscan.github.io/.

</details>


### [541] [LIBERO-VPro: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Visual Robustness of Robotic Foundation Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24350)
*Huiqiong Li,Zhiting Mei,Anirudha Majumdar,Jingjing Chen,Yu-Gang Jiang,Bin Zhu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 LIBERO-VPro 基准，通过扰动执行过程中的视觉信息，系统评估机器人基础模型的闭环视觉鲁棒性，发现标称性能强掩盖了视觉 grounding 与适应能力的显著缺陷。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有机器人基础模型评测多假设视觉观测干净、及时且一致，缺少对闭环执行中视觉证据扰动的系统评估，导致强标称性能掩盖真实的视觉接地与适应弱点。

Method: 构建 LIBERO-VPro 基准，涵盖四个互补维度（视觉证据退化、相机陈旧、视觉源一致性、任务相关场景变化），包含 12 类挑战、96 种实验设置、3,296 个任务-条件案例；评估 3 个 VLA 模型与 3 个 WAM 模型，约 196,000 个仿真回合，并在 Franka Research 3 上完成 200 次真实世界 rollout。

Result: 模型在严重物体级遮挡下常仍成功，但局部交互线索被破坏或熟悉空间先验被违反时性能急剧下降；对陈旧或缺失观测高度敏感，任务前置条件变化需行为适应时表现困难；VLA 与 WAM 呈现不同鲁棒性画像，说明视觉鲁棒性是多维且依赖架构的。

Conclusion: LIBERO-VPro 提供了系统诊断框架，有助于开发在挑战性视觉条件下更可靠地接地与适应动作的机器人基础模型。

Abstract: Robotic foundation models achieve impressive performance on standard manipulation benchmarks, yet these evaluations typically assume clean, timely, and consistent visual observations throughout execution. We introduce LIBERO-VPro, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the closed-loop visual robustness of robotic foundation models by perturbing the visual evidence available during execution. LIBERO-VPro covers four complementary dimensions, including Visual Evidence Degradation, Camera Staleness, Visual Source Consistency, and Task-Relevant Scene Variation, spanning 12 challenge categories, 96 experimental settings, and 3,296 task-condition cases. We evaluate three vision-language-action models and three world-action models over approximately 196,000 simulated episodes, complemented by 200 real-world rollouts on a Franka Research 3. Our results reveal that strong nominal performance can mask substantial weaknesses in visual grounding and adaptation. Models often remain successful despite severe object-level occlusion, yet degrade sharply when local interaction cues are disrupted or familiar spatial priors are violated. They are also highly sensitive to stale or missing observations and struggle when changed task preconditions require behavioral adaptation. Finally, VLAs and WAMs exhibit distinct robustness profiles, showing that visual robustness is multi-dimensional and architecture-dependent. LIBERO-VPro provides a systematic diagnostic framework for developing robotic foundation models that can more reliably ground and adapt their actions under challenging visual conditions.

</details>


### [542] [What do VLM-Based Vision-Language Navigation Models Rely on: Interpreting and Steering Policy Behavior](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24576)
*Débora Oliveira Makowski,Samiran Gode,Abhijeet Nayak,Marco Hutter,Cordelia Schmid,Lukas Rosenberger Schmid,Wolfram Burgard*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究视觉语言导航（VLN）模型的可解释性与可操控性，通过干预式指标量化视觉观测、指令与视觉记忆对导航决策的因果影响，发现导航策略对多模态均敏感，并编码导航进度与语义结构，可进行概念级操控，且抽象行为的激活向量可零样本迁移至真实分布外场景并提升性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现代VLN模型多依赖预训练大型视觉语言模型（VLM）预测导航动作，这种融合虽支持多模态推理，但掩盖了跨模态信息路由机制与导航决策驱动因素，导致无法确认VLN模型是否基于相关语义线索进行预测、能否追踪任务进度。

Method: 采用干预式（intervention-based）指标，测量视觉观测、指令与视觉记忆对导航决策的因果影响；并提取抽象行为的激活向量，将其零样本迁移至分布外真实场景。

Result: 导航策略对所有输入模态均敏感，不依赖单一模态；智能体编码了导航进度并保留VLM骨干的语义结构，支持概念级（concept-level）内部激活操控；抽象行为的激活向量可零样本迁移至分布外真实场景，无需额外微调即可提升性能。

Conclusion: VLN模型的导航决策具有多模态因果依赖性，其内部激活蕴含可解释的进度与语义信息，并可通过概念级操控与激活向量迁移实现跨域泛化与性能提升，为VLN模型的透明性与可控性提供新途径。

Abstract: Modern Vision-Language Navigation (VLN) models rely mostly on pre-trained large Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to predict navigation actions. While this fusion of language instructions and visual observations allows multimodal reasoning, it obscures how information is routed across modalities or what mechanisms drive navigation decisions. Thus, it remains unclear whether VLN models ground their predictions in relevant semantic cues or can track task progress. In this work, we study the interpretability and steerability of VLN models. We use intervention-based metrics that measure how visual observations, instructions, and visual memory causally influence navigation decisions. Our results show that these navigation policies are sensitive to all input modalities and do not depend on a single one. We further show that these agents encode navigation progress and retain semantic structure from their VLM backbones, enabling concept-level steering through internal activations. Finally, we extract activation vectors for abstract behaviors to transfer them zero-shot to out-of-distribution real-world scenarios, improving performance without additional fine-tuning.

</details>


### [543] [Think Like a World Model, Act Like a VLA: Distilling World-Model Representations into Compact Robot Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24682)
*Trung Dao,Sankalp Yamsani,Jaden Park,Joohyung Kim,Yong Jae Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出将世界模型的内在表征知识以特征对齐方式蒸馏到VLA策略训练中，冻结世界模型仅用于一次性缓存特征，训练后丢弃投影器，部署策略与基线完全相同（32ms、1.86GB），纯靠表征提升鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型将观测直接映射为动作，缺乏关于"世界如何响应"的目标函数，稳健性受限于数据覆盖范围；世界模型恰好具备该目标与物理接地性，但逐决策推演未来需数秒，无法进入控制回路。因此需要一种方式在保留世界模型物理先验的同时摆脱其推理开销。

Method: 核心洞察是世界模型对物理场景的知识存于其内部特征中，生成未来只是产生这些特征的目标函数，故可继承"接地"而丢弃生成机制。做法是在常规VLA训练中增加一个特征对齐项：先冻结世界模型对训练帧推理一次并缓存其特征，学生网络学习与该缓存一致；训练期间不加载教师模型，训练后丢弃投影器，部署策略与未蒸馏基线完全一致，从而保证增益归因于表征而非容量或测试时算力。

Result: 0.8B学生模型在LIBERO上达到97.9%；RoboCasa-GR1人形操作从48.2%提升至50.5%；同一目标亦迁移至真实硬件，涵盖单臂与双臂平台。增益在改变学生规模、骨干网络、对齐层及教师模型后依然保持。

Conclusion: 该结果表明增益来源于一种广泛的表征先验，而非两个特定网络间脆弱的对齐；实现了世界模型知识向VLA策略的低成本、可迁移传承，且不增加部署开销。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map observations to actions with no objective that accounts for how the world responds, so their robustness is bounded primarily by data coverage. World models carry precisely that missing objective and are better grounded for it, yet rolling the future forward costs seconds per decision and rules them out of the control loop. We show the two can be separated. What a world model knows about physical scenes lives in its \emph{internal features}; generating the future is merely the objective that produced them, so the grounding can be inherited while the generative machinery is left behind. We add one feature-alignment term to ordinary VLA training: a frozen world model is run over the training frames once and cached, and the student learns to agree with that cache. No teacher is loaded during training, the projector is discarded after it, and the deployed policy is identical to the undistilled baseline, running in $32$~ms and $1.86$~GB on a consumer RTX~5090, so every gain is attributable to the representation rather than to added capacity or test-time compute. A $0.8$B student reaches $97.9\%$ on LIBERO, improves from $48.2\%$ to $50.5\%$ on RoboCasa-GR1 humanoid manipulation, and the same objective carries over to real hardware, on both a single-arm and a bimanual platform. The gain survives changes of student scale, backbone, alignment layer, and teacher, indicating a broad representational prior rather than a fragile alignment between two particular networks. Project page: https://thaw-vla.trung-dt.com/.

</details>


### [544] [DexTacWAM: A Visuo-Tactile World-Action Model for Dexterous Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24976)
*Haoran Yuan,Zekai Wang,Boning Shao,Haoran Lu,Trevor Darrell,Ismini Lourentzou,Wei Zhan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出DexTacWAM，一种视觉-触觉世界-动作模型，将分布式指尖触觉表征注入视频扩散世界模型，在6个富接触双臂灵巧操作任务上全部取得最高分（平均70.6 vs 最强基线38.0）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作依赖接触动力学，而接触信息在视觉中往往只能部分观测。现有世界-动作模型（WAM）以视觉为中心，无法直接建模接触动力学。

Method: 对每个指尖独立编码，经手指与位姿感知的触觉压缩器聚合特征，再将触觉潜变量注入视频扩散世界模型，实现联合视觉-触觉世界建模；并以冻结预训练视觉VAE下的触觉编码器持续适配，实现从视觉到触觉的持续学习。

Result: 在22自由度双臂平台的6个富接触任务上均为最高分，平均70.6（最强基线38.0）；消融显示移除触觉世界建模使四任务均值由74.7降至26.6；每任务约100条演示即可扩展至触觉，视觉预测质量保持在纯视觉对照0.5 dB以内；压缩器保留89.4%融合前接触召回，训练加速2.26x、推理加速1.29x。

Conclusion: 关键增益源于将接触演化作为预测世界状态的一部分来建模，而非仅作触觉条件；预训练视频先验可以数据与算力高效的方式扩展到分布式多指接触动力学。

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation depends on contact dynamics that are often only partially observable from vision. Recent World-Action Models (WAMs) couple predictive video world modeling with action generation, but remain largely vision-centric and therefore cannot directly model these contact dynamics. We present DexTacWAM, a visuo-tactile WAM that encodes each fingertip independently, aggregates the resulting features through a finger- and pose-aware tactile compressor, and injects the tactile latent into a video diffusion world model for joint visuo-tactile world modeling. Across six contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on a 22-DoF bimanual platform, DexTacWAM achieves the highest score on every task, averaging 70.6 versus 38.0 for the strongest baseline. Ablations attribute the gain to modeling contact evolution as part of the predicted world state rather than tactile conditioning alone: removing tactile world modeling reduces the four-task mean from 74.7 to 26.6 while keeping the same tactile features and action expert. After four hours of tactile-encoder adaptation with a frozen pretrained vision VAE, our continual vision-to-touch learning extends the pretrained video model to touch using roughly 100 demonstrations per task without tactile midtraining, while retaining visual prediction quality within 0.5 dB of vision-only counterparts. The compressor retains 89.4% of pre-fusion contact recall while enabling 2.26x faster training and 1.29x faster inference. Together, these results show that pretrained video priors can be extended to distributed multi-finger contact dynamics in a data- and compute-efficient manner.

</details>


### [545] [CHOREO: Every Humanoid Skill as a Trajectory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22274)
*Ziyi Sun,Jingwen Chen,Yuxi Wang,Xiuze Xia,Long Cheng,Zhaoxiang Zhang,Yujun Dong*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: CHOREO 提出一种免训练的人形机器人异构技能组合框架，将不同来源学得的技能统一表示为 SkillMotion（可执行运动轨迹），并通过续接、Hermite 混合与验证式桥接动作直接拼接技能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有人形机器人技能虽经强化学习、动作模仿和生成建模取得进展，但受限于互不兼容的表征、接口与控制器，技能彼此孤立、难以复用组合。

Method: 核心观察：任何方式学得的技能最终都可表达为可执行运动轨迹。据此将各能力转换为统一表征 SkillMotion，融合运动状态、接触、语义与边界条件；技能通过直接续接（direct continuation）、三次 Hermite 混合（cubic Hermite blending）或经过验证的桥接动作（validated bridge motions）进行组合，无需重训源模型，也不在测试时更新模型。

Result: 在 Unitree G1（MuJoCo 仿真）上，CHOREO 组织来自异构来源的 2,950 个已准入 SkillMotion 资产，在 130 个多动作任务上取得 95.4% 的序列成功率，其中八动作序列成功率达 93.8%。

Conclusion: 实验表明可执行轨迹为累积与组合预训练人形机器人能力提供了可扩展的统一接口。

Abstract: Recent advances in humanoid robotics have produced diverse skills through reinforcement learning, motion imitation, and generative modeling. Yet these capabilities remain siloed because they are built around incompatible representations, interfaces, and controllers. We present CHOREO, a framework for training-free composition of heterogeneous humanoid skills. Our key observation is that, regardless of how a skill is learned, it can ultimately be expressed as an executable motion trajectory. Based on this observation, CHOREO converts each capability into SkillMotion, a unified representation that combines motion states, contacts, semantics, and boundary conditions. Skills are composed through direct continuation, cubic Hermite blending, or validated bridge motions, without retraining source models or updating models at test time. On Unitree G1 in MuJoCo, CHOREO organizes 2,950 admitted SkillMotion assets derived from heterogeneous sources and achieves 95.4\% sequence success across 130 multi-action tasks, including 93.8\% success on eight-action sequences. These results demonstrate that executable trajectories provide a scalable interface for accumulating and composing pretrained humanoid capabilities.

</details>


### [546] [D3DWA: Adaptive Weight and Prediction-Horizon for Dynamic Window Approach via Dueling Double Deep Q-Network](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22276)
*Zahra Jooyandeh,Masato Kobayashi,Yuki Uranishi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出D3DWA，一种基于D3QN的自适应DWA框架，在每个控制步从连续导航状态中联合选择DWA评价权重与预测时域，同时保留DWA的轨迹生成与碰撞检测机制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: DWA在局部导航中应用广泛，但其性能高度依赖导航前固定的参数。尤其是合适的预测时域会随局部自由空间变化：开阔区域适合较长时域以实现高效运动，狭窄或拥挤区域则需较短时域以保持可行运动。固定参数难以兼顾，因此需要自适应机制。

Method: 提出D3DWA框架，基于Dueling Double Deep Q-Network（D3QN），在每一步控制中根据连续导航状态联合选择DWA的评价权重与预测时域；DWA原有的轨迹生成与碰撞检测模块被完整保留，仅由学习策略调节参数。

Result: 在八个仿真环境（含未见过的新布局）中，D3DWA均成功到达目标；实机实验中D3DWA完成全部三种测试配置，其中包括仅调节权重的变体超时的受限场景。

Conclusion: 结果表明，联合自适应评价权重与预测时域优于仅调节权重，能提升DWA在受限环境中的导航鲁棒性与成功率。

Abstract: The Dynamic Window Approach (DWA) is widely used for local navigation, but its performance depends strongly on parameters that are typically fixed before navigation. In particular, the appropriate prediction horizon can vary with local free space: longer horizons support efficient motion in open areas, whereas shorter horizons help preserve feasible motions in narrow or cluttered regions. This paper proposes D3DWA, an adaptive DWA framework based on a Dueling Double Deep Q-Network (D3QN), which jointly selects the DWA evaluation weights and prediction horizon from a continuous navigation state at every control step while retaining DWA's trajectory generation and collision checking. In eight simulated environments, including unseen layouts, D3DWA reached every goal. Real-robot experiments further showed that D3DWA completed all three tested configurations, including a constrained case in which the weights-only variant timed out. These results demonstrate the benefit of jointly adapting the evaluation weights and prediction horizon. Additional material is available at https://mertcookimg.github.io/d3dwa/

</details>


### [547] [DeViGrasp: Robust Visual Mobile Grasping for Quadruped Manipulators under Degraded Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22278)
*Liang Zhou,Jiaming Su,Yancong Wei,Kangkang Dong,Houde Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出视觉退化下四足机械臂移动抓取的基准DeViGrasp-Bench及师生框架DeViGrasp-Net，通过状态条件抓取推理与可靠性感知时序目标估计，在退化视觉、未见物体和复杂地形下显著优于VBC与DQ-Net。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 四足机械臂可支撑复杂环境中的移动抓取，但其全身控制策略对机载视觉感知不可靠性很敏感。现有方法多在较可靠观测下开发，尚未系统考察遮挡、分割掩码丢失、深度噪声与目标定位抖动对抓取推理和目标跟踪的影响，因此需要建立退化视觉下的评测基准并提出鲁棒方法。

Method: 提出DeViGrasp-Bench基准，包含受控视觉退化、已见/未见物体、多难度等级与复杂地形，并评估任务成功率、执行效率和动作平滑性；提出DeViGrasp-Net师生框架，将状态条件抓取推理与可靠性感知时序目标估计结合。特权教师基于物体、机器人、末端执行器和任务状态关注离线抓取候选；可部署学生融合双视角分割深度观测与当前、记忆、恢复目标假设，采用Target Hold Memory与Temporal Memory Attention。

Result: DeViGrasp-Net在退化等级、未见物体和复杂地形上优于VBC，并在所有评估退化等级上超过适配的DQ-Net。Difficult设置下成功率达62.3%，较VBC和DQ-Net分别提升16.1和4.3个百分点；Hard设置下对DQ-Net的领先扩大到10.5个百分点。消融研究验证了抓取感知监督与可靠性感知时序记忆的互补收益。

Conclusion: 在退化视觉条件下，结合特权抓取监督与可靠性感知时序目标估计的师生框架可显著提升四足机械臂移动抓取的鲁棒性、成功率和稳定性；所提基准为系统评估视觉退化影响提供了统一平台。

Abstract: Quadruped manipulators enable mobile grasping in complex environments, yet their whole-body control policies remain vulnerable to unreliable onboard visual perception. Existing methods are typically developed under relatively reliable observations and have not systematically examined how occlusion, segmentation-mask dropout, depth noise, and target-localization jitter affect grasp reasoning and target tracking. To address this gap, we introduce DeViGrasp-Bench, a benchmark for mobile grasping under degraded vision that incorporates controlled visual degradations, seen and unseen objects, multiple difficulty levels, and complex terrains, and evaluates task success, execution efficiency, and action smoothness. We further propose DeViGrasp-Net, a teacher--student framework that combines state-conditioned grasp reasoning with reliability-aware temporal target estimation. The privileged teacher attends to offline grasp candidates conditioned on object, robot, end-effector, and task states, while the deployable student fuses dual-view segmented-depth observations with current, memory, and recovery target hypotheses through Target Hold Memory and Temporal Memory Attention. DeViGrasp-Net outperforms VBC across degradation levels, unseen objects, and complex terrains, and surpasses an adapted DQ-Net across all evaluated degradation levels. Under the Difficult setting, it achieves a success rate of 62.3\%, improving upon VBC and DQ-Net by 16.1 and 4.3 percentage points, respectively; under the Hard setting, its margin over DQ-Net increases to 10.5 percentage points. Ablation studies confirm the complementary benefits of grasp-aware supervision and reliability-aware temporal memory.

</details>


### [548] [ORDER: A Fictitious-World Benchmark for Domain-Adaptive Embodied AI](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22285)
*Sai Krishna Reddy Sathi,Anuj Tiwari*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出 ORDER 基准，基于虚构物理世界构建 342,069 token 合成语料，用于评估持续预训练中的真实学习而非记忆；包含知识测试 ORDER-BENCH（500 题）与组合排序任务 ORDER-SPATIAL。GPT-4.1 零样本在 ORDER-SPATIAL 低于随机水平，经持续预训练后小模型在新旧场景均显著提升；机器人流水线中，知识测试成绩好≠能生成可执行规划，加入技能适配阶段后小模型全离线表现超越带检索的 GPT-4.1（Kendall's tau 0.848 vs 0.606），且 ORDER-SPATIAL 成绩而非知识测试准确率预测真实规划质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 持续预训练面临归因难题：训练语料与模型已有知识重叠时，性能提升无法区分是新学习还是既有知识。该问题在知识密集、任务轻微（KHTL）的机器人部署场景（如药品分发、危化品处理、设施专属规程）尤为关键，其规则专有且安全攸关，而实机测试昂贵或危险。因此需要一个不可能出现在任何预训练数据中的自洽虚构世界基准，以干净地衡量真实的世界模型归纳能力。

Method: 构建 ORDER（Ontology-driven Decision-making for Embodied Reasoning）基准：基于虚构世界生成 342,069 token 合成语料，定义自洽物理规律。将 500 题的 ORDER-BENCH 知识测试与更难的组合任务 ORDER-SPATIAL（在熟悉与全新场景中为安全操作排序物体）配对。评估流程包括：零样本大模型基线、持续预训练小模型、技能适配阶段，并在模拟 iiwa7 机械臂上构建完整感知—执行闭环，含人在环纠正；同时对比 GPT-4.1 的检索增强访问同一规则。

Result: GPT-4.1 未适配时在 ORDER-SPATIAL 低于随机水平（Kendall's tau = 0.441），表明其先验与虚构物理主动冲突。持续预训练后小模型在熟悉与全新场景均大幅提升，说明是真实世界模型归纳而非记忆。机器人流水线中，知识测试得分高的模型常无法生成有效可执行规划，需额外技能适配阶段；适配后小模型全离线超越带检索的 GPT-4.1（Kendall's tau = 0.848 vs. 0.606）。ORDER-SPATIAL 表现而非知识测试准确率能预测真实规划质量。

Conclusion: 仅靠知识与问答式评估不足以反映具身规划能力，知识测试准确率并非可靠指标；组合式 ORDER-SPATIAL 任务才是真实规划质量的有效预测器。持续预训练结合技能适配可使小型全离线模型在知识密集、任务轻微的机器人场景中超越大型通用模型及其检索增强版本，为安全攸关的专有规则部署提供可行路径。

Abstract: Adapting language models to new domains via continual pre-training raises a basic evaluation problem: if the training corpus overlaps with what the model already knows, performance gains cannot be cleanly attributed to new learning rather than pre-existing knowledge. This matters most for knowledge-intensive, task-light (KHTL) robot deployments - pharmaceutical dispensing, hazardous-material handling, facility-specific protocols, where the physical task is simple but the governing rules are proprietary and safety-critical, and where extensive live testing is costly or unsafe. We introduce ORDER (Ontology-driven Decision-making for Embodied Reasoning), a benchmark built on a fictitious world: a 342,069-token synthetic corpus defining a self-consistent physics that cannot appear in any model's pre-training data. ORDER pairs a 500-question knowledge test (ORDER-BENCH) with a harder compositional task, ORDER-SPATIAL: ordering objects for safe manipulation across both familiar and entirely novel scenes. GPT-4.1 without adaptation scores below chance on ORDER-SPATIAL (Kendall's tau = 0.441), showing its priors actively conflict with the invented physics. After continual pre-training, small models improve substantially on both familiar and novel scenes alike evidence of genuine world-model induction rather than memorization. We then carry this through to a robot pipeline: models that answer the knowledge test well often cannot produce valid, executable plans without a further skill-adaptation stage, after which small, fully offline models outperform GPT-4.1 even when GPT-4.1 is given retrieval access to the same rules (Kendall's tau = 0.848 vs. 0.606), on a full perception-to-execution loop demonstrated on a simulated iiwa7 arm with human-in-the-loop correction. Throughout, ORDER-SPATIAL performance, not knowledge-test accuracy is what predicts real plan quality.

</details>


### [549] [OJOx: Specification-Conditioned Demonstrations for Embodied AI in Construction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22289)
*Mohamed Dawod*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出"规范条件示范"（specification-conditioned demonstration）概念，并设计OJOx采集接口，在建筑场景中同步记录施工者感知的物理状态、外部设计模型给出的目标状态以及连接两者的行为，为具身智能提供可检验"按规范行动"能力的数据接口。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大规模自我中心与全身人类示范正成为具身智能的主要数据来源，但其只记录人感知和做了什么，很少记录赋予动作目的的外部规范。在建筑等技能型工作中，这一缺失尤为关键：任务目标是设计模型中定义的项目特定构型，而该构型在被观测的环境中尚不存在。泥瓦匠可迁移的能力不是某一面墙的几何，而是依据规范实现新几何的能力。

Method: 作者提出规范条件示范这一数据形式，同步记录三要素：示范者感知的物理状态、由外部设计提供的预期状态、以及连接二者的行为。据此开发OJOx采集接口，将设计几何传输至头显、锚定到物理工作空间、渲染进示范者的立体透视视图（stereo passthrough），并与全身及手部动作同步录制。验证实验为一个完整装配会话：砌筑33个组件的墙体，且规范在工作过程中动态变化；通过独立配准的外部相机对记录与物理场景进行校验。

Result: 完成了一次全流程仪表化的采集会话（33组件墙体、规范动态变化），并通过独立配准的外部相机验证了记录与物理场景的一致性。录制的会话与现有人形机器人重定向（retargeting）基础设施兼容，可回放至仿真中的Unitree G1人形机器人。

Conclusion: 该工作提供了一个数据接口，用于检验具身策略能否不仅模仿已示范的动作，还能朝向训练经验中未曾出现的规范行动，即从"模仿行为"走向"依据规范实现目标状态"的可迁移能力。

Abstract: Large-scale egocentric and whole-body human demonstrations are becoming a primary source of data for embodied intelligence. They record what people perceive and do, but rarely the external specification that gave an action its purpose. In construction that omission is consequential: skilled work is directed at project-specific configurations defined in a design model - configurations not yet present in the environment being observed. A mason's transferable competence is not the geometry of one wall but the ability to realise a new geometry from a specification. We introduce the specification-conditioned demonstration: a synchronised record of the physical state a demonstrator perceives, the intended state supplied to them by an external design, and the behaviour connecting the two. We present OJOx, a capture interface that realises this for construction - delivering design geometry to a headset, anchoring it in the physical workspace, rendering it into a demonstrator's stereo passthrough view, and recording that view synchronously with whole-body and hand motion. We report one fully instrumented session - a 33-component wall laid against a specification that changes while the work proceeds - and check the record against the physical scene through an external camera registered independently of the capture. Recorded sessions remain compatible with existing humanoid retargeting infrastructure and replay onto a Unitree G1 in simulation. The result is a data interface for testing whether embodied policies can learn not merely to imitate demonstrated actions, but to act toward specifications absent from their training experience.

</details>


### [550] [When Does Test-Time Physical Diagnosis Pay? A Frozen Policy Buys Evidence It Never Reads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22299)
*Zhengshu Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出并检验"物理诊断"的六项有序经验条件，发现在受控环境中链条完整成立，但迁移到未见机制后在"证据使用"环节断裂；用于评估的冻结解码器在需完整轨迹的决策上不变更选择，而仅用轨迹增量的线性模型却能正确恢复选择，说明证据虽具信息量却未被使用，且失败集中在最丰富证据层级，被聚合准确率所掩盖。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人面对陌生物理条件时，通常先收集变化证据再适应。但"诊断是否真正改进行为"缺乏可检验的判据：仅凭恢复准确率或聚合性能无法说明证据是否被实际使用。论文因此提出一套有序经验条件链，用于定位诊断到行为改进之间的断点。

Method: 提出六项有序经验条件作为诊断有效性的检验链条：有意义的参照、物理条件的可辨识性、所获证据的使用、决策价值、相对固定替代方案的选择价值、安全实现。在受控环境与公开环境中对该链条逐环节进行检验，并通过迁移到未见机制测试其泛化性。采用冻结解码器（依赖完整轨迹）与仅使用轨迹增量的线性模型进行对照实验。

Result: 在受控环境中链条端到端成立。迁移到未见机制后，链条在"证据使用"环节断裂：在需要完整轨迹的决策上，冻结解码器不改变其选择；而仅使用轨迹增量的线性模型在未参与拟合的机制上恢复了正确选择，证明轨迹具有信息量但未被使用。失败集中在最丰富证据层级——这些决策降至随机水平，而以较低成本证据即可解决的决策仍保持正确，该分化被聚合准确率掩盖。公开环境中同一链条也可能在其他环节断裂。

Conclusion: 成功的物理辨识既不能保证证据被使用，也不能保证适应有效。评估应识别诊断链条在何处断裂，而非仅依赖恢复准确率或聚合性能。

Abstract: When a robot faces unfamiliar physical conditions, a common approach is to collect evidence about what changed and adapt. For such diagnosis to improve behavior, six ordered empirical conditions must hold: a meaningful reference, identifiability of the physical condition, use of the acquired evidence, decision value, selection value over a fixed alternative, and safe realization. We test this chain in controlled and public environments. It holds end to end in our controlled environments. After transfer to unseen mechanisms, however, it breaks at evidence use. On decisions requiring the full trace, the frozen decoder does not change its choice. A linear model using only trace increments recovers the correct choice on mechanisms excluded from fitting, showing that the trace is informative but unused. The failure is concentrated at the richest evidence level: those decisions fall to chance, while decisions settled with lower-cost evidence remain correct, a split hidden by aggregate accuracy. The same chain can fail at other links in public environments. Successful physical identification therefore guarantees neither evidence use nor useful adaptation; evaluation should identify where the chain breaks rather than rely on recovery accuracy or aggregate performance alone.

</details>


### [551] [EditWM: Event-Decomposed World Modeling with Incremental Correction for End-to-End Autonomous Driving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22317)
*Junjie Yang,Qingwei Zeng,Youyou Li,Zicheng Ding,Ziyi Shi,Shuqi Shen,Hongliang Lu,Hai Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 EditWM 世界模型，将未来预测分解为"常规演化"与"事件驱动增量修正"两部分，在紧凑视觉特征空间中实现选择性的特征校正，并将修正后的未来特征用于轨迹评分，在 NAVSIM 上取得更优的未来特征预测精度与有竞争力的规划表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 驾驶场景的动态可预测性并不一致：多数时刻属于规律性的常规演化，而少数事件会引发偏离。若用统一模型不加区分地预测，难以对关键偏离进行针对性建模。因此作者主张将未来预测显式拆分为常规基线与事件触发的增量修正，以更高效地捕捉需要选择性纠正的演化差异。

Method: EditWM 在紧凑视觉特征空间中工作。首先由轨迹条件化的正常预测器（normal predictor）给出基础未来特征，随后将其冻结用于修正学习。修正解码器以基线预测、观测历史与规划动作为输入，输出有界的特征增量，其贡献由学习得到的门控（gate）调节。修正后的未来特征通过候选轨迹特定的交叉注意力（candidate-specific cross-attention）参与轨迹评分，从而把世界建模与规划选择连接起来。推理阶段仅使用过去与当前观测、自车状态以及候选轨迹。

Result: 在 NAVSIM navtest 全部 12,146 个场景上，以专家轨迹为条件的评估显示，未来特征 MSE 相对 Normal 基线降低 5.35%，且 83.54% 的场景获得改善；使用官方 EPDMS 评估器在百分制下达到 91.05 EPDMS。

Conclusion: 结果表明，将修正后的未来表征引入规划，可同时提升未来特征预测质量与轨迹选择性能，验证了"常规演化 + 事件驱动修正"这一分解式世界模型范式的有效性。

Abstract: World models support autonomous driving by predicting the scene evolution associated with candidate trajectories. Driving dynamics differ in predictability, motivating a distinction between regular evolution and event-induced deviations that call for selective correction. We propose EditWM, a world model that decomposes future prediction into normal evolution and event-driven incremental correction in compact visual feature space. A trajectory-conditioned normal predictor provides the base forecast and is then frozen for correction learning. A correction decoder compares this forecast with observation history and planned actions, producing a bounded feature update whose contribution is regulated by a learned gate. The corrected future features condition trajectory scoring through candidate-specific cross-attention, linking world modeling to plan selection. At inference, EditWM uses only past and current observations, ego state, and candidate trajectories. Across all 12,146 NAVSIM navtest scenes, expert-trajectory-conditioned evaluation shows a 5.35\% reduction in future-feature MSE over Normal, with improvements in 83.54\% of scenes. The system achieves 91.05 EPDMS on a 100-point scale using the official EPDMS evaluator. These results demonstrate improved future-feature prediction and competitive trajectory selection when corrected future representations are integrated into planning.

</details>


### [552] [Embedding Physics Priors in Robot Learning: A Survey](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22319)
*Mattia Piccinini,Lucas Schulze,Alice Plebe,Matteo Saveriano,Thomas Beckers,Yuan Gao,Oleg Arenz,Baha Zarrouki,Dingrui Wang,Finn Rasmus Schäfer,Jan Peters,Johannes Betz,Gastone Pietro Rosati Papini*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 这是一篇关于"物理嵌入式机器人学习"的综述，提出了统一的分类体系，梳理了物理先验在机器人学习中的应用、软件生态与未来方向。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 纯数据驱动方法在计算机视觉与自然语言处理中取得成功，但机器人领域受限于数据稀缺、真实世界交互复杂以及可靠性要求，因此需要将物理先验嵌入学习算法。然而现有文献在术语、方法和应用领域上高度碎片化，难以评估该领域进展。

Method: 综述跨越广泛的物理先验、机器人应用与机器学习模型（从单层感知机到生成式基础模型），提出统一分类体系，按物理嵌入方式分为三类：物理引导的输入、数据与表征；物理编码的模型架构；物理信息驱动的训练损失函数。基于此分类体系，回顾了机器人动力学学习、轨迹规划、预测、控制与估计等方法及开源软件生态。

Result: 通过统一分类体系整合了碎片化的文献，系统梳理了物理嵌入式机器人学习在各类任务中的方法，并整理了相应的开源软件生态，同时识别出关键开放挑战。

Conclusion: 物理先验是特别相关的机器人专属归纳偏置，能够补充而非替代数据驱动学习，有助于构建更具泛化性、数据高效且可信赖的机器人系统，并指出了未来研究方向。

Abstract: The rapid progress of artificial intelligence is reshaping robotics and accelerating the adoption of learning-based approaches. While purely data-driven methods have achieved remarkable success in computer vision and natural language processing, robotics remains constrained by limited data, complex real-world interactions, and the need for reliable operation. These challenges have motivated the exploration of physics-embedded robot learning, which embeds physics priors into learning algorithms. By encoding the underlying physical laws and constraints, physics priors can complement limited data with robotics-specific inductive biases, potentially improving generalization, interpretability, and sample efficiency. However, the literature on physics-embedded robot learning remains fragmented across terminology, methodologies, and application domains, making it difficult to assess this growing body of work. This survey reviews physics-embedded robot learning across a broad range of physics priors, robotics applications, and machine learning models, from single-layer perceptrons to generative foundation models. We adopt a unified taxonomy that classifies existing approaches according to their physics embedding: physics-guided inputs, data, and representations; physics-encoded model architectures; and physics-informed training loss functions. Building on this taxonomy, we review methods for robot dynamics learning, trajectory planning, prediction, control, and estimation, together with the corresponding open-source software ecosystem. We identify key open challenges, and outline promising future research directions. Overall, we argue that physics priors provide a particularly relevant robotics-specific inductive bias, complementing rather than replacing data-driven learning, and paving the way toward more generalizable, data-efficient, and trustworthy robotic systems.

</details>


### [553] [ReliCAD: From Uncertain LLM Generation to Reliable Parametric CAD Modeling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22325)
*Peng Zheng,Xintong Dong,Chuanyang Li,Jiaxin Jing,Chuqi Han,Hailong Shen,Yanzhi Song,Zhouwang Yang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ReliCAD统一框架，将LLM的概率生成转化为可靠的参数化CAD建模，在HistCAD及自建编辑数据集上取得99.8%有效率和0.8753 IoU。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM的概率性生成与CAD建模的确定性要求之间存在根本矛盾，导致可靠性、设计意图保持和几何有效性受限；现有方法依赖大规模标注数据、缺乏设计意图显式建模，且未充分利用CAD内核的确定性能力。

Method: 通过显式设计意图建模将用户需求转为结构化设计规范，显式建模几何关系、拓扑依赖与特征构建顺序；生成约束感知的参数化指令，并通过Agent-ready API调用CAD内核完成几何构建与约束求解；记录运行时证据，采用验证-反馈机制评估模型与规范的一致性，实现错误定位与迭代修复。

Result: 在公开HistCAD生成数据集和自建多粒度CAD编辑数据集上显著优于基线方法，达到99.8%有效率和0.8753 IoU。

Conclusion: ReliCAD为自然语言交互式CAD建模提供了可验证、可修复、可泛化的方法路径。

Abstract: Large language models have shown considerable potential for natural-language-driven parametric CAD modeling. However, a fundamental contradiction exists between their probabilistic generation and the deterministic requirements of CAD modeling, resulting in limitations in reliability, design-intent preservation, and geometric validity. Existing methods typically rely on large-scale annotated datasets, lack explicit modeling of design intent, and underutilize the deterministic capabilities of CAD kernels. To address these limitations, we propose ReliCAD, a unified framework that transforms uncertain LLM generation into reliable parametric CAD modeling. Through explicit design-intent modeling, ReliCAD converts user requirements into structured design specifications and explicitly models geometric relations, topological dependencies, and feature construction order. It then generates constraint-aware parametric instructions and invokes the CAD kernel through an Agent-ready API to perform geometric construction and constraint solving. ReliCAD further records runtime evidence and employs a verification-feedback mechanism to assess consistency between the generated model and the design specifications, enabling error localization and iterative repair. Experiments on the public HistCAD generation dataset and our multi-granularity CAD editing dataset demonstrate that ReliCAD significantly outperforms baseline methods, achieving 99.8\% validity rate and 0.8753 IoU. ReliCAD provides a verifiable, repairable, and generalizable approach to natural-language-interactive CAD modeling.

</details>


### [554] [Behavior Trees for Robotic Systems: An Empirical Study on Practices and Experiences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22404)
*Razan Ghzouli,Jennifer Horkoff,Daniel Strüber,Rebekka Wohlrab*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文通过混合方法研究（某汽车公司的技术行动研究+34名机器人从业者的问卷调查），揭示了行为树（BT）在工业与学术实践中的真实采用状况：BT提升了团队沟通与决策逻辑可理解性，但从业者在设计、集成、粒度控制、库使用与规划算法等方面面临诸多缺乏指南与工具支持的非平凡决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 过去十年行为树已成为协调机器人系统任务的主流行为模型，但其在真实场景（尤其学术界与工业界从业者经验与实践）中的采用情况缺乏实证证据。缺乏基于从业者的证据，研究社区可能开发出理论上合理但与真实挑战脱节的指南和工具，导致临时性实践，妨碍软件复用、维护与演化。

Method: 采用混合方法研究：一是某汽车公司的技术行动研究（technical action research），二是对34名机器人从业者进行问卷调查，结合两者的定性与定量数据进行综合分析。

Result: BT改善团队沟通及机器人决策逻辑的可理解性，体现其超出任务协调的实用价值；但从业者面临大量非平凡的设计与集成决策，受限于指南与工具支持不足。这些决策涉及实现BT并集成到ROS时的架构与语言选择（报告了观察到的模式）、多因素粒度决策、对现有库的混合体验（最常用库存在实现挑战与文档缺口）、规划算法中最优节点排序的困难；关于可扩展性的看法尚无定论，当前库与实践的局限阻碍了更广泛的采用。

Conclusion: 论文提出跨领域的观察与启示，分别面向在机器人系统中采用BT的从业者，以及旨在推进BT采用实证理解的研究者。

Abstract: Over the last decade, behavior trees (BT) have become one of the dominant behavior models for coordinating missions of robotic systems. Yet empirical evidence on BT adoption in real-world contexts remains limited, especially regarding practitioners experiences and practices. Without practitioner-grounded evidence from both academic and industrial settings, the research community risks developing guidelines and tools that are plausible in principle but only partly aligned with real challenges. This scarcity of evidence leads to ad-hoc practices, impeding software reuse, maintenance, and evolution. This paper reports a mixed-methods study combining a technical action research investigation at an automotive company with a survey of 34 robotics practitioners. Our results indicate that BTs improve team communication and the understandability of robotic decision-making logic, reflecting BTs practical value beyond mission coordination. At the same time, practitioners face multiple non-trivial design and integration decisions, complicated by the lack of adequate guidelines and tool support. These decisions span architectural and language choices when implementing BTs and integrating them within ROS, for which we report observed patterns. Additionally, practitioners faced multi-factor granularity decisions and mixed experiences with current libraries. For the most used BT libraries, they reported implementation challenges and documentation gaps. Regarding planning algorithms, practitioners find deciding optimal BT node ordering challenging. Views on scalability remained inconclusive, and limitations in current libraries and practices hinder broader adoption. We conclude with cross-cutting observations and implications for both practitioners adopting BTs in robotic systems and researchers aiming to advance empirical understanding of BT adoption.

</details>


### [555] [VLPSA: Vision-Language-Poisson-Safe Actions for Full-Body Safety of Learned Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22462)
*Meg Wilkinson,Emily Fourney,Joel W. Burdick,Aaron D. Ames*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出VLPSA安全过滤框架，无需重训练即可为VLA策略在杂乱、动态环境中提供全身碰撞安全保证。通过在线合成Poisson安全函数并构建CBF-QP过滤器，结合双分辨率布尔组合实现实时部署，在SafeLIBERO上把避碰率从23.1%提升到91.2%，并在Franka FR3真机上验证了实时全身安全。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA模型使机器人操作日益通用，但学习型策略无法提供碰撞避免的安全保证，尤其在训练分布之外的环境中。现有方法需要重训练或无法覆盖全身及抓取物体的安全，因此需要一种无需重训练、能在杂乱和动态环境中提供全身安全保障的过滤框架。

Method: 提出VLPSA框架：1）从感知数据在线合成Poisson安全函数（PSF），导出控制障碍函数（CBF）；2）通过CBF-QP安全过滤器在全身及被抓取物体（视为末端连杆延伸）上施加约束；3）为兼顾实时性与关键任务区域的精细空间分辨率，采用布尔CBF组合将PSF的双分辨率融合。

Result: 在SafeLIBERO上与安全过滤基线对比，取得最高的避碰率，将基础π0.5策略的避碰率从23.1%提升至91.2%，同时任务成功率超过基线。在Franka FR3上于含动态障碍和人员干扰的杂乱场景中部署，验证了操作任务期间的实时全身安全。

Conclusion: VLPSA为VLA策略提供了一种无需重训练的全身安全过滤方案，兼顾碰撞避免与任务性能，并具备在真实机器人动态环境中的实时部署能力。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models enable increasingly general-purpose robotic manipulation, but such learned policies do not provide safety guarantees for collision avoidance---especially in environments outside of training distributions. This work presents Vision-Language-Poisson-Safe Actions (VLPSA), a safety filtering framework that provides full-body safety for VLA policies in cluttered and dynamic environments without retraining. VLPSA synthesizes Poisson Safety Functions (PSF) online from perception data, yielding a Control Barrier Function (CBF) that is enforced through a CBF-QP safety filter over the full body and any grasped object, treated as an extension of the final robot link. To enable real-time deployment while maintaining fine spatial resolution in critical task regions, VLPSA combines dual resolutions of this PSF using Boolean CBF compositions. We evaluate VLPSA on SafeLIBERO against safety-filtering baselines, where it achieves the highest collision avoidance rate among the evaluated methods, increasing collision avoidance from 23.1% for the base $π_{0.5}$ policy to 91.2% while surpassing its task success rate. We further deploy VLPSA on a Franka FR3 in cluttered scenes with dynamic obstacles and human interference, demonstrating real-time full-body safety during manipulation tasks.

</details>


### [556] [Tracker-Free Robotic Ultrasound Calibration with a Spherical-Marker Phantom and Threshold-Free Center Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22483)
*Kyoungmo Koo,Guangshen Ma,Xueding Wang,Mark Draelos*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种无需外部追踪器的机器人超声标定框架，基于球形标记体模与无阈值图像处理实现球心定位，并在多姿态观测下估计US到EE的变换，精度与三标记标定相当。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人超声标定需准确建立US图像与机器人坐标系的对应关系，但现有方法常依赖复杂体模或外部3D追踪器，难以实现准确且自动化的标定。

Method: 使用球形标记体模与高度自动化的感知流程进行球心定位；提出无阈值图像处理方法，依据每幅US图像的强度分布定位球形特征，避免手工调节强度阈值；利用球形基准的多姿态观测，在无外部追踪、无需预先在机器人基坐标系中定位球心的情况下估计US-to-EE变换；在机器人US平台上通过重复球扫描验证，并用具有已知CAD模型的几何异构体模评估标定系统。

Result: 12折交叉验证中，单标记标定的球心精度与精密度为1.75±0.51 mm和0.85±0.11 mm，三标记为1.72±0.51 mm和0.84±0.12 mm；三组重建中，单标记标定配准后点到面MAE±SD为圆锥0.41±0.35 mm、三棱柱0.50±0.41 mm，三标记对应为0.40±0.35 mm和0.48±0.40 mm。

Conclusion: 该无追踪器机器人US标定框架依托球形标记与无阈值感知流程，实现了自动化、鲁棒且无需逐系统重调的标定，单标记标定精度与三标记标定基本持平。

Abstract: Robotic ultrasound (US) calibration is essential for accurately relating US images to the robot coordinate system, but accurate and automated calibration remains challenging because existing methods often require complex phantoms or external 3D trackers. In this work, we develop a tracker-free robotic US calibration framework using a spherical-marker phantom and a highly automated perception pipeline for sphere-center localization. The proposed threshold-free image-processing method localizes the spherical feature based on each US image's intensity distribution, eliminating hand-tuned intensity thresholds and improving robustness across imaging settings without per-system retuning. Multi-pose observations of the spherical fiducial are then used to estimate the US-to-EE transformation without external tracking or prior localization of the sphere center in the robot base frame. We validate the proposed framework on a robotic US platform through repeated sphere scans and further assess the calibrated system using geometrically distinct phantoms with known CAD models. Across 12 cross-validation folds, single-marker calibration achieved sphere-center accuracy and precision of $1.75\pm0.51$ mm and $0.85\pm0.11$ mm, respectively, compared with $1.72\pm0.51$ mm and $0.84\pm0.12$ mm for three-marker calibration. Across the three reconstruction sets, the single-marker calibration yielded pooled post-registration point-to-surface MAE$\pm$SD values of $0.41\pm0.35$ mm for the cone and $0.50\pm0.41$ mm for the triangular prism, closely matching the three-marker results of $0.40\pm0.35$ mm and $0.48\pm0.40$ mm, respectively.

</details>


### [557] [Layered e-skin for Shear Sensing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22493)
*Qingzheng Cong,Alexis W. M. Devillard,Abu Bakar Dawood,Xinxin Zhang,Wen Fan,Neri Niccolò Dei,Cem Suulker,Kaspar Althoefer,Etienne Burdet,Dandan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种双层堆叠FSR阵列机器人指尖，利用层间压力中心位移将剪切力转化为可测信号，结合物理力矩平衡与CNN-GRU模型实现三轴力估计、接触运动跟踪与滑移检测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统单层力敏电阻(FSR)阵列通常仅能感知法向压力，缺乏剪切力与滑移信息，难以满足机器人灵巧操作对三维力与接触状态感知的需求，因此需要一种能在指尖尺度兼顾高分辨率压力映射与剪切力估计的传感方案。

Method: 设计双层堆叠FSR阵列，中间引入柔性晶格弹性体间隔层，将剪切载荷转化为层间位移，产生上下层压力中心(CoP)相对偏移；用基于物理的力矩平衡建立层间CoP位移与剪切力的关系，并采用端到端CNN-GRU模型补偿载荷相关压缩与接触重分布引起的非线性。机器人操作实验中对比单层基线，并比较不同信号线索的滑移检测性能。

Result: 以两层信号为输入的模型对剪切力估计达到R²=0.914(F_x)与R²=0.944(F_y)，稳定优于单层基线。接触运动跟踪中，深层跟踪机械臂施加的平移与旋转，浅层跟踪接触面滑移；两层总压力响应之差的瞬态变化在所测线索中取得最佳滑移事件检测性能。

Conclusion: 双层FSR阵列可突破传统法向力感知的局限，同时实现三轴力估计、接触运动跟踪与滑移事件检测，为机器人指尖触觉传感提供可行方案。

Abstract: This paper presents a stacked two-layer force-sensing resistor (FSR) array designed for robotic fingertips that combines high-resolution pressure mapping with shear-force estimation. A compliant lattice elastomer spacer converts shear loading into a measurable inter-layer displacement, producing relative center-of-pressure (CoP) shifts between layers. A physics-based moment balance links inter-layer CoP displacement to shear force, while an end-to-end CNN--GRU model captures nonlinear effects from load-dependent compression and contact redistribution. This model, with both layers as input, achieves coefficients of determination $R^2 = 0.914$ for $F_x$ and $R^2 = 0.944$ for $F_y$, consistently outperforming single-layer baselines for shear-force estimation. Robotic manipulation experiments show that, for contact-motion tracking, the deep layer tracks the translation and rotation imposed by the robot arm, whereas the superficial layer tracks the slip at the contact surface. Transient changes in the difference between the total pressure responses of the two layers provide the best slip-event detection performance among the tested cues. These results demonstrate that two-layer FSR arrays can provide three-axis force estimation, contact-motion tracking, and slip-event detection beyond conventional normal-force sensing.

</details>


### [558] [Latent Policy Steering: An Efficient and Flexible Framework for Cross-Embodiment Transfer](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22521)
*Yiqi Wang,Mrinal Verghese,Jeff Schneider*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出Latent Policy Steering (LPS)框架，通过跨具身共享的视觉动力学进行无具身预训练，并在测试时利用目标具身稀缺数据引导策略，显著提升Diffusion Policy与Pi0.5在新具身上的表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 学习型机器人视觉运动策略的性能高度依赖训练数据的规模与质量，而真实世界高质量示教采集成本高昂。尽管大规模机器人与人类数据集日益丰富，但具身差异（embodiment gaps）与动作空间不匹配使其难以直接利用。因此，跨具身迁移——复用其他具身经验以提升目标具身学习——成为突破"逐机器人数据采集"瓶颈、扩展机器人学习的关键。

Method: 提出Latent Policy Steering (LPS)框架，其核心假设是跨具身可共享的是"世界对运动如何响应的视觉动力学"。框架分两个阶段：(1) 具身无关预训练阶段，利用光流在多样具身上训练基于图像的世界模型（World Model, WM）；(2) 在目标具身上用机器人动作微调该WM。测试时，LPS在WM的隐空间中搜索既接近微调数据、又能导向更优动作的规划，从而对基础策略进行引导。LPS是策略无关（policy-agnostic）框架，可灵活适配不同策略而无需重新训练。

Result: 在Robomimic仿真与真实世界评估中，仅使用未见过目标具身上的50条示教：LPS使Diffusion Policy的平均性能相对提升16%（仿真）和62%（真实世界）；使Pi0.5相对提升8%（仿真）和14%（真实世界）。

Conclusion: LPS验证了通过跨具身共享的视觉动力学进行预训练、并在测试时有效利用稀缺目标具身数据，可实现高效的跨具身迁移。该策略无关框架在极少目标示教下显著提升多种现有策略性能，为超越逐机器人数据采集的规模化机器人学习提供了可行路径。

Abstract: The performance of learned robot visuomotor policies depends heavily on the size and quality of their training data, yet collecting high-quality demonstrations remains costly for robots in the real world. Although large-scale robot and human datasets are increasingly available, embodiment gaps and mismatched action spaces make them difficult to leverage directly. Cross-embodiment transfer, reusing experience from other embodiments to improve learning on a target embodiment, is therefore crucial for scaling robot learning beyond per-robot data collection.
  In this work, we find that efficient transfer can be achieved by learning from what is shared across embodiments, the visual dynamics of how the world responds to motion, and by effectively exploiting the scarce target-embodiment data at test time. The proposed framework, called Latent Policy Steering (LPS), implements an embodiment-agnostic pretraining phase, which trains an image-based World Model (WM) with optical flow across diverse embodiments. The resulting WM is finetuned on the target embodiment with robot actions. It then steers the base policy toward better actions by searching in the WM's latent space for plans that stay close to the finetuning data. LPS is a policy-agnostic framework: it can flexibly accommodate different policies without having to retrain them. In Robomimic and real-world evaluations, LPS improves the average performance of Diffusion Policy relatively by 16% and 62%, and Pi0.5 by 8% and 14%, with only 50 demonstrations on an unseen target embodiment.

</details>


### [559] [FRAMES: Failure Recovery And Monitoring of Embodied Skills for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22538)
*Ajay Vikram Periasami,Xinyuan Luo,Haoyu Li,Xianyi Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出FRAMES——面向Unitree G1人形机器人的失败感知监督框架，在CEER全身控制器之上运行，通过Planner、Monitor、Recovery三个智能体及Memory模块实现长时程loco-manipulation的闭环监督；在MuJoCo中100次试验上监测模块达到94.0%总体准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM规划器虽能分解自然语言指令并选择可复用技能，但选对技能并不保证物理执行成功。在人形loco-manipulation中，接近、抓取、搬运或放置环节的错误会使长时程计划的后续部分失效，因此需要具备失败感知能力的监督机制。

Method: FRAMES作为高层监督框架运行于CEER全身控制器之上。Planner Agent通过参数化中层技能选择子任务；基于VLM的Monitor Agent利用时序多视角观测及结构化机器人与接触证据评估每项技能；检测到失败后终止当前技能并向Recovery Agent提供有依据的反馈。框架还包含复用历史技能经验的Memory Module，并通过深度与分割实现几何定位。

Result: 在MuJoCo中对监测模块独立评估，共100次试验（5项任务，50次失败与50次成功执行）。监测器检出50次失败中的48次，正确接受50次成功执行中的46次，总体准确率94.0%。

Conclusion: 结果为监测组件提供了初步证据，完整恢复闭环的端到端评估仍在进行中。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) planners can decompose natural-language instructions and select reusable robot skills, but choosing the correct skill does not guarantee successful physical execution. This gap is especially important in humanoid loco-manipulation, where errors during approach, grasping, transport, or placement can invalidate the remainder of a long-horizon plan. We present FRAMES, a failure-aware supervisory framework for the Unitree G1 humanoid that operates above the CEER whole-body controller. A Planner Agent selects subtasks through parameterized mid-level skills, while a vision-language-model-based Monitor Agent evaluates each skill using temporal multi-view observations and structured robot and contact evidence. Detected failures stop the active skill and provide grounded feedback to a Recovery Agent. The framework further includes a Memory Module for reusing prior skill experience, and geometric grounding via depth and segmentation. We independently evaluate the monitoring module of the framework in MuJoCo using 100 trials comprising 50 failed and 50 successful executions across five tasks. The monitor detects 48 of 50 failures, correctly accepts 46 of 50 successful executions, and achieves 94.0% overall accuracy. These results provide initial evidence for the monitoring component, while end-to-end evaluation of the complete recovery loop remains ongoing.

</details>


### [560] [React When You Need To: Event-Triggered Asynchronous Inference for VLA Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22587)
*Yansong Wu,Huaqing Li,Tianding Hou,Lingyun Chen,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出事件引导的动态推理策略，根据自上次推理以来的场景变化自适应调整推理间隔，兼顾动作连贯性与反应速度，平均成功率达95%，超出最强基线55个百分点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLA模型通常预测动作块（action chunks），导致执行过程中难以对环境变化做出反应；而现有异步推理方法虽提升了反应性，但依赖固定的推理间隔，无法灵活适应场景变化。

Method: 提出事件引导的动态推理策略（event-guided dynamic inference），依据上一次推理以来观测到的场景变化来动态调整推理间隔。

Result: 在静态与动态的真实世界环境中均取得最优表现，平均成功率达95%，较最强基线高出55个百分点。

Conclusion: 该动态推理策略可同时保持运动一致性与即时反应能力，显著优于固定间隔的异步推理方法；代码将在录用后公开。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models commonly predict action chunks, limiting their ability to react to environmental changes during execution. Existing asynchronous inference methods improve reactivity but typically rely on a fixed inference gap. In this paper, we propose an event-guided dynamic inference strategy that adapts the inference gap according to scene changes observed since the previous inference. Thereby, it simultaneously preserves motion consistency and prompt reactivity. Across static and dynamic real-world settings, our method consistently performs best, averaging 95% success and exceeding the strongest baseline by 55 percentage points. The code will be made publicly available upon acceptance. The project page is available at https://react-when-you-need-to.github.io/.

</details>


### [561] [REBOOT: From Failure to Recovery - A Dataset and Benchmark for Precision Assembly](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22591)
*Nana Yaw Owusu Ofori-Ampofo,Samira Ebrahimi Kahou,Joseph Thekinen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出REBOOT，首个以失败为一等信号的机器人操作基准：含18个精密装配任务、2160条演示（一半为专家演示、一半为恢复演示），按五阶段分解并可做阶段级评估，揭示二值成功率掩盖的模型特异性失败点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人学习策略存在特征性失败：在不确定状态停滞、接触密集对齐中漂移、精密任务中毫米级偏离目标。然而训练数据多为成功演示，真实基准又常把性能压缩为二值成功率，导致恢复监督缺失、失败位置无法分析。因此需要一个以失败为核心信号的基准。

Method: 构建REBOOT基准：18个精密装配任务、2160条演示，每任务分解为五个共享阶段（Align(pick)、Engage(pick)、Transport、Align(place)、Engage(place)）。跨阶段注入失败并配以专家恢复轨迹，使系统回到有效续接状态。任务标注旋转对称性、engagement-clearance精度档位，并通过install-remove配对标注装配方向。失败片段按阶段和类别性失败模式标注，实现运动学阶段与容差违规归因。数据含四视角同步RGB-D与接地自然语言的阶段级成功/失败条件描述。半数为专家演示，半数为按模仿学习策略rollout中观察到的失败采样的恢复演示。基准测试action-chunked transformer、diffusion与π0-FAST策略，采用阶段级完成率评估。

Result: 用阶段级完成率评测三类策略（action-chunked transformer、diffusion、π0-FAST），显示出被二值成功率评估掩盖的模型特异性失败点；数据与代码已公开于项目页面。

Conclusion: REBOOT将失败作为可监督、可归因的一等信号，通过阶段分解、恢复轨迹与细粒度标注，实现超越终端成功率的阶段级评估，为失败恢复学习与精细化诊断提供数据与方法基础。

Abstract: Robot learning policies fail in characteristic ways: they stall in uncertain states, drift during contact-rich alignment, and miss targets by millimetres in precision tasks. Yet training datasets consist largely of successful demonstrations, while real-world benchmarks often reduce performance to binary success. This limits both supervision for recovery and analysis of where failures occur. We introduce REBOOT (Recovery Episode Benchmark for Off-nominal Trajectories), the first robot manipulation benchmark designed around failure as a first-class signal. REBOOT contains 2,160 demonstrations across 18 precision assembly tasks, each decomposed into five shared phases: Align(pick), Engage(pick), Transport, Align(place), and Engage(place), enabling phase-level evaluation beyond terminal success. Failures are introduced across phases and paired with expert recovery trajectories that return the system to a valid continuation state. Tasks are annotated with rotational symmetry, engagement-clearance precision tier, and assembly direction through matched install-remove pairs. Failure episodes are labeled by phase and categorical failure mode, enabling attribution to kinematic stage and tolerance violation. Data includes synchronized RGB-D observations from four viewpoints and grounded natural-language descriptions of phase-level success and failure conditions. Half the dataset contains expert demonstrations; the other half contains recovery demonstrations sampled to reflect failures observed in imitation-learned policy rollouts. We benchmark action-chunked transformer, diffusion, and $π_0$-FAST policies using phase-level completion rates, revealing model-specific failure points hidden by binary evaluation. Dataset and code: https://nanayawoa.github.io/REBOOT

</details>


### [562] [Characterizing Wildlife Response to Biomimetic and Conventional Underwater Vehicles](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22594)
*Huy Pham,Levi Cai,Yogesh Girdhar,Daniela Rus,Zach J. Patterson*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提供了首个野外数据集，比较传统螺旋桨推进AUV、仿生海龟扑翼推进AUV与潜水员对礁区鱼类的扰动，利用计算机视觉量化鱼类行为变化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AUV是规模化采集海洋生态数据的潜力工具，但机器人可能惊扰当地动物、造成与其它监测手段显著不同的行为差异，从而削弱其作为科研工具的价值。作者推测采用非掠食性动物的形态与行为（仿生）可减少负面影响，但此前缺乏野外对比证据。

Method: 在加勒比珊瑚礁生物多样性热点区域开展实验，对比三种采样主体：常规螺旋桨驱动AUV、受海龟启发的扑翼驱动AUV以及潜水员。采集场景图像并用计算机视觉进行鱼类定位与行为变化分析，比较不同条件下的鱼类扰动响应。

Result: 两种AUV均引起可测量的鱼类行为变化。经多重比较校正后，两台机器人之间的差异不再显著，但点估计总体上更有利于仿生AUV。此外，潜水员样线期间的鱼类响应大于AUV样线期间，但该探索性比较基于较小的潜水员样本且存在若干混杂因素。

Conclusion: 受操作与实验条件限制，结论属初步性质。该研究为学界提供了首个已知数据集与基准，用于量化仿生机器人在野外生态监测中的行为影响，并提示需更大规模实验以解析微弱效应并优化设计以降低扰动。

Abstract: Autonomous underwater vehicles (AUVs) are a promising alternative to divers for scalable collection of natural ocean ecology data. However, these robots may disturb local fauna and cause drastic behavioral differences compared to other monitoring techniques, decreasing their value as scientific tools. A promising prospect is to make AUVs that are more biomimetic, with the hope that taking on the form and behavior of a non-predatory animal may reduce adverse responses. We present the first dataset comparing fish disturbance in response to a conventional thruster-driven AUV, a sea turtle inspired flipper-driven AUV, and a diver. Experiments were conducted at a biodiversity hotspot in a Caribbean reef, and images of the scene were analyzed using computer vision to localize and study fish behavior change. Both AUVs cause measurable changes in fish behavior. Although no between-robot differences remain significant after correction for multiple comparisons, point estimates generally favor the biomimetic AUV, motivating larger studies capable of resolving modest effects and further design changes to optimize for disturbance. We also observe larger responses during diver transects than during AUV transects, although this exploratory comparison is based on a small diver sample with several confounds. While conclusions must be taken as preliminary due to operational and experimental limitations, this study provides the community with a first known dataset and benchmarks to quantify the behavioral impacts of biomimetic robots for ecological monitoring in the wild.

</details>


### [563] [VT-Bridge: Bridging Pretrained Foundation VLAs to VTLAs via Lightweight Residual Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22606)
*Yansong Wu,Tuo Yang,Rongping Zhao,Lingyun Chen,Xiao Chen,Junnan Li,Fan Wu,Alois Knoll*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出VT-Bridge轻量残差适配策略，将预训练VLA桥接为VTLA，显著降低视觉-触觉数据与算力门槛，在4个接触密集任务上平均成功率由11.7%提升至62.9%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VTLA模型在接触密集操作中优于VLA，但从零训练VTLA需海量视觉-触觉数据与计算资源，构成严重瓶颈；因此需要一种低数据、低算力的适配方案。

Method: VT-Bridge采用跨VLA骨干统一的轻量残差适配器架构，配合骨干专属权重，在机器人执行频率上对动作进行残差式精修；不改变预训练VLA原始结构，仅需每任务最多50条视觉-触觉演示微调VLA骨干并训练0.98M参数的残差适配器。在π0、π0.5、SmolVLA三种代表性骨干上验证。

Result: 在四个接触密集操作任务上跨三种VLA骨干一致有效；相比仅做任务级VLA微调，平均任务完成率从11.7%提升到62.9%。

Conclusion: VT-Bridge以极低数据与参数开销实现了跨VLA架构的通用、有效且易获取的接触密集操作能力提升，为VTLA模型开发提供了实用路径。

Abstract: Vision-Tactile-Language-Action (VTLA) models have demonstrated clear advantages over Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models in contact-rich manipulation. However, developing VTLA models is severely constrained by the massive amounts of vision-tactile data and computational resources required. To address this bottleneck, we propose VT-Bridge, a lightweight residual adaptation strategy that bridges pretrained foundation VLAs to VTLAs. Rather than training a VTLA model from scratch or modifying the original architecture of a pretrained VLA, VT-Bridge employs an identical lightweight residual-adapter architecture across VLA backbones and uses backbone-specific weights to refine actions at the robot execution frequency. This design substantially lowers the data and training barriers. Specifically, it requires up to 50 vision-tactile demonstrations per task to fine-tune a VLA backbone and train a 0.98M-parameter residual adapter. Experiments with three representative VLA backbones ($π_0$, $π_{0.5}$, and SmolVLA) across four contact-rich manipulation tasks further demonstrate its consistent effectiveness across VLA architectures. On average, VT-Bridge raises the task completion rate from 11.7% with task-level VLA fine-tuning alone to 62.9%. Together, these findings demonstrate the broad applicability, effectiveness, and accessibility of VT-Bridge for contact-rich manipulation. The project page is available at https://hoxnocha.github.io/vt-bridge-web/.

</details>


### [564] [Becoming a Fruit Ninja: Real-Time Probabilistic Kinodynamic Planning for Manipulator Projectile Interception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22608)
*Lucas Chen,Austin Garrett,Andrew Niu,Zachary Kingston*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 FRUITNINJA：一种基于 GPU 的 anytime 采样规划器，在批量增长的树上搜索拦截流形，用于机械臂拦截抛掷物体（切片任务）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 拦截抛掷物是困难的动态操作问题：机械臂须在物块下落过程中、于毫秒级时间内到达其路径上的某一点，且切片任务还固定了接触瞬间的速度与姿态，因此解空间受限并受执行器力矩约束。

Method: FRUITNINJA 是 anytime 采样规划器，在 GPU 上分批向拦截流形生长搜索树；每条边为精确三次曲线，其行程时间通过对机械臂动力学的并行搜索获得，从而保证每条边满足执行器限制；规划按对物体位置不确定性与到达时间不确定性的风险感知目标函数排序。

Result: 在 Franka Research 3 上、于标定过的实时仿真中与六种基线对比：开阔场景切割成功率为 96.7%（最佳基线 68.3%），五个障碍物场景为 68.3%（最佳基线 35.0%）。

Conclusion: 通过 GPU 并行采样与显式动力学可行性校验，FRUITNINJA 显著优于现有基线，表明 anytime 采样规划结合风险感知排序可有效求解毫秒级动态拦截问题。

Abstract: Projectile interception is a challenging dynamic manipulation problem. Intercepting a thrown object with a robot arm requires reaching a point on the object's path as the object passes through it. Slicing also fixes the blade's velocity and orientation at contact. The goal is therefore a subset of the states of the robot and arrival times that moves as the object falls, and the arm must reach it within its actuator limits in milliseconds. We present FRUITNINJA, an anytime sampling-based planner that grows a tree on the GPU in batches toward the interception manifold. Each edge is an exact cubic whose travel time is found by a parallel search against the arm's dynamics, so every edge satisfies the actuator limits. Plans are ranked by a risk-aware objective over the uncertainty in the object's position and the arm's arrival time. We evaluate on a Franka Research 3 against six baselines in a calibrated real-time simulator, where FRUITNINJA cuts 96.7% of tosses in the open and 68.3% among five obstacles, versus the best baseline's 68.3% and 35.0% respectively.

</details>


### [565] [From Documented Strengths to Force Limits: Material-Informed Robotic Insertion for Construction Assembly](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22609)
*Lin He,Yanyi Chen,Haofei Sun,Lingyao Li,Min Deng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SAGE系统，将文献中的材料证据转化为机器人插入装配的承载力估计，并据此控制装配力与判定装配可行性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人插入装配中，材料属性与装配条件多变，难以选取既完成任务又不超出装配体承载能力的接触力。施工文档虽含材料工程知识，但将文档知识转化为特定装配的载荷限值仍很困难。

Method: SAGE把任务拆分为两步：一是约束LLM仅从检索到的段落与表格中提取抗拉、抗压强度并记录来源；二是由响应模型对离线有限元解进行插值，将强度与装配条件转换为轴向承载力。对于正间隙配合，用该承载力设定策略的轴向力上限；对于过盈配合，将承载力与实测支撑需求比较以决定是否准入。

Result: 在主基准上，SAGE将平均承载力误差由直接LLM估计的80.65%降至10.74%；不重新拟合时，在额外16种几何上平均误差仍为8.00%。在给定支撑释放模型下，对62次计分仿真运行正确分类59次，且误差均为保守方向。在xArm6实机演示中，以材料文档为输入，13次试验中9次完成物理插入。

Conclusion: 将文档解读交给LLM、将力计算交给显式力学模型，可获得准确的承载力估计与可追溯的插入决策。

Abstract: Insertion is a fundamental operation in robotic construction assembly, where variations in material properties and assembly conditions make it difficult to select contact forces that complete the task without exceeding the assembly's capacity. Although construction documents encode engineering knowledge about materials and their conditions, translating this knowledge into load limits for a specific assembly remains difficult. This paper presents SAGE (Source-grounded Assembly Gating and Execution), a system that converts documented material evidence into capacity estimates for robotic insertion. SAGE restricts a large language model (LLM) to extracting tensile and compressive strengths from retrieved passages and tables and records their sources. A response model then interpolates offline finite element (FE) solutions to convert these strengths and the assembly conditions into axial load capacity. For fits with positive clearance, the estimated capacity sets the policy's axial force limit; for interference fits, it is compared with measured support demand to determine admission. On the primary benchmark, SAGE reduces mean capacity error from 80.65\% for direct LLM estimates based on the same evidence to 10.74\%. Without refitting, the mean error remains 8.00\% on 16 additional geometries. Under the assigned support release model, SAGE correctly classifies 59 of 62 scored simulation runs, with only conservative errors. In recorded xArm6 demonstrations, SAGE takes material documents as input and completes physical insertion in 9 of 13 trials. These results show that assigning document interpretation to the LLM and force calculation to an explicit mechanical model produces accurate capacity estimates and traceable insertion decisions.

</details>


### [566] [HIGenNTO: Scalable Humanoid Interaction Generation via Noise-Space Trajectory Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22611)
*Lalit Jayanti,Kashu Yamazaki,Yuto Shibata,Kotaro Amaya,Katerina Fragkiadaki*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出HIGenNTO框架，通过优化预训练文本条件运动模型的初始噪声，在稀疏时空与场景约束下合成人形机器人-场景交互运动参考，并成功部署于Unitree G1完成四类富接触任务。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形机器人可通过模仿运动学运动参考获得复杂技能，但富接触交互的可靠参考难以获取：动捕在遮挡和紧密物理接触下退化，重定向则引入额外的接触与几何不一致。

Method: HIGenNTO在稀疏时空与场景约束下优化预训练文本条件运动模型的初始噪声。同一优化形式可同时满足期望接触、避免碰撞并维持稳定支撑，同时保留先验的真实性与时序连贯性；支持从零生成交互运动，并按阶段组合长时程行为。任务规格可由编码智能体编写，自动提出交互任务并编译为提示、约束与场景程序。

Result: 在机器人-环境和机器人-物体任务上，HIGenNTO生成的运动可由跟踪策略在仿真中执行，并用于训练仅依赖机载感知的深度条件视觉运动策略；在Unitree G1上部署完成四个富接触任务。编码智能体编写了八个评估任务中的三个及另外四个行为。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了从高层任务描述到物理可执行人形交互的可扩展路径。

Abstract: Humanoid robots can acquire complex skills by imitating kinematic humanoid motion references, yet reliable references for contact-rich interactions remain difficult to obtain: motion capture deteriorates under occlusion and close physical contact, while retargeting introduces additional contact and geometric inconsistencies. We present HIGenNTO, a framework that synthesizes humanoid-scene interaction motion references by optimizing the initial noise of a pretrained text-conditioned motion model under sparse spatiotemporal and scene constraints. The same formulation satisfies desired contacts, avoids collisions, and maintains stable support while retaining the prior's realism and temporal coherence, generating interaction motions from scratch and composing long-horizon behaviors stage-wise. Across robot-environment and robot-object tasks, HIGenNTO produces motions that can be executed by tracking policies in simulation and used to train depth-conditioned visuomotor policies operating solely from onboard sensing. We deploy these policies on a Unitree G1 across four contact-rich tasks. Finally, the task specifications themselves can be written by a coding agent, which proposes interaction tasks and compiles them into prompt, constraint, and scene programs, authoring three of our eight evaluated tasks and four further behaviors. Together, these results establish a scalable path from high-level task descriptions to physically executable humanoid interactions.

</details>


### [567] [Simultaneous Forward and Inverse Human-in-the-Loop Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22630)
*Kyeongwon Park,Steven H. Collins*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出SFIHILO框架，通过同时进行前向建模与逆向奖励学习，仅需有限用户查询即可从人类结果偏好中推断个体特定奖励函数，并据此优化最终控制策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人机交互中主观用户体验很重要，但用户所重视的结果及其在个体与情境间的差异往往未知。逆学习虽可利用人类数据识别用户奖励，但在辅助场景中，执行控制策略、测量生物力学或生理指标、收集用户反馈的实验成本高，限制了查询次数与优化迭代次数。

Method: SFIHILO自举一个前向模型，从控制策略预测用户结果；利用该模型进行主动查询以加速逆向奖励学习；随后在无额外用户试验的情况下优化最终控制策略。候选策略依据其在前向与逆向信念上期望不确定性降低程度来评分，并以区域偏好边界为查询目标，从而稳健地驱动这一同步学习过程。

Result: 仿真结果表明，SFIHILO在用户异质性、结果维度、精度要求、噪声水平及非平稳性等条件下均有效；与互信息方法相比，所提出的主动查询策略在保持前向模型精度的同时显著提高了逆向学习的样本效率。

Conclusion: 该方法展示了推断潜在人类目标的能力，有望实现更具可迁移性与有效性的人机交互。

Abstract: Subjective user experience is important to human-robot interaction, but the outcomes users value, and how those preferences vary across individuals and contexts, are often unknown. While inverse learning approaches using human data can help identify user rewards, in many assistive settings the experimental costs of executing a control policy, measuring biomechanical or physiological outcomes, and collecting user feedback often limit the number of queries and optimization iterations. Here, we present Simultaneous Forward and Inverse Human-In-the-Loop Optimization (SFIHILO), which efficiently infers individual-specific reward functions from preferences over human outcomes and identifies a final control policy that maximizes the learned reward.
