Result: 得到了由12个运动学路径基元与3个非滑动路径基元组成的完整时间最优轨迹集合，并提供了非滑动路径基元的近似解析解；算例展示了非滑动约束对类车机器人时间最优轨迹的影响。

Conclusion: 将动力学非滑动约束引入时间最优轨迹规划，可弥补纯运动学模型的不足，扩展后的路径基元体系能更准确地描述类车机器人的最小时间轨迹。

Abstract: This paper studies the minimum time trajectoriesvof a car-like mobile robot navigating in an obstacle free environment. The robot, with forward and backward speeds, is controlled by bounded front-wheels acceleration and limited front-wheels steering rate. The paper extends previous results which solved this problem for the kinematic car-like robot. However, the kinematic model assumes pure rolling at the wheels ground contacts. This assumption requires non-sliding constraints for the front and rear wheels that can only be handled by the robot dynamics. This paper formulates the non-sliding constraints based on the robot dynamics then augments the kinematic model time-optimal path primitives with three new path primitives associated with the non-sliding constraints. The three non-sliding path primitives together with the kinematic model twelve path primitives form the car-like robot time optimal trajectories. Approximate analytic solutions for the non-sliding path primitives are also provided. Examples study the time-optimal path primitives along representative maneuvers, illustrating how the non-sliding constraints influence the time optimal trajectories of the car-like robot.

</details>


### [707] [PredActor: Predictive Action Diffusion for Steerable Onboard Humanoid Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24840)
*Lei Ye,Haibo Gao,Yitang Li,Peng Xu,Zetong Jing,Junhan Sun,Fanrong Dong,Ziqi Han,Xue Wang,Jianhua Sun,Cewu Lu,Hao Zhao,Liang Ding*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: PredActor是一种基于本体感受观测的预测式动作扩散策略，联合生成可执行动作与内部未来状态轨迹，统一了行为选择与测试时运动引导能力，并已在仿真与Unitree G1真机上验证实时性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将扩散模型的灵活运动生成能力转化为可反馈响应的人形机器人控制存在困难：分层系统依赖的参考轨迹可能超出独立跟踪器能力，恢复与物理执行被推给跟踪器；纯动作扩散缺乏显式未来状态轨迹，难以支持测试时运动目标；联合状态-动作扩散虽提供该表示，但代表性控制器依赖特权全身状态，且行为选择与测试时运动引导能力分散、不完整。

Method: 提出PredActor预测式动作扩散策略：以本体感受历史与可选任务上下文为条件，联合生成可执行动作与内部未来状态轨迹；采用无分类器引导增强文本条件行为，采用分类器引导将预测状态导向测试时目标；策略仅执行动作，无需独立运动参考跟踪器，也不将外部估计的全身状态作为输入；为便于机载部署，引入滚动去噪与计算保持型运行时优化。

Result: 仿真中PredActor到达全部15个目标点，文本检索得分0.580（条件动作扩散为0.373），扰动存活率相近；在Jetson Orin NX上完整回调中位耗时16.790 ms、p95为19.383 ms，均低于20 ms控制周期；在Unitree G1上完成文本条件运动、扰动响应、手柄控制与语义插值等评测。

Conclusion: PredActor将互补的运动引导能力整合进单一可直接执行的本体感受策略，兼具显式未来状态表示、测试时目标引导与机载实时性能，并在仿真与真机上验证了多种交互控制能力。

Abstract: Diffusion models offer flexible motion generation, but translating this flexibility into feedback-responsive humanoid control remains challenging. Hierarchical systems steer motion through references that may exceed a separate tracker's capabilities, leaving recovery and physical execution largely to the tracker. Action-only diffusion generates actions directly but lacks an explicit future-state trajectory for test-time motion objectives. Joint state-action diffusion provides this representation, yet representative controllers often depend on privileged full-body states, and support for learned behavior selection and test-time motion steering remains fragmented. We present PredActor, a predictive action diffusion policy that brings these complementary steering capabilities into one directly executed policy using proprioceptive observations. Conditioned on proprioceptive history and optional task context, PredActor jointly generates executable actions and an internal future-state trajectory. Classifier-free guidance strengthens text-conditioned behavior, while classifier guidance steers predicted states toward test-time objectives. Only actions are executed, without a separate motion-reference tracker or externally estimated full-body states as policy inputs. In simulation, PredActor reaches all 15 destination targets and achieves a text retrieval score of 0.580, compared with 0.373 for conditional action diffusion, with similar observed disturbance survival. To make this guided policy practical onboard, rolling denoising and computation-preserving runtime optimizations reduce the complete callback to 16.790 ms median and 19.383 ms p95 on a Jetson Orin NX, both below the 20 ms control period. We deploy PredActor on a Unitree G1; evaluations across simulation and physical hardware demonstrate text-conditioned motion, disturbance response, joystick control, and semantic interpolation.

</details>


### [708] [CAST: Collision-Aware Assembly with Construction Robots using Simultaneous Trajectory Estimation and Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24841)
*Karthik Shaji,Chisung Kim,John D'Amato,Edvard Bruun,Frank Dellaert*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出基于单一因子图的轨迹估计与规划框架，将机器人状态测量、显式碰撞约束与学习到的缆线约束统一建模，实现高维多机器人协同运动规划，并在后置梁柱结构建造任务中验证其有效性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多机器人系统在建筑领域应用前景广阔，可执行高精度动作并减少人员暴露于危险任务。但建筑环境配置空间维度高，且存在来自其他机器人、装配对象及工作空间边界的强碰撞规避约束，同时重型机器人系统的刚性及振动诱导不确定性使规划更具挑战。

Method: 采用单一因子图进行轨迹估计与规划，在图中同时纳入实测机器人状态、显式碰撞约束以及学习得到的缆线约束；该框架支持工作空间变化，并可实现同步的高维机器人运动规划，同时考虑重型机器人系统的刚性与振动诱导不确定性。

Result: 在一个后置梁柱结构的建造任务中验证了框架的成功：一台机械臂作为木材抓取器，第二台机器人作为钉固执行器。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，将测量状态、显式碰撞与学习约束统一到单一因子图中，可有效应对高维、强约束的建筑多机器人规划问题，并在真实装配建造任务中取得验证。

Abstract: Multi-robot systems have shown increasing viability in construction due to their ability to execute high-precision actions while reducing human exposure to hazardous tasks. However, these environments have high-dimensional configuration spaces and possess substantial collision-avoidance constraints, which include other robots, assembly objects, and workspace boundaries. We utilize a single factor graph for trajectory estimation and planning that incorporates measured robot states together with explicit collision and learned cable constraints. This supports changing workspaces and enables synchronized, high-dimensional robot motion planning while accounting for the stiff, vibration-induced uncertainty of heavy robotic systems. We demonstrate the success of our framework on the construction of a post-and-lintel structure using one robot arm as a timber gripper, and a second robot as a nail-fastener.

</details>


### [709] [Range-Aided SLAM Initialization Exploiting Accurate Heading Information](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24846)
*Isabel Lougheed,James Richard Forbes*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种面向距离辅助SLAM(RA-SLAM)的初始化方法：基于已知高精度航向，先用GTRS求解AUV相对应答器的位置，再通过线性最小二乘估计应答器与AUV的全局位置，为非线性RA-SLAM提供可靠初值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 通用SLAM具有可分离结构，在航向已知时地标与机器人位置可线性求解。AUV导航中通过INS可获得高精度航向，因此希望利用该条件，将RA-SLAM的初始化简化为线性问题，避免非线性优化的初值敏感性。

Method: 两步法：(1) 在给定非线性距离测量下，以广义信赖域子问题(GTRS)求解应答器相对AUV的位置；(2) 结合相对应答器位置与已知AUV航向，通过线性最小二乘求解应答器与AUV的绝对位置，得到非线性RA-SLAM的初值。

Result: 在真实AUV数据集上验证，该数据集提供长基线(LBL)距离测量以及INS提供的高精度航向信息，实验表明所提方法能有效完成初始化。

Conclusion: 利用高精度航向与距离测量的可分离结构，可将RA-SLAM初始化转化为GTRS与线性最小二乘两步求解，为通用非线性RA-SLAM提供可靠初值，并在真实AUV数据上验证有效。

Abstract: This paper presents a novel initialization method for range-aided simultaneous localization and mapping (RA-SLAM). The general SLAM problem has a well-known separable structure where landmark and robot positions can be solved for in a linear fashion given known robot headings. This paper considers the case where highly accurate heading information is available, which is typical of autonomous underwater vehicle (AUV) navigation, to solve for the range transponder and robot positions. The proposed approach consists of two steps. First, using a generalized trust region subproblem (GTRS), the positions of the transponders relative to the AUV are solved for given the nonlinear range measurements. Second, the relative transponder positions and the known heading of the AUV are used to estimate the transponder and AUV positions by solving a linear least-squares problem. These transponder and AUV position estimates, combined with the highly accurate heading information, provide a reliable initialization method for the general nonlinear RA-SLAM problem. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is tested on a real-world AUV dataset where long baseline (LBL) range measurements are provided in concert with highly accurate heading information provided by an inertial navigation system (INS).

</details>


### [710] [SE(3) Neural Potential Fields for 6-DoF Trajectory Planning Directly from Images Without Explicit 3D Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24864)
*Jeffrey Eiyike,Masoud Ataei,Elvis Gyaase,Vikas Dhiman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种从带位姿RGB图像学习的SE(3)神经势场，用测地距离（导航函数）监督，消除经典势场的局部极小与贴障问题，在UR10上实现避障抓取。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在杂乱场景中到达6-DoF抓取位姿需要无碰撞轨迹，传统方法依赖三维重建后在其内部规划，代价是重建精度与计算开销；直接从图像学习势场可免去重建，但继承了人工势场的固有缺陷：吸引与排斥梯度相互抵消处，下降轨迹会贴着障碍而非绕行，并可能中途停滞无法到达目标。

Method: 从带位姿的RGB图像学习SE(3)神经势场，并以导航函数监督——即从同一批图像在训练时恢复的自由空间中到抓取位姿的测地距离，从而同时消除贴障与停滞两种失效模式。

Result: 在两个桌面场景、由障碍阻挡的起始位姿、在UR10上执行：场从每个起点均收敛到抓取3 cm以内，所执行路径对照真值几何全部无碰撞，而仅有图像监督时分别为25%和0%；平均间隙由不足1 cm升至8.6–8.8 cm，机械臂连杆接触由20.6–50.4%的执行构型降至2.7–5.5%。两场景执行抓取成功率90.0%与40.0%，残余失败源于笛卡尔执行器的拒绝而非势场本身。规划约2 s，而基于同批图像重建的RRT*需67–133 s；但在统一离线测试框架下二者相当，部署时的差距来自对稠密重建做碰撞检查的开销，而非规划器复杂度。

Conclusion: 以图像监督的SE(3)神经势场配合测地导航函数监督，可在不重建场景的前提下生成无碰撞、高间隙的抓取轨迹，并显著降低部署规划耗时。

Abstract: Reaching a 6-DoF grasp pose in clutter requires a collision-free trajectory, conventionally obtained by reconstructing the scene in 3D and planning inside that reconstruction, at the cost of its accuracy and compute. Potential fields learned directly from images remove that dependency but inherit the classical weakness of artificial potential fields: where attractive and repulsive gradients cancel, the descent grazes the obstacle instead of going around it, and can stall short of the goal. We present an SE(3) neural potential field learned from posed RGB images and supervised with a navigation function, the geodesic distance to the grasp through free space recovered from those same images during training, which removes both failures. On two tabletop scenes, from obstacle-blocked starts executed on a UR10, the field converges within 3 cm of the grasp from every start and every path it executes is collision-free against the ground-truth geometry, against 25% and 0% under image supervision alone; mean clearance rises from under a centimeter to 8.6-8.8 cm and arm-link contacts fall from 20.6-50.4% to 2.7-5.5% of executed configurations. Executed grasp success is 90.0% and 40.0% on the two scenes, the residual failures being refusals of the Cartesian executor rather than of the field. Planning takes about 2 s against 67-133 s for RRT* on a reconstruction of the same images, though under a common offline harness the two are comparable: the deployed margin is the cost of collision-checking a dense reconstruction, not planner complexity.

</details>


### [711] [DualWAM: Dual-System World Action Models for Asynchronous Global Planning and Local Refinement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24868)
*Yixin Zheng,Jiangran Lyu,Yuntian Deng,Kai Liu,Yizhou Zhou,Yizhou Wang,Xiaoguang Zhao,He Wang,Zhizheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出了一种双系统世界动作模型，将全局规划与局部细化解耦，在保持较长时间跨度世界-动作生成能力的同时实现高频闭环动作更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有世界动作模型因未来视觉预测计算开销大，通常依赖长动作块来摊薄推理成本，但这牺牲了闭环响应能力。因此需要一种既能保持长时程世界-动作生成、又能支持高频闭环更新的方法。

Method: 采用双系统架构沿共享去噪轨迹异步运行：系统二周期性对较长的世界-动作块进行高噪声双向去噪，建立全局规划；系统一仅使用腕部观测，从中间去噪状态中提取时间对齐的短窗口，并结合最新腕部观测完成低噪声细化，从而获取与动作对齐的局部几何、运动和接触线索。全局规划被多次局部更新复用，系统一持续引入最新交互反馈。

Result: 在 Franka 和 Galbot 的零样本操作任务上，平均成功率比最强基线提升 4.5 个百分点，并实现 16.6 倍的关键路径加速。进一步研究表明，角色匹配的自我中心数据和 UMI 数据可提升成功率 14 个百分点，且解耦设计天然支持边云部署，通信开销显著低于基线。

Conclusion: 通过解耦全局规划与局部细化，该方法在保持长时程世界-动作生成能力的同时实现了高频闭环控制，兼顾性能与效率，并具备边云部署优势。

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate robot actions and predict future world states, transferring priors from video pretraining to robot control. However, future visual prediction is computationally expensive, so existing WAMs often rely on long action chunks to amortize inference cost across control steps, at the cost of closed-loop responsiveness. We present \method, a dual-system WAM that preserves broader-horizon world-action generation while enabling high-frequency closed-loop action updates by decoupling global planning and local refinement. \systwo periodically performs high-noise bidirectional denoising over a broader world-action chunk to establish a global plan, while wrist-only \sysone extracts a temporally aligned short window from the intermediate denoising state and completes low-noise refinement using the latest wrist observations, which provide action-aligned cues about local geometry, motion, and contact during interaction. The two systems operate asynchronously along a shared denoising trajectory: each global plan is reused across multiple local updates, while \sysone repeatedly incorporates fresh interaction feedback. Across zero-shot manipulation tasks on Franka and Galbot, \method improves success over the strongest evaluated baseline by 4.5 percentage points on average, while achieving a 16.6$\times$ critical-path speedup. Further studies show that role-matched egocentric and UMI data improve success by 14 percentage points, and that the decoupled design naturally supports edge--cloud deployment with substantially lower communication overhead than the baseline.

</details>


### [712] [Steerable and Reactive Grasping Through Modular Design with a Three-Point Interface](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24896)
*Andrew Nguyen,Yonghyeon Lee,Sangbae Kim*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出一种模块化灵巧抓取框架，用"三点接触接口"解耦全局几何推理与局部接触控制：先从预计算的可抓取热图中采样接触三元组，再由模型驱动的反应式控制器引导手部到达并避碰，最后用仅依赖本体感受反馈的强化学习策略在最后几厘米稳定抓取，实现跨物体与抓取构型的共享策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧抓取需同时解决"抓哪里、如何到达、如何保持稳定接触"三个问题。端到端方法虽统一但泛化性与可解释性差，纯几何方法又难以应对到达误差与感知误差；因此需要一个既能利用全局几何推理、又能依靠局部反馈稳健收尾的模块化方案。

Method: 1) 接口设计：构建紧凑的三点接触接口，将全局几何推理（抓取位姿选择）与局部接触控制（稳定抓取）分离。2) 接触选择：基于物体几何与可选语言指令，在预计算的抓取可供性热图上采样接触三元组。3) 到达阶段：模型驱动的反应式控制器跟踪物体、规避碰撞，引导手部接近选定接触点。4) 收尾阶段：在最后几厘米由RL策略仅依据手指关节状态与近期动作（无目标点、无视觉、无物体几何）进行微调与稳定。5) 评估：仿真中对比抓取-提升成功率（vs. squeeze与端到端基线），刻画到达收敛性，并演示抓取转向；硬件上在两件训练物体与一件未见物体上验证完整流程。

Result: 仿真实验中，所提方法在抓取-提升成功率上优于squeeze与端到端基线；到达阶段表现出可收敛性；并成功演示了抓取转向能力。硬件实验在2个训练物体和1个未见物体上完成了从接触选择、到达避碰到RL稳定抓取的完整流水线验证。单个RL策略可在不同物体与抓取构型间共享。

Conclusion: 模块化框架以几何引导到达、以局部反馈保证抓取稳定，仅凭本体感受的共享RL策略即可在最后阶段补偿到达与感知误差，具备跨物体与跨构型的泛化潜力，并在仿真与硬件上验证了全流程可行性。

Abstract: Dexterous grasping requires deciding where to grasp, reaching the target, and maintaining stable contact. We connect these stages through a compact three-point interface that separates global geometric reasoning from local contact control. Given object geometry and optional language commands, our framework samples contact triples from a precomputed grasp-affordance heatmap. A model-based reactive controller tracks the object, avoids collisions, and guides the hand toward the selected contacts. In the final centimeters, a Reinforcement Learning (RL) policy uses proprioceptive feedback to refine and stabilize the grasp despite reaching and perception errors. It observes only finger joint states and its recent actions, with no target points, visual observations, or object geometry, so a single policy is shared across objects and grasp configurations. In simulation, we compare grasp-and-lift success against squeeze and end-to-end baselines, characterize reaching convergence, and demonstrate grasp steering; hardware demonstrations on two training objects and one unseen object illustrate the full pipeline. Our modular framework uses geometry to guide the reach and local feedback to secure the grasp.

</details>


### [713] [Visuomotor Robotic Pruning in Planar Orchards Using Hybrid Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24906)
*Abhinav Jain,Cindy Grimm,Stefan Lee*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出端到端流水线，学习闭环视觉运动控制器用于平面化果园（V-Trellis苹果、UFO樱桃）机器人修剪，全程仿真训练，零样本迁移到真实果园。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 休眠期修剪劳动密集但对现代高产出果园至关重要；平面树形系统中树干与主枝近似成平面墙，为自动化提供机会。

Method: 合成生成平面果园树网格；构建基于物理的果园仿真器；运动规划自动采集成功修剪轨迹；提出混合强化学习算法结合离线示范与在线仿真回放；控制器使用腕部相机光流输入，无需完整3D重建，引导刀具穿越枝叶到指定切点并保持正确工具姿态。

Result: 3000个修剪点仿真评估：V-Trellis苹果成功率49.9%，UFO樱桃46.0%；38次实体试验（28次商业与实验果园户外、10次室内实验室）实现零样本sim-to-real迁移；实验室硬件上优于经典RRT-Connect基线。

Conclusion: 证明纯仿真训练的闭环视觉运动策略可零样本部署于真实果园修剪任务，且优于传统规划基线。

Abstract: Dormant tree pruning is labor-intensive yet essential for maintaining modern high-productivity fruit orchards. In this work, we focus on pruning of modern planar tree training systems - V-Trellis apples and UFO cherries - where trunks and primary branches are trained into approximately planar walls. We introduce an end-to-end pipeline to learn a closed-loop visuomotor controller for robotic pruning. This controller is trained entirely using simulation and synthetically generated data and deployed in real orchards in a zero-shot manner. The pipeline comprises synthetic generation of planar orchard tree meshes, construction of a physics-based orchard simulator, automated collection of successful pruning trajectories via motion planning, and policy learning with a novel hybrid reinforcement-learning algorithm that combines offline demonstrations with online simulated rollouts. The controller uses optical-flow inputs from a wrist-mounted camera - avoiding the need for full 3D-reconstruction - and continuously guides the cutter through cluttered branch environments to a specified cutpoint with correct tool orientation. In exhaustive simulated task-space evaluations over 3,000 pruning points, the policy attains 49.9% success on V-Trellis apples and 46.0% on UFO cherries. We validate the learned controller across 38 physical trials - comprising 28 outdoor field trials in commercial and experimental orchards and 10 indoor laboratory tests - demonstrating zero-shot sim-to-real transfer. The learned policy also outperforms a classical RRT-Connect baseline on physical hardware in laboratory trials.

</details>


### [714] [Learning to Drive on Mars: Visual Multimodal Traversability Estimation for Off-World Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24952)
*Darren Chiu,Cole Wilson,Andrei Tumbar,Gaurav S. Sukhatme,Steven Myint*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文发布了火星2020毅力号500火星日、45公里轨迹的多模态数据集，并提出不确定性感知的可通行性估计框架，AUROC 0.874、F1 0.758，优于最强基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 火星自主导航要求车辆在多样且视觉困难的越野环境中区分可通行地形，但离地环境的学习型导航进展受限于缺乏大规模数据集。

Method: 构建包含灰度立体图像对、位姿、加速度计读数、摇臂-转向架角度以及倾斜与车轮滑移估计的数据集（覆盖人操与机载规划器ENav驾驶轨迹）；在此基础上提出不确定性感知的可通行性估计框架，从多模态驾驶经验中学习地形表征。

Result: 在Mars 2020数据集上，所提方法AUROC达0.874、F1达0.758，分别比最强基线高0.058和0.156，同时取得最高的平均精度与召回率；视觉表征可集成到ENav等路径规划器，并在实体火星车测试台上验证。

Conclusion: 该工作通过大规模真实火星驾驶数据与不确定性感知可通行性估计方法，推动了离地环境学习型自主导航的发展，并展示了向机载规划器部署的可行性。

Abstract: Autonomous navigation on Mars requires vehicles to distinguish between traversable terrains across diverse and visually challenging environments. However, progress in learning-based navigation for off-world environments has been limited by the lack of large-scale datasets. Since landing in Jezero Crater, the Mars 2020 Perseverance rover has traversed terrain ranging from sandy dunes, rocky patches, and flat bedrocks. As a result, this paper presents a dataset spanning 500 sols and 45km of trajectories driven by both human operators and the onboard planner, ENav. Our dataset contains grayscale stereo image pairs, poses, accelerometer readings, rocker-bogie angles, and estimates of tilt and wheel slip. Building on this dataset, we introduce an uncertainty-aware traversability-estimation framework that learns terrain representations from multimodal driving experience. We compare our proposed method against existing approaches on the Mars 2020 dataset and show that our method achieves an AUROC of 0.874 and an F1 score of 0.758, outperforming the strongest baseline by 0.058 and 0.156, respectively, while also achieving the highest average precision and recall. Finally, we show that the visual representations can be integrated into path planners, such as ENav, on a physical rover test bed. Videos, code, and the M2020 dataset will be available at https://darren-chiu.github.io/learning-to-drive-on-mars.

</details>


### [715] [MIGU: Multimodal Instruction Grounding under Uncertainty for Manipulation Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24995)
*Mingke Lu,Anxing Xiao,David Hsu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MIGU是一个模块化多模态指令定位框架，融合语义与几何证据为统一定位信念，并连接至操作规划。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在以人为本的环境中部署机器人需理解自然人类指令；语言与手势提供互补但不确定的线索，需要显式建模多模态不确定性。

Method: 通过眼-指几何传播视线方向与深度不确定性（含手部方向估计误差）构建3D几何似然；用视觉语言模型（VLM）给出候选物体与区域的语义先验；经贝叶斯式融合构建统一定位信念，支持行为规划：直接进入下游规划或请求澄清；定位目标用于移动操作与桌面任务-运动规划。

Result: 在真实世界基准上，MIGU优于所有评估基线；消融实验支持显式多模态不确定性建模的收益。

Conclusion: MIGU通过语义-几何融合与不确定性建模提升多模态指令定位，并能桥接至移动操作与桌面任务规划，验证了多模态不确定性建模的有效性。

Abstract: Understanding natural human instructions is crucial for deploying robots in human-centric environments. We study multimodal instruction grounding, where language and gesture provide complementary but uncertain cues. We present MIGU, a modular framework that combines semantic and geometric evidence into a unified grounding belief and connects it to manipulation planning. MIGU constructs a 3D geometric likelihood by propagating viewing-direction and depth uncertainty through eye-finger geometry while accounting for hand-direction estimation error. A vision-language model (VLM) provides semantic priors over candidate objects and regions, which are combined with the geometric likelihood through Bayes-inspired fusion. The resulting belief supports behavior planning to either proceed directly to downstream planning or request clarification. Grounded targets then define goals for mobile manipulation and tabletop task-and-motion planning. On a real-world benchmark, MIGU outperforms all evaluated baselines, while ablations support the benefit of explicit multimodal uncertainty modeling. Project website: multimodal-instruction.github.io

</details>


### [716] [Learning Beyond What Humans Can Demonstrate](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24996)
*Yuchen Song,Aditya Mittal,Unnat Jain*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: GLIDE 通过推断任务特定失效模式并生成可执行护栏，解决专家演示不可行场景下的机器人模仿学习数据收集与策略部署问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 行为克隆依赖专家演示，但对于需要动态稳定性、精确接触时序或灵巧协调的任务，人类操作者难以甚至无法采集数据，即“演示不可行”情形。

Method: 提出 GLIDE（Guardrails for Learning from Infeasible Demonstrations Efficiently）框架：给定任务描述与条件遥操作代码，利用系统状态过滤遥操作与策略指令、约束易失败动作，并从轨迹反馈中迭代改进护栏。

Result: 在三个任务上，GLIDE 发现了超越领域专家硬编码的涌现护栏，数据采集优于朴素 VR 遥操作与专家硬编码护栏；细化后将采集成功率从 0-10% 提升至 70-90%；策略执行时混合数据护栏策略在番茄盘转移、记号笔交接与支架、斟酒任务上分别达到 70%、60%、60% 成功率。

Conclusion: GLIDE 能够支持直接演示不可行条件下的策略学习。

Abstract: Behavior cloning for robot manipulation relies on expert demonstrations. However, for tasks that require dynamic stability, precise contact timing, or dexterous coordination, human operators may find it hard or even impossible to collect data. We study this infeasible-demonstration regime and propose GLIDE: Guardrails for Learning from Infeasible Demonstrations Efficiently, a framework that infers task-specific failure modes and converts them into executable guardrails for data collection and policy deployment. Given a task description and the conditioning teleoperation code, GLIDE writes guardrails that use system states to filter teleoperation and policy commands, constrain failure-prone actions, and iteratively improve from trajectory feedback. Across three tasks, GLIDE discovers emergent guardrails that go beyond domain-expert hardcoded ones, improving data collection over naive VR teleoperation and domain-expert hardcoded guardrails. After refinement, GLIDE raises data-collection success from 0-10 percent to 70-90 percent across the three tasks. During policy execution, mixed-data guarded policies reach 70 percent, 60 percent, and 60 percent success on Tomato plate transfer, Marker handover and stand, and Wine serving tasks. These results show that GLIDE can support policy learning when direct demonstrations are infeasible. Project website: http://guardrail-policy.github.io/

</details>

### [717] [Causal Localization of the Refusal Direction in Audio Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22260)
*Leonardo Haw-Yang Foo,Hung-yi Lee*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 通过因果干预（消融有害/良性提示分离方向）定位五个音频语言模型（LALM）拒答余量的依赖位置，发现其主要依赖中后段文本LM层而非音频接口，即拒答能力多为文本LM继承而非前端产生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 核心问题是：LALM在语音前端接入已安全对齐的文本LM后，对有害语音请求的拒答究竟由音频前端承载，还是从文本LM继承而来。这一归属问题直接关系到安全审计应检查的组件。

Method: 采用因果干预而非仅依赖探针：在音频到LM的接口处以及被测LM残差层，拟合区分有害与良性提示的方向，消融该方向分量，测量模型首token拒答余量的变化；在五个LALM（三个骨干家族，其中三个通过基线安全门）上评估，四个在类别迁移的留出集上测试，并辅以编码器输出置零、跨模型方向迁移等对照。

Result: 最大效应出现在中后段LM层，接口方向消融影响甚微。Qwen2.5-Omni上消融L16方向使余量变化-7.10，投影器仅-0.013；编码器输出置零使余量变化-4.7，说明音频通路仍在使用。同一模型中该对比在早期层即可线性解码，但单层消融影响小；在LM骨干上拟合的方向可迁移到完整音频模型。因有害与良性提示在形式上也有差异，该方向被解释为与拒答相关而非有害性特异。

Conclusion: 这些干预定位的是拒答余量的依赖来源，而非拒答的计算位置；移动余量并不总改变模型输出内容。LALM安全审计应使用干预方法而非仅靠探针，并需同时检查所继承的文本LM与音频接口。

Abstract: A large audio language model (LALM) attaches a speech front end to a text language model (LM) that is already safety-aligned. When such a model refuses a harmful spoken request, is the refusal carried by the front end, or inherited from the text LM? We test this with causal interventions. At each model's audio-to-LM interface and at tested LM residual layers, we fit a direction separating harmful from benign prompts, ablate its component, and measure the resulting change in the model's first-token refusal margin. Four of the five models are evaluated under held-out category shift. Across five LALMs spanning three backbone families, with three models passing a baseline safety gate, the largest tested effects occur in a mid-to-late LM band, while ablations of the tested interface directions have little effect. On Qwen2.5-Omni, ablating the L16 direction changes the margin by -7.10, versus -0.013 at the projector. The audio pathway is still in use: zeroing the encoder output changes the margin by -4.7. In the same model, the contrast is linearly decodable at an early layer where single-layer ablation has little effect, and a direction fitted on the LM backbone alone transfers to the full audio model. Because harmful and benign prompts also differ in form, we interpret the direction as refusal-linked rather than harmfulness-specific. These interventions localize dependence of the refusal margin, not where refusal is computed. Moving the margin also does not always change what the model writes. Safety audits of these models should use interventions rather than rely on probes alone, and should examine the inherited text LM alongside the audio interface.

</details>


### [718] [Hi-Singers: A Comprehensive High-Quality Dataset for Expressive Audio-Driven Singing Head Synthesis](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22264)
*Yichi Zhang,Hui Zhang,Guanjun Liu,Yuefeng Zou,Fengzhao Sun,Jun Yu*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出 Hi-Singers，首个面向歌唱头合成的大规模高质量真实场景视频数据集，包含29,608个片段、约170小时，并建立跨语言与音乐风格的评测基准，证明该数据集能显著提升多种架构模型的视觉真实感、唇同步与节奏动态表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音频驱动数字人生成在说话头合成上已实现照片级真实效果，但扩展到歌唱头合成仍面临显著域差异（Domain Gap）：歌唱包含更夸张的表情、更生动的下颌张合与精确的节奏同步。现有模型多基于语音数据集训练，易出现"节奏漂移"与动态受限问题。

Method: 构建 Hi-Singers 数据集，经过严格的自动化与人工双重过滤流程，确保主题一致性、高分辨率渲染与稳定运动；同时建立跨语言和音乐风格均衡的专用评测基准，并在包括 3D 系数模型与扩散模型在内的多种架构上进行广泛实验。

Result: Hi-Singers 包含29,608个视频片段，总计约170小时。实验表明，该数据集在所有维度上均持续显著提升模型性能，使模型获得更优的视觉真实感、更强的唇同步一致性与更精确的节奏动态，有效弥合域差异。

Conclusion: Hi-Singers 为歌唱头合成任务设定了新的性能标准，有效弥合了语音与歌唱之间的域差异，数据集已公开于 HuggingFace。

Abstract: State-of-the-art models for audio-driven digital human generation have achieved photo-realistic results in talking-head synthesis. However, extending these models to singing-head synthesis remains challenging due to a significant Domain Gap: singing requires more exaggerated expressions, vivid jaw openings, and precise rhythmic synchronization. Current models, primarily trained on speech datasets, often struggle with "rhythmic drift" and constrained dynamics. To address this, we introduce Hi-Singers, the first large-scale, high-quality, in-the-wild video dataset specifically tailored for singing head synthesis. Hi-Singers undergoes a rigorous automated and manual filtering pipeline, ensuring strict thematic adherence, high-resolution rendering, and stable motion, resulting in 29,608 video segments totaling approximately 170 hours. We further establish a dedicated evaluation benchmark balanced across linguistic and musical styles. Extensive experiments across diverse architectures, including 3D-coefficient and diffusion-based models, demonstrate that Hi-Singers consistently and significantly improves performance across all dimensions. Specifically, it enables models to achieve superior visual realism, enhanced lip-sync consistency, and more precise rhythmic dynamics, effectively bridging the domain gap and setting a new performance standard for the singing synthesis task. The dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/CharlesZhang-USTC/Hi-Singers

</details>


### [719] [Visual Graph Reasoning via Knowledge Compilation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22327)
*Rongzheng Wang,Zhe Wang,Ke Qin,Rongwei Wang,Muquan Li,Yizhuo Ma,Yihong Huang,Jielei Wang,Shuang Liang*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 提出VGCompiler，一种以知识编译为核心的视觉图推理范式，通过表示编译器和操作编译器从图图像恢复保结构中间表示并生成可执行图操作，在三个基准上显著超越闭源VLM和代码基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视觉图推理方法直接在图上问答，偏重最终答案监督，忽视对保留图拓扑与状态的显式图表示的中间恢复，导致在简单视觉图问题上仍失败。这一根本局限促使作者转向以编译为中心的范式。

Method: VGCompiler基于知识编译，包含两个编译器：表示编译器从视觉输入恢复保结构的中间图表示；操作编译器在恢复的图状态下将查询意图编译为可执行图操作。模型建立在Qwen3-VL-8B上，采用强化学习训练，奖励分层覆盖可执行性、编译图有效性、表示质量和操作质量；并使用冻结观察器将图与问题条件总结为轻量签名，支持归档检索与相似情形下的代码复用。

Result: 在GVLQA、VisionGraph、VGCURE三个基准上，8B骨干的Qwen-VGCompiler分别超过最强闭源VLM基线28.9%、超过最强代码基线23.7%，同时保持高效率。在地铁路径规划、物流配送、网络故障评估三个真实领域中也验证了跨异构视觉图和领域任务的泛化能力。

Conclusion: 以显式中间图表示为中枢的编译式范式能有效弥补现有VLM在视觉图推理中的短板，兼具性能与效率，并可泛化到多样化真实场景。

Abstract: Visual graph reasoning requires answering graph-theoretic questions directly from graph images, where graph topology and state are conveyed visually rather than given in symbolic form. Despite recent progress of vision-language models (VLMs), current approaches to visual graph reasoning still fail on simple visual graph problems. This reveals a fundamental limitation of existing approaches: they prioritize final-answer supervision over the intermediate recovery of an explicit graph representation that preserves graph topology and state from visual input. To address this limitation, we propose VGCompiler, a compilation-centric paradigm for visual graph reasoning via knowledge compilation. VGCompiler organizes reasoning around two compilers: a representation compiler that recovers a structure-preserving intermediate graph representation from visual input, and an operation compiler that compiles query intent under the recovered graph state into an executable graph operation. Specifically, we build VGCompiler on Qwen3-VL-8B and train it with reinforcement learning guided by a layered reward over executability, compiled graph validity, representation quality, and operation quality. VGCompiler uses a frozen observer to summarize graph and question conditions into lightweight signatures, enabling archive retrieval and code reuse across similar regimes. Experiments on three benchmarks GVLQA, VisionGraph, and VGCURE, show that Qwen-VGCompiler, built on an 8B backbone, surpasses the strongest closed-source VLM baseline by 28.9% and the strongest code-based baseline by 23.7%, while maintaining high efficiency. We further evaluate VGCompiler on three real-world domains, including metro routing, logistics delivery, and network fault assessment, where it generalizes across heterogeneous visual graphs and domain-grounded tasks.

</details>


### [720] [If You Hear It, Help Find It: Orthogonal Knowledge Distillation for Open-Vocabulary Audio-Visual Event Localization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23376)
*Yi Xu,Cheng Chen,Wenzhuo Lei*

Main category: cs.MM

TL;DR: 本文提出OV-OrthKD，一个可靠性感知的非对称蒸馏框架，用于开放词汇音视频事件定位（OV-AVEL），通过监督放置策略让视觉教师塑造定位决策、音频教师提供辅助表征。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: OV-AVEL任务中不同监督来源的时间边界可靠性存在差异：在OV-AVEBench上，配置的视觉教师比音频教师提供更可靠的边界线索，尽管音频教师本身是强预训练模型且语义信息丰富。作者将这一挑战形式化为"监督放置"问题——哪些教师信号可以塑造定位决策，哪些应保持辅助地位。

Method: 提出OV-OrthKD非对称蒸馏框架：视觉特征迁移塑造决策对齐表征；音频特征迁移丰富互补的辅助子空间；文本原型锚定可见/不可见类别语义；正交损失限制两个教师特定投影之间的方向重叠。推理时学生网络仍通过查询感知融合使用双模态，但默认训练配方将音频教师监督保持在段logit路径之外。

Result: 在OV-AVEBench上，OV-OrthKD取得0.816的segment AP，相比官方微调基线，F1@0.5整体提升2.7个百分点，在未见类别上提升3.4个百分点。

Conclusion: 路径分配、角色互换、损坏和迁移分析一致支持"监督放置"作为OV-AVEL任务特定设计轴的有效性。

Abstract: Open-vocabulary audio-visual event localization (OV-AVEL) grounds a text-queried event in time from video, audio, and language. The supervision sources available to this task can differ in temporal-boundary reliability: on OV-AVEBench, our configured visual teacher gives more reliable boundary cues than the configured audio teacher, although the latter is a strong pretrained audio model and remains semantically informative. This is a setting-specific diagnostic rather than a universal ranking of vision and audio. We formulate the resulting challenge as supervision placement: which teacher signals may shape the localization decision, and which should remain auxiliary. Based on this view, we propose OV-OrthKD, a reliability-aware asymmetric distillation framework. Visual feature transfer shapes a decision-aligned representation, audio feature transfer enriches a complementary auxiliary subspace, a text prototype anchors seen/unseen category semantics, and an orthogonality loss limits directional overlap between the two teacher-specific projections. The student continues to use both modalities through query-aware fusion at inference, while the default training recipe keeps audio-teacher supervision off the segment-logit path. On OV-AVEBench, OV-OrthKD achieves 0.816 segment AP and improves F1@0.5 over the official fine-tuning baseline by 2.7 points overall and 3.4 points on unseen categories. Path-assignment, role-swap, corruption, and transfer analyses consistently support supervision placement as a task-specific design axis for OV-AVEL.

</details>


<div id='cs.LG'></div>

# cs.LG [[Back]](#toc)

### [721] [Generalized Multimodal Foundation Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22107)
*Huizi Cui,Zongbo Han,Chenggong Ding,Naichuan Xiao,Jialong Yang,Jingdong Chen,Guangyu Wang,Qinghua Hu,Changqing Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于大规模合成多模态数据集训练的通用多模态基础模型，可处理任意模态组合与任意预测任务，在18个真实数据集上无需任务特定适配即达到与专用模型相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有多模态融合模型部署后只能处理预定义模态（如视觉、文本、音频）和单一任务，难以快速适应新的下游应用。因此作者提出一个激进但自然的问题：是否存在能适用于任意模态组合和任意预测任务的通用多模态融合模型。作者认为统一的多模态融合模型不应依赖特定模态，而应编码可迁移的多模态相关性模式。

Method: 提出一种简单有效的学习范式：基于大规模合成多模态数据集的生成进行训练，这些数据集具有多样化的因果结构，形式化刻画了真实世界多模态数据的生成过程。在此框架上提出通用多模态基础模型（generalized multimodal foundation model）。通过构建具有多样相关模式的大规模合成多模态数据集，模型在训练中编码可迁移的多模态相关性，并在推理时通过上下文示例激活适当的关联。

Result: 在涵盖12种模态和11种预测任务的18个真实世界数据集上进行大量实验，结果表明该模型无需任务特定适配即可达到与专用模型相当（competitive）的性能。

Conclusion: 通过合成数据驱动的可迁移多模态相关性编码与上下文激活机制，构建了一个不依赖特定模态的统一多模态基础模型，验证了通用多模态融合模型在任意模态组合与任意任务上的可行性。

Abstract: Making prediction with multimodal data is widely used in diverse scenarios. Existing multimodal fusion models, once deployed, can only handle predefined modalities (e.g., vision, text and audio) and single tasks, making it difficult to quickly adapt to new downstream applications. Therefore, a natural yet rather aggressive question arises, whether there exists a general multimodal fusion model that can be applied to arbitrary modality combinations and arbitrary prediction tasks. We argue that a unified multimodal fusion model should not depend on specific modalities and instead encode transferable patterns of multimodal correlation. To this end, we propose a simple and effective learning paradigm based on training over the generation of large-scale synthetic multimodal datasets with diverse causal structures that formally characterize the generative processes of multimodal data in real world. Building on this framework, we propose the generalized multimodal foundation model, a unified foundation model for generalized multimodal learning. By constructing large-scale synthetic multimodal datasets with diverse correlation patterns, our model encodes transferable multimodal correlations during training and activates appropriate associations through in-context examples during inference. Extensive experiments on 18 real-world datasets spanning 12 modalities and 11 prediction tasks demonstrate that our model achieves competitive performance with specialized models without task-specific adaptation.

</details>


### [722] [Success Leaves Detours: Learning Executable Walkthroughs for Long-Horizon Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22120)
*Kaijie Chen,Chenyu Fang,Liang Yan,Bo Li,Bo Zhang,Peng Ye*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Trace框架，从稀疏奖励轨迹中归纳出可执行的Walkthrough记忆，通过信用引导与依赖溯源编译噪声轨迹，在三个任务上平均AUC与Final-3显著超越八个基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 测试时自进化智能体依赖复用历史经验，但稀疏奖励轨迹中充满失败、循环与绕路，且现有摘要往往丢失执行所需的状态条件与动作依赖信息，难以直接复用。

Method: 研究可执行Walkthrough归纳任务：从稀疏奖励轨迹中抽取紧凑、状态条件化、可验证的过程。关键观察是延迟信用只能定位与进展相关的动作，无法判定其是否产生后续动作所需事实。据此提出Trace：由奖励与持续状态变化检测进度锚点，传播信用识别高价值转移，基于跨回合成功/失败证据估计动作前置条件，再通过反向依赖切片将所需事实回溯至其产生者，提取依赖一致的动作链并剔除无关循环与绕路，最终形成含入口条件、有序状态-动作-效果步骤及完成/失败谓词的Walkthrough。

Result: 在J-TTL、WebShop、ScienceWorld上使用三种开源LLM，Trace一致优于八种测试时学习与记忆基线；相较最强基线，平均AUC提升30.0%、Final-3提升40.5%，且推理token更少。

Conclusion: 长时程交互中，状态条件化的可执行过程比完整轨迹或抽象摘要更具复用价值，验证了依赖溯源式Walkthrough归纳的有效性。

Abstract: Test-time self-evolving agents improve by reusing past experience, yet sparse-reward trajectories contain failures, loops, and detours, while summaries often omit the state conditions and action dependencies needed for execution. We study executable Walkthrough induction from sparse-reward trajectories: extracting compact, state-conditioned, and verifiable procedures. Our key observation is that delayed credit identifies actions associated with progress but cannot determine whether they produce facts required by later actions. We propose Trace, a credit-guided, dependency-grounded framework that compiles noisy trajectories into executable Walkthrough Memory. It detects progress anchors from rewards and persistent state changes, propagates credit to identify valuable transitions, and estimates action prerequisites from cross-episode success and failure evidence. Backward dependency slicing then traces required facts to their producers, extracting dependency-consistent action chains while removing irrelevant loops and detours. The resulting Walkthroughs encode entry conditions, ordered state--action--effect steps, and completion and failure predicates, supporting reuse, intermediate-state resumption, and programmatic verification. Experiments on J-TTL, WebShop, and ScienceWorld with three open-source LLMs show that Trace consistently outperforms eight test-time learning and memory baselines. Compared with the strongest baseline, it improves average AUC and Final-$3$ by $30.0%$ and $40.5%$, respectively, while using fewer inference tokens. These results show that long-horizon interaction benefits more from state-conditioned executable procedures than from complete trajectories or abstract summaries.

</details>


### [723] [Weak Ties, Strong Signals: Efficient Training Data Detection in Diffusion LLMs via Independent Token Sampling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22145)
*Hongyao Yu,Tianqu Zhuang,Ziyuan Xu,Hao Fang,Jiaxin Hong,Bin Chen,Shu-Tao Xia*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文针对扩散大语言模型（dLLM）成员推断检测中，随机掩码带来的 token 间依赖问题，提出基于累积条件互信息（CMI）的理论刻画，并设计查询高效的独立 token 采样框架 ITS，在多个数据集与模型上显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散大语言模型（dLLMs）在去噪过程中可能泄露敏感训练数据，但因其缺乏因果架构的单次概率分解能力，检测此类数据使用十分困难。现有方法依赖随机掩码在有限查询预算下获取可计算的 token 级检测信号，却无法控制被掩码 token 之间的依赖关系，导致检测效果受限。

Method: 作者首先证明 token 级近似会引入非负的结构性估计误差，并用被掩码 token 间的累积条件互信息（CMI）对该误差进行理论刻画，指出可靠检测需要内部依赖较弱的掩码 token 集合。为避免直接估计 token 组合上 CMI 的高昂成本，提出独立 token 采样框架 ITS：利用注意力导出的成对依赖代理来近似 CMI 感知的选择准则，并引入多样性促进策略以提升多轮采样中的 token 覆盖率，从而聚合出受依赖误差影响更小的 token 级信号。

Result: 在多个数据集上的实验表明，ITS 在不同模型与数据集下持续优于当前最优基线；在 ArXiv 数据集上 AUC 提升达 0.18，并在有限查询预算下仍保持较强性能。

Conclusion: 该工作从理论上揭示了随机掩码 token 依赖对 dLLM 成员推断的干扰机制，并提出查询高效的 ITS 框架，通过弱化掩码 token 间依赖与增强采样多样性，有效提升检测可靠性与查询效率，代码已开源。

Abstract: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) offer a compelling alternative to autoregressive models, yet they may expose sensitive training data during denoising. Detecting such usage is challenging because dLLMs lack the efficient one-pass probability decomposition of causal architectures. Existing methods rely on random masking to obtain tractable token-wise detection signals under limited query budgets, but fail to control dependencies among masked tokens. We demonstrate that this token-wise approximation introduces a non-negative structural estimation error, which is theoretically characterized by the cumulative conditional mutual information (CMI) among masked tokens and can obscure subtle memorization signals. This insight suggests that reliable detection requires masked token sets with weak internal dependency. To avoid the prohibitive cost of directly estimating CMI over token combinations, we propose \textit{Independent Token Sampling} (ITS), a query-efficient framework that uses an attention-derived pairwise dependency proxy to approximate the CMI-aware selection criterion. ITS further incorporates a diversity-promoting strategy to improve token coverage across sampling rounds, yielding aggregated token-wise signals that are less affected by dependency-induced approximation error. Experiments on multiple datasets show that ITS consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across different models and datasets, achieving an AUC improvement of 0.18 on the ArXiv dataset while maintaining strong performance under limited query budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/Chrisqcwx/DLLM-MIA .

</details>


### [724] [GRRR: The Geometry of Reshaping, Rotation, and Routing in Decoder LLM post-training](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22146)
*Jianing Qi,Hao Tang,Zhigang Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究后训练（SFT与RL）如何相对于预训练权重改变LLM权重。通过在预训练矩阵的SVD框架下分解权重更新，发现后训练收益主要来自重构和扩展预训练路径，而非改变预训练模型的奇异值。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 理解后训练（微调与强化学习）究竟在多大程度上、以何种几何方式改变大语言模型的预训练权重，对于揭示后训练的作用机制至关重要。

Method: 在12条包含监督微调（SFT）和强化学习（RL）的后训练链上，将每次权重更新表示在预训练矩阵的奇异值分解（SVD）框架中，从而分离出三种几何性质不同的成分：对角成分（重塑奇异值）、非对角成分（旋转预训练输入与输出方向间的耦合）以及零空间成分（在原非零SVD核心之外进行路由）。随后在数学评测集上分别考察各成分的贡献。

Result: 在数学评测集上，移除对角成分通常仍能保留后训练所带来的大部分性能提升。

Conclusion: 后训练收益主要由对预训练路径的重构与扩展所承载，而非显著改变预训练模型的奇异值。

Abstract: We study how post-training changes the weights of Large Language Models (LLMs) relative to their pretrained weights. Across 12 post-training chains with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL), we express each weight update in the pretrained matrix's singular value decomposition (SVD) frame. This decomposition separates the changes of three geometrically distinct components: diagonal values, which reshapes singular values; off-diagonal values, which rotates the coupling between pretrained input and output directions; and null-space values, which routes outside the matrix's original nonzero SVD core. On a math evaluation suite, we find that removing the diagonal component usually preserves most of the gains from post-training. These results suggest that post-training gains are carried primarily by reconfiguring and extending pretrained pathways rather than by substantially changing singular values of pre-trained models.

</details>


### [725] [PAGE: Partition-Aware Gated KV-Cache Eviction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22157)
*Pankaj Kumar,Subhankar Mishra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将KV-cache驱逐重构为逐输入的"准入决策"，提出无标签标量（prefill注意力中成对top-k注意力头一致性的早晚期下降幅度）来预判输入类别，并据此设计PAGE门控：下降大时启用驱逐器，否则保留全缓存。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有KV-cache驱逐方法只决定保留哪些token，而不决定是否应当驱逐；因此基准均值会掩盖一类输入——在这些输入上压缩会把准确率从99%拉到0%（灾难性崩溃），这类问题被平均指标所隐藏。

Method: 把驱逐改写为逐输入的准入问题，将输入划分为"容量受限类"（任何预算下驱逐都灾难性）与"稀释易感类"（驱逐安全甚至有益）。用一个由prefill注意力计算的无标签标量——成对top-k注意力头一致性的早晚期下降幅度——在解码前预测类别。PAGE对该下降量设阈值：下降大时应用任一基础驱逐器，否则保留完整缓存，无需训练与准确率标签。跨四种架构族验证该标量的排序一致性，并用约100条无标签输入的per-model试运行对新家族重校准阈值。

Result: 作为安全护栏，PAGE在容量受限区间将危害率从0.75降至0.026（29倍降低），跨4种驱逐器、4个模型与2个基准，把99%→0%的崩塌转为稳定的89%，且无需重新训练驱逐器。门控在驱逐本已安全的场景下不起作用。实际压缩率为1.8–3.4×（均值2.9×），远低于标称16×预算，在静态分配下batch 16时趋近1×；在匹配内存下训练式驱逐器更优。

Conclusion: PAGE是逐输入安全护栏而非压缩器：它保护的是少数可识别的容量受限输入，带来的是针对性安全提升而非平均性能提升。

Abstract: KV-cache eviction methods decide which tokens to keep but not whether to evict at all, so a benchmark mean can hide a class of inputs on which compression drives accuracy from 99\% to 0\%. We reframe eviction as a per-input admission decision and show that inputs separate into a capacity-bound class, where eviction is catastrophic at every budget, and a dilution-prone class, where eviction is safe or beneficial. A single label-free scalar computed from prefill attention, the early-to-late drop in pairwise top-$k$ head agreement, predicts this class before any decoding. PAGE thresholds this drop: it applies any base evictor when the drop is large and retains the full cache otherwise, with no training and no accuracy labels. The drop orders inputs by eviction safety consistently across four architecture families, and a per-model unlabeled pilot of about 100 inputs recalibrates the threshold for a new family. Used as a safeguard, PAGE cuts the harm rate on the capacity-bound regime from 0.75 to 0.026, a 29 $\times$ reduction, across four evictors, four models, and two benchmarks, turning a 99\% to 0\% collapse into a flat 89\% without retraining the evictor. The gate is inert wherever eviction is already safe, and the capacity-bound class it protects is a small, identifiable minority of inputs, so the benefit is a targeted safety gain rather than an average one. PAGE is a per-input safeguard, not a compressor: realized compression is $1.8 - 3.4 \times$ (mean 2.9$\times$) against a nominal 16$\times$ budget and decays toward unity by batch 16 under static provisioning, and a trained evictor wins at matched memory.

</details>


### [726] [Multiple latent orderings better predict language model preferences](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22170)
*Aviral Chawla,William H. W. Thompson,Jean-Gabriel Young*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出LLM偏好中的非传递性并非采样噪声，而是多个内部一致的潜在偏好排序的聚合，并用混合Bradley-Terry模型验证了这一观点。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有建模LLM偏好的工作将非传递性（如A>B、B>C但C>A）视为围绕单一潜在排序的采样噪声。作者认为这种解释不足，因为观察到的偏好不一致无法用任何单调链接函数下的单一排序来解释，因此需要新的建模视角来捕捉偏好的异质性。

Method: 作者首先证明观察到的结构不一致无法由任何单调链接函数下的单一排序解释；随后提出一种噪声增强的混合Bradley-Terry（MBT）模型，从重复的成对比较中推断出多个潜在的、内部一致的偏好排序分量。

Result: 在七个模型和四个任务上，偏好排序的混合模型比单一效用模型更好地解释结构不一致。聚合偏好往往掩盖了潜在的偏好异质性；在Moral Machine困境的案例研究中，聚合排序上存在分歧的模型仍可能共享潜在的偏好分量。

Conclusion: LLM反映的是多元偏好而非单一偏好函数。因此，将LLM偏好视为单一函数的对齐与评估流程存在风险——它们可能在多个内在一致的排序上进行平均，而这些排序在不同用户之间可能获得不同支持。将面向多元偏好进行建模与评估是重要的改进方向。

Abstract: Language models are frequently employed in settings where they are asked to make value judgments and choices. These observed choices often exhibit intransitivity: A model may prefer item $A$ to $B$ and $B$ to $C$, while also preferring $C$ to $A$. Existing work that models LLM preferences treats such inconsistencies as sampling noise around a single latent ordering. We instead propose that intransitivity reflects the aggregation of multiple latent, internally consistent orderings. We first show that observed inconsistencies cannot be explained by a single ordering under any monotone link function. We then introduce a noise-augmented mixture Bradley-Terry (MBT) model that infers latent preference components from repeated pairwise comparisons. Across seven models and four tasks, a mixture of orderings often explains structural inconsistencies better than single-utility models. We find that aggregate preferences often hide underlying preference heterogeneity. A case study on Moral Machine dilemmas shows that models which disagree on aggregate orderings can still share latent components. Together, these results suggest that LLMs reflect plural preferences. Alignment and evaluation pipelines that treat LLM preferences as a single function, therefore, risk averaging over coherent orderings that different users may endorse differently.

</details>


### [727] [Beyond Task Completion: Training Capable and Safe Computer-Use Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22178)
*Zeyu Kang,Zhenyun Yin,Yang Zhang,Shan He,Shanzhe Lei,Yanjiu Zhong,Xinquan Chen,Yuhong Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出SCOPE方法，通过联合后训练让计算机使用智能体（CUA）同时具备任务执行能力与安全感知决策能力，并配套SCOPE-Gen自动数据生成流程与SATraj-OS轨迹数据集，在OSWorld与OS-BLIND上取得最佳综合能力—安全得分58.80%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有以任务成功率为唯一目标的后训练无法诱导出可靠的安全行为；可靠的CUA应依据风险条件化执行：完成普通良性任务、规避环境危害并在存在安全路径时继续、在目标有害或无安全路径时拒绝。因此需要一种能同时学习能力与安全的条件策略。

Method: 提出SCOPE，联合后训练任务执行能力与安全感知决策。配套SCOPE-Gen自动化流程，合成可验证的能力任务并转换为保留原始目标的成对环境风险变体；据此构建SATraj-OS轨迹数据集，包含能力演示、安全继续与显式拒绝三类轨迹。SCOPE先对三类轨迹进行监督微调，再通过在线强化学习进一步提升任务完成度。基座模型为Qwen3.5-9B。

Result: SCOPE-RL在OSWorld上任务成功率达54.17%，在OS-BLIND上攻击规避率达64.30%，综合能力—安全得分58.80%，为所评估智能体中最优。消融实验显示两类安全监督作用不对称但互补：拒绝轨迹贡献了大部分攻击规避增益，而风险处理轨迹在相当攻击规避水平下保留了更高的任务效用。

Conclusion: 以任务成功为单一目标的后训练不足以产生可靠安全行为；能力与安全的联合后训练（SFT+在线RL）能有效塑造条件化安全策略，且拒绝监督与风险处理监督需配合使用以兼顾安全与效用。

Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) have made rapid progress in completing complex tasks through graphical user interfaces, yet post-training centered on task success alone does not induce reliable safety behavior. A reliable CUA must condition its execution on risk: it should complete ordinary benign tasks, avoid environmental hazards and continue when a safe completion path remains, and refuse when the goal is harmful or no safe path exists. To learn this conditional policy, we develop Safety and Capability Optimization for Policy Execution (SCOPE), which jointly post-trains a CUA for task-execution capability and safety-aware decision making. To provide aligned training data for this joint objective, we further introduce SCOPE-Gen, an automated pipeline that synthesizes verifiable capability tasks and converts them into paired environment-risk variants while preserving their original goals. Using the resulting tasks, we construct SATraj-OS, a trajectory dataset comprising capability demonstrations, safe continuations, and explicit refusals. SCOPE first learns from all three trajectory types through supervised fine-tuning and then further improves task completion through online reinforcement learning. Starting from Qwen3.5-9B, SCOPE-RL achieves a 54.17% task success rate on OSWorld and a 64.30% attack-avoidance rate on OS-BLIND, yielding the best aggregate capability--safety score of 58.80% among the evaluated agents. Ablations reveal asymmetric but complementary roles for the two forms of safety supervision: refusal trajectories account for most of the attack-avoidance gain, whereas risk-handling trajectories preserve greater task utility at comparable attack-avoidance levels.

</details>


### [728] [EvoRank: LLM-Guided Evolution of Multi-Objective Learning-to-Rank Pipelines](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22196)
*Rayhan Patel,Shabaz Patel*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: EvoRank：以LLM引导的进化循环自动发现完整LTR流水线（特征、模型、损失、集成），在多目标电商搜索上50次迭代（约10美元）内即超过经Optuna调参的LambdaMART，进入原始竞赛前6%；同时提出“headroom gate”，用搜索空间裕度相对适应度噪声之比，在花费前预测进化搜索是否值得。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多目标电商排序需人工设计特征、模型、损失与集成，成本高且依赖专家经验；LLM能否自动完成全流水线设计、其增益是否真实可信，尚缺系统验证。

Method: 构建EvoRank自主排序工程系统：LLM引导的进化循环，联合搜索特征、模型、损失与集成。在Expedia ICDM 2013数据上以相关性、转化、营收为目标，做三次独立运行；先做仅进化训练目标的campaign，再对获胜者做transfer audit（在留出数据上重评分），并检验领域知识种子与诊断反馈的作用；最后提炼headroom gate指标。

Result: 三次运行均在50次迭代内收敛（约10美元），在6万留出query上优于Optuna调参的LambdaMART，并在全量数据下保持优势、进入原竞赛前6%。首轮campaign中，选择折上的改进经transfer audit后证实几乎全部来自适应度噪声；领域知识种子与更丰富诊断反馈均未改变迁移效果。

Conclusion: 决定成败的可测量量为搜索空间裕度与适应度噪声之比，据此提出headroom gate，可在LLM花费前预测收益，并开源系统、审计工具及失败模式与护栏目录，供团队迁移到自身排序栈。

Abstract: We present EvoRank, an open autonomous ranking engineer: an LLM-guided evolutionary loop that discovers complete Learning-to-Rank pipelines (features, models, losses, ensembles) for multi-objective e-commerce search. On the Expedia ICDM 2013 dataset, with relevance, conversion, and revenue as competing objectives, three independent runs each converge within 50 iterations (about ten dollars) on interpretable pipelines that beat an Optuna-tuned LambdaMART on 60k held-out queries, an advantage that persists at full data scale and places in the top 6 percent of the original competition. A first campaign, evolving only training objectives, builds the central design rule: it appeared to work on its selection fold (the small dataset it uses to pick winners) while a transfer audit, re-scoring winners on held-out data, showed the gains were almost entirely fitness noise (the randomness of its own scoring), and neither seeded domain knowledge nor richer diagnostic feedback changed what transferred. The deciding quantity is measurable in advance: search-space headroom relative to fitness noise. We package this as a headroom gate that predicts, before any LLM spend, whether the loop will pay off, and we release the system, the auditing tools, and a catalog of failure modes with their guardrails, so teams can apply the procedure to their own ranking stacks.

</details>


### [729] [The Effect of Quantization on Clinical Benchmarks: Accuracy and Safety Across Model Families](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22216)
*Leonard Twagirayezu,Prasenjit Mitra*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究系统评估了5个7-8B模型在FP16、GPTQ-INT8、GPTQ-INT4下的临床准确性与安全性，发现INT8普遍安全，INT4退化显著且依赖模型与任务，精度鲁棒性与安全鲁棒性相互独立，恢复策略需按任务验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 量化可使大模型部署于资源受限的临床边缘设备，但其对临床准确性与安全性的影响尚缺乏系统研究，尤其缺少跨比特宽度、模型族与任务类型的联合评估及风险分层与安全度量。

Method: 在FP16、GPTQ-INT8、GPTQ-INT4三种精度下评估5个7-8B模型，覆盖MedQA、MedMCQA、Med-HALT、HealthBench风险分层样本与MedSafetyBench五个基准；联合变化量化位宽、模型族与临床任务类型，并进行显式风险分层与安全度量；另测试临床校准替换与QLoRA微调两种恢复方法。

Result: INT8 GPTQ普遍安全（最大退化-1.9%~1.9%）；INT4退化显著且依赖模型：临床微调的BioMistral-7B在MedMCQA上损失19.7%，超过通用模型，表明临床微调未带来压缩鲁棒性；MedMCQA退化大于MedQA，Med-HALT基本不受影响；HealthBench急诊风险子组中Qwen2.5-7B在INT4下降26.8%，提示高风险场景更易受损；MedSafetyBench上模型族影响大于精度（FP16拒绝率10.2%~74.9%），但Qwen2.5-7B（-17.8%）与Meditron-7B（-28.3%）INT4安全退化明显，且Qwen2.5-7B同时是精度最鲁棒模型，说明精度与安全鲁棒性相互独立；两种恢复方法均呈相同权衡：MedMCQA恢复而MedQA进一步退化。

Conclusion: INT8可广泛安全用于临床部署；INT4安全性须逐模型、逐任务评估；安全对齐主要由指令微调而非临床领域适配决定；恢复策略需任务特定验证，不可默认普遍有益。

Abstract: Quantization enables deployment of large language models on resource-constrained clinical edge devices, but its effect on clinical accuracy and safety remains understudied. We evaluate five 7-8B parameter models at FP16, GPTQ-INT8, and GPTQ-INT4 precision across five benchmarks: MedQA, MedMCQA, Med-HALT, a risk-stratified sample of HealthBench, and MedSafetyBench. The study jointly varies quantization bit width, model family, and clinical task type, with explicit risk stratification and safety measures. INT8 GPTQ is universally safe (max. degradation -1.9%-1.9%), while INT4 degradation is substantial and model-dependent: BioMistral-7B, clinically fine-tuned, loses 19.7% on MedMCQA, more than any general-purpose model, showing clinical fine-tuning does not confer compression robustness. MedMCQA degrades more than MedQA under INT4; Med-HALT is largely unaffected. On HealthBench's emergency-risk subgroup, Qwen2.5-7B degrades by 26.8% under INT4, suggesting high-risk scenarios are disproportionately vulnerable to compression. On MedSafetyBench, the model family dominates over precision (refusal rates range 10.2%-74.9% at FP16), though Qwen2.5-7B (-17.8%) and Meditron-7B (-28.3%) show substantial INT4 safety degradation; notably, Qwen2.5-7B is simultaneously the most accuracy-robust model, demonstrating that accuracy and safety robustness are independent properties. We additionally test two recovery methods, clinical calibration substitution and QLoRA fine-tuning, both producing the same trade-off: MedMCQA recovers while MedQA further degrades, indicating recovery strategies require task-specific validation rather than being assumed universally beneficial. These findings indicate INT8 is broadly safe for clinical deployment, while INT4 safety must be assessed per-model and per-task, and that safety alignment is determined primarily by instruction tuning rather than clinical domain adaptation.

</details>


### [730] [Toollery: Scaling LLM Agents to Thousands of Skills and Tools](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22218)
*Xiangxi Tian,Ran Guan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Toollery 是一个免训练的候选压缩框架，通过"文档侧查询扩展"为每个技能/工具生成用户意图查询并构建检索索引，将在线选择限定在紧凑的 top-k 候选集内，从而在超大规模能力库（约 79K）与工具注册表场景下实现可扩展的 LLM 技能/工具选择。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当 LLM agent 面对数百至数万个技能、工具和 API 函数时，全库提示（full-library prompting）代价高、速度慢且可靠性下降：每新增一个候选都会增加 prompt token 与延迟，过长的候选列表还会引入更多干扰项，降低 LLM 的选择准确率。因此需要一个能在大规模、持续演化的能力库上压缩候选集合的方案。

Method: Toollery 采用免训练（training-free）的候选压缩框架，借鉴文档侧查询扩展（document-side query expansion）：从每个技能/工具规格说明生成用户意图查询，并据此构建检索索引，使真实用户请求在进入 LLM 最终决策前先被映射到紧凑的候选集合。该方法把高层技能与原子工具统一视为可选能力，因而同时适用于技能库与工具注册表。

Result: 在约 79K 能力的 SkillRouter 基准、包含 440 多个原子工具的 BFCL-V4，以及覆盖 220 多个工具的 3,396 条专有智能座舱请求上评测：Toollery 将在线选择稳定限制在紧凑的 top-k 候选集，并在召回率上优于普通的规格检索；在固定 top-10 预算下，Toollery 提升了智能座舱数据集的端到端选择效果，并在 BFCL-V4 上保持可比的 AST Accuracy。

Conclusion: 结果表明 Toollery 是面向大规模且不断演化的 agent 能力库的实用候选压缩框架；同时表明其质量与成本收益依赖于工作负载覆盖度以及服务商缓存（provider caching）。

Abstract: As LLM agents are exposed to hundreds to tens of thousands of skills, tools, and API functions, full-library prompting becomes costly, slow, and less reliable: each added candidate increases prompt tokens and latency, while longer candidate lists introduce more distractors for LLM selection. We present \textbf{Toollery}, a training-free candidate-compression framework for scalable LLM skill/tool selection. Following established document-side query expansion, Toollery generates user-intent queries from each skill/tool specification and builds a retrieval index that maps real user requests to compact candidate sets before final LLM decision-making. By treating high-level skills and atomic tools as selectable capabilities, Toollery can be applied to both skill libraries and tool registries. We evaluate Toollery on the roughly 79K-capability SkillRouter benchmark, BFCL-V4 with over 440 atomic tools, and 3,396 proprietary smart-cockpit requests over 220 tools. Across these settings, Toollery keeps online selection bounded to a compact top-$k$ candidate set and improves recall over ordinary specification retrieval. At a fixed top-10 budget, Toollery improves end-to-end selection on the cockpit dataset, and maintains comparable AST Accuracy on BFCL-V4. These results support Toollery as a practical candidate-compression framework for large and evolving agent capability libraries, while showing that quality and cost gains depend on workload coverage and provider caching.

</details>


### [731] [Can Coding Agents Reproduce Official Statistics? Metadata, Retry Budget and the Limits of Execution Feedback in a Controlled Eurostat Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22222)
*Sabina-Cristiana Necula*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究通过30个Eurostat自然语言任务、四组实验条件（任务、任务+元数据卡、元数据+修复循环、元数据+等预算无诊断）与360次任务运行，检验权威元数据与执行反馈对编码智能体答案可复现性的作用。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大语言模型能生成可执行的数据分析代码，但可执行并不等于产出有效的官方统计结果，因此需探究权威元数据与执行反馈能否提升Eurostat答案的可复现性，并厘清执行反馈的真实贡献。

Method: 构建含7个领域、7个Eurostat数据集、4个难度层级的30个自然语言任务基准；设置四种条件：A仅任务、B任务+冻结数据集元数据卡、C元数据+基于净化执行反馈的修复循环、D元数据+同等尝试预算但无任何诊断；由Claude Sonnet 5经Anthropic Messages API生成Python，独立重复三次，共360次任务运行；精确正确性要求执行成功且数据集、过滤、输出形状、数值与单位均正确；另设输出契约不完整的对照实验。

Result: 在输出契约未明确说明排序键与单位表示的对照实验下，条件C的表现被低估23.4个百分点，表明评估者与契约设计可能主导所测得的智能体误差。

Conclusion: 可靠的统计编码智能体需要针对冻结规范的语义校验、完整指定的输出契约以及重试预算，而非执行诊断。

Abstract: Large language models can generate executable data-analysis code, but successful execution is not equivalent to a valid official-statistics result. This study asks whether authoritative metadata and execution feedback improve the reproducibility of Eurostat answers produced by a coding agent, and isolates what execution feedback actually contributes. A benchmark of 30 natural-language tasks covering seven domains, seven Eurostat datasets and four difficulty tiers was run under four conditions: task only (A), task plus a frozen dataset metadata card (B), metadata plus a repair loop driven by sanitized execution feedback (C), and metadata plus the same attempt budget with no diagnostics of any kind (D). Claude Sonnet 5 generated Python through the Anthropic Messages API in three independent replicates, yielding 360 task-runs. Exact correctness required successful execution, the correct dataset, filters, output shape, values and unit. A companion experiment run under an under-specified output contract, in which the required ranking key and unit representation were never stated to the model, understated condition C by 23.4 points, showing that evaluator and contract design can dominate measured agent error. Reliable statistical coding agents need semantic validation against frozen specifications, a fully specified output contract, and a retry budget - not execution diagnostics.

</details>


### [732] [CAMFT: Conflict-Aware Mergeable Fine-Tuning for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22253)
*Jingang Zhou,Haiyang Guo,Yuan Ma,Han Zhu,Xu-Yao Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出冲突感知可合并微调方法CAMFT，将可合并性视为微调阶段形成的属性，引导任务更新稀疏且低冲突的坐标，从而在多任务合并中超越标准微调基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型合并方法主要对独立微调后的模型做事后处理，忽略了训练阶段对跨任务兼容性的影响。微调后再解决参数冲突本质上次优，因此需要在训练阶段即考虑可合并性。

Method: CAMFT将可合并性视为微调过程中塑造的属性，而非仅事后解决的问题。它引导每个任务更新具有较低跨任务冲突的稀疏坐标，从而产生训练高效且对下游合并更兼容的任务更新。

Result: 大量实验表明，在多任务合并场景下，CAMFT优于标准微调基线。

Conclusion: 可合并性应在训练阶段被主动塑造；CAMFT通过冲突感知的稀疏更新实现高效训练与良好合并兼容性，代码已开源。

Abstract: Model merging has emerged as a promising paradigm for integrating multiple task-specific capabilities into a single large language model. However, existing methods predominantly focus on post-hoc processing of independently fine-tuned models, overlooking how the training phase itself impacts cross-task compatibility. Resolving parameter conflicts after fine-tuning is inherently sub-optimal. To address this, we propose CAMFT, a Conflict-Aware Mergeable Fine-Tuning method that makes task adaptation both efficient and mergeaware. CAMFT treats mergeability as a property shaped during fine-tuning, rather than only a problem to be solved after fine-tuning. By guiding each task to update sparse coordinates with lower cross-task conflict, CAMFT produces task updates that are efficient to train and more compatible for downstream model merging. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CAMFT outperforms standard finetuning baselines in multi-task merging scenarios. Codes are available at https://github.com/gyanchow/CAMFT-LLM.

</details>


### [733] [Strategy Accumulation and Guided Execution for Automated LLM Fine-Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22257)
*Haoran Zhao,Wei Du,Dingwen Yang,Jixuan Huang,Junlin Shang,Lingyong Fang,Ya Guo,Tao Gui,Qi Zhang,Xuanjing Huang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出SAGE两阶段框架，使自动微调搜索具备累积性：第一阶段用多智能体+MCTS探索并蒸馏出经验仓库，第二阶段检索经验指导新任务微调，在9个未见任务上将相对提升从3.2%提高到15.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有自动微调系统是无状态的，每次搜索结束后会丢弃已发现的训练策略、数据集洞见与超参数结论，导致新任务必须从冷启动重复昂贵的搜索过程。作者希望让自动微调搜索能够跨任务累积经验。

Method: SAGE为两阶段框架。第一阶段：多智能体流水线执行基于蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）的探索，并行的蒸馏智能体（Distillation Agent）抽取任务特定的探索记录与带置信度评分的跨任务洞见，共同构成结构化经验仓库。第二阶段：从该仓库检索相关经验，筛选适用部分来指导新任务的训练。

Result: 在涵盖单类目与跨类目设置的9个未见任务上评估。单轮执行中，SAGE累积的经验将相对基线的平均相对改进从3.2%提升至15.6%，相比不含经验累积的同一流水线提高12.4个百分点。

Conclusion: 持续性的策略经验能为未见任务上的自动微调提供有效指导，验证了让自动微调搜索具备累积性与可复用性的价值。

Abstract: Producing task-specific large language models requires discovering effective training strategies through experimentation. Automated fine-tuning systems have made this experimentation feasible with far less manual effort. However, these systems are stateless: each search discards its discovered strategies, dataset insights, and hyperparameter findings once it ends. Every new task must then repeat this costly search from a cold start. To address this, we propose Strategy Accumulation and Guided Execution (SAGE), a two-stage framework that makes automated fine-tuning search cumulative. In the first stage, a multi-agent pipeline performs Monte Carlo Tree Search-based exploration. A parallel Distillation Agent extracts task-specific exploration records and confidence-scored cross-task insights, which together constitute a structured experience repository. In the second stage, SAGE retrieves relevant experience from this repository and selects what applies to guide training on the new task. We evaluate SAGE on nine unseen tasks spanning both single- and cross-category settings. In single-round execution, SAGE's accumulated experience raises the average relative improvement over baseline from 3.2% to 15.6%, a 12.4-percentage-point gain over the same pipeline without it. These results show that persistent strategy experience provides effective guidance for automated fine-tuning on unseen tasks.

</details>


### [734] [Efficient Mixture-of-Experts with Speculative Decoding via Expert Coactivation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22471)
*Kumari Nishu,Han-Byul Kim,Santosh Chilkunda,Maxwell Horton,Arnav Kundu,Mohammad Samragh,Lauren Hannah,Mohammad Sekhavat,Nikhil Bhendawade,Manuel Ciosici,Iman Mirzadeh,Keivan Alizadeh Vahid,David Harrison,Irina Belousova,Mehrdad Farajtabar,Minsik Cho*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究MoE路由设计对专家共激活程度的影响，发现结合全局负载均衡损失、共享专家、一致性损失和自回归专家选择机制可显著提升专家共激活，从而将MoE+投机解码的吞吐量提升21%，同时保持精度不降。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型常与投机解码结合以加速推理，但二者结合存在困难：投机解码通过并行验证多组token提速，而MoE在验证token数增加时会有更多专家需要从DRAM传输到NPU，内存传输开销上升，而内存传输通常是推理瓶颈，因此验证token越多反而越慢。作者希望探究训练阶段的路由器设计如何影响MoE+投机解码的运行速度。

Method: 作者首先分析发现高专家共激活程度的路由器能显著加快运行时间，缓解多验证token带来的负面影响。随后在十亿参数级Transformer模型上评估多种路由器设计选择对专家共激活和运行时间的影响，系统比较不同设计组合的效果。

Result: 实验表明，在训练中同时采用全局负载均衡损失、共享专家、一致性损失以及自回归专家选择机制时，专家共激活程度显著增强。专家共激活的提升转化为更高的整体运行吞吐量：所探索出的模型相比MoE基线吞吐量提升21%，同时精度与基线MoE相当。

Conclusion: MoE路由器设计（尤其是影响专家共激活的设计选择）对MoE结合投机解码的推理效率至关重要。合理组合全局负载均衡损失、共享专家、一致性损失和自回归专家选择机制，可在不损失精度的前提下大幅提升吞吐量，为高效MoE推理提供了一条有效路径。

Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models are increasingly deployed alongside Speculative Decoding (SD) to accelerate inference, but combining the two is challenging. SD improves the inference speed of dense models by verifying groups of tokens in parallel. However, the inference speedup for SD with MoEs depends heavily on the number of tokens being verified. Using more verification tokens results in more experts being transferred from DRAM to the Neural Processing Unit (NPU), which increases the memory transfer cost. This negatively impacts model runtime, as memory transfer is typically the bottleneck in inference. In this work, we investigate the impact of MoE router design during training on the speed of MoEs with SD. We find that routers with high degrees of expert coactivation result in much faster runtimes, mitigating the impact of using more verification tokens. Motivated by this observation, we assess the impact of various router design choices on expert coactivation and runtime using billion-parameter transformer models. We find that combining a global load-balancing loss, shared experts, a consistency loss, and an autoregressive expert selection mechanism during training results in significantly stronger expert coactivation. This increased coactivation translates into higher overall runtime throughput: our exploration yields a model that improves throughput by 21% over MoE baselines, while maintaining on-par accuracy with the baseline MoE.

</details>


### [735] [Beyond Similarity: Coverage-Aware Prompt Selection for Time Series Forecasting with LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22977)
*Daeun Ji,Minkyoung Kim,Dongkuk Kim,Yohan Lee,Beomsoo Kim,Beakcheol Jang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CASP-LLM，通过使用追踪与饱和门构成的无参数覆盖正则项，缓解基于相似度的提示检索偏差，在多数长期与M4短期预测基准上匹配或超越相似度基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于相似度的检索是LLM上下文学习、检索增强生成及提示式时间序列预测的主流规则，但其偏向近重复候选、集中于主导模式而忽略稀有但信息量大的事件。该问题虽在多样性感知检索中被关注，却在其他检索条件化流程中缺乏考察。

Method: 以提示式时间序列预测为试验台（通过相似度检索学习到的提示池）：提出覆盖感知语义提示框架CASP-LLM，将使用追踪与饱和门技术结合为覆盖正则项，且不引入可学习参数。

Result: 在六个长期基准与M4短期基准上，CASP-LLM在多数数据集-预测步长设置中匹配或优于基于相似度的LLM预测器，例外为Electricity、M4-Monthly及少样本长步长设置。对照研究将失败模式定位于跨批次使用层面而非单次检索冗余：MMR等检索内多样化无帮助，而跨训练正则化锚点使用有效。

Conclusion: 提示选择偏差的根源在于跨批次使用分布，而非单次检索冗余；以无参数的覆盖正则化促进锚点使用均衡，可有效提升检索条件化预测性能。

Abstract: Similarity-based retrieval is the dominant rule for conditioning large language models (LLMs) in in-context learning, retrieval-augmented generation, and prompt-based time series forecasting. The rule concentrates on near-duplicate candidates, an issue that has motivated diversity-aware retrieval but remains unexamined in other retrieval-conditioned pipelines. We study this issue using prompt-based time series forecasting as a test bed, where a learned prompt pool is retrieved by similarity. Dominant methods in this setting retrieve top-K entries by cosine similarity without redundancy control, producing a bias toward dominant temporal patterns while overlooking rare but informative events. We propose CASP-LLM, a coverage-aware semantic prompting framework that addresses this prompt selection bias by combining usage-tracking and saturating-gate techniques into a coverage regularizer that adds no learnable parameters. On six long-term benchmarks and the M4 short-term benchmark, CASP-LLM matches or improves on similarity-based LLM forecasters on most dataset-horizon settings, with the exceptions of Electricity, M4-Monthly, and the few-shot long-horizon setting. A controlled study locates the failure mode at the cross-batch usage level rather than per-retrieval redundancy: within-retrieval diversification such as MMR does not help, whereas regularizing anchor usage across training does.

</details>


### [736] [CTRL: Control-Based Time Series Forecasting with LLM-Guided Residual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23257)
*Minkyoung Kim,Daeun Ji,Yohan Lee,Beomsoo Kim,Beakcheol Jang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CTRL是一个将语义推理与数值预测解耦的时间序列预测框架：冻结骨干网络生成基础预测，专用LLM智能体通过分解趋势/季节/不规则成分分析误差并输出紧凑控制信号，由轻量残差解码器转化为预测修正；同时引入无标签测试时自适应以应对分布漂移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有基于LLM的时间序列预测方法存在两类问题：一是将LLM退化为数值预测器，未发挥其推理优势；二是直接生成预测，在非平稳场景下导致预测不稳定。因此需要一个既能利用LLM推理能力、又能在非平稳与分布漂移下保持稳健的框架。

Method: CTRL将语义推理与定量预测解耦。冻结骨干模型生成基础预测；专用LLM智能体作为控制器，通过分解趋势、季节与不规则成分来分析骨干预测误差，使推理建立在可解释的时间结构上；每个智能体输出紧凑控制信号，由轻量残差解码器转换为预测修正。此外包含无标签测试时自适应：仅从输入统计量检测分布漂移，并通过缓存以仅3–24次LLM调用重新适配控制信号。

Result: 论文摘要未给出具体实验数值结果，但声明CTRL在非平稳时间动态与分布漂移下明确提升稳健性，同时在高度平稳的时间序列上仍具竞争力（此类场景自适应修正带来的额外收益有限）。

Conclusion: CTRL通过解耦语义推理与数值预测，并引入低开销的无标签测试时自适应，为利用LLM推理能力进行稳健时间序列预测提供了一种可解释且高效的方案。

Abstract: Time series forecasting underpins critical decision-making across diverse domains. While large language models (LLMs) offer promising reasoning capabilities, existing LLM-based time series forecasting approaches either reduce them to numerical predictors that bypass their strengths, or allow direct forecast generation that destabilizes predictions in non-stationary settings. We introduce CTRL, a framework that decouples semantic reasoning from quantitative prediction. A frozen backbone generates base forecasts, while specialized LLM agents function as controllers that analyze backbone prediction errors through decomposed trend, seasonal, and irregular components, grounding reasoning in interpretable temporal structure. Each agent outputs compact control signals that a lightweight residual decoder translates into forecast corrections. CTRL incorporates label-free test-time adaptation that detects distribution shift from input statistics alone and readapts control signals with only 3-24 LLM calls via caching. CTRL is explicitly designed to improve robustness under non-stationary temporal dynamics and distribution shift, while remaining competitive on highly stationary time series where adaptive correction provides limited additional benefit.

</details>


### [737] [Tool-Augmented On-Policy Distillation for LLM Domain Adaptation in Sequence-Based Omics Tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23435)
*Jie Ying,Zhefan Wang,Zihong Chen,Zhengqing Li,Jinzhe Li,Gang Li,Jian Liu,Fang Hu,Tao Luo,Zhonghang Yuan,Wanli Ouyang,Stan Z. Li,Fan Yang,Nanqing Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出首个面向多组学序列的推理基准OmicsBench（含1160道专家验证题目、6类任务、证据链与实例化评分标准），发现专用科学LLM虽分类更准却缺乏有效证据（疑似捷径学习），并提出工具增强的在线策略蒸馏TA-OPD，在0.8B–27B的5个Qwen3.5模型上同时提升证据 grounding 与预测性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多组学序列蕴含复杂生物模式，LLM能否据此进行自动化科学发现的关键在于是否真正理解背后的生物学机制；而现有基准仅用分类/回归指标评估预测结果，忽略模型是否掌握支撑预测的生物学证据，无法诊断推理失败。

Method: 1) 构建OmicsBench：覆盖DNA调控、RNA加工、蛋白质功能三大方向共6类任务的1160道专家验证问题，要求可追溯的证据链，并采用与领域专家共同设计的实例化评分标准进行评测；2) 评测17个LLM，比较科学专用模型与通用模型在序列分类准确率和证据有效性上的差异；3) 提出TA-OPD（工具增强的在线策略蒸馏）后训练方法，将序列预测与基于证据的生物学推理对齐。

Result: 评测17个LLM发现反向关系：科学专用LLM在序列分类准确率上优于通用LLM，却无法给出支持其预测的有效证据，可能源于捷径学习（依赖统计模式而非生物学机制）。TA-OPD在0.8B至27B共5个Qwen3.5模型上一致增强生物学证据 grounding，并在多数任务上提升预测性能，且增益跨模型规模持续存在。

Conclusion: 更强的序列推理能力并非仅来自模型容量提升，而可通过证据感知训练获得。OmicsBench与TA-OPD共同为诊断多组学LLM的推理失败提供了评测框架，并为构建预测有生物学证据支撑的模型提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Multi-omics sequences contain complex biological patterns, yet deciphering their mechanisms for automated scientific discovery remains challenging. As large language models (LLMs) interpret these sequences, evaluating both predictions and scientific reasoning is critical. However, existing benchmarks for multi-omics sequence tasks rely on classification and regression metrics, neglecting whether models grasp the underlying biological evidence. We introduce OmicsBench, the first reasoning benchmark for multi-omics sequences, comprising 1,160 expert-validated questions across six tasks spanning DNA regulation, RNA processing, and protein function. OmicsBench requires traceable evidence chains, evaluated using instance-specific rubrics developed with domain experts. Evaluating 17 LLMs reveals an inverse relationship: while scientific LLMs outperform general-purpose LLMs in sequence classification accuracy, they fail to provide valid evidence to support their predictions. One plausible interpretation is shortcut learning: specialized models may rely on statistical patterns rather than the biological mechanisms needed for scientific discovery. Motivated by this finding, we introduce tool-augmented on-policy distillation (TA-OPD), a post-training method to align sequence prediction with evidence-grounded biological reasoning. Across five Qwen3.5 models spanning 0.8B to 27B parameters, TA-OPD consistently strengthens biological evidence grounding while improving predictive performance on most tasks. These gains persist across model scales, indicating that stronger sequence reasoning does not arise solely from increased model capacity, but can be improved through evidence-aware training. Together, OmicsBench and TA-OPD provide a framework for diagnosing reasoning failures in multi-omics LLMs and a path toward models whose predictions are better grounded in biologically meaningful evidence.

</details>


### [738] [Global Ranks Survive, Selected Heads Shift: BOS-Sink Topology under 4-bit Weight-Only Quantization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23585)
*Kuanlin Chen,Chen-Wei Kuo,Cheng-En Ou*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文检验了"在量化前识别first-token attention head（sink head）并在4-bit NF4 PTQ后复用该部署映射"这一捷径何时安全。作者提出STC指标区分全局排序保持、top-k集合重叠与逐层sink质量漂移，并在三个小模型上发现全局秩相关虽高（ρ_s≥0.980），但离散head集合重叠明显下降（Jaccard 0.619-0.793），存在被全局统计掩盖的局部失效与跨域退化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Sink-aware部署在量化前预先识别重要的first-token注意力头，并在边缘端复用该映射，可节省算力与工程成本。但该捷径假设量化不改变sink head的身份与分布；若量化后head排序或集合发生变化，则预量化映射失效。论文旨在明确该假设在4-bit NF4 weight-only PTQ下成立的条件与边界。

Method: 提出Sink Topology Consistency (STC) 指标，分离三类度量：全局秩保持、top-k集合重叠、逐层sink-mass漂移，并区分per-input敏感性与calibration-map可迁移性。在Qwen2.5-0.5B、Qwen2.5-1.5B、Llama-3.2-1B上进行bf16到4-bit NF4的对比，考察4,096 token下的秩相关与top-k Jaccard，分析逐层漂移、C4-to-LongBench域偏移下的跨域重叠，以及匹配域4-bit重校准所需的样本量（n=8/32），并在Jetson Orin NX上测量16样本工作负载的端侧耗时。

Result: 全局bf16-to-4-bit秩保持很高（ρ_s≥0.980，4,096 token），但top-k Jaccard仅0.619-0.793，对应76.5-88.5%成员保留率。全局统计掩盖局部失效：Qwen末端层sink-mass漂移达模型均值的6.2-7.9倍，而Llama-3.2-1B漂移低且近似均匀。C4-to-LongBench域偏移下，两个Qwen模型的跨域重叠退化大于同域精度对比，Llama-3.2-1B则不然。匹配域4-bit重校准在Qwen上n=8即达split-half稳定平台的90%，Llama-3.2-1B需n=32，但并非尖锐阈值；仅更新选定层无法满足Qwen的全图稳定判据。Jetson Orin NX上16样本工作负载在具有有效端侧sink测量的两个模型上仅需数秒。

Conclusion: 全局排序通常可迁移，但离散head集合、逐层局部策略与跨域校准在量化后必须重新验证；sink-aware部署不能仅依赖全局秩相关指标，应结合top-k集合重叠、逐层漂移与域匹配校准样本量共同判断复用安全性。

Abstract: Sink-aware deployment may identify important first-token attention heads before a model is quantized, then reuse that map at the edge. We test when this shortcut is safe for 4-bit NF4 weight-only post-training quantization (PTQ). Our Sink Topology Consistency (STC) metrics separate global rank preservation, top-$k$ set overlap, and layerwise sink-mass shift, and distinguish per-input sensitivity from calibration-map transfer. Across Qwen2.5-0.5B, Qwen2.5-1.5B, and Llama-3.2-1B, global bf16-to-4-bit ranks remain high at 4,096 tokens ($ρ_s \geq 0.980$), yet top-$k$ Jaccard overlap is only 0.619-0.793, corresponding to 76.5-88.5% membership retention. The global statistic also masks local failures: terminal Qwen layers shift by 6.2-7.9x their model means, whereas Llama-3.2-1B shows low, nearly uniform drift. Under a C4-to-LongBench shift, cross-domain overlap degrades more than the within-domain precision comparison for both Qwen models, but not for Llama-3.2-1B. Matched-domain 4-bit recalibration reaches 90% of a split-half stability plateau at the smallest tested $n=8$ for both Qwen models and $n=32$ for Llama-3.2-1B, though not as a sharp threshold; for the two Qwen models, updating only selected layers does not reach the full-map stability criterion. On Jetson Orin NX, the 16-sample workload takes seconds for the two models with valid on-device sink measurements. The practical message is precise: global rankings often transfer, but discrete head sets, layer-local policies, and cross-domain calibration should be revalidated after quantization.

</details>


### [739] [SupportCal: Label-Free Calibration of Post-Trained LLMs via Reference Support and Corroboration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24303)
*Linhan Luo,Lequan Lin,Dai Shi,Feng Chen,José Miguel Hernández-Lobato,Junbin Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免标签后校准方法 SupportCal：保留一致样本单位权重，对不一致样本依据 PLM 支持度与佐证给出连续权重，从而改善后训练模型的置信度校准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 后训练（post-training）虽提升任务表现，却常损害置信度校准，使后训练语言模型（PoLM）比预训练模型（PLM）更过度自信。由于任务相关的标注校准数据昂贵或不可得，对应的预训练 PLM 成为天然的免标签参考。此前的"一致性门控"校准仅用 PoLM 与 PLM 一致的样本拟合标量温度，因直接对齐会使温度过高并导致欠自信而排除不一致样本。

Method: 重新审视一致/不一致二值处理，通过受控重引入诊断发现非单调的总体效应：适度纳入不一致样本可改善校准，但随单位权重纳入接近全部不一致集时收益递减。提出 SupportCal：一致样本保持单位权重，不一致样本赋予连续权重，权重基于 own-base PLM 的相对支持度以及从规模兼容候选池中选出的预训练参考模型的佐证。并刻画加权目标存在有限最优温度的条件。

Result: 在 MedMCQA 与 MathQA 上，SupportCal 在几乎所有评估的目标模型配置下 ECE 均低于仅一致基线；补充的 TweetEval Sentiment 结果在固定标签分类任务上呈现相同规律。

Conclusion: 不一致样本并非应被一律排除，适度、连续加权地引入可提升校准。SupportCal 作为免标签事后校准方法，在多个任务与目标模型配置上稳定优于仅一致基线，并给出最优温度存在性的理论刻画。

Abstract: Post-training often improves task performance but can degrade confidence calibration, leaving post-trained language models (PoLMs) more overconfident than their corresponding pretrained language models (PLMs). Because task-specific labeled calibration data can be costly or unavailable, the corresponding pretrained PLM provides a natural label-free reference for post-hoc calibration. Prior agreement-gated PLM-referenced calibration fits a scalar temperature using only examples on which the PoLM and its PLM reference agree, excluding disagreement examples because direct alignment can drive the fitted temperature excessively high and induce under-confidence. We revisit this binary treatment. A controlled reintroduction diagnostic reveals a non-monotonic aggregate effect: admitting a moderate fraction of disagreement examples can improve calibration, whereas the benefit diminishes as unit-weight inclusion approaches the full disagreement set. We introduce SupportCal, a label-free post-hoc method that retains agreement examples at unit weight and assigns disagreement examples continuous weights based on the own-base PLM's relative support and corroboration from pretrained references selected from a size-compatible candidate pool. We further characterize when the resulting weighted objective admits a finite optimal temperature.
