We further connect the general information-time analysis to practical LLM policy optimization by relating state-wise information density to local policy movement, while also providing theoretical grounding for the adaptive update mechanism. Experiments on Qwen3 models demonstrate consistent gains over competitive baselines across five challenging competition-style mathematical reasoning benchmarks. InfoPPO also maintains stable accuracy and response length across non-trivial discount settings under which token-time PPO deteriorates.

</details>


### [806] [Artificial Structure Function Search: Preserving Artificial Functional Connectivity for Structured Pruning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24401)
*Mindula Illeperuma,Rafael Pina,Charuka Herath,Sharmarke A. Gabayre,Varuna De Silva*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出结构化剪枝框架ASF-S，其核心为受大脑结构-功能关系启发的剪枝候选选择准则PGI，并定义人工功能连接（AFC）以验证合理选择准则能获得精确的小型网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度神经网络在资源受限设备上部署时计算成本高，需要结构化剪枝来压缩模型。然而主流剪枝方法依赖不透明的启发式规则或基于权重的准则，无法揭示网络中的结构依赖关系，因此需要一种能刻画结构-功能对应关系的剪枝准则与框架。

Method: 提出结构化剪枝框架ASF-S（Artificial Structure Function Search），其核心是剪枝候选选择准则PGI（Principle Gradient Importance），灵感来源于大脑中的结构-功能关系；通过确保剪枝后模型的结构尊重输出层的拓扑组织，定义人工神经网络中的人工功能连接（AFC）。

Result: 将PGI作为选择准则、ASF-S作为剪枝框架与近期基准方法进行对比实验，结果显示该方法可得到参数减少70%的模型变体，且无需对剪枝层进行再训练即可恢复基线精度。

Conclusion: AFC为“通过精心的剪枝候选选择准则可找到精确的小型网络”提供了证据，表明基于结构-功能关系的剪枝准则和框架在大幅压缩参数的同时能够保持模型精度。

Abstract: Structured pruning is a model compression technique that is used to reduce the computational cost of deploying deep neural networks on resource-constrained devices. Popular methods of pruning rely on opaque heuristics or weight-based criteria that give no indication as to the structural dependencies in the network. To address these limitations we present Artificial Structure Function Search (ASF-S): a novel structured pruning framework. ASF-S utilizes Principle Gradient Importance (PGI): a novel prune-candidate selection criteria that is inspired by structure-function relationships in the brain. By ensuring the pruned structure of the model respects topographical organization of the output layer, we define Artificial Functional Connectivity (AFC) for artificial neural networks. AFC provides evidence to demonstrate that accurate smaller networks can be found using careful prune candidate selection criteria. We present results for PGI as a selection criterion and for ASF-S as a pruning framework against recent benchmarks, demonstrating that our method yields model variants with 70\% parameter reduction, that can recover baseline accuracy without re-training the pruned layers.

</details>


### [807] [ARM: Attention with Routed-Memory for Learnable Sparse Control](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24417)
*Qiuhao Zeng,Jerry Huang,Peng Lu,Ruiyi Fang,Gezheng Xu,Zihao Jing,Yufei Cui,Charles Ling,Gang Niu,Boyu Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出ARM（Attention with Routed Memory），一种可微分的固定大小KV缓存结构，采用层次化路由器组织记忆槽，通过Gumbel-Softmax选择与Sigmoid门控更新软性组合新旧信息，避免硬驱逐导致的信息丢失，并在推理时动态分配记忆量，从而在短/长上下文任务上兼顾性能与效率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长上下文推理中，LLM受限于为稳定计算所必需的KV缓存机制。选择性token驱逐与剪枝虽缓解了缓存增长问题，但常丢弃核心信息，造成信息损失，且难以在简单上下文与需深度推理的输入之间自适应地分配缓存资源。

Method: 提出ARM（Attention with Routed Memory）：一种新型KV缓存结构，引入完全可微的固定大小记忆系统，组织为层次化路由器。借助Gumbel-Softmax学习选择记忆槽，并通过Sigmoid门控更新软性融合新信息与已存信息，取代硬驱逐；同时训练策略在推理时动态选择不同数量的记忆访问量，以适配简单与复杂上下文。

Result: 在标准常识推理与长上下文推理基准上的实验表明，相较固定KV缓存方法，ARM在性能与效率上均更优，且在内存占用与生成延迟方面保持高效与可扩展。

Conclusion: ARM通过可微分、固定大小、路由化的记忆机制与自适应记忆访问策略，缓解了传统KV缓存驱逐带来的信息损失，实现了短、长上下文下更具扩展性与有效性的检索，兼顾性能、内存与延迟效率。

Abstract: Despite advances in long-context inference, large language models (LLMs) remain fundamentally limited by the key-value (KV) caching mechanisms that are necessary for stable computation. Techniques such as selective token eviction and pruning have vastly mitigated these issues, but often discard core information to manage the growing cache. In this paper, we propose Attention with Routed Memory (ARM) a novel KV caching structure that introduces a fully differentiable, fixed-size memory system organized as a hierarchical router. Via a Gumbel-Softmax, ARM learns to select memory slots and perform sigmoid-gated updates that softly combine new and stored information, avoiding hard eviction and reducing information loss. By further training a policy to dynamically select varying amounts of memory at inference, ARM adapts its accesses for both simple contexts and inputs that require deeper reasoning, enabling more scalable and effective retrieval on both short- and long-contexts. Experimental results on standard commonsense and long-context reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that ARM achieves superior performance and efficiency compared to fixed KV-caching approaches, while remaining efficient and scalable in terms of both memory and generation latency.

</details>


### [808] [WPBench: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Wind Power Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24444)
*Yuhan Zhu,Jilin Hu,Xinying Cai,Yingshan Li,Li Ma,Xiangfei Qiu Linsen Li,Kai Zhang,Yao Fu,Weihao Jiang,Bin Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出WPBench，一个面向风电功率预测的综合、公平、可扩展基准，整合26个公开数据集与19个代表性模型，在统一协议下从点误差、曲线保真度、计算效率及结构感知诊断等多维度进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 准确、可靠且可部署的风电功率预测对电力系统调度、可再生能源并网和电力市场运行至关重要，而该领域进展依赖于对预测方法的实证、全面基准测试。现有基准存在四方面不足：1）风电场景覆盖有限（机组规模、变量构成、空间结构）；2）预测模型族覆盖不全；3）评价指标与风电需求不匹配；4）缺乏超越单一时间模式的结构感知诊断。

Method: WPBench整合26个公开数据集，按机组规模与变量构成组织，覆盖单机组、多机组、单变量与多变量场景；在统一的数据处理、训练和评估协议下，对19个代表性模型进行基准测试，涵盖传统方法、深度时序模型、时空模型和基础模型；评估除逐点误差外，还考察预测曲线保真度与计算效率，并提供时间、变量依赖、空间依赖三个视角的结构感知诊断。

Result: 构建了覆盖多类风电场景与多模型族的统一基准平台，实现了跨场景的系统性模型比较，并能从时间、变量依赖和空间依赖维度给出结构感知诊断及计算效率评估。

Conclusion: WPBench通过统一协议与多维度评估弥补了现有风电预测基准在场景覆盖、模型覆盖、指标匹配和结构诊断方面的不足，为多样风电场景下的系统模型比较提供支撑，并为后续研究提供可复用平台。

Abstract: Accurate, reliable, and deployable wind power forecasting is critical for power system dispatch, renewable energy integration, and electricity market operations. Progress in this field hinges on the ability to empirically and comprehensively benchmark forecasting methods. Yet existing benchmarks fall short of supporting systematic evaluation in four key aspects: 1) limited coverage of wind power scenarios across turbine scale, variable composition, and spatial structure; 2) incomplete coverage of forecasting model families; 3) evaluation metrics misaligned with wind power requirements; and 4) limited structure-aware diagnostics beyond individual temporal patterns. To address these limitations, we propose WPBench, a comprehensive, fair, and extensible benchmark for wind power forecasting. WPBench integrates 26 public datasets organized by turbine scale and variable composition, spanning single-turbine, multi-turbine, univariate, and multivariate settings. Under unified processing, training, and evaluation protocols, it benchmarks 19 representative models covering traditional methods, deep temporal models, spatio-temporal models, and foundation models. Beyond point-wise errors, WPBench assesses forecast-curve fidelity and computational efficiency, and delivers structure-aware diagnostics across temporal, variable-dependency, and spatial-dependency perspectives. Together, these capabilities enable systematic model comparison across diverse wind scenarios and provide a reusable platform for future research.

</details>


### [809] [Lifted Bellman Linear Programming for Offline Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24489)
*Hyukjun Yang,Jongchan Park,Narim Jeong,Donghwan Lee*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出Lifted Bellman Linear Program (LBLP)，将Bellman最优性的线性规划刻画提升到联合(Q,V)空间，使所有约束仅涉及数据集内的状态-动作对；其松弛形式ALBUM用铰链惩罚和神经网络实现，无需目标网络或EMA更新，在OGBench上以更少参数和显存达到与FQL相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离线强化学习通常通过最小化对bootstrapped价值目标的回归损失来训练critic，并依赖目标网络和EMA更新来稳定。多步目标包含行为策略动作，需要off-policy correction。作者希望避免这些复杂性，转而直接在critic上施加in-sample Bellman最优性约束。

Method: 提出LBLP，将Bellman最优性的LP刻画提升到联合(Q,V)空间，使每条约束只涉及数据集中的状态-动作对；沿数据集轨迹的K步片段添加约束，对任意rollout策略和horizon不改变唯一极小值点。将约束松弛为hinge惩罚，在表格情形下超过有限惩罚系数即可恢复相同解。用神经网络实现ALBUM，对K步rollout目标做stop gradient分离，不含对bootstrapped目标的平方回归，因此无需目标网络或EMA。

Result: LBLP的唯一极小值点是in-sample最优对；确定性动态下该点位于最佳数据集回报与最优值之间。确定性动态下，LBLP解在某个与γ和K无关的系数条件下是detached更新的不动点；不等式约束允许沿数据集轨迹的折扣回报作为下界，无需off-policy correction或action chunking。在OGBench上，ALBUM用单个critic和高斯策略，平均性能与FQL相当，与近期action-chunking方法可比，同时参数量和峰值GPU显存均为比较方法中最少。

Conclusion: 通过将Bellman最优性以不等式约束形式直接施加于critic的联合(Q,V)空间，LBLP及其松弛实现ALBUM提供了一种无需目标网络、EMA更新和off-policy correction的离线RL训练范式，并在OGBench上以更低资源消耗取得有竞争力的性能。

Abstract: Offline reinforcement learning (RL) typically trains a critic by minimizing a regression loss against bootstrapped value targets stabilized by target networks with exponential moving average (EMA) updates. Multi-step targets incorporate behavior-policy actions and therefore require off-policy correction. We instead impose in-sample Bellman optimality on the critic through inequality constraints. We formulate the Lifted Bellman Linear Program (LBLP), which lifts the linear programming characterization of Bellman optimality to the joint $(Q,V)$ space so that every constraint involves only state-action pairs in the dataset. Its unique minimizer is the in-sample optimal pair, and constraints along $K$-step segments of dataset trajectories leave this minimizer unchanged for any rollout policy and horizon. Under deterministic dynamics, this minimizer lies between the best dataset return and the optimal value. Relaxing the constraints into hinge penalties recovers the same solution above a finite penalty coefficient in the tabular case. Approximate Lifted Bellman Unconstrained Minimization (ALBUM) implements this relaxation with neural networks and detaches the $K$-step rollout targets by stop gradient. Its objective contains no squared regression onto bootstrapped targets, so it can be trained without target networks or EMA updates. Under deterministic dynamics, the LBLP solution is a stationary point of the detached update under a coefficient condition independent of $γ$ and $K$, and the inequality constraints allow discounted returns along dataset trajectories to serve as lower bounds without off-policy correction or action chunking. On OGBench, ALBUM uses a single critic with a Gaussian policy, matches the average performance of FQL, and is comparable to recent action-chunking methods, while using the fewest parameters and the least peak GPU memory among all compared methods.

</details>


### [810] [On Emergent Capabilities and Model Merging](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24504)
*Luca Zhou,Emanuele Rodolà*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文系统研究了模型权重合并（model merging）对"涌现能力"（从未被显式训练的目标行为）的影响，通过激活预言机与涌现失准模型两个测试平台、三个模型家族的实验，提出三方面发现：合并可保留双亲共有的涌现能力；无法通过加权合成为双亲所不具备（超加性）的涌现能力；当仅单亲携带某涌现能力时，合并会以快于伴随训练能力的速度稀释它。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 公开仓库中充斥着微调检查点与适配器，而对这些产物最常见的操作就是在权重上做算术的模型合并，以低成本组装能力。作者希望探究：模型合并这一操作究竟会对"涌现能力"（即产物携带但从未作为显式训练目标的行为）产生何种影响。

Method: 研究在两个独立测试平台（激活预言机 activation oracles、涌现失准模型 emergent-misaligned models）上进行，覆盖三个模型家族；核心手段是对不同检查点进行加权权重合并，并考察合并后模型在涌现能力上的表现随混合比例（whole mixing range）的变化。

Result: 得到三方面结论：(1) 合并会保留双亲共同携带的涌现能力——将两个失准检查点合并，在整个混合范围内仍保留大部分广泛失准；(2) 合并不具备超加性，无法创造出双亲都不具备的涌现能力——两个单任务预言机的任意加权合成都达不到联合训练预言机的审计能力；(3) 当仅单亲携带该能力时，合并对其的稀释速度快于伴随的训练能力，在多数设定下差距显著。

Conclusion: 产物的涌现行为并不像其训练能力那样可以按权重加性"组合"。这一发现揭示了模型合并的边界：合并适合保留共有涌现能力，但在创造新涌现能力或保护单亲携带的涌现能力方面存在根本局限。

Abstract: Fine-tuned checkpoints and adapters now fill public repositories, and the most common operation applied to these artifacts is model merging: arithmetic on their weights that assembles capabilities cheaply. We ask what this operation does to emergent capabilities: behaviors an artifact carries that were never an explicit training target. Studying two independent testbeds (activation oracles and emergent-misaligned models) across three model families, we find that the answer is threefold. First, merging preserves an emergent capability that both parents carry: merging two misaligned checkpoints retains most of their broad misalignment across the whole mixing range. Second, merging cannot create an emergent capability that is superadditive in its parents: no weighted merge of two single-task oracles reaches the jointly-trained oracle's auditing ability. Third, when only one parent carries the capability, merging dilutes it faster than the trained capability that accompanies it: the gap is significant in most settings. In short, emergent behaviors of an artifact do not compose the way its trained capability does.

</details>


### [811] [$t_0$: A Time-Series Foundation Model for Forecasting with Context](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24559)
*Lucas Meyer,Claudio Sole,Huikan Xiang,Nicolas Li,Lucas Franceschino,Arnau Quera-Bofarull,Maarten P. Scholl,Joachim Fainberg,Geoffrey Négiar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 $t_0$ 系列开源权重基础模型（t0-alpha 102M、t0-beta 256M），支持多变量上下文预测，无需任务特定重训练，通过时间与变量交替注意力及分位数预测实现概率预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 构建可跨任务泛化的时间序列基础模型，能够同时利用目标历史、历史协变量与已知未来协变量，并在零样本设置下达到与最优 TSFM 接近的性能。

Method: 模型采用交替在时间维与变量维上的注意力 Transformer 层；以分位数预测输出概率预测；预训练融合精选公开数据与合成的、含协变量到目标依赖关系的生成器数据族。

Result: 在 GIFT-Eval 上，t0-alpha 聚合 CRPS 为 0.4941，t0-beta 为 0.4738、MASE 为 0.6865，二者均列第三，距最优零样本 TSFM 差距 4.0% 以内；在 fev-bench 技能分分别为 42.2 与 46.7，后者第三、落后榜首 2.0 分；已知未来协变量在 30 个任务上提升 6.3 个百分点；在 Victoria 电力需求基准与 ERCOT 电价评估中表现突出，后者相较滞后价格基线 MAE 降低 38%。

Conclusion: $t_0$ 作为开源多变量上下文预测基础模型族，在零样本预测、校准、长时程 rollout、缺失数据鲁棒性及真实能源场景中均表现良好，验证了协变量条件建模与合成预训练的有效性。

Abstract: We present $t_0$, a family of open-weights foundation models for forecasting with multivariate context. We release its first two members: $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ and $\texttt{t0-beta}$, respectively 102M and 256M parameters. Both condition their forecasts on target history, past covariates, and known-future covariates, without task-specific retraining. Their transformer layers alternate attention along time and across variates. They produce probabilistic forecasts through quantile predictions. Pretraining combines curated public data with synthetic generator families constructed to contain covariate-to-target dependencies. On GIFT-Eval, $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ reaches an aggregate CRPS of 0.4941, and $\texttt{t0-beta}$ a CRPS of 0.4738 and a MASE of 0.6865, third on both and within 4.0% of the best zero-shot TSFM. On fev-bench they score 42.2 and 46.7 in skill, the latter third again and 2.0 points behind the leader. We analyze $\texttt{t0-alpha}$ in depth. Known-future covariates raise its skill by 6.3 percentage points across 30 tasks. The report also examines its calibration, its rollout strategy on long horizons, and its robustness to missing data. On the Victoria electricity-demand benchmark, $\texttt{t0-beta}$ is among the most accurate models with a context of nearly a year. In an independent Macrocosm evaluation of hourly ERCOT prices over 29 months, both cut the MAE of the lagged-price baseline by 38%.

</details>


### [812] [Overlay\_dx - Automating forecasting evaluation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24586)
*Long Ngo,Mohammed Amine Chamli,Jonathan Rivalan,Thomas Jaillon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 overlay_dx，一种结合可视化与数值的时间序列预测评估指标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统评估指标仅给出数值，缺乏可理解性，难以有效区分不同模型的性能。

Method: overlay_dx 以预测值落入真实值置信区间的百分比作为可视化指标，并在绘制评估结果后计算 overlay 曲线下面积，从而在不同阈值和预测下量化预测与真实的吻合度。

Result: 大量实验表明，该方法提供了统一的评估框架，兼顾视觉与数值评估，改善了模型比较。

Conclusion: overlay_dx 为时间序列预测提供了可解释且定量的评估手段，为后续研究与优化提供参考。

Abstract: Traditional evaluation metrics provides numerical values but often lack comprehensibility, hindering effective differentiation of model performances. Our work addresses this challenge by introducing overlay\_dx, a novel evaluation metric measuring the performance of time series prediction models. Overlay\_dx is a visual metric that represents the percentage of predictions falling within a confidence interval around actual values. Additionally, once evaluation results are plotted, overlay\_dx computes the area under the overlay curve, providing a quantitative measure of alignment between predicted and actual values across different thresholds and predictions. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate that our approach offers a unified evaluation framework that combines both visual and numerical assessments, enabling improved model comparison and providing valuable insights for further research and optimization efforts in time series prediction.

</details>


### [813] [GraphToolbox: A Configurable Python Framework for Graph Neural Network Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24609)
*Eloi Campagne,Yvenn Amara-Ouali,Yannig Goude,Argyris Kalogeratos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: GraphToolbox 是一个开源 Python 框架，基于 PyTorch Geometric 将图构建、模型选择、训练、聚合与可解释性统一为配置驱动的电力预测流水线，并在两个案例中验证了其系统性架构评估能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 电力预测涉及跨区域、变电站与馈线等空间相关信号，图神经网络适合建模此类关系。但构建完整 GNN 预测实验十分繁琐：图构建、模型选择、训练、聚合与解释分散在不兼容的工具中，缺乏统一流程。

Method: 提出 GraphToolbox：基于 PyTorch Geometric 的开源 Python 框架，采用单一配置驱动流水线统一上述各阶段。功能包括数据驱动图构建、适配器实例化并训练 65 个 PyTorch Geometric 卷积中的 51 个及 PyTorch Geometric Temporal 的循环单元、在线专家聚合、预测可解释性与基于缓存预测的显著性检验。通过两个案例研究进行评测。

Result: 在法国区域负荷上，完整预测扫描包含的 48 个卷积误差处于 1.14%–1.60% 区间，在线聚合将其降至 0.98%，且图模型优于经典加性与提升基线。在净负荷上，直接图模型精度低于经典加性模型，按物理分量分别预测可改善但未消除该差距。

Conclusion: 两个对比均使用同一实验接口，表明 GraphToolbox 在系统性架构评估中具有实用价值，可作为统一、可复现的 GNN 电力预测实验平台。

Abstract: Electricity forecasting often involves spatially related signals observed over regions, substations, and feeders, and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) provide a natural way to represent these relations. Building a complete GNN forecasting experiment is nonetheless laborious, because graph construction, model selection, training, aggregation, and interpretation sit in incompatible tools. We present GraphToolbox, an open-source Python framework that unifies these stages in one configurationdriven pipeline built on PyTorch Geometric. It offers data-driven graph construction, an adapter that instantiates and trains 51 of the 65 PyTorch Geometric convolutions together with the recurrent cells of PyTorch Geometric Temporal, online expert aggregation, forecasting interpretability, and significance testing on cached forecasts. We evaluate the pipeline in two case studies. On French regional load, the 48 convolutions included in the complete forecasting sweep fall in a band from 1.14% to 1.60% error, online aggregation lowers this to 0.98%, and the graph models improve on classical additive and boosting baselines. On net-load, direct graph models are less accurate than a classical additive model, while forecasting each physical component separately improves them without closing that gap. Both comparisons use the same experimental interface, illustrating the role of GraphToolbox in systematic architectural evaluation.

</details>


### [814] [Augmented Hypothesis Testing with Persona-Based LLM Simulations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24629)
*Ziyad Benomar,Aymen Al Marjani,Paul Missault,Saab Mansour*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种学习增强假设检验框架，利用质量未知的机器学习预测（从群体级方向信号到个体级估计）在保持统计有效性的前提下降低A/B测试样本量，并通过LLM人格模拟在四个真实数据集上验证了其可行性与稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: A/B测试需要大样本、长周期和高成本。机器学习模型可对实验结果提供辅助预测，但预测质量不确定，无法完全替代人类实验；然而这些预测中仍含有可用信号。因此需要一种既能利用预测、又能对不准确或对抗性预测保持稳健的统计框架。

Method: 提出学习增强假设检验（learning-augmented hypothesis testing）框架，覆盖预测粒度的两个端点：(1) 群体级方向预测——仅获得处理效应符号的二值信号时，采用非对称检验，并在学习增强算法范式下证明一致性与稳健性界；(2) 个体级预测——提出广义PPI++（GPPI），将Prediction-Powered Inference扩展到通过高维变换处理非线性预测误差。两类方法均在预测准确时获益，在预测不准或对抗时保持稳健。使用基于人设的LLM模拟（配备用户人设的AI智能体预测个体行为）作为跨粒度预测来源进行验证。

Result: 在四个真实数据集上，所提方法与基于人设的预测相结合，在保持严格统计有效性的同时大幅降低实验成本；群体级非对称检验给出一致性与稳健性理论保证，GPPI在个体级非线性误差场景下有效。

Conclusion: 学习增强假设检验框架可在预测质量未知条件下同时实现样本量缩减与统计有效性，兼顾准确预测的收益与不准确/对抗预测的稳健性，为降低A/B测试成本提供了有理论保障的实用方案。

Abstract: A/B testing requires large sample sizes, long timelines, and significant costs. When auxiliary predictions of experimental outcomes are available from machine learning models, uncertain prediction quality precludes replacing human experiments entirely, yet these predictions may still contain useful signal. We propose a principled framework for learning-augmented hypothesis testing that leverages predictions of unknown quality to reduce sample sizes while maintaining statistical validity. Predictions naturally vary in granularity, from coarse aggregate signals to fine-grained individual-level estimates, and our framework addresses both ends of this spectrum: (1) for population-level directional predictions, where only a binary signal on the treatment effect sign is available, we use an asymmetric test and prove consistency and robustness bounds within the learning-augmented algorithms paradigm; (2) for individual-level predictions, we introduce Generalized PPI++ (GPPI), extending Prediction-Powered Inference to handle nonlinear prediction errors through higher-dimensional transformations. Both methods benefit from accurate predictions while remaining robust to inaccurate or adversarial ones. We validate our framework using persona-based LLM simulations, where AI agents equipped with user personas predict individual behavior, as a natural prediction source spanning both granularity levels. Experiments on four real-world datasets demonstrate that our methods, combined with persona-based predictions, substantially reduce experimental costs while preserving rigorous statistical validity.

</details>


### [815] [iSDFT: Information-Proximal Self-Distillation for Continual Learning in LLMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24646)
*Ahmed Khaled Khamis,Xiaotong Ji,Hassan Jaber,Rasul Tutunov,Matthieu Zimmer,Jun Wang,Haitham Bou-Ammar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: iSDFT将教师视为“有预算的信息源”，在每个token处选择满足给定教师信息约束且最接近当前学生的分布，并锚定冻结基座策略，从而控制示范信息迁移的“量”与“时机”，在专业化的同时更好地保持通用能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: on-policy自蒸馏微调（SDFT）能从示范中学习新技能并减少遗忘，但它始终朝向完整的“示范条件教师”蒸馏，把教师影响固定在“全教师”这一端点上。这导致无法控制在每个预测状态应当迁移多少示范信息，即缺乏对迁移强度的细粒度调节能力。

Method: 提出Information-Proximal SDFT（iSDFT）：把教师视为有预算（budgeted）的信息源。在每个token处，iSDFT在满足规定教师信息约束的前提下，选择与当前学生最接近的分布，得到一个具有局部确定倾斜（locally determined tilt）的闭式指数目标（closed-form exponential target）。为进一步控制累积漂移，将学生锚定到其冻结的基座策略上。

Result: 在4个异构LLM骨干与2个专业化任务上，iSDFT在8个“模型-任务”组合中的7个优于原始SDFT，剩余1个持平。在原始SDFT基准套件上保持性更强：73%的评测结果与基座模型差距在0.5分以内，而最强基线为52%；同时在全部10个额外基准（数学、代码与竞赛数学）上取得最大平均提升。

Conclusion: 结果表明，对教师信息“迁移多少”和“何时引入”进行控制，能够在提升专业化能力的同时保持更广泛的通用能力。

Abstract: On-policy self-distillation fine-tuning (SDFT) learns new skills from demonstrations while reducing forgetting, but it always distils toward the full demonstration-conditioned teacher. This fixes teacher influence at the full-teacher endpoint, providing no control over how much demonstration information should be transferred at each prediction state. We introduce Information-Proximal SDFT (iSDFT), which instead treats the teacher as a budgeted source of information. At each token, iSDFT selects the distribution closest to the current student that satisfies a prescribed teacher-information constraint, yielding a closed-form exponential target with a locally determined tilt. To control cumulative drift, we further anchor the student to its frozen base policy. Across four heterogeneous LLM backbones and two specialisation tasks, iSDFT improves vanilla SDFT in 7 of 8 model-task settings and matches it in the remaining one. It also provides tighter retention on the original SDFT benchmark suite, with 73% of evaluations remaining within 0.5 points of the base model versus 52% for the strongest baseline, while achieving the largest mean improvement on all ten additional mathematics, coding, and competition-mathematics benchmarks. These results show that controlling how much and when teacher information is introduced improves specialisation while preserving broader capability.

</details>


### [816] [Corrective Forcing: Unified Post-Training for Diffusions and Flows in Generative Speech Enhancement](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24651)
*Qing Yao,Lijian Gao,Qirong Mao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 Corrective Forcing (CoF)，一种针对扩散与流匹配语音增强模型的后训练范式，通过让模型在自生成 rollout 状态上学习并纠正预测，缓解训练-推理不匹配，在 SB-VE 与 OT-CFM 上提升感知质量与重建保真度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散与流模型在语音增强中存在训练-推理不匹配：训练使用解析路径状态，而推理在离散采样轨迹上对自生成 rollout 状态递归评估模型，导致预测误差与离散化误差不断累积。现有方法未能有效解决这一差距。

Method: 提出 Corrective Forcing (CoF) 后训练范式：(1) 在动态采样调度下，将 rollout 状态上的干净语音预测朝真值纠正，使模型暴露于多变的推理条件；(2) 利用局部纠正的反事实转移作为事实转移的参考，正则化局部演化；(3) 通过共享的干净语音预测参数化表达模型输出，使同一后训练目标可统一应用于扩散与流两种形式。

Result: 在 SB-VE 与 OT-CFM 上的实验表明，CoF 在感知质量与重建保真度上均有提升，并在不同采样步数下保持稳健性能。

Conclusion: CoF 通过训练时引入自生成 rollout 与纠正机制，有效缓解扩散/流语音增强的训练-推理不匹配，且具跨公式通用性与对采样步数的鲁棒性。

Abstract: Diffusion and flow models, as promising generative paradigms for speech enhancement, face a training--inference mismatch: training uses analytical path states, whereas inference recursively evaluates models on self-generated rollout states along discretized sampling trajectories. This mismatch causes prediction and discretization errors to accumulate. To address it, we introduce Corrective Forcing (CoF), a post-training paradigm that forces diffusion and flow models to learn from self-generated rollouts and correct their predictions. CoF corrects clean-speech predictions on rollout states toward the ground truth under dynamic sampling schedules, exposing the model to varying inference conditions. It further regularizes local evolution using locally corrected counterfactual transitions as references for factual transitions. By expressing model outputs through a shared clean-speech prediction parameterization, CoF applies the same post-training objective across diffusion and flow formulations. Experiments with SB-VE and OT-CFM demonstrate improvements in perceptual quality and reconstruction fidelity, together with robust performance across different numbers of sampling steps.

</details>


### [817] [Enhancing Transformer Representations of Symbolic ODE Expressions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24746)
*Xiyue Fan,Adam Prugel-Bennett,Stuart E. Middleton*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 系统研究树位置编码在符号ODE任务中的有效性，并结合对比学习建模数学交换律，验证其在多数据规模与任务上的一致增益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有求解微分方程的方法（符号回归、PINN、神经算子）多依赖数值近似或对数值数据的拟合式盲符号搜索，较少关注能保持交换律、支持符号形式推理的结构化数学表达式表示。Transformer虽在符号微分方程求解上表现良好，但标准位置编码面向序列设计，而符号微分方程天然以表达式树表示，难以有效捕获其层次结构。

Method: 在符号常微分方程（ODE）任务中考察已有树位置编码，并在不同设置下系统评估其效果；在学到的结构化表示基础上，引入对比学习以支持数学中的交换律；通过消融实验分析各方法的交互作用。

Result: 树位置编码在训练早期阶段即可辅助学习，并在整个训练过程中持续提升性能，最终在不同数据规模与任务上取得一致优势；消融实验揭示了各方法在建模符号数学结构时的相互作用。

Conclusion: 树位置编码优于面向序列的标准位置编码，能更有效捕获符号微分方程的层次结构；结合对比学习有助于表征数学交换律，为符号形式的结构化表示与推理提供可行路径。

Abstract: Existing approaches to solving differential equations, such as symbolic regression, physics informed neural networks, and neural operators, typically focus on numerical approximations or blind symbolic search via fitting to numerical data. Less attention has been paid to learning structured representations of mathematical expressions that preserve commutative properties and could support mathematical reasoning in symbolic forms. Transformer models have shown strong capabilities in solving symbolic differential equations. However, standard positional embeddings in transformers are designed for sequence data. Symbolic differential equations are naturally represented by expression trees, so these positional embeddings may not efficiently capture their hierarchical structures. We investigate existing tree positional embeddings in symbolic ordinary differential equation (ODE) tasks. We systematically study their effectiveness under different settings. Our results show that tree positional embeddings aid learning in early epochs and continue to improve performance throughout, ultimately yielding consistent advantages across various data sizes and tasks. Based on learned structural representations, we apply contrastive learning to support the commutative property in mathematics. Ablation studies provide insight into how these methods interact in modelling symbolic mathematical structures.

</details>


### [818] [When Tomorrow Becomes Today: Self-Evolving Policies for Agentic Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24862)
*Yifan Hu,Xilin Dai,Zhiyuan Qu,Yiding Liu,Zewei Dong,Jiang-ming Yang,Qiang Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 TimEvolve，一种冻结骨干的时间序列智能体，通过"预测—揭示—更新"协议将部署中延迟反馈转化为对专家信任、路径选择与干预强度的持久联合策略更新。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 时间序列底层机制随时间演化，数值模型、推理策略与干预规则的相对有效性是时变的，因此智能体需同时自适应其预测输出与组件编排策略。部署过程中，随着预测视界结束、真实值揭示，自然产生对先前决策的监督信号；若在观测目标前提交所有数值专家预测与候选智能体路径，则每个已实现结果可评估整个备选集合，从而无需额外标注即可获得延迟反馈。但现有时间序列智能体主要依赖预测精炼、反思或检索引入先验经验，未系统地将已实现结果转化为对后续起点起作用的联合编排策略的持久更新。

Method: TimEvolve 采用冻结骨干（frozen-backbone）架构，把每个已实现结果转化为对三方面的持久联合更新：专家信任度、智能体路径选择与干预强度。并设计时间有序的"预测（predict）—揭示（reveal）—更新（update）"协议，将该反馈应用于后续预测。

Result: 在八个 Time-MMD 领域上，TimEvolve 在十五种方法中取得最佳的平均 MSE 与 MAE 排名，并在七个领域的两项指标上误差最低。

Conclusion: 结果证明从部署过程中所遇到的实际未来中学习预测策略具有显著价值，即利用延迟反馈持续更新联合编排策略可有效提升时间序列智能体的预测表现。

Abstract: Agentic time series forecasting concerns systems whose underlying mechanisms evolve, making the relative effectiveness of numerical models, reasoning strategies, and intervention rules inherently time-varying. Consequently, a time series agent must adapt the forecasts it produces and the orchestration policy that determines which components to trust and how to coordinate them. The deployment process naturally provides supervision for this adaptation as forecast horizons elapse and realized targets reveal the effectiveness of earlier decisions. Committing all numerical expert forecasts and candidate agent paths before target observation allows each realized outcome to evaluate the entire alternative set, providing delayed feedback without additional annotation. However, existing time series agents primarily incorporate prior experience through forecast refinement, reflection, or retrieval, without systematically converting realized outcomes into persistent updates to the joint orchestration policy governing later origins. To exploit this delayed feedback systematically, we introduce TimEvolve, a frozen-backbone time series agent that converts each realized outcome into persistent joint updates of expert trust, agent path selection, and intervention strength. A temporally ordered predict, reveal, and update protocol applies this feedback to subsequent forecasts. Experiments across eight Time-MMD domains show that TimEvolve achieves the best average MSE and MAE ranks among fifteen methods and the lowest errors on both metrics in seven domains. These results demonstrate the value of learning forecasting policies from the futures encountered during deployment.

</details>


### [819] [Exactness at Inference: A Representational Criterion for Out-of-Distribution Generalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24942)
*Filipe Marinho Rocha,Inês Dutra,Vítor Santos Costa,Luís Paulo Reis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 模型只有在计算与生成机制结构等价的表示时才能泛化到训练分布之外，近似拟合不行。该"精确性判据"约束推理而非训练，Tensor Logic 在 T=0 时满足，逻辑张量网络不满足。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有模型常通过拟合近似泛化，但拟合代理的残差在分布外会发散并在复合下累积。作者希望提出一个区分"真正泛化"与"表面拟合"的判据，解释为何等变模型某些轴失效、ARC-AGI 中归纳/演绎分裂等现象。

Method: 提出"精确可表示性"判据：模型在推理时须计算与生成机制结构等价的表示（无需离散表示或抽取表达式）。以零温张量收缩等价于离散逻辑为例（布尔张量、正交嵌入、仅算术连续），检验各类方法（Tensor Logic、可微 ILP、逻辑张量网络、阈值化神经网络）。并推导混合架构的传播规则：输出继承其路径上每个拟合估计器的误差界。

Result: Tensor Logic 在 T=0 与可微 ILP 通过判据；逻辑张量网络与阈值化神经网络不通过。区间 [0,1] 内的精确边缘分布通过。分片仿射外推发散与无法绑定新实体是精确可表示性不足的两个表现。在法则推导的划分上，精确假设类能找出 56.3% 可回答的远端查询，而集成方法以虚假置信度给出答案、距离度量排序相反。

Conclusion: 只有精确假设类才能认证训练数据未确定的部分。常见归纳偏置（对称性、记忆等）之所以达到精确性，是因为人类注入了它们。因此应诱导精确表示，而非拟合残差在分布外发散并且在复合下累积的代理模型。

Abstract: A model generalizes outside its training distribution only when it computes a representation structurally equivalent to the generating mechanism, not an approximation fitted to it. Such equivalence is necessary for exactness in and out of distribution, and extrapolation is governed by this exactness at inference, whatever its realization. Tensor Logic shows this: a zero-temperature contraction is equivalent to discrete logic, deducing in place with no artefact extracted, its tensors Boolean, its embeddings orthonormal, only its arithmetic continuous. Lacking infinite recursion it reaches Datalog, not Prolog, and though exact over closed domains it needs external memory to bind a novel entity. The criterion needs neither a discrete representation nor an extracted expression, and constrains inference, not training: an exact marginal in $[0,1]$ passes, a Neural Network thresholded to a hard label does not. Logic Tensor Networks fail it, while differentiable ILP and Tensor Logic at $T=0$ pass. Piecewise-affine extrapolation divergence and an inability to bind novel entities are two faces of a shortfall in exact representability. For hybrid architectures, a propagation rule follows: the output inherits the bounds of every fitted estimator on its path, explaining which axes fail in equivariant models and the ARC-AGI induction/transduction split. Only an exact hypothesis class certifies what the training data leave underdetermined: on a law-derived partition it finds the $56.3\%$ of distant queries that are answerable, which ensembles meet with false confidence and distance metrics rank backwards. Common inductive biases, from symmetries to memory, reach exactness only because humans inject them, an argument for inducing exact representations rather than fitting surrogates whose residuals, even at the arithmetic floor in training, diverge outside the data and compound under composition.

</details>


### [820] [Rare Event Estimation via Iterative Unalignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24969)
*Hanming Yang,Daksh Mittal,Jing Dong,Hongseok Namkoong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于权重扰动的重要采样方法，用可微语言模型作为提议分布，配合事件放大替代目标与自适应正则，估计智能体自身动作随机性引发的极稀有事件概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 智能体自主体增大后，其随机输出轨迹上极稀少事件也可能发生且后果严重。安全部署的关键在于估计此类事件发生的频率而非是否能发生。但这类风险需在组合爆炸的轨迹空间中搜索，朴素蒙特卡洛计算代价过高；而构造有效的IS提议需对依赖上下文的整条条件分布链做协调调整，十分困难。

Method: 提出新的重要采样方法，通过扰动原模型权重构造提议分布。该提议本身是一个可微参数化语言模型，从而可在权重空间做基于梯度的搜索。设计目标函数：将可微的事件放大代理目标与自适应正则化方案相结合，动态平衡放大效果与估计器稳定性。在约1.2亿与26亿参数模型上、三个事件族、300多个稀有事件（概率低至1e-9）上评估，参考概率由相对标准误差小于10%计算得到。

Result: 在最可验证的设置中，对于概率低于1e-7的事件，所提IS估计器相对朴素蒙特卡洛实现了超过800倍的计算加权效率提升。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 通过将提议分布本身参数化为可微语言模型并在权重空间做梯度搜索，可有效估计智能体动作随机性产生的极稀有事件概率，显著优于朴素蒙特卡洛，为智能体安全部署中的稀有风险评估提供了可行工具。

Abstract: As agents are deployed with increased autonomy, even extremely rare events along their stochastic output trajectories can occur and prove catastrophic. Safe deployment therefore does not depend on whether these events can occur, but on how often they might. We study the problem of estimating the probability of rare events that arise from stochastic variation in the agent's own actions. Estimating this type of risk requires searching over the combinatorially vast space of trajectories. Naive Monte Carlo is computationally prohibitive in this regime, and constructing effective importance sampling (IS) proposals requires coordinated changes to a context-dependent chain of conditional distributions. We develop a new IS method that perturbs the original model's weights to construct the proposal. The proposal is itself a differentiably parameterized language model, enabling gradient-based search over weight space. We formulate an objective that combines a differentiable surrogate for event amplification and an adaptive regularization scheme that dynamically balances amplification against estimator stability. We evaluate our approach on $\sim$120M and $\sim$2.6B models across three event families spanning 300+ rare events as rare as $10^{-9}$, with reference probabilities computed with $<10\%$ relative standard error. In our most verifiable settings, we observe that our IS estimator achieves over $800\times$ compute-weighted efficiency gains over naive Monte Carlo for events with probabilities lower than $10^{-7}$. Our implementation is available at https://github.com/namkoong-lab/iterative-unalignment.

</details>


### [821] [The Limits of Speculation: Bounding Speculative Decoding in Mixture-of-Experts](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22156)
*Aidar Amankulov,Denis Mamatin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究MoE模型投机解码中因专家加载依赖输入导致的验证代价不稳定问题，将其建模为离线随机最短路（SSP）问题并构建诊断性Oracle，在边际增量空间（Delta Space）中发现被拒绝候选形成严格线性边界，揭示了局部支配全局优化的必要条件。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MoE模型的投机解码面临验证代价随输入变化而不稳定的挑战，缺乏对"投机预算选择"这一过程内在机理（physics）的理解，导致难以设计有效的在线自适应启发式策略。

Method: 将投机预算选择形式化为参考序列上的离线随机最短路（SSP）问题；构建诊断性Oracle，利用反事实模拟（counterfactual simulation）精确刻画MoE的验证代价；在Qwen3-Coder与EAGLE-3配对上分析Oracle决策，并在边际增量空间（Delta Space）中考察其结构。

Result: 在Qwen3-Coder与EAGLE-3配对下，Delta Space中被拒绝的候选形成严格的线性边界，表明复杂的全局优化在局部受单一必要条件支配，即边际代价与期望进展之比（ΔE[Cost]/ΔE[a]）的平衡。

Conclusion: 该研究为理解MoE投机解码的验证代价机制提供了严谨的数学参考点，所得的必要条件可作为未来设计自适应在线启发式策略的理论依据。

Abstract: Speculative decoding in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models faces the problem of unstable verification cost caused by input-dependent expert loading. To study the physics of this process, we formulate speculation-budget selection as an offline Stochastic Shortest Path (SSP) problem over reference sequences and build a diagnostic Oracle that uses counterfactual simulation to account for MoE verification cost. A detailed analysis of the Oracle's decisions on the Qwen3-Coder and EAGLE-3 pairing, in the space of marginal deltas (Delta Space), shows that rejected candidates form a strict linear boundary. This result demonstrates that a complex global optimization is locally governed by a necessary condition balancing marginal cost against expected progress ($\frac{Δ\mathbb{E}[Cost]}{Δ\mathbb{E}[a]}$), providing a rigorous mathematical reference point for designing future adaptive online heuristics.

</details>


### [822] [UniGIO: Unified Generative Global In-situ Weather Modeling from Spatiotemporal Incomplete Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22217)
*Songru Yang,Zili Liu,Tao Han,Ben Fei,Lei Bai,Chang Liu,Zhengxia Zou,Xiangyang Ji,Wanli Ouyang,Zhenwei Shi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出UniGIO，一个直接从原生不完整全球地面观测数据建模天气动态的生成式框架，统一了预报、插补与生成任务，在Weather-5K数据集上取得SOTA性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球地面观测（GIO）提供稀疏站点的高精度直接记录，对局部与瞬态天气动态捕捉不可或缺，在数值天气预报、防灾减灾和农业等领域至关重要。但GIO存在强时空不完整性，严重影响准确、实时的地面天气建模。现有方法需等待补全为"AI-ready"数据并引入额外误差，因此需要直接从不完整GIO建模的方案。

Method: 提出UniGIO生成式框架，直接基于带掩码标注的观测数据生成缺失数据，在任意缺失率下统一预报、插补和生成。通过Observation Mixer与Event Aligner捕捉站点与区域级互补性，将离散观测扩散到连续空间；用Adaptive Temporal Mixer建立带模式迁移的时间依赖；用Mixture-of-Experts结构追踪混沌局部系统中的极端事件；解码器中的Local Refiner适配平稳与极端事件。

Result: 在迄今最大全球站点天气数据集Weather-5K上，UniGIO在准确性、保真度与极端事件捕捉上分别取得11%、12%和5%的优势，验证其SOTA性能。

Conclusion: UniGIO为GIO网络中的天气建模提供了新的整体性解决方案，可统一处理不完整观测下的多种下游任务。

Abstract: Global In-situ Observation (GIO) provides fine-scale, direct records of the global weather system from sparse point stations, making it an indispensable source for capturing localized and transient dynamics beyond the reach of satellite gridded data, and playing a critical role in key fields such as numerical weather prediction, disaster prevention, and agriculture. However, GIO exhibits strong spatiotemporal incompleteness, severely impairing accurate and real-time in-situ weather modeling. Unlike existing methods waiting for completed AI-ready data with extra introduced errors, in this work, we explore UniGIO, a novel generative framework for directly modeling global in-situ weather dynamics from native incomplete GIO. By generating missing data from observed ones annotated by masks, it unifies the coexisting forecasting, imputation, and generation under arbitrary missing ratios. Between the missing and observed, UniGIO captures station and region level complementarity through the Observation Mixer and Event Aligner, which diffuse discrete observations into continuous spaces where weather processes naturally span multiple stations. We further establish temporal dependencies with pattern shifts using the Adaptive Temporal Mixer, and track extreme events in chaotic local weather systems through a Mixture-ofExperts structure. Steady and extreme events are adapted in decoder by a Local Refiner. Extensive experiments on the up-todate largest global station weather dataset Weather-5K validate its SOTA performance with 11%, 12%, and 5% advantages on accuracy, fidelity, and extreme event capture, delivering a novel holistic solution for weather modeling in GIO networks.

</details>


### [823] [CNA: An AI-Oriented Comprehensive Normalized Assessment for Healthy Status and Application to Optimize RRT Strategies by Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22232)
*Jiang Liu,Chan Zhou,Yujie Li,Di Wu,Yihao Xie,Peiwei Li,Xin Shu,Jiaqi Zhu,Chunyong Yang,Yuwen Chen,Bin Yi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向AI的综合归一化评估指标CNA，将生命体征分布映射到标准正态空间生成健康评分，并结合离线强化学习优化肾脏替代治疗（RRT）策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全球数百万人依赖RRT维持生存，但患者动态异质、数据缺失以及缺乏面向AI的健康评估标准，使AI优化RRT策略面临挑战。

Method: 提出CNA：将生命体征分布变换到标准正态空间，以相对参考区间的偏离度定义统一的数据驱动健康评分，作为策略质量评估与RL终止准则；构建23维状态表示（19项指标+4项RRT描述符），并用矩阵分解重建缺失生命体征；将上述组件嵌入多种离线RL算法，在RRT特征子集上做系统消融实验。

Result: 与医生实际治疗相比，最优学习策略将死亡率从13.2%降至5.0%（降低62.24%），平均住院时长从308.5小时缩短至250.1小时（降低18.93%）。

Conclusion: CNA为健康状态提供统一可量化的评估标准，可作为离线RL的策略评价与终止依据；CNA引导的RL在肾脏病学RRT治疗中兼具方法创新性与改善预后的潜力。

Abstract: Millions worldwide require Renal Replacement Therapy (RRT) as a treatment essential for survival. However, optimizing RRT strategies via AI is challenging due to heterogeneous patient dynamics, missing data, and the absence of an AI-oriented health assessment criterion. We propose an AI-Oriented Comprehensive Normalized Assessment (CNA) for healthy status and apply it to optimize RRT strategies by using offline reinforcement learning (RL). The key idea of CNA is transforming vital-sign distributions into a standard normal space, enabling a unified, data-driven health-status score defined by deviations from referent intervals, which also provides an AI-oriented criterion to assess strategy quality and supports RL termination. We further design a structured 23-dimensional state representation that integrates 19 indicators with 4 RRT descriptors, and employ matrix decomposition to reconstruct missing vital signs, improving data completeness for learning. These components are incorporated into multiple offline RL algorithms and validated via systematic ablation studies on RRT feature subsets. Compared with physicians' observed treatments, the best learned strategy reduces mortality from 13.2% to 5.0% (reducing 62.24%) and shortens average in-hospital stay from 308.5 to 250.1 hours (reducing 18.93%), demonstrating both methodological innovation and the potential of CNA-guided RL to improve RRT outcomes in nephrology.

</details>


### [824] [Statistical Inference for Adversarial Training: Central Limit Theorems via Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22240)
*Kim Jakwang,Kwon Dohyun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文严格量化了对抗训练分类模型的统计与学习理论性质，等价地建立了经验最优部分传输的统计性质，核心给出两类中心极限定理，并得到鞍点稳定性、样本复杂度与泛化误差集中概率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗训练模型的统计与学习理论性质此前缺乏严格的量化刻画，而这类模型与经验最优部分传输（empirical optimal partial transport）等价，因此有必要从其统计性质入手进行严格分析。

Method: 基于最优部分传输等价形式中最优势函数的唯一性，并结合经验过程理论论证，证明两类中心极限定理：一是以经验期望值为中心，二是以带平滑的总体值为中心；在二分类情形下，利用最优部分传输与导出的多边际最优传输公式之间的联系证明最优势的唯一性。

Result: 得到了以经验期望值和以带平滑总体值为中心的两类中心极限定理；在二分类设定下证明了最优势的唯一性；作为副产品，还获得了对抗训练模型鞍点的稳定性，以及泛化误差的样本复杂度与集中概率。

Conclusion: 该工作为对抗训练分类模型及经验最优部分传输提供了严格的统计理论基础，所建立的中心极限定理、唯一性、鞍点稳定性及泛化误差界，为进一步分析对抗训练的统计与学习性质提供了工具。

Abstract: The purpose of this paper is to rigorously quantify the statistical and learning-theoretic properties of adversarial training models for classification. Equivalently, we establish the statistical properties of empirical optimal partial transport. Precisely, first we provide two types of central limit theorems (CLT): CLT centered at the expected empirical value, and CLT centered at the population one with smoothing. These results are based on the uniqueness of optimal potential for various equivalent optimal transport formulations, and the empirical process theory argument. For the binary setting, we indeed prove the uniqueness of optimal potential by leveraging the connection between optimal partial transport and the derived multi-marginal optimal transport formula. As byproducts, we also obtain the stability of a saddle point of the adversarial training model, and the sample complexity and concentration probability of the generalization error.

</details>


### [825] [Classification with Abstention Under Class-Conditional Error Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22632)
*Mohammadreza M. Kalan,Yuyang Deng,Sanaz Hamidi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究带弃权的二分类问题，在分别约束两类条件误差的前提下最小化弃权率，刻画了与假设类复杂度及样本量相关的分布无关极小极大超额弃权风险率，并提出替代损失框架、有限样本保证、凸情形下的约束优化复杂度分析，并在多个数据集上验证。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在许多风险敏感场景中，两类错误需分别满足给定阈值而非仅优化总体错误，同时希望尽量少弃权；已有工作缺乏对此设定下最优学习速率的刻画以及可用于神经网络等模型的可行计算框架。

Method: 将问题建模为带两类条件误差约束的二元分类弃权学习；用分布无关极小极大分析刻画超额弃权风险率（至多差对数因子）；引入替代损失（surrogate-loss）公式并给出超额替代歧义风险的有限样本保证；将学习任务表述为约束优化问题，并在凸设定下分析其计算复杂度。

Result: 在假设类复杂度和样本量方面，得到了（至多对数因子）最优的分布无关极小极大超额弃权风险率；给出了替代目标的有限样本泛化保证及凸情形下约束优化的复杂度刻画；在多个数据集上进行了实证评估并与竞争方法比较。

Conclusion: 该工作为带分离误差约束的分类弃权学习提供了统计最优性刻画与可计算替代框架，理论上连接极小极大风险率与替代损失泛化，实践上便于与神经网络等模型结合，并通过实验验证了方法的有效性。

Abstract: We study binary classification with abstention under separate class-conditional error constraints, with the objective of minimizing abstention while keeping both errors below prescribed thresholds. We characterize the distribution-free minimax rate of excess abstention risk, up to logarithmic factors, in terms of the complexity of the hypothesis class and the sample size. To make the framework amenable to computation with models such as neural networks, we introduce surrogate-loss formulations and derive finite-sample guarantees for excess surrogate ambiguity risk. We formulate the resulting learning task as a constrained optimization problem and characterize its computational complexity in the convex setting. Finally, we evaluate our approach on various datasets and compare its performance with a competing method for this problem.

</details>


### [826] [Monotone-Constrained Diffusion Models for Long-Horizon Production Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22643)
*Temesgen Mikael Abraha,Yves Lucet*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Physics-SIMS-TS 条件扩散预测器，用于油气产量长期预测，通过负向引导、递减曲线约束与等渗投影保证单调性，在三辖区 3.5 万余口井上精度领先于同类扩散模型，与集成 Transformer 相当，单调性代价不超过 0.5% MSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仅凭序列最初少量观测进行长时程预测本质上是不适定问题：同一段短历史对应多条可能轨迹。油气产量预测中，约在井生产寿命前五分之一后做出的预测会驱动开发与弃井决策，且可用预测必须呈单调递减，因此需要同时处理预测不确定性与物理可行性约束。

Method: 提出 Physics-SIMS-TS 条件扩散预测器，包含四类机制：针对合成伪影的负向引导（negative guidance）；递减曲线约束与采样过程中的等渗投影（isotonic projection）；空间训练增强；以及集成式随机采样器以输出完整预测分布。另提出骨干网络的可逆实例归一化（reversible instance normalization）变体。评估采用共享空间、验证集冻结的统一协议，覆盖三个辖区、超过 35,000 口井。

Result: 在该协议下，Physics-SIMS-TS 是同组对比中最准确的扩散预测器，与集成 Transformer 预测器相比具有竞争力但并不占优；其预测在构造上即满足单调性，MSE 代价最多 0.5%；轨迹集成经每个辖区拟合一个离散因子后给出校准区间；在六个标准基准上，骨干的可逆实例归一化变体是最佳扩散基线；并量化了四项影响排序结果的协议选择。

Conclusion: 在长期油气产量预测中，将物理约束（单调递减）直接嵌入扩散采样可在极小精度损失下保证预测可行性，并获得校准的预测区间；扩散模型在该任务上可媲美但尚未超越集成 Transformer 基线。研究同时表明，评测协议中的若干选择会显著左右模型排名，提示需谨慎设定与冻结验证协议。代码与评测工件已公开。

Abstract: Forecasting a long horizon from only the first observations of a sequence is ill-posed: many trajectories are consistent with the same short history. We study this problem in oil and gas production forecasting, where forecasts made after roughly the first fifth of a well's producing life drive development and abandonment decisions, and where a usable forecast must describe a monotone decline. We present Physics-SIMS-TS, a conditional diffusion forecaster that combines negative guidance against synthetic artifacts, decline-curve constraints and an isotonic projection applied during sampling, spatial training augmentation, and an ensembled stochastic sampler yielding a full predictive distribution. Across three jurisdictions and more than 35,000 wells, under a shared-space, validation-frozen protocol, Physics-SIMS-TS is the most accurate diffusion forecaster in the comparison and is competitive with, but not superior to, ensembled transformer forecasters. Its forecasts are monotone by construction at a cost of at most 0.5% in mean squared error, and its trajectory ensemble yields calibrated intervals after one dispersion factor is fitted per jurisdiction. On six standard benchmarks a reversible-instance-normalization variant of the backbone is the leading diffusion baseline. We also quantify four protocol choices on which the measured ranking depends. Code and evaluation artifacts are released.

</details>


### [827] [Multi-Armed Bernoulli Bandits via Minimax Single-Arm Stopping](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22690)
*Huikang Liu,Zhengchao Wang,Daniel Kuhn,Wolfram Wiesemann*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于单臂老虎机（SAB）问题的极小极大解，提出一种有限时域伯努利多臂老虎机的索引策略，并证明其上界为 $4.45\sqrt{KT}+10.75K$ 的无分布遗憾界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有伯努利多臂老虎机问题需要达到极小极大最优遗憾阶，而如何在有限时域下构造简单且具有理论保证的索引策略仍具挑战。作者希望从单臂问题的极小极大解出发，导出具有直观比较意义的索引，从而兼顾理论最优性与实际性能。

Method: 将单臂伯努利问题（未知臂 vs. 已知奖励）的worst-case regret最小化问题化为精确的半无限线性规划，得到最优停止策略；据此定义基于累积延续概率的索引，并加入单调调整与奖励短缺上限。通过将索引误差与单臂停止策略遗憾相联系，导出遗憾界，并借助伯努利随机化扩展到 $[0,1]$ 奖励，同时给出有限网格实现及近似损失量化。

Result: 得到无分布遗憾界 $4.45\sqrt{KT}+10.75K$，与文献中的极小极大最优遗憾阶一致；有限网格实现有可量化的近似损失。数值实验中，该索引策略在所有测试的臂数与时域下均优于所有基准策略的worst-case regret，在双臂设定下接近基于网格的MAB极小极大策略。

Conclusion: 从单臂极小极大解导出的索引策略兼具理论最优遗憾阶与良好实证表现，为有限时域伯努利多臂老虎机提供了一种有原则且实用的方法。

Abstract: We develop an index policy for finite-horizon Bernoulli multi-armed bandits from minimax solutions to single-arm bandit (SAB) problems. Each SAB problem involves choosing between an unknown Bernoulli arm and a known reward. We show that minimizing worst-case regret of SAB problems over all non-anticipative policies admits an exact semi-infinite linear programming formulation. The resulting stopping policies offer a natural way to compare arms: the higher the known reward against which a policy continues sampling, the more promising the unknown arm. We turn this intuition into indices based on cumulative continuation probabilities, with a monotone adjustment and a reward-shortfall cap. By relating index errors to the regret of single-arm stopping policies, we establish a distribution-free regret bound of $4.45\sqrt{KT}+10.75K$ for $K$ arms and horizon $T$. This bound matches the minimax-optimal regret order established in the literature. The guarantee extends to rewards supported on $[0,1]$ through Bernoulli randomization. We also provide a finite-grid implementation with quantified approximation loss. In numerical experiments, the SAB-based index policy achieves lower worst-case regret than every tested benchmark policy across all evaluated numbers of arms and horizons, while closely matching the grid-based MAB minimax policy in the two-arm setting.

</details>


### [828] [On attention heads and bilinear forms](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22990)
*Andrew O'Desky*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究训练后大语言模型注意力头中双线性形式的对称与反对称部分，提出正交不变剖面映射，发现训练后的双线性形式剖面聚集于秩一双线性形式的剖面附近，并证明在Zariski稠密子集上注意力头中双线性形式的对称部分是双曲形式与零形式之和。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 探究训练后大语言模型注意力头中双线性形式（由query-key矩阵诱导）的内在代数结构，理解其为何呈现低秩或特殊形态，从而为注意力机制的可解释性与理论刻画提供代数几何视角。

Method: 将双线性形式分解为对称部分与反对称部分；构造一个正交不变（orthogonally invariant）的剖面映射，将实双线性形式映到三维单纯形上，以此刻画其结构特征；并结合代数几何工具（Zariski稠密性）对对称部分进行分类分析。

Result: 实验观察显示，训练后双线性形式的剖面集中聚集在秩一双线性形式对应剖面的附近；理论上证明了对于query-key矩阵的一个Zariski稠密子集，注意力头中双线性形式的对称部分可表示为双曲形式（hyperbolic form）与零形式（zero form）之和。

Conclusion: 训练后注意力头中的双线性形式具有显著的低秩偏好与特殊代数结构，其对称部分在一般情形下可被分解为双曲形式与零形式，这为理解注意力机制提供了新的几何与代数刻画框架。

Abstract: We study the symmetric and antisymmetric parts of bilinear forms in the attention heads of trained large language models. We introduce an orthogonally invariant profile map from real bilinear forms to a three-dimensional simplex and observe that profiles of trained bilinear forms accumulate near profiles of rank-one bilinear forms. We prove that the symmetric part of a bilinear form in an attention head is the sum of a hyperbolic form and a zero form for a Zariski-dense subset of query-key matrices.

</details>


### [829] [Decoupled Causal Discovery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23535)
*Zhengkang Guan,Fei Wu,Kun Kuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出解耦因果发现方法DCD，通过加权函数解耦非目标变量以直接识别马尔可夫边界，并迭代构建CPDAG，具有理论可识别性与完备性，在噪声环境下表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有因果发现方法主要依赖条件独立性检验、结构评分或受限的函数假设，存在局限性，本文希望摆脱这些方法框架。

Method: DCD基于解耦视角，利用加权函数解耦非目标变量，使解耦分布下仅马尔可夫边界内变量与目标保持依赖关系，从而直接识别MB；并利用MB内的结构不对称性迭代构建CPDAG。

Result: 建立了DCD的理论可识别性、可靠性与完备性；实证评估显示DCD性能强劲，尤其在具有挑战性的噪声环境中表现突出。

Conclusion: DCD提供了一种不依赖条件独立性检验、结构评分或函数假设的新型因果发现思路，理论与实验均验证了其有效性。

Abstract: Causal discovery from observational data is a fundamental yet challenging task in scientific research. While existing approaches are primarily based on conditional independence tests, structure scores, or restrictive functional assumptions, we propose Decoupled Causal Discovery (DCD), a novel decoupling-based perspective that does not rely on these methodologies. DCD directly identifies the Markov boundary (MB) by decoupling non-target variables via weighting functions, such that only variables within the MB preserve dependence with the target under the decoupled distribution. Building on this, DCD iteratively constructs the Completed Partially Directed Acyclic Graph (CPDAG) by exploiting structural asymmetries within the MBs. We establish the theoretical identifiability, soundness, and completeness of DCD. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that DCD achieves strong performance, particularly excelling in challenging noise regimes.

</details>


### [830] [Iterative Atom Refinement: A Monotonicity Principle for Dictionary Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23812)
*Alexander Christie,Miguel Moscoso,Alexei Novikov,George Papanicolaou,Chrysoula Tsogka*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出迭代原子精炼（IAR）算法，用于从稀疏观测中恢复字典原子，并给出严格收敛理论，证明仅需三步即可识别生成原子。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 字典学习需从观测 y_i = A x_i 中恢复未知字典 A，现有方法缺乏对单原子恢复过程严格的收敛性保证。

Method: IAR 从随机方向出发，反复选取与当前迭代最相关的观测，并对选取数据求平均来更新方向；理论分析采用高维概率估计与新颖的原子选取概率单调性原理。

Result: 理论证明：原子的微小初始优势会被逐步放大直至该原子被孤立；在模型假设下，IAR 仅经三步精炼即可识别一个生成原子。数值实验支持理论，且动力学行为与字典精炼中的观察一致。

Conclusion: IAR 为字典原子恢复提供了一种简单且具严格收敛保证的方法，三步内即可识别生成原子，理论与实验相符。

Abstract: Dictionary learning seeks to recover an unknown dictionary $A$ from observations ${\bf y}_i = A{\bf x}_i$ with sparse coefficient vectors ${\bf x}_i$. We introduce the \emph{Iterative Atom Refinement} (IAR) algorithm, a simple procedure for recovering individual dictionary atoms. Starting from a random direction, IAR repeatedly selects the observations most strongly correlated with the current iterate and updates the direction by averaging the selected data. Our main contribution is a rigorous convergence theory of IAR. Using high-dimensional probabilistic estimates and a novel monotonicity principle for atom-selection probabilities, we show that a small initial advantage of one atom is amplified until that atom is isolated. Under our model assumptions, IAR identifies a generating atom after only three refinement steps. Numerical experiments support the theory and show that the resulting dynamics accurately capture the behavior observed in dictionary refinement.

</details>


### [831] [A Distributional Optimisation Perspective on Combining Models in Deep Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24328)
*Congye Wang,Yan Lin,Zheyang Shen,Matthew A. Fisher,Chris. J. Oates*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将集成（ensemble）与低秩适配器平均（adapter averaging）统一为熵正则化的分布式优化问题：集成情形下目标为凸，适配器平均情形下非凸，因此平均场Langevin动力学的收敛保证只适用于前者。作者评估了现有与新颖算法（含函数型变分梯度下降），并在合成分类任务与大语言模型常识推理微调上进行了实证研究。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组合多个模型的预测通常能提升机器学习任务性能，但个体模型的训练与组合规则往往被分开设计且依赖经验性（ad hoc）手段，缺乏原则性的联合训练框架。分布式优化近年进展提供了将模型集合视为离散分布、对其支撑点进行优化的可能性，但此类方法在该任务上的潜力尚不明确。

Method: （1）将两种标准组合策略——集成与低秩适配器平均——表述为熵正则化的分布式优化，分析目标函数的凸性：集成情形为凸，适配器平均情形非凸，故平均场Langevin动力学的既有收敛保证仅能迁移至前者；（2）评估针对该任务的现有与新颖算法，包括变分梯度下降的函数型变体；（3）开展实证研究，涵盖合成分类任务以及在常识推理基准上对大语言模型的微调。

Result: 集成情形下的目标函数被证明为凸，因此可继承平均场Langevin动力学的收敛保证；适配器平均情形目标非凸，收敛保证无法直接迁移。论文提出并评估了包括函数型变分梯度下降在内的新算法，并通过合成分类任务与常识推理基准上的大语言模型微调实验给出实证结果。

Conclusion: 将模型组合统一为熵正则化分布式优化，为模型的联合训练提供了原则性框架；但其理论保证的适用范围受目标凸性限制——仅集成情形可迁移现有收敛结果，适配器平均则需新的分析。实证表明所提算法在合成任务与大语言模型微调中具有有效性。

Abstract: Combining predictions from different models can improve performance at machine learning tasks, but the training of the individual models and the rule used to combine them are typically chosen separately, and by ad hoc means. Recent advances in distributional optimisation (i.e. where the optimisation occurs over the set of probability distributions) offer an opportunity for principled joint training, viewing the collection of models as a discrete distribution whose support points are to be optimised, but the potential of these methods is not well-understood. In this paper we (1) cast two standard combination strategies - ensembles and low-rank adapter averaging - as entropy-regularised distributional optimisation, observing that the resulting objective is convex in the ensemble case but not in the adapter-averaging case, so that existing convergence guarantees for mean field Langevin dynamics transfer only to the former; (2) assess existing and novel algorithms for this task, including a functional variant of variational gradient descent; and (3) report an empirical study spanning synthetic classification tasks and fine-tuning of large language models on a commonsense reasoning benchmark.

</details>


### [832] [Prior-Amortized In-Context Bayesian Inference for Generalized Linear Mixed-Effects Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24422)
*Alex Kipnis,Marcel Binz,Eric Schulz*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: metabeta是一个预训练神经网络，实现GLMM的先验摊销上下文贝叶斯推断，测试时可接受先验族与超参数输入，实现零样本泛化；通过Independence Metropolis-Hastings修正或warm-start NUTS，速度比NUTS快2-3个数量级且推断结果一致。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 层次数据在实证科学中普遍存在，常用GLMM分析。GLMM的贝叶斯推断虽能给出校准的不确定性，但依赖MCMC；NUTS作为金标准速度慢，且每遇新数据集、模型或先验都需从头重启，缺乏摊销能力。

Method: 提出metabeta预训练神经网络，用于GLMM的先验摊销上下文贝叶斯推断。与训练时固定先验的神经后验估计器不同，其在测试时接受先验族与超参数作为输入，实现零样本泛化。用两个set transformer和条件归一化流映射后验的两层结构（跨组共享的全局参数、每组局部参数）。在覆盖连续、二值和计数结果的数百万模拟数据集上训练。默认用Independence Metropolis-Hastings对未归一化后验修正流后验，正确性由采样器保证；也可用流warm-start NUTS。

Result: 在带真值参数的受控基准上，metabeta在参数恢复、校准和样本外预测上与NUTS相当；调参免费，推断速度比NUTS快2-3个数量级。在分布外真实数据集上，其各类型参数后验与NUTS高度一致，且在似然与先验误设、分布外预测变量、共线设计和数据稀缺情形下仍保持可靠。warm-start NUTS可获得几乎相同推断，同时显著提升速度与稳定性。

Conclusion: metabeta为GLMM提供了快速、免调参且校准良好的摊销贝叶斯推断，兼具NUTS级精度与显著加速，在多种挑战性场景下稳健，模型开源开放权重，可立即部署。

Abstract: Hierarchical data is ubiquitous in the empirical sciences and is most commonly analyzed with generalized linear mixed-effects models (GLMMs). Bayesian inference for GLMMs yields calibrated uncertainty but requires MCMC; the No-U-Turn Sampler (NUTS) is the gold standard but is slow and must restart from scratch for every new dataset, model and prior. We introduce metabeta, a pretrained neural network for prior-amortized in-context Bayesian inference over GLMMs. Unlike previous neural posterior estimators that fix the prior at training time, metabeta accepts prior families and hyperparameters as inputs at test time, enabling zero-shot generalization. Two set transformers and conditional normalizing flows mirror the posterior's two-level structure (global parameters shared across groups, local parameters per group). The model is trained on millions of realistic simulated datasets spanning continuous, binary, and count outcomes. By default, the flow posterior is refined by Independence Metropolis-Hastings against the unnormalized posterior, so its correctness rests on the sampler rather than the network; this yields tuning-free inference two to three orders of magnitude faster than NUTS. Alternatively, the flow can warm-start NUTS, giving nearly identical inference with substantially increased speed and stability. On controlled benchmarks with ground-truth parameters, metabeta matches NUTS in parameter recovery, calibration and out-of-sample prediction. On out-of-distribution real datasets, its posteriors closely match those of NUTS across all parameter types, and they remain faithful under misspecified likelihoods and priors, out-of-distribution predictors, collinear designs, and data-poor regimes. The model is open-source and open-weights and thus immediately deployable.

</details>


### [833] [A Shared Learning Rate Is Not a Neutral Control in Selective On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22109)
*Chencheng Zhu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 选择性on-policy蒸馏中，选择器比较结果与学习率强耦合（"选择器-学习率纠缠"），应报告"臂×学习率"矩阵而非单一共享学习率列。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文献在比较选择性蒸馏选择器时，均使用同一共享学习率作为"中性"控制变量。本文质疑这一控制假设的合理性，认为该设置可能系统性扭曲选择器之间的比较结论。

Method: 在GSM8K上以LoRA微调Qwen2.5-1.5B学生、7B教师，在8倍学习率网格上对比密集监督与多种选择性监督（随机5%子集、全变差选择器、可教性选择器）。并通过预注册的冻结评分消融实验（用初始学生打分、12种子/单元）分离反馈回路与选择本身的作用；另在全量微调（1e-6~1e-5）与MATH-500上进行验证。

Result: 密集监督对学习率不敏感（波动1.8 pp，p=0.26），而选择性方法波动显著：随机5%为5.4 pp、TV选择器6.7 pp、可教性选择器高达17.7 pp。密集vs选择性判定在lr=1e-4为10.1 pp，在5e-5为5.1 pp，相差2.0倍；6组选择器两两显著性检验中有2组在相邻学习率间翻转而无秩反转。AdamW更新幅度与学习率误差在2.2%内，但各臂梯度范数相差15.5倍，表明源于选择机制而非步长。冻结评分消融显示实时评分额外贡献3.79±1.69 pp的学习率敏感性（p=0.035），冻结臂仍显著纠缠（p=0.015）。全量微调下密集波动19.8 pp、选择性波动49.5 pp，判定从+3.6 pp（不显著）变至+34 pp（p=0.005）。MATH-500上LoRA未复现该依赖，但选择性训练约10 pp的性能代价可复现。

Conclusion: 选择性蒸馏的选择器比较受学习率纠缠严重影响，共享学习率并非中性控制；反馈回路会加剧而非引发该现象。建议将报告"臂×学习率"矩阵作为选择器比较的前提条件。

Abstract: Selective on-policy distillation trains a student only at the token positions a selector scores highest, and the literature compares selectors under a single shared learning rate--a control chosen to be neutral. We show it is not. Under LoRA on GSM8K (Qwen2.5-1.5B student, 7B teacher), across an 8x learning-rate grid, dense supervision is statistically flat (swing 1.8 pp, p=0.26) while every selective arm moves with the rate: 5.4 pp for a random 5% subset, 6.7 pp for a total-variation selector, up to 17.7 pp for a teachability selector. Consequently the dense-versus-selective verdict reads 10.1 pp at lr=1e-4 but 5.1 pp at 5e-5--a 2.0x difference decided by a parameter the protocol treats as scenery--and two of six pairwise significance calls between selectors flip between adjacent rates without any rank inversion. We call this selector-rate entanglement and trace it to selection itself rather than step size: AdamW update magnitudes track the rate to within 2.2% despite 15.5x gradient-norm differences across arms. A preregistered frozen-scoring ablation (selection scored by the initial student; criterion, budget, and on-policy rollouts unchanged; 12 seeds per cell) shows live scoring adds 3.79+/-1.69 pp of rate sensitivity (p=0.035) while the frozen arm remains significantly entangled (p=0.015): the feedback loop aggravates the phenomenon rather than causing it. Under full fine-tuning at the rates this literature actually uses (1e-6 to 1e-5) the pattern grows: dense itself swings 19.8 pp, the selective arm 49.5 pp, and the verdict ranges from a non-significant +3.6 pp at the published operating point to +34 pp (p=0.005) one notch hotter. On MATH-500 the rate dependence does not reproduce under LoRA, scoping that result, while the ~10 pp cost of selective training does. We prescribe reporting the arm x rate matrix, not a shared-rate column, as a precondition for selector comparisons.

</details>


### [834] [Toward Fairness in Machine Learning Models for Predicting Treatment Retention and Premature Discontinuation in Medication for Opioid Use Disorder](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22113)
*Tongnian Wang,Carolina Vivas-Valencia,Cici Bauer,Yanmin Gong,Kim-Kwang Raymond Choo,Yuanxiong Guo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本研究系统评估了预测阿片类药物使用障碍药物治疗（MOUD）保留与提前脱落的机器学习模型的算法公平性，并检验了偏见缓解技术的效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: MOUD的保留率与完成率长期偏低，促使研究者使用机器学习模型预测保留情况并识别提前脱落的患者，但这些模型在不同患者群体间的公平性尚缺乏探索，引发其在治疗决策支持中应用的担忧。

Method: 使用2015—2019年美国出院个体治疗事件数据集TEDS-D，针对接受门诊MOUD的个体训练四种机器学习模型，预测提前治疗脱落及保留超过180天；按种族、族裔、年龄和性别划分患者子群，评估整体性能与子群错误率，辅以模型解释分析，并评估偏见缓解技术对公平性与预测性能的影响。

Result: 即使整体预测性能看似可接受，ML模型在MOUD结局预测中仍可能存在子群层面的性能差距；偏见缓解技术可缩小这些差距，但无法完全消除，且存在权衡。

Conclusion: 研究强调了公平性感知评估与子群性能透明报告的重要性，为MOUD治疗场景中机器学习模型用于风险分层和护理优先级排序的负责任、情境敏感应用提供了实践启示。

Abstract: Persistent low retention and completion rates in medications for opioid use disorder (MOUD) have driven the use of machine learning (ML) models to predict retention and identify patients at risk of premature discontinuation. However, the fairness of these models across patient populations remains largely unexplored, raising concerns about their application in treatment decision support. This study systematically assesses algorithmic fairness in ML models for predicting MOUD retention and premature discontinuation and investigates the effectiveness of bias mitigation techniques. Using the cross-sectional Treatment Episode Data Set-Discharges (TEDS-D), which includes treatment episodes for individuals in the U.S. discharged between 2015 and 2019, we trained four ML models to predict premature treatment discontinuation and retention beyond 180 days among individuals receiving outpatient MOUD. We evaluated overall performance and subgroup-level error rates across patient subgroups defined by race, ethnicity, age, and sex, complemented by model explanation analyses. We further assessed bias mitigation techniques and their effects on both fairness and predictive performance. Our findings demonstrate that ML models for MOUD outcome prediction can exhibit subgroup-level performance gaps even when overall predictive performance appears acceptable and that bias mitigation can reduce, but not fully eliminate, these gaps without trade-offs. By demonstrating the importance of fairness-aware evaluation and transparent reporting of subgroup performance, this study provides practical insights for the responsible and context-sensitive use of ML models for risk stratification and care prioritization in MOUD treatment settings.

</details>


### [835] [ZoAQ: Adaptive Zeroth-Order Querying via Query-Reuse Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22115)
*Yangyang Feng,Yao Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ZoAQ是一种基于查询复用的自适应零阶优化方法，通过让历史评估同时服务于下一步更新与是否继续查询的决策，实现无需额外验证查询的自适应查询分配。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 零阶优化中扰动查询是主要成本：固定预算在每步使用相同查询数，而自适应控制器可能因额外调用预言机测试估计可靠性而抵消节省，因此需要一种不引入额外验证查询的自适应分配机制。

Method: ZoAQ不丢弃每步之后的过往函数评估，而是将其复用于下一次更新以及“是否进一步查询”的判断；并通过理论分析刻画这种一致性何时能识别出支持下降的更新，并据此将控制器引导至足够的查询预算。

Result: 在合成目标上，相较固定基线（1.2M查询）减少43–48%查询；在黑盒攻击中，MNIST与CIFAR-10分别以平均320和625次查询达到100%成功率；在四种OPT微调设置中，相较固定K=4节省43–46%前向评估，任务内准确率变化范围为-0.018至+0.010。

Conclusion: 查询复用可同时支撑更新与查询分配决策，使ZoAQ在不增加验证查询的前提下显著降低查询/前向评估开销，并在合成优化、黑盒攻击与大模型微调任务上保持性能。

Abstract: Zeroth-order optimization (ZOO) estimates updates from function evaluations, making perturbation queries a primary cost. Fixed budgets spend the same number of queries at every step, while adaptive controllers may offset their savings by using additional oracle calls to test estimator reliability. We introduce ZoAQ, an adaptive ZOO method built around query reuse. Rather than discarding past evaluations after each step, ZoAQ makes them useful for both the next update and the decision to query further. This enables adaptive query allocation without extra validation queries. Our analysis characterizes when this agreement identifies an update that supports descent and guides the controller to a sufficient query budget. On synthetic objectives, ZoAQ reduces queries by 43-48% relative to fixed baselines using 1.2M queries. In black-box attacks, it reaches 100% success with 320 and 625 average queries on MNIST and CIFAR-10, respectively. Across four OPT fine-tuning settings, ZoAQ saves 43-46% forward evaluations relative to fixed K=4, with accuracy changes within tasks ranging from -0.018 to +0.010.

</details>


### [836] [LE4Mob: Towards Inductive, Distance-Aware and General-Purpose Location Embedding for Human Mobility Modelling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22117)
*Xinglei Wang,Stephen Law,Zichao Zeng,Junyuan Liu,Guangsheng Dong,Tao Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出LE4Mob：一种归纳式、距离感知、地理来源的位置嵌入框架，用于人类移动建模，在未见位置和跨任务迁移中表现优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有位置嵌入依赖移动观测数据，无法表示未见位置，且对地理距离约束较弱，限制了跨数据集与跨任务的复用。

Method: 扩展对比式语言-位置预训练，引入距离感知正则项，使嵌入空间保留空间关系；基于地理语境预训练，可归纳生成未见位置的嵌入，且不依赖下游移动任务监督。

Result: 在个体级下一位置预测与群体级通勤流生成任务上，跨多个数据集和研究区域，LE4Mob优于强基线，在归纳设定及下游模型直接依赖嵌入交互时优势尤为明显。

Conclusion: 距离感知、地理来源的位置表示可作为人类移动建模的可复用基础。

Abstract: Location representations provide mobility models with fundamental information about the spatial position, functional characteristics, and relationships of places. However, existing embeddings are often dependent on mobility observations, unable to represent unseen locations, and weakly constrained to retain geographic distance. This limits their reuse across datasets and mobility tasks. To address these limitations, we propose LE4Mob, an inductive, distance-aware, and geography-derived location embedding framework for mobility modelling. LE4Mob extends contrastive language-location pre-training while introducing a distance-aware regularisation objective that encourages the embedding space to preserve spatial relationships. Pre-trained from geographic context, LE4Mob can encode rich spatial-semantic information and generate embeddings for unseen locations inductively. Its independence from downstream mobility task supervision also makes it transferable across different mobility tasks. We evaluate LE4Mob on individual-level next location prediction and population-level commuter flow generation. Experiments across multiple datasets and study areas show that LE4Mob outperforms strong baselines, with particular advantages in inductive settings and when downstream models rely directly on interactions between location embeddings. These findings demonstrate the potential of distance-aware, geography-derived location representations as reusable foundations for human mobility modelling.

</details>


### [837] [Modelling daily activity patterns from mobile phone location data via deep representation learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22121)
*Xinglei Wang,Junyuan Liu,Guangsheng Dong,Zichao Zeng,Stephen Law,James Haworth,Tao Cheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出Activity Chain Encoder（ACE），一种自监督模型，将预训练城市嵌入与停留时间、时长结合，用Transformer建模停留序列，并借助掩码活动建模与身份引导对比学习，在无确定性活动目的标签条件下学习日常活动表征，用于从被动收集的手机位置数据中挖掘活动模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 被动收集的手机位置数据虽能提供大规模、纵向的人类移动性观测，但无法直接揭示活动目的；而访问地点的功能特征虽提供情境信息，其与活动目的的关系在混合使用的城市环境中仍不确定。因此需要一种无需确定性活动目的标签、能从无标注手机位置数据中导出具有行为意义的人群活动模式的方法。

Method: 将活动模式挖掘概念化为表示、聚类与解释三个集成阶段，并在表示阶段提出ACE。ACE为自监督模型，融合预训练城市嵌入与访问时间、停留时长，使用Transformer建模停留的序列组织，通过掩码活动建模和身份引导对比学习训练，无需确定性活动目的标签。学习到的日表征聚合为用户级画像后进行聚类，并通过时间-功能模式及人口普查衍生的人口统计情境进行解释。

Result: 将该方法应用于伦敦的手机应用位置数据，并与三种代表性方法比较，ACE支持识别出六个差异化的工作日活动模式组，这些组具有不同的日节律、城市功能情境与人口统计关联。

Conclusion: 这些互补证据进一步支持构建基于实证的活动模式人物画像（personas），为从无标注手机位置数据中导出具有行为意义的人群模式建立了整体性路径。研究开发的完整分析流程源代码已在 https://github.com/xlwang233/ACE 公开。

Abstract: Passively collected mobile phone location data provide large-scale, longitudinal observations of human mobility but do not directly reveal activity purposes. The functional characteristics of visited locations offer useful contextual information, yet their relationship with activity purpose remains uncertain, particularly in mixed-use urban environments. We conceptualise activity pattern mining as an integrated process of representation, clustering, and interpretation, and propose the Activity Chain Encoder (ACE) for the representation stage. ACE is a self-supervised model that combines pre-trained urban embeddings with visit timing and duration and uses a Transformer to model the sequential organisation of stays. It is trained using masked activity modelling and identity-guided contrastive learning without requiring deterministic activity purpose labels. Learned daily representations are aggregated into user-level profiles, clustered, and interpreted through temporal-functional patterns and Census-derived demographic context. Applied to mobile phone app location data from London and compared with three representative methods, ACE supports the identification of six differentiated weekday activity-pattern groups characterised by distinct daily rhythms, urban functional contexts, and demographic associations. These complementary forms of evidence further support the development of empirically grounded activity-pattern personas, establishing a holistic route for deriving behaviourally meaningful population patterns from unlabelled mobile phone location data. The source code for the entire analytical pipeline developed in this study is publicly available at https://github.com/xlwang233/ACE.

</details>


### [838] [Rank Portability Does Not Imply Feasibility Portability: Target-Specific Evaluation of Joint Hardware Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22122)
*Wesley Shu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文检验"跨设备架构排序可迁移即代理设备可支持目标端模型选择"这一假设，发现排序可迁移性与联合延迟-能耗可行性可迁移性相互分离，代理复用存在高可行性违规风险。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨设备硬件评估常假设架构排序在设备间可迁移，从而可用代理设备替代目标设备进行模型选择。作者认为这一假设在联合延迟-能耗可行性场景下未被严格检验，需要压力测试其边界失效原因。

Method: 在两个公开架构族上开展实验：NAS-Bench-201上进行跨设备排序相关性与目标可比可行集重叠分析，并引入忠实的AdaProxy诊断以排除适配能力不足的解释；采用精确有限样本分裂共形分析刻画阈值估计的证据瓶颈；随后在HW-GPT-Bench的13台设备、10,000个GPT架构上复现该现象，以RTX3080为代理、在匹配联合约束下测量目标延迟SRCC与代理复用违规风险。

Result: NAS-Bench-201上跨设备排序相关性中等，但目标可比可行集重叠不完整；AdaProxy显著改善延迟排序，说明边界失效并非源于适配能力弱。有限样本共形分析显示单侧90%阈值至少需要9个校准观测，存在证据瓶颈。在HW-GPT-Bench上，相对RTX3080代理，目标延迟SRCC为0.951–0.996，但匹配联合约束下代理复用违规风险达33.3%–100%。

Conclusion: 排序可迁移性、可行性可迁移性与目标特定决策支持是三个不同的评估对象，不能相互替代。跨设备评估应报告哪些目标环境实际支持所声称的工作点，而非仅依赖代理排序相关性。

Abstract: Cross-device hardware evaluation often assumes that if architecture rankings transfer across devices, a proxy device can support target-side model selection. We stress-test this assumption for joint latency-energy feasibility across two public architecture families. On NAS-Bench-201, cross-device rank correlations are moderate, while target-comparable feasible-set overlap remains incomplete. A faithful AdaProxy diagnostic substantially improves latency ranking, showing that the observed boundary failures are not simply due to weak adaptation. Exact finite-sample split-conformal analysis also exposes an evidence bottleneck: a finite one-sided 90% threshold requires at least nine calibration observations. We then replicate the phenomenon on 10,000 GPT architectures across 13 HW-GPT-Bench devices. Relative to an RTX3080 proxy, target latency SRCC ranges from 0.951 to 0.996, yet proxy-reuse violation risk ranges from 33.3% to 100% under matched joint constraints. These results show that rank portability, feasibility portability, and target-specific decision support are distinct evaluation objects. Cross-device evaluations should therefore report which target environments actually support the operating point being claimed.

</details>


### [839] [StationPDE: Station-Oriented Surface PDE Learning for Multi-Station Multivariate Weather Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22123)
*Xiao Wang,Changjian Chen,Rongwen Li,Hongwu Liu,Kun Fang,Zhuo Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出StationPDE，一种面向站点的地表PDE学习模型，通过构建地形感知连续场并分解物理演化，实现多站多元天气预测，MSE平均降低约9.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有站点预测模型学习离散站点间的统计依赖，缺乏显式物理演化；而基于PDE的天气模型虽具可解释物理动力学，但需要连续场和地面站点数据中不可得的高空变量。因此需要弥合这一差距。

Method: 从离散站点观测构建地形感知的连续地表场，将其物理演化分解为地表风输送与高空推断。地表风输送显式演化可观测天气变量；高空推断用可学习水平扩散近似缺失高空变量的影响。并设并行数据驱动扩散分支捕捉互补运动模式，用自适应路由器整合两路预测。

Result: 在Weather2K和MeteoNet数据集上，StationPDE持续优于最先进基线，相比最强基线MSE平均降低约9.6%。

Conclusion: StationPDE通过结合PDE物理演化与数据驱动方法，为地面站点多元天气预测提供了可行且有效的方案，代码已开源。

Abstract: Multi-station multivariate weather forecasting aims to forecast future weather variables at multiple weather stations from historical surface observations. Existing station forecasting models learn statistical dependencies among discrete stations, but lack explicit physical evolution. Meanwhile, PDE-based weather models provide interpretable physical dynamics, yet require continuous fields and upper-air variables unavailable in surface station data. To bridge this gap, we propose StationPDE, a station-oriented surface PDE learning model. StationPDE constructs a terrain-aware continuous surface field from discrete station observations and decomposes its physical evolution into surface wind transport and upper-air inference. Surface wind transport explicitly evolves observable weather variables, while upper-air inference uses learnable horizontal diffusion to approximate the missing influence of unavailable upper-air variables. A parallel data-driven diffusion branch captures complementary motion patterns, and an adaptive router integrates the two forecasts for station-level multivariate forecasting. Experiments on Weather2K and MeteoNet show that StationPDE consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, reducing MSE by about $9.6\%$ on average compared with the strongest baseline. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/hnu-vis/StationPDE.

</details>


### [840] [Helix-FNO: Spectral-Domain Operator Learning Coupled with a High-Fidelity Mechanistic Model for Fast Surrogate Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22129)
*Jiabao Zhao,Chuwei Wang,Jinxi Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Helix-FNO：以32状态机理模型为教师、傅里叶神经算子(FNO)为学生，学习解算子本身而非单一解，实现毫秒级推理，比机理模型快三个数量级。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 全尺度处理过程的机理仿真模型是唯一可信且可外推的物化动力学描述，但运行过慢，无法支撑现代决策引擎在5分钟决策节奏下所需的数千次前向评估。常规代理建模常只学到单一配置的单一解，对新进水水质、控制设定或厂区布局泛化性差。

Method: 提出Helix-FNO教师-学生架构：32状态机理教师通过拉丁超立方与基于不确定性的主动学习构建高保真"输入场-解"配对数据集，覆盖边界与超负荷工况；学生FNO在谱域学习解算子本身而非单一解，从"学一个实例"转向"学一族方程"。给出算子形式化、谱卷积定义、加权蒸馏损失与主动学习准则，并分析截断傅里叶展开相对于参数化解流形光滑性的逼近误差。

Result: 以算例研究对比Helix-FNO与物理信息网络、数据驱动循环代理，在精度、数据集效率与推理时延上评估，并将各方法置于速度-精度Pareto前沿。所得算子在毫秒级推理下比机理教师快三个数量级。

Conclusion: Helix-FNO具备大规模候选筛选与在线决策支持所需的能力，是替代机理模型进行快速前向评估的可行方案。

Abstract: Mechanistic simulation models of full-scale treatment processes remain the only trustworthy, extrapolative description of the underlying physico-chemical dynamics, yet their runtime is far too slow to support the thousands of forward evaluations that a modern decision engine requires at a 5-minute decision cadence. The standard remedy-surrogate modelling-often produces a network that learns a single solution for a single configuration, so it generalises poorly to new influent profiles, control settings or plant layouts. This paper presents Helix-FNO, a teacher-student architecture that couples a thirty-two-state mechanistic teacher with a Fourier neural operator (FNO) student. The teacher supplies a high-fidelity dataset of input-field-to-solution pairs, curated by Latin-hypercube and uncertainty-based active learning to cover the boundary and overload regimes that matter in practice; the student learns, in the spectral domain, the solution operator itself rather than any single solution, thereby moving from learning one instance to learning an entire family of equations. We give the operator formulation, the spectral convolution definition, the weighted distillation loss and the active-learning criterion, and we analyse the approximation error of a truncated Fourier expansion with respect to the smoothness of the parametric solution manifold. An illustrative study compares Helix-FNO against a physics-informed network and a data-driven recurrent surrogate on accuracy, dataset efficiency and inference latency, and places the methods on a speed-accuracy Pareto front. The resulting operator is three orders of magnitude faster than the mechanistic teacher at millisecond inference, which is precisely the capability required for massive candidate screening and online decision support.

</details>


### [841] [Hierarchical Bayesian optimization of an aircraft-based multi-agent system-of-systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22130)
*Paul Saves,Thierry Lefebvre,Nathalie Bartoli,Jasper Bussemaker,Nikolaos Kalliatakis,Nabih Naeem,Prajwal Prakasha*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种分层贝叶斯优化框架，利用高斯过程元建模处理SoS架构设计中的离散选择、条件依赖与异构变量，并将其应用于欧盟COLOSSUS项目的野火扑救多智能体飞行系统，显著提升了搜索效率与鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 复杂系统之系统（SoS）架构设计依赖高保真多物理场/多学科仿真，但仿真计算代价高且存在评估失败风险，直接优化困难；现有代理模型方法难以应对SoS固有的离散架构选择、条件依赖和异构设计变量。
