These results suggest that combining adversarial training with temporal state representation can improve the robustness of reinforcement-learning-based market-making strategies under order-flow self-excitation, price impact, and regime uncertainty.

</details>


### [875] [FIRM-WM: State-factorized factual-interventional recurrent modeling for reward-free visual planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22816)
*Yilun Wu,Yunjian Zhang,Aobo Li,Mujiangshan Wang,Haitao Wu,Aqiang Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: FIRM-WM通过分离"目标可比配置态"与"动态纤维态"，并引入公共重置干预分支解决离线视频世界模型的表征与训练错配问题，在多个图像目标任务上显著优于LeWM且参数更少、规划更快。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 奖励无关的潜在世界模型需从离线视频学习并通过优化动作求解新图像目标。这带来两处错配：一是规划状态需与目标图像坐标可比，同时其动力学还需保留速度、运动趋势、接触等历史相关信息，超出目标坐标本身；二是离线训练中每条轨迹只揭示一个事实未来，而基于采样的规划器需在同一状态下比较多个未执行动作，造成事实与反事实之间的训练错配。

Method: 提出FIRM-WM（Factual-Interventional Recurrent World Model）紧凑像素世界模型：其循环状态将类型化的、与目标可比的配置态与128维动态纤维分离，动态纤维用于预测但不参与终端目标代价；数据上使用覆盖广的事实轨迹提供状态覆盖，并加入公共重置的干预分支，为替代动作序列提供可观测结果——执行每条分支前重置环境并通过环境状态设置接口恢复相同的记录值。规划采用统一的CEM。

Result: 在匹配CEM规划与三个独立全流程随机种子下：TwoRoom达99.0±1.0%、Reacher达92.7±2.1%、OGBench-Cube达88.0±3.0%；对比LeWM分别为89.0%、88.0%、70.0%。部署模型参数量2.98–3.42M，规划时间降低2.13–11.60倍。

Conclusion: 通过将目标可比坐标与历史依赖的动态信息解耦，并用公共重置干预分支弥补事实单轨迹与多动作采样的错配，FIRM-WM在保持紧凑参数与更低规划耗时的同时，显著提升离线图像目标任务的规划成功率，验证了该设计对两处错配的有效性。

Abstract: Reward-free latent world models can learn from offline videos and solve new image--goal tasks by optimizing actions through predicted latent futures. This setting places two demands on the planning state: its coordinates must be comparable with a goal image. Moreover, its dynamics must retain velocity, motion trend, contact, and other history--dependent information beyond those goal coordinates. Offline training creates a second mismatch: each recorded trajectory reveals one factual future, whereas a sampling--based planner compares many actions that were not taken from the same state. We introduce FIRM-WM (Factual--Interventional Recurrent World Model), a compact pixel world model designed around these two gaps. Its recurrent state separates a typed, goal--comparable configuration from a 128-dimensional dynamic fiber used for prediction but excluded from the terminal goal cost. Broad factual trajectories provide state coverage, while common--reset intervention branches provide observed outcomes for alternative action sequences. Before executing each branch, we reset the environment and restore the same recorded values exposed by the environment's state--setting interface. Under matched CEM planning and three independent full-pipeline seeds, FIRM-WM reaches 99.0$\pm$1.0% on TwoRoom, 92.7$\pm$2.1% on Reacher, and 88.0$\pm$3.0% on OGBench-Cube, compared with 89.0%, 88.0%, and 70.0% for LeWM. The deployed model uses 2.98--3.42M parameters and records 2.13--11.60$\times$ lower planning time on these tasks.

</details>


### [876] [Counterfactual Tool Ranking under Utility, Cost, and Privilege Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22819)
*Jiapeng Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种可证伪的工具（tool）反事实评估方法，用于区分"权威性、历史支持、比较量所估计的目标"，并借助11个企业风格可执行工具、精确倾向性日志与真实本地MCP传输，在合成与BFCL现实任务上验证其结论稳健性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 反事实工具评估中常混淆三类问题：估计的是何量（权威/识别目标）、历史数据是否提供支持（support）、以及比较对象究竟估计了什么。作者希望揭示：在缺乏支持或分布偏移时，表面上的DR优势可能反转或不具部署意义，需建立可证伪的评估流程。

Method: 用11个企业风格可执行工具、精确倾向性（exact-propensity）日志与真实本地Model Context Protocol传输构建环境。先做45次运行的合成研究，再用30次实现回报（realized-return）控制运行与15组实验（含1,930个独立发布的BFCL任务）予以挑战。比较直接回归与双重稳健（DR）估计器，并考察函数名分组不相交的BFCL衍生划分；评估两个固定版本的本地Qwen2.5模型在200个留出任务上的弃权（abstain）表现；分析缺失支持下的策略差异与"保留分歧"回退方案。

Result: 全回报直接回归推翻了线性设定下最初对DR有利的评估：平均绝对误差直接回归为0.0139，DR为0.0272。环境偏移下DR保持优势，误差0.0227对0.0948。在函数名分组不相交的BFCL衍生划分上，直接与DR选择器的平衡准确率分别为81.85%与79.83%。两个固化本地Qwen2.5模型在相同200个留出任务上暴露固定提示下严重的弃权失败。缺失支持下，两策略共有的不支持动作相互抵消，使增量变化在绝对值不可识别时仍可点识别；保留分歧的回退在全部5次支持缺口运行中达成该性质，但保守采样界未能认证部署改进。

Conclusion: 贡献在于一种可证伪的评估方法与独立公开证据，而非新的DR估计器、官方BFCL榜单成绩或生产级智能体安全声明。

Abstract: Counterfactual tool evaluation must distinguish authority, historical support, and what a comparison actually estimates. We study these distinctions with eleven executable enterprise-inspired tools, exact-propensity logs, and real local Model Context Protocol transport. An initial 45-run synthetic study is retained, then challenged by 30 realized-return control runs and 15 experiments on 1,930 independently released Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard (BFCL) tasks. Full-return direct regression reverses an initially favorable doubly robust (DR) evaluation result in the linear setting: mean absolute errors are 0.0139 for direct regression and 0.0272 for DR. Under a shifted environment, DR retains an advantage, with errors 0.0227 versus 0.0948. On function-name-group-disjoint BFCL-derived splits, direct and DR selectors obtain balanced accuracies of 81.85% and 79.83%. Two pinned local Qwen2.5 models are evaluated on the same 200 held-out tasks, exposing a strong failure to abstain under the fixed prompt. We further characterize policy differences under missing support: unsupported actions shared by two policies cancel, allowing point identification of an incremental change when neither absolute value is identifiable. A disagreement-preserving fallback achieves this property in all five support-gap runs, but conservative sampling bounds do not certify deployment improvement. The contribution is a falsifiable evaluation method and independent public evidence, not a new DR estimator, official BFCL leaderboard score, or production-agent safety claim.

</details>


### [877] [Beyond Average Error through Oracle-Informed Stress Tests for Time-Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22820)
*Xu Lin,Runheng Zuo,Shengxuan Xu,Qitai Tan,Hongyu Lin,Xiao-Ping Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种成对、机制可控的压力测试基准，将各预测步长上期望平方误差的变化分解为"环境风险"与"预测—预言机距离"两部分，用仅评估方可见的、以起点为条件的预测预言机实现归因，并对24个可部署预测模型及多变量关系漂移场景进行了系统评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 平均平方误差（MSE）本身无法区分预测性能下降的来源：究竟是未来变得更难预测（环境风险上升），还是预测值偏离条件均值（模型自身误差增大）。缺乏可归因的诊断工具，会导致对模型鲁棒性的误判，也会把不稳定的"发现"误当作真实规律。因此需要一个机制可控、可验证归因正确性的压力测试框架。

Method: 1）构造成对、机制可控的压力测试，在每个lead time上将期望平方误差的变化分解为环境风险与forecast-oracle distance，使用被评估模型无法获得的、以origin为条件的预测oracle；2）设置三个已知归因的端到端对照：null、environmental-only、information-gap control，用于验证pipeline把变化归到正确成分；3）对24个可部署forecaster施压；4）扩展到多变量关系漂移：6个模型×3种耦合强度，另在八通道系统及Ring、Block、Hub关系的匹配难度审计中验证；5）在独立DGP实现上做预设对比（prespecified contrasts）以检验发现的可复现性。

Result: 在frequent switching下，14个方法MSE更高但oracle distance更低；在outlier-variance feedback下，19个方法MSE更高但scale-standardized MSE更低。短lead与长lead的压力响应排序Spearman相关仅0.624，说明排序对预测步长高度敏感。多变量关系漂移中，oracle distance仅解释分解后期望风险增量的0.7%–3.9%，环境风险占主导，且在八通道系统和匹配难度审计中保持一致。独立DGP上的预设对比显示，若干视觉上很有说服力的"发现"（如trend accumulation、假设的switching reversal）无法复现。

Conclusion: 该基准把逐成分诊断与留出数据稳定性审计结合起来：既能指明性能变化归因于环境还是模型，也能量化发现的稳健性。它是对真实数据OOD评估的补充——后者在无法获得精确oracle归因时，衡量的是现实漂移下的表现。

Abstract: Average squared error cannot reveal whether forecasting performance degrades because the future becomes less predictable or because forecasts move farther from the conditional mean. We introduce paired, mechanism-controlled stress tests that decompose changes in expected squared error at each lead time into environmental risk and forecast-oracle distance, using an origin-conditioned predictive oracle unavailable to the evaluated models. Three end-to-end controls have known attribution. Specifically, the null, environmental-only, and information-gap controls verify that the pipeline assigns changes to the correct component. We then apply the benchmark to 24 deployable forecasters. Under frequent switching, 14 methods have higher realized MSE but lower oracle distance; under outlier-variance feedback, 19 have higher MSE but lower scale-standardized MSE. Short- and long-lead stress-response rankings have Spearman correlation 0.624, revealing substantial horizon-dependent reordering. We then study multivariate relation shifts. Across six models and three coupling severities, oracle distance accounts for only 0.7-3.9% of the decomposed expected-risk increase, and environmental-risk majority persists in an eight-channel system and a matched-difficulty audit of Ring, Block, and Hub relations. Finally, prespecified contrasts on independent data-generating process (DGP) realizations show that several visually compelling discovery profiles, including trend accumulation and the hypothesized switching reversal, do not replicate. The benchmark thus combines component-wise diagnosis with a held-out stability audit. It complements real-data out-of-distribution evaluation, which measures performance under realistic shifts when exact oracle attribution is unavailable.

</details>


### [878] [Personalized Federated Reinforcement Learning via Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning: Convergence of Exact and Hessian-Free Meta-Policy Gradients](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22833)
*Ali Beikmohammadi,Sarit Khirirat,Sindri Magnússon*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究个性化联邦强化学习，提出Per-FedAvg-PG算法，通过τ步本地随机元策略梯度实现单步自适应，并给出收敛性与Hessian-free变体分析。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在个性化联邦强化学习中，各智能体处于不同马尔可夫决策过程，需要通过服务器协作学习一个共享的MAML式策略初始化，使单个智能体仅经一步本地策略梯度自适应即可获得良好个性化策略；同时需厘清监督学习理论中的有界梯度与异质性假设在RL设定下是否自动成立。

Method: 提出Per-FedAvg-PG：智能体在通信轮次间执行τ步本地随机元策略梯度。基于标准策略类正则性，证明各智能体目标函数的梯度与Hessian具有显式常数的一致有界性，从而监督理论中的有界梯度与有界异质性条件自动满足，无需额外异质性假设。进一步分析免Hessian变体并界定其偏差。

Result: 证明算法在K=O(ε^{-3/2})轮通信、τ=Θ(ε^{-1/2})步本地更新下达到ε-近似一阶稳定点。指出精确元梯度依赖内层策略Hessian，实验表明其为实际瓶颈；免Hessian变体存在阶为α的非零元梯度不动点，说明稳定点下界是方法固有属性。表格与神经导航实验验证预测行为，并以比独立训练低一个数量级的样本代价迁移到未见智能体。

Conclusion: 自适应步长可作为个性化调节旋钮，曲率估计是决定精确元梯度是否可行的关键量。

Abstract: We study personalized federated reinforcement learning, in which $n$ agents, each acting in its own Markov decision process, collaborate through a server to learn a shared MAML-style policy initialization that becomes effective for an individual agent once that agent adapts it with a single local policy-gradient step. We propose Per-FedAvg-PG, in which agents take $τ$ local stochastic meta-policy-gradient steps between communication rounds, and prove that it reaches an $\varepsilon$-approximate first-order stationary point of the personalized objective in $K=\mathcal O(\varepsilon^{-3/2})$ rounds with $τ=Θ(\varepsilon^{-1/2})$ local steps. The analysis rests on a structural feature of the reinforcement learning setting: under standard policy-class regularity, the per-agent objectives have uniformly bounded gradients and Hessians with explicit constants, so the bounded-gradient and bounded-heterogeneity conditions imposed by the supervised theory hold automatically and no separate heterogeneity assumption is needed. The exact meta-gradient requires the inner-loop policy Hessian, which our experiments identify as the practical bottleneck. We therefore analyze the Hessian-free variant, bound its bias, and exhibit fixed points at which the meta-gradient is nonzero and of order $α$, showing that the resulting stationarity floor is a property of the method rather than of the bound. Experiments on tabular and neural navigation confirm the predicted behavior and show transfer to unseen agents at an order of magnitude lower sample cost than independent training. Together these results identify the adaptation step size as a tunable personalization knob and the curvature estimate as the quantity that governs whether exact meta-gradients are affordable.

</details>


### [879] [A Hybrid Attention Model Learning Unified Time-aware Patch Representation for Irregular Multivariate Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22836)
*Zhihao Lin,Li Lin,Qi Zhang,Kaiwen Xia,Shuai Wang,Jialin Qiao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种混合注意力模型，通过时间感知patch编码、时间偏置注意力与混合因果掩码，在不插补的前提下统一表示不规则多元时间序列，实现IMTS零样本预测SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 真实决策常依赖不规则多元时间序列（IMTS），其观测间隔不一致、变量间异步采样且存在信息性缺失。现有时间序列基础模型要么通过插补引入伪值，要么用索引式位置编码忽略连续时间，缺乏遵循IMTS原始采样模式的基座模型。

Method: 1）时间感知patch编码：将patch内数量可变的连续时间戳映射为固定维度嵌入，无需插补即可统一不规则patch格式；2）时间偏置注意力：以辅助注意力偏置校准patch间时间错位与跨通道异步依赖；3）混合因果掩码：在decoder-only Transformer上对历史上下文保留双向全视图，对预测视界保持严格自回归；4）构建VersaTSA，300亿观测的大规模预训练语料，保留数据源原生采样稀疏性。

Result: 在三个IMTS基准和标准规则MTS基准上，模型在IMTS零样本预测达到SOTA，迁移至规则预测任务时保持竞争性。

Conclusion: 该工作以时间感知的patch表示与混合注意力机制，填补了遵循IMTS原始模式的基座模型空白，并验证了大规模不规则序列预训练的有效性与迁移性。

Abstract: Time series foundation models (TSFMs) have recently delivered impressive zero-shot performance across diverse forecasting tasks. However, real-world decision-making frequently relies on \emph{irregular multivariate time series} (IMTS), where inconsistent inter-observation intervals and asynchronous sampling across variables coexist with informative missingness. Existing TSFMs handle such inputs either through imputation that injects spurious values or through index-based positional encodings that ignore continuous time. There is still a gap in the foundation model that follows the original IMTS patterns. In this paper, we propose a hybrid attention model that learns a unified time-aware patch representation for IMTS forecasting. We first design a \emph{time-aware patch encoding} that maps a variable number of intra-patch timestamps into a fixed-size embedding, producing a uniform format for irregular patches without resorting to imputation. We then introduce a \emph{time bias attention} mechanism that calibrates inter-patch temporal misalignment and asynchronous cross-channel dependencies as auxiliary attention offset. Finally, on top of a decoder-only Transformer backbone, we adopt a \emph{hybrid causal mask} that preserves a bidirectional full view over the historical context while keeping the forecast horizon strictly autoregressive. To support large-scale pretraining under irregular settings, we also curate VersaTSA, an archive of $30$B observations that retains the native sampling sparsity of its sources. Experiments on three IMTS benchmarks and a standard regular-MTS benchmark show that our model achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on IMTS and remains competitive when transferred to regular forecasting.

</details>


### [880] [CurvFlow-DTA: dual-graph discrete Ricci curvature flow for drug--target affinity prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22862)
*Jicheng Ma,Yunyan Yang,Juan Zhao,Liang Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出CurvFlow-DTA，用加权Forman曲率流与配对条件选择器在两图（分子图与蛋白残基接触图）上实现配对自适应的几何表示，仅需SMILES与序列即可推理，在Davis/KIBA的warm与cold-start设定中一致提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有曲率感知的DTA方法多对药物图使用静态曲率，蛋白侧主要依赖序列衍生特征，缺乏配对自适应的图几何建模，难以应对实际筛选中的冷启动未见实体。

Method: 以加权Forman曲率流替代单一静态曲率表示，同时在分子图和蛋白残基-残基接触图上应用；为每个实体预计算与标签无关的流轨迹，由配对条件选择器决定双分支Flow-GINE读取的流动视界（horizons）；用冻结的ESM-2提供残基层表示与接触分数以构建蛋白图；推理只需SMILES与蛋白序列，无需结合复合物结构。

Result: 在Davis与KIBA上，相比协议匹配的Ricci-GraphDTA基线，所有warm与cold-start设定均提升：warm划分MSE在Davis降19.9%、KIBA降18.9%；六个cold-start比较中MSE降14.3%–27.4%，CI全程更高；在自建文献基线集合中，warm基准MSE最低，并在六个cold-start设定中的四个取得最低MSE。

Conclusion: 将静态曲率升级为加权Forman曲率流并进行配对自适应选择，可有效增强DTA预测的几何表征与冷启动泛化能力，且在无复合物结构输入下取得一致优于基线的性能。

Abstract: Graph neural networks are widely used for drug--target affinity (DTA) prediction, and discrete Ricci curvature has recently been used to characterize molecular graph geometry. Existing curvature-aware DTA approaches mainly use static curvature on the drug graph while representing proteins primarily with sequence-derived features. This leaves pair-adaptive use of graph geometry underexplored, which may limit adaptation to unseen entities in cold-start settings relevant to practical screening.
  We present CurvFlow-DTA, which replaces a single static curvature representation with weighted Forman curvature flow on both molecular and protein residue--residue contact graphs. A label-independent flow trajectory is precomputed for each entity, and a pair-conditioned selector determines the horizons read by a dual-branch Flow-GINE. A frozen ESM-2 supplies residue-level representations and contact scores used to construct the protein graph. Inference requires only SMILES strings and protein sequences, without a bound complex structure.
  On Davis and KIBA, CurvFlow-DTA improves on the protocol-matched Ricci-GraphDTA baseline in every warm and cold-start setting. Warm-split mean squared error (MSE) decreases by $19.9\%$ on Davis and $18.9\%$ on KIBA. Across the six cold-start comparisons, MSE decreases by $14.3$--$27.4\%$, with higher concordance index (CI) throughout. Within our compiled set of literature baselines, CurvFlow-DTA achieves the lowest MSE on both warm benchmarks and across four out of six cold-start evaluation settings.

</details>


### [881] [Causilo Technical Report](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22866)
*Minyong Cho,Minho Jeong,Dooho Lee,Jinmo Lee,Jaemin Yoo*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: Causilo 是一种结合前沿预测性能与极快推理速度的表格基础模型，在 TabArena 取得 1785.4 Elo，每 1K 测试样本中位推理时间仅 0.10 秒，较 TabPFN-3.5-Fast 快 31.6%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在表格基础模型领域，预测性能与推理效率常存在权衡，现有模型难以同时达到两者最优。作者希望构建一个能位于性能-效率帕累托前沿的模型。

Method: Causilo 沿用 TabICL 的"先列后行"架构，但在行压缩前引入一个行精化模块：在列编码后于每行内部的单元格表示之间交换信息，精化后的单元格再通过额外的列阶段重新访问上下文集，随后压缩为行嵌入。为提升推理效率，两个行阶段均通过固定数量的摘要 token 进行交叉注意力，使注意力成本随特征数线性增长。模型在约 3600 万个合成表格上预训练。

Result: 在 TabArena 上达到 1785.4 Elo，每 1K 测试样本中位推理时间 0.10 秒，较 TabPFN-3.5-Fast 减少 31.6% 推理时间并位于性能-效率帕累托前沿；在 TabArena、BeyondArena 和 ScoringBench 上均取得前沿级性能。

Conclusion: Causilo 通过行精化模块与线性注意力的行阶段设计，在大规模合成表格预训练下实现了前沿预测性能与显著更快推理的统一，验证了性能与效率可以兼得。

Abstract: We introduce Causilo, a tabular foundation model (TFM) that combines frontier predictive performance with exceptionally fast inference. On TabArena, Causilo achieves 1785.4 Elo, at a median inference time of 0.10 seconds per 1K test samples. It outperforms TabPFN-3.5-Fast with 31.6% less inference time, placing it on the performance--efficiency Pareto frontier. Causilo follows TabICL's column-then-row architecture but introduces another row-refinement module before row compression. This module exchanges information among cell representations within each row after column encoding. The refined cells then visit the context set again through an additional column stage before being compressed into row embeddings. For inference efficiency, both row stages use cross-attention through a fixed number of summary tokens, keeping their attention cost linear in the number of features. Pretrained on approximately 36M synthetic tables, Causilo delivers strong benchmark results across TabArena, BeyondArena, and ScoringBench, achieving frontier-level performance with substantially faster inference.

</details>


### [882] [Leveraging Inference-Time Compute for Diffusion Models via Global Scheduling of Denoising Trajectories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22867)
*Yuan Cao,Yifu Tang,Hangqi Li,Zeyu Zheng*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将扩散采样中"每步多候选+验证器筛选"的推理时计算分配形式化为预算分配问题，给出灵敏度因子分解、水位填充式最优分配、自适应策略的不可行性下界，并提出离线锚定+在线微调的实现，实验在三个采样器族上以少20%~50%函数评估达到均匀分配的质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 部署期可通过额外计算提升扩散模型样本质量而无需重训练：在每步采样若干候选噪声、用验证器打分并保留最优，但每个候选需一次网络评估。由此产生关键问题：在固定函数评估预算下，搜索努力应如何沿去噪轨迹的各步分配。

Method: 1) 将问题建模为计算预算分配；在步长主导阶下证明K个候选的期望收益可分解为各步内生的灵敏度参数与通用样本量因子（K个标准正态抽样期望最优值）之积。2) 对固定灵敏度剖面，最优分配对应可分离凹整数规划，具水位填充结构；固定总灵敏度时，其相对均匀分配的优势随灵敏度离散度（majorization序）增大。3) 证明灵敏度跨实例变化时，任何自适应策略的最坏遗憾随轨迹长度线性增长，故采用离线锚定分配、在线仅回收实例松弛的设计。4) 将分析从独立随机搜索推广到更广的局部搜索算子族，并实例化为可实现的算法。

Result: 在三个扩散采样器族上的实验表明，所提分配策略以少20%~50%的函数评估达到均匀分配基线的质量。理论上给出收益的灵敏度×样本量因子分解、水位填充型最优分配及离散度优势刻画，并证明自适应策略的最坏情况遗憾下界。

Conclusion: 推理时计算应按步灵敏度非均匀分配；最优解具水位填充结构且收益随灵敏度离散度提升；由于自适应存在线性最坏遗憾，离线锚定+在线松弛回收是稳健设计，可在显著节省评估次数的同时保持样本质量。

Abstract: Diffusion models generate a sample by traversing a denoising trajectory, a sequence of stochastic noise-reduction steps that transforms pure noise into a draw from a target distribution. At deployment time, additional computation can improve sample quality without retraining: at each step, the sampler draws several candidate noise samples, scores the resulting predictions with a quality criterion called the verifier, and retains the best candidate at the cost of one network evaluation per candidate. This raises a resource allocation question: given a fixed budget of function evaluations, how should search effort be distributed across the steps of the denoising trajectory? We formulate this as a computational budget allocation problem. First, we show that, to leading order in the step size, the expected gain from evaluating $K$ candidates at a step factorizes into an endogenous, step-specific sensitivity parameter times a universal sample-size factor equal to the expected best of $K$ standard-normal draws. Second, for a fixed sensitivity profile, the optimal allocation solves a separable concave integer program with water-filling structure; at fixed total sensitivity, its advantage over uniform allocation increases with sensitivity dispersion in the majorization order. Third, we prove that when sensitivities vary across instances, no adaptive policy can avoid worst-case regret that grows linearly in the trajectory length, which motivates a design that anchors the allocation offline and adapts online only to recover instance-specific slack. We extend the analysis from independent random search to a broader family of local search operators, and instantiate it as an implementable algorithm. Experiments on three families of diffusion samplers show that the proposed allocation attains the quality of the uniform benchmark with 20 to 50 percent fewer function evaluations.

</details>


### [883] [Prioritized Rollouts for Efficient World Model-based Vision-Language-Action Policy Optimization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22879)
*Yifei Sheng,Haoxiang Ren,Zhilong Zhang,Haonan Wang,Runjie Xu,Yihao Sun,Nan Tang,Zhichao Wu,Lei Yuan,Haoxin Lin,Yang Yu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 U-GROW，一个轻量级、即插即用的采样式层，利用策略不确定性识别对策略改进更有价值的状态，从而将更多世界模型 rollout 导向这些信息量高的状态，在仿真与真实机器人操作任务上提升了基于模型的强化学习微调 VLA 模型的效率与效果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: VLA 模型是具身智能的重要范式，但用强化学习微调受限于真实机器人交互成本。基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）通过学得的世界模型生成 rollout 来降低该成本，然而随着 VLA 策略与世界模型规模增大，计算开销也变得高昂。现有方法通常平等对待所有状态，忽略了不同状态对策略改进效用的显著差异。

Method: 作者发现策略不确定性可识别具有更大策略改进潜力的状态：策略仅在少数状态上表现出高不确定性，这通常出现在决策敏感阶段（微小动作差异会改变任务结果）。基于此，提出 U-GROW——一个轻量级、即插即用的采样层，通过仅修改分支起始分布（branched-start distribution），将更多模型 rollout 导向这些高信息量状态，无需改变策略优化目标即可嵌入现有 MBRL 流程。

Result: 在仿真和真实世界操作任务上的实验验证了 U-GROW 的高效性与有效性，支持使用策略不确定性来引导经验生成。

Conclusion: U-GROW 表明策略不确定性可作为引导世界模型 rollout 生成的有效信号，在不修改策略优化目标的前提下以轻量方式提升 MBRL 微调 VLA 的计算与样本效率，为具身智能中的高效经验生成提供了新思路。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have emerged as a powerful paradigm for embodied intelligence, but fine-tuning them with reinforcement learning (RL) remains constrained by the cost of real-world robot interaction. Model-based reinforcement learning (MBRL) reduces this cost by using a learned world model to generate rollouts for policy optimization. However, it becomes computationally expensive as VLA policies and world models scale. Existing methods typically treat states equally, overlooking substantial differences in their utility for policy improvement. In this paper, we show that policy uncertainty helps identify states with greater potential for policy improvement. The policy exhibits high uncertainty at only a small subset of states, often during decision-sensitive stages where small action differences can alter task outcomes, suggesting that policy improvements at these states could be particularly valuable. Building on these findings, we introduce U-GROW, a lightweight, plug-and-play sampling layer that directs more model rollouts to these informative states. By modifying only the branched-start distribution, U-GROW can be integrated into existing MBRL pipelines without changing the policy optimization objective. Experiments in both simulated and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate the efficiency and effectiveness of U-GROW, supporting the use of policy uncertainty to guide experience generation.

</details>


### [884] [Joint Domain-Class Modeling for Federated Learning Under Feature Skew](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22932)
*Sina Najafi,Mostafa Tavassolipour,Seyed Pooya Shariatpanahi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: JDFL：一种轻量、优化器无关的联邦学习扩展，通过推断伪域并扩展分类头到联合域-类logits，配合相似性感知软标签与随机目标分配两种监督策略，缓解特征偏斜，在域偏移图像基准上稳定提升全局测试精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习在特征偏斜下性能下降：客户端标签分布共享，但条件输入分布 p_i(x|y) 因客户端特有的潜在外观因素而变化（潜域变异）。作者希望在不共享原始数据的前提下利用这种潜域变异。

Method: 提出 JDFL：首先从简短的本地更新信号推断域聚类（伪域）；然后将分类头扩展为输出 M×C 的联合域-类 logits，使模型在共享主干下表达域条件外观；并引入两种监督：(1) 相似性感知软标签，在相近伪域间迁移证据同时允许域特化；(2) 每样本随机目标分配，扰动联合输出上的监督，作为低成本训练期正则化。方法优化器无关，可与 FedAvg、SCAFFOLD 等标准联邦方法以最小改动集成。

Result: 在标准域偏移图像基准上，两种监督模式均一致提升全局测试精度；消融与敏感性研究表明增益来自所提出的监督与参数化设计，而非单纯的容量增加。

Conclusion: JDFL 以轻量、即插即用的方式解决联邦学习中的特征偏斜问题，验证了显式建模潜域变异与相应监督策略的有效性。

Abstract: Federated learning (FL) enables collaborative model training without centralizing private data, but performance often degrades under feature skew: clients share labels while the conditional input distributions $p_i(x\!\mid\!y)$ vary due to latent, client-specific appearance factors. We propose Joint Domain-Class Federated Learning (JDFL), a lightweight, optimizer-agnostic extension that makes this latent domain variation usable without sharing raw data. JDFL first infers domain clusters called pseudo-domains from brief local update signals. It then expands the classifier head to output $M\times C$, joint (domain-class) logits. This allows the model to represent domain-conditioned appearance while keeping a shared backbone. To train the expanded head we introduce two complementary supervision strategies based on simple intuitions: a similarity-aware soft-labeling that transfers evidence between nearby inferred domains while allowing domain-specific specialization, and a per-sample randomized target assignment that perturbs supervision across the joint outputs and serves as a low-cost training-time regularizer. JDFL integrates with existing standard FL methods (e.g., FedAvg, SCAFFOLD) with minimal changes. Empirically, both supervision modes consistently improve global test accuracy on standard domain-shifted image benchmarks; ablations and sensitivity studies show the gains stem from the proposed supervision and parametrization rather than mere capacity increase.

</details>


### [885] [Token Utility Is Selection-Conditioned: Coupled Selection of Prompt Context and Response Supervision for Efficient Instruction Tuning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22943)
*Can Wu,Xinrui Chen,Ou Wu,Yi Du*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: BRIDGE提出了一个基于预算的双向梯度引导token选择方法，通过共享的验证导向交互代理模型，在被选择状态下评估响应与提示词的相互效用，并利用交替选择与结构感知投影实现高效LLM指令微调数据压缩。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM指令微调中的监督数据选择方法通常将提示词(prompt)与响应(response)两侧独立估值，这会引发估值状态与最终保留训练子集之间的选择状态不匹配问题，从而影响压缩后微调效果。

Method: 提出BRIDGE（Budgeted Response-Prompt Interaction via Directional Gradient-guided Efficient Token Selection）。核心包括：(1) 共享的验证导向交互代理模型，在对方保留状态下对每一侧进行估值，获取选择条件化的token效用；(2) 预算约束下的交替选择，通过对当前另一侧子集聚合预计算交互来更新条件分数，实现保留子集的协调选择；(3) 结构感知投影，将条件响应分数转换为连贯的监督跨度。

Result: 在三个模型族上，BRIDGE在数学推理、代码生成和指令跟随任务中整体优于其他对比选择方法；在数学推理任务中，其相对独立选择方法的优势随压缩率提高而增大。

Conclusion: BRIDGE通过捕捉提示词与响应的交互效用，解决了独立选择带来的状态不匹配问题，在多种任务和模型族上实现了更优的指令微调数据选择效果，且在高压缩场景下优势更为显著。

Abstract: Efficient large language model (LLM) instruction tuning requires selecting response supervision with supporting prompt context. Existing methods typically value both sides separately, risking selection-state mismatch between valuation and retained training subsets. BRIDGE (Budgeted Response-Prompt Interaction via Directional Gradient-guided Efficient Token Selection) captures selection-conditioned token utility through a shared validation-directed interaction surrogate valuing each side under the other's retained state. Budgeted alternating selection coordinates retained subsets by aggregating precomputed interactions over the current opposite-side subset to update conditional scores. Structure-aware projection converts conditional response scores into coherent supervision spans. Across three model families, BRIDGE leads compared selection methods overall in mathematical reasoning, code generation, and instruction following. In mathematical reasoning, its advantage over independent selection grows with compression.

</details>


### [886] [WaveFront Decoding: Parallelized Self-Speculative Decoding for Looped Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23033)
*Hyeongju Ha,Jae-Joon Kim*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出免训练自推测解码框架Wavefront Decoding (WFD)，利用循环语言模型的中间递归输出作为草稿预测并结合权重共享批量处理混合深度状态，将草稿与验证协同批处理，在多个任务上实现显著加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环语言模型通过重复应用权重共享块提升有效深度而不增加参数量，但每个生成token需要T次顺序递归块调用，导致解码延迟大幅增加。现有draft-then-verify方案将草稿与验证分阶段进行，未能充分利用循环架构的特性，存在进一步加速空间。

Method: WFD是一种免训练的自推测解码框架，利用两个特性：1）中间递归输出可作为有效草稿预测；2）权重共享使不同位置和递归深度的token状态可在一次批处理递归块调用中处理。将混合深度状态组织成对角波前（diagonal wavefront），在浅层持续草拟新位置，同时将较早位置推进至全深度验证，从而在同一递归调用中协同批处理草稿与验证，并对被拒绝草稿使用全深度预测修正；此外引入跨递归KV共享以减少波前KV传输。

Result: 在Spec-Bench六个任务类别上，WFD在Ouro-2.6B上实现2.42倍加速，在Huginn-3.5B上实现3.54倍加速（相比自回归解码），持续优于draft-then-verify方案。跨递归KV共享进一步降低波前KV传输，将Huginn-3.5B上的加速提升至4.81倍。

Conclusion: WFD为循环语言模型提供了一种有效的免训练自推测解码加速方案，通过波前批处理和KV共享显著降低解码延迟，验证了利用循环架构固有特性进行协同草稿-验证的可行性与有效性。

Abstract: Looped language models repeatedly apply a weight-shared block to increase effective depth without increasing parameter count, but the resulting T sequential recurrent-block calls per generated token substantially increase decoding latency. To address the issue, we introduce Wavefront Decoding (WFD), a training-free self-speculative decoding framework designed for looped language models. WFD exploits two properties of these architectures: intermediate recurrence outputs provide effective draft predictions, and weight sharing allows token states at different positions and recurrence depths to be processed in one batched recurrent-block call. WFD organizes these mixed-depth states into a diagonal wavefront, continuously drafting new positions at shallow depth while advancing earlier positions toward full-depth verification. Unlike the phase-separated draft-then-verify schedule, WFD therefore co-batches drafting and verification within the same recurrent calls, while rejected drafts are corrected using full-depth predictions. Across six Spec-Bench task categories, WFD achieves 2.42x speedup on Ouro-2.6B and 3.54x on Huginn-3.5B over autoregressive decoding, consistently outperforming draft-then-verify. Cross-recurrence KV sharing further reduces wavefront KV traffic and increases WFD's speedup to 4.81x on Huginn-3.5B.

</details>


### [887] [Optimizers for Diffusion Models: A Controlled Benchmark](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23055)
*Arman Bolatov,Egor Shulgin,David Li,Abduragim Shtanchaev,Sebastian U. Stich,Maxim Panov,Eric Moulines,Peter Richtárik,Martin Takáč*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文首次对离散扩散模型进行了受控优化器基准测试：在四种扩散形式（掩码扩散/text8、均匀扩散/QM9与经高斯对偶的LM1B、图像高斯扩散/CelebA-64）上比较七种优化器（AdamW、Lion、Muon、SOAP、MARS、MARS-M、Schedule-Free），统一搜索协议并对获胜者以完整预算、三个随机种子重训。结果表明AdamW是强默认但非总是最优，胜者随扩散形式变化，且在自回归预训练上验证的优化器（Muon、MARS-M、SOAP）可有效迁移至扩散训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散扩散模型已在多个基准上媲美自回归语言模型，但其训练方法（尤其是优化器选择）关注不足：优化器往往从前作沿用而未加比较；而新优化器又几乎只在自回归预训练上验证，目标函数与损失曲面均不同，导致离散扩散缺少专门的优化器评测。

Method: 跨四种扩散形式构建受控基准：掩码扩散（text8）、均匀扩散（QM9，及通过高斯对偶的LM1B）、图像高斯扩散（CelebA-64），每个任务均有公开参考值。比较七种优化器：AdamW、Lion、Muon、SOAP、MARS、MARS-M、Schedule-Free。所有优化器采用相同搜索协议，获胜者以完整预算、三个随机种子重训以保证可靠性。

Result: AdamW是强默认但并非总是最优：在四个任务中的两个上被以显著差距（resolved margin）击败，且获胜优化器随扩散形式变化。在自回归语言模型预训练上验证的方法迁移性良好：Muon、MARS-M、SOAP各自在至少一种扩散形式上优于调优后的AdamW。

Conclusion: 优化器选择应与训练配方其他环节同等重视，不应被默认沿用。基准、全部运行与所有图表均可通过开源代码 https://github.com/armanbolatov/diffusion-baselines 端到端复现。

Abstract: Discrete diffusion models now match autoregressive language models on several benchmarks, while the question of how best to train them has received far less attention: the optimizer is inherited from one paper to the next and never compared. New optimizers, meanwhile, are validated almost exclusively on autoregressive pretraining, a different objective on a different loss surface. We present a controlled optimizer benchmark across four diffusion formulations, to our knowledge the first for discrete diffusion: seven optimizers (AdamW, Lion, Muon, SOAP, MARS, MARS-M, Schedule-Free) on masked diffusion (text8), uniform diffusion (QM9, and LM1B through the Gaussian duality) and Gaussian diffusion on images (CelebA-64), each on a task with published reference values. Every optimizer receives the same search protocol, and every winner is retrained at the full budget with three seeds. AdamW is a strong default but not always the right choice: it is beaten by a resolved margin on two of the four tasks, and the winner changes with the formulation, so the optimizer deserves the same care as the rest of the training recipe. Notably, methods validated on autoregressive language model pretraining transfer well: Muon, MARS-M and SOAP each beat the tuned AdamW on at least one diffusion formulation. The benchmark, all runs and every figure are reproducible end to end from the released code at https://github.com/armanbolatov/diffusion-baselines.

</details>


### [888] [AirGC-CD: Gaussian-Circulant Precoding for Exactly Debiasable PAPR Reduction in Over-the-Air Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23084)
*Jonggyu Jang,Hyeonsu Lyu,Hyun Jong Yang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AirGC-CD，一种空中联邦学习方案：在裁剪前用部分高斯循环矩阵对本地更新预编码，使预编码输出恒为高斯分布，从而使裁剪可被闭式Bussgang增益在均值意义上精确求逆，聚合结果无偏；同时预编码器兼作压缩器，将传输维度由d降至m，仅需O(dlog d)。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 空中联邦学习虽允许边缘设备同时传输本地更新以降低通信开销，但叠加波形的高峰均比（PAPR）随模型维度增长。为保持放大器线性，只能裁剪峰值或回退发射功率：裁剪会在接收端引入无法消除的偏置，回退则保持信号完好但降低平均信噪比（SNR）。此外，传输仍未压缩，每个模型参数占用一次信道使用，使大模型训练难以实现。

Method: 提出AirGC-CD：对每个本地更新先用部分高斯循环矩阵预编码，再进行裁剪。由于预编码输出无论更新稀疏性如何都严格服从高斯分布，裁剪函数面向已知分布设计，而非从数据继承分布。这使得裁剪可在均值意义上由闭式单一标量Bussgang增益求逆，并证明聚合结果精确无偏，裁剪仅增加方差。裁剪比成为唯一自由参数，用于权衡裁剪方差与回退导致的SNR损失，作者给出其近似最优的闭式解。预编码器为线性，同时充当压缩器，借助两次快速傅里叶变换以O(dlog d)代价把传输从模型维度d降到草图维度m，而高斯草图需O(md)。

Result: 在五个图像数据集上的实验表明，AirGC-CD在多数设置下优于基线空中联邦学习方案，尤其在低SNR时表现突出，且每轮使用更少的信道使用次数。

Conclusion: AirGC-CD通过高斯循环预编码统一解决了空中联邦学习的PAPR、裁剪偏置与传输未压缩三方面问题：实现无偏聚合、闭式近最优裁剪比，并以低复杂度完成维度压缩，在低SNR与有限信道使用条件下取得更优性能。

Abstract: Over-the-air federated learning lets edge devices transmit their local updates simultaneously, reducing the communication overhead. The resulting waveform, however, has a peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) that grows with the model dimension, and keeping the amplifier in its linear range leaves two remedies: clipping the peaks or backing off the transmit power. Neither remedy is without cost: i) the clipping distortion appears at the receiver as a bias that cannot be removed, and ii) back-off keeps the signal intact but degrades the average signal-to-noise ratio (SNR). Independent of this trade-off, the transmission remains uncompressed, spending one channel use per model parameter, which keeps large-model training out of reach. To address these challenges, we propose AirGC-CD, an over-the-air scheme that precodes each local update with a partial Gaussian circulant matrix before clipping. In AirGC-CD, the precoder's output is exactly Gaussian regardless of the update's sparsity, so the clipping function is designed for a known distribution instead of inheriting it from the data. This enables the clipping to be inverted on average by a single scalar Bussgang gain in closed form, and we prove that the resulting aggregate is exactly unbiased, with clipping adding only variance. The clipping ratio is then the only free parameter left, trading the variance of the clipping against the SNR loss from back-off, and we derive its near-optimum in closed form. Since the precoder is linear, it also acts as a compressor, reducing the transmission from the model dimension d to the sketch dimension m at a cost of only O(dlog d) via two fast Fourier transforms, whereas a Gaussian sketch costs O(md). Experiments on five image datasets show that AirGC-CD outperforms baseline over-the-air FL schemes in most settings, particularly at low SNR, while using fewer channel uses per round.

</details>


### [889] [The Role of Coordinates in Pareto Regret for Adversarial Multi-Objective Bandits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23092)
*Changkun Guan,Mengfan Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 针对对抗性多目标赌博机中"易坐标"信息缺失是否会改善Pareto遗憾，本文证明暴露易坐标并不能改善最坏情况阶，并给出匹配该下界的Poly-INF及奖励倍增算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 对抗性多目标赌博机中，奖励为对手选取的多维向量，性能由Pareto遗憾衡量。既有理论暗示"更易的坐标"（最小累积损失更小）可降低Pareto遗憾，但实际中往往不知道哪个坐标更易。本文旨在厘清该信息缺失是否影响遗憾的最坏情况阶，并寻找不依赖该信息的算法。

Method: 将损失定义为1减奖励，以某坐标上各臂的最小累积损失衡量其"易"程度。负向方面，通过构造下界证明即使已知最易坐标的L0=min_d L_d，较小的累积损失也不改善Pareto遗憾的阶。正向方面，当L0已知时，在固定坐标上应用Poly-INF；当L0未知时，提出Poly-INF的奖励倍增版本以自适应未知量。

Result: 对K≥4臂、T≥6轮、至少2个坐标，证明极小极大期望Pareto遗憾为Ω(min{T−L0, √(K(T−L0))})，且关于L0单调递减，即使L0已知亦然。L0已知时，固定坐标的Poly-INF上界与下界同阶，达到匹配；L0未知时，奖励倍增版Poly-INF仍达到匹配的极小极大率。

Conclusion: 易坐标信息本身不能改善Pareto遗憾的最坏情况阶；最优rate可由任意坐标（而非仅最易坐标）达成，关键在于对L0的自适应。所提算法无额外log T因子，且不依赖于坐标数目，从而给出信息缺失下的紧致刻画与自适应最优方案。

Abstract: Adversarial multi-objective bandits hold the potential to help us optimize choices (arms) whose reward is a multidimensional vector chosen by an adversary and whose performance is measured by Pareto regret. We define loss as one minus reward and measure the easiness of a coordinate by the smallest cumulative loss of the arms on it, and call the coordinate easier when this quantity is smaller. Existing work suggests that in theory an easier coordinate may reduce Pareto regret. However, in practice, one may not know which coordinate is easier. On the negative side, we show that this lack of information eliminates the possibility: a smaller cumulative loss does not improve the worst-case order of Pareto regret. Precisely, let \(L_d\) be the smallest cumulative loss along coordinate $d$ over $T$ rounds. For \(K\ge4\) arms, \(T\ge6\) rounds, and at least 2 coordinates, we prove that the minimax expected Pareto regret is \(Ω(\min\{T-L_0,\sqrt{K(T-L_0)}\})\). It is monotonically decreasing in \(L_0\), even when \(L_0=\min_d L_d\) itself is known. On the positive side, this result motivates the possibility that other coordinates, not just the easy one, may suffice to attain the optimal rate of Pareto regret. When $L_0$ is known, we apply Poly-INF to a fixed coordinate and obtain an upper bound on Pareto regret that exhibits the same order and thus matches the lower bound. Without such knowledge, we develop a reward-doubling version of Poly-INF that adapts to this unknown quantity while still attaining the matching minimax rate. Another implication is that it has no extra \(\log T\) factor and is independent of the number of coordinates.

</details>


### [890] [When Does Adversarial Refinement Help? A Negative Result and Open Problem in Adapting R3GAN to Time Series Imputation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23102)
*Yufeng He*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 将R3GAN适配到1D时序插补并审计14组配置，报告负结果：对抗信号基本无效，稳定GAN并未复兴对抗式插补。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散模型与Transformer已因GAN训练不稳定而取代GAN用于多变量时序插补。R3GAN通过正则化相对论损失与可证收敛性消除了该不稳定性，因此引出问题：稳定化的现代GAN能否复兴对抗式插补。

Method: 将R3GAN适配到1D时序数据，采用由粗到细的refinement框架与频域判别器，并在3个数据集上审计14组已保存配置。证据为异质单次运行，属描述性而非匹配的因果消融。

Result: 全部5组mean/zero-start配置提升48.4%–70.2%；8组合格的非legacy linear-start配置平均变化-0.7%（-3.0%至+1.1%），另有一处-21.9%的legacy日志异常仅作溯源保留、不计入聚合。已保存的Weather对比中，独立R3GAN-1D比BRITS差5.8倍。重建权重扫描与对抗信号惰性或有害一致，但无法确定其因果贡献。

Conclusion: 对抗式refinement在稳定GAN下未带来收益。作者指出"GAN优化分布目标而扩散优化逐点目标"这一常见解释不成立，因为扩散同样优化分布目标却达到SOTA插补；学习到的判别器为何无法提供有用refinement梯度（而扩散去噪器可以）被列为开放问题，并给出对抗式refinement适用时机的实践建议。

Abstract: Diffusion models and transformers have supplanted GANs for multivariate time series imputation, largely on grounds of GAN training instability. R3GAN (NeurIPS 2024) removes that instability via regularized relativistic losses with provable convergence, raising a natural question: do stable, modern GANs revive adversarial imputation? We adapt R3GAN to 1D temporal data with a coarse-to-fine refinement framework and a frequency-domain discriminator, and audit 14 saved configurations across 3 datasets. Because these are heterogeneous single runs, the evidence is descriptive rather than a matched causal ablation. We report a negative result. All five saved mean/zero-start configurations improve by 48.4-70.2%. Among eight eligible non-legacy linear-start configurations, the mean change is -0.7% (range -3.0% to +1.1%); a separate -21.9% legacy logging anomaly is retained for provenance but excluded from that aggregate. In a saved Weather comparison, standalone R3GAN-1D underperforms BRITS by 5.8x. Crucially, we argue the common explanation (that GANs optimize distributional rather than point-wise objectives) cannot be the whole story, since diffusion models also optimize distributional objectives yet achieve state-of-the-art imputation. Our saved reconstruction-weight sweep is consistent with the adversarial signal being inert or harmful, but cannot identify its causal contribution; a matched discriminator-removed ablation is the key next experiment. We frame the precise reason a learned discriminator fails to provide useful refinement gradients (where a learned diffusion denoiser succeeds) as an open problem, and offer practical guidance on when adversarial refinement is worthwhile.

</details>


### [891] [Perplexity Cost Understates What Activation Quantisation Breaks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23125)
*Anish Sathyanarayanan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 困惑度（perplexity）作为激活量化的聚合评价指标，能可靠地指示整体优劣，但无法揭示量化对不同计算能力的差异化损伤：在困惑度仅上升1.2–1.5倍时，归纳能力（induction）仍保留0.959的完好精度，而检索能力（retrieval）已降至0.554。该差异具有结构性，单纯误差幅度无法解释，旋转基座量化可大幅恢复归纳能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 激活量化通常以困惑度这一对全体token取平均的聚合指标来评估，但作者质疑这种平均值能否识别量化究竟损伤了模型的哪些具体计算。研究动机在于揭示聚合指标的盲区，即困惑度相同的模型可能在特定能力（如归纳、检索）上存在巨大差异。

Method: 在4个模型家族共12个模型、780次模型内比较中，考察困惑度偏好与归纳、检索能力的对应关系；设计匹配的高斯噪声对照（相同逐通道幅度）以分离幅度因素；通过仅随机化量化误差符号（固定幅度）测试幅度是否解释损伤；采用旋转基座量化（改变坐标对齐但不改变误差幅度）进行单块干预实验，并在端到端4比特及AWQ部署配置下验证，另在参数量高达32B的两个模型上复现。

Result: 困惑度偏好与归纳、检索的一致性极高，仅在2.1%和4.0%的情况下不一致。当困惑度上升1.2–1.5倍时，归纳保留0.959精度，检索却降至0.554，聚合指标掩盖了这一差距。匹配幅度的高斯噪声对照基本保留了该差距，仅随机化误差符号也几乎无害，说明幅度并非损伤主因。旋转基座量化在3比特/令牌的单块干预下将归纳从0.001恢复到0.980，检索恢复较少（0.694）；端到端4比特下归纳达0.968、检索0.534。结论在32B模型及AWQ 4比特激活配置下依然成立。

Conclusion: 困惑度目标只能界定对激活施加变换的平均代价，本身无法表明哪些计算得以幸存。评估激活量化需超越聚合指标，关注具体计算能力（如归纳与检索）的差异化损伤及其背后的坐标对齐结构因素。

Abstract: Activation quantisation is usually evaluated with an aggregate metric, perplexity, averaged over every token a model predicts. We ask whether that average identifies which computations a quantiser damages. Perplexity turns out to be a reliable aggregate signal: across 12 models from four families and 780 within-model comparisons, the arm perplexity prefers also retains more induction and more retrieval in all but 2.1 and 4.0 percent of cases respectively. But where perplexity has risen by only a factor of 1.2 to 1.5, induction still keeps 0.959 of its intact accuracy while retrieval has already fallen to 0.554, a gap the aggregate number does not surface. This gap has structure, not just size: a matched Gaussian-noise control of the same per-channel magnitude leaves it largely intact, and randomising only the sign of the quantisation error, every magnitude held fixed, is nearly as harmless, so magnitude alone does not explain the damage. Quantising in a rotated basis, which changes coordinate alignment without changing error magnitude, restores induction from 0.001 to 0.980 at three average bits per token in a single-block intervention, though retrieval recovers less completely at the same setting (0.694); end-to-end at four average bits, induction reaches 0.968 and retrieval 0.534. The pattern holds on two further models up to 32B parameters and, in the deployed configurations we tested, under AWQ once activations are pushed to 4 bits. A perplexity target bounds the average cost of a transformation applied to the activation; it does not, by itself, show which computations survived.

</details>


### [892] [Provably Efficient Reinforcement Learning in Continuous-Time Episodic MDPs with Poisson Decision Epochs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23127)
*Kenny Guo,Valentio Iverson,Sahan Wijetunga,William Chang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究泊松决策时刻下的连续时间分段MDP，利用时间Lipschitz平滑性离散化，将UCRL与Q-learning拓展至此，证明模型/无模型算法$\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$遗憾界，并给出匹配下界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实RL问题多在连续时间中以不规则、事件驱动方式演化，而非固定离散步。现有理论多针对离散时间MDP，缺乏对连续时间、泊松决策时刻、时变平滑动态场景的紧致遗憾保证，本文旨在填补该空白。

Method: 研究分段连续时间MDP：决策时刻由齐次泊松过程驱动，奖励与转移动态随时间平滑变化；考虑每回合固定跳数及固定时间预算（随机泊松决策次数）两种设定。在时间Lipschitz连续性假设下，通过离散化利用局部平滑性，将UCRL（模型型）与Q-learning（无模型）拓展至该设定。

Result: 对模型型与无模型算法均证明$\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$遗憾上界；并建立匹配的$\widetilde{\Omega}(T^{2/3})$极小极大下界，表明该速率在对数因子内最优。

Conclusion: 给出Lipschitz平滑、泊松决策时刻连续时间分段MDP的首个紧致遗憾保证，证明$T^{2/3}$为最优速率（至对数因子），统一了模型型与无模型方法的连续时间理论。

Abstract: Many real-world reinforcement learning (RL) problems evolve in continuous time, where decisions occur at irregular, event-driven intervals rather than at fixed discrete steps. We study episodic continuous-time Markov Decision Processes (MDPs) in which decision epochs are governed by a homogeneous Poisson process and the reward and transition dynamics vary smoothly over time. We consider both a fixed number of jumps per episode and a fixed time budget with a random number of Poisson decision epochs. Under a Lipschitz continuity assumption in time, we exploit local smoothness through discretization and extend both UCRL (Auer and Ortner 2006) and Q-learning (Jin et al. 2018) to this setting, proving $\widetilde{O}(T^{2/3})$ regret bounds for both model-based and model-free algorithms. Finally, we establish matching $\widetildeΩ(T^{2/3})$ minimax lower bounds, showing that the rate is optimal up to logarithmic factors. These results provide the first tight regret guarantees for Lipschitz-smooth continuous-time episodic MDPs with Poisson decision epochs.

</details>


### [893] [Ask for Any Appliance: A Prompt-Programmable Foundation Model for Non-Intrusive Load Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23146)
*Xudong Wang,Jiacheng Cui,Junyu Xue,Tongxin Li,Guoming Tang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 FM4NILM，一个可通过提示编程的 NILM 基础模型，用单一模型从总表数据估计指定电器的功率轨迹，在多个公开数据集上取得与电器专用模型相当或更优的解聚性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 NILM 需要为每个电器训练专用模型，且输出电器清单固定，导致扩展覆盖范围成本高昂。作者希望用单一共享模型，通过提示和示例而非新增专用网络来扩展电器覆盖。

Method: FM4NILM 以聚合测量、自然语言描述和可选激活示例为输入。采用轻量级节奏感知（cadence-aware）Transformer，在来自七个公开语料、采样间隔 1–60 s 的 645k 序列上以掩码重构预训练，再用观测掩码损失对部分标注家庭进行电器请求对齐。解码器采用 Bernoulli-lognormal 结构，将活动检测与条件功率估计分离。

Result: 在 REDD、UK-DALE、REFIT 的留出家庭与时间段上，一个冻结的文本提示模型服务十二个电器-语料请求，取得 0.556 事件 F1、0.625 AUPRC 及七种电器专用基线中最低的活跃窗口 MAE（251.8 W）。流式分数聚合在 60 s 延迟下将事件 F1 提升至 0.582。在类别留出评估中，增加十个激活示例使微波炉 AUPRC 从 0.132 提升到 0.214，且无需参数更新。输入干预消融实验考察了模型对电器请求与聚合测量的依赖。

Conclusion: 结果表明，单一共享模型可实现具有竞争力的负荷解聚，并支持通过提示和示例而非额外专用网络来扩展电器覆盖范围。

Abstract: Non-intrusive load monitoring (NILM) estimates appliance-level consumption from a whole-home meter, but appliance-specific models and fixed output inventories make coverage costly to extend. We present FM4NILM (Foundation Model for NILM), a single prompt-programmable model that estimates a requested appliance's power trajectory from aggregate measurements, a natural-language description, and optional activation exemplars. A lightweight cadence-aware transformer is pretrained by masked reconstruction on 645k sequences from seven public corpora spanning 1-60 s sampling intervals, then aligned with appliance requests using observation-masked losses for partially labeled households. A Bernoulli-lognormal decoder separates activity detection from conditional power estimation. On held-out households and time periods from REDD, UK-DALE, and REFIT, one frozen text-prompted model serves twelve appliance-corpus requests, achieving 0.556 event F1, 0.625 AUPRC, and the lowest active-window MAE (251.8 W) among seven appliance-specific baselines. Streaming score aggregation raises event F1 to 0.582 with a 60 s aggregation delay. In a separate category-held-out evaluation, adding ten activation exemplars raises microwave AUPRC from 0.132 to 0.214 without parameter updates. Input-intervention ablations probe the model's dependence on appliance requests and aggregate measurements. These results demonstrate competitive disaggregation with one shared model and support extending appliance coverage through prompts and examples rather than additional specialist networks.

</details>


### [894] [K-TRAIL: Simulator-Guided Generative Design of EM/RF Circuits](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23183)
*Piyush Saha,Evan Newell,Hanna O'Leary,Arun Natarajan,Alireza Aghasi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出K-TRAIL——一个模拟器引导的生成式框架，用于自动化EM/RF电路的逆向设计，将扩散式版图生成与无导数集合卡尔曼引导相结合，实现黑箱全波仿真反馈在生成过程中的布局优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RF与EM电路逆向设计困难：版图与电响应之间的映射非唯一（多解性），且全波仿真计算代价高昂。此外，现有方法多依赖伴随灵敏度或可微求解器模型，限制了黑箱仿真器的使用。

Method: K-TRAIL将扩散模型用于版图生成，并引入无导数的集合卡尔曼（ensemble Kalman）引导机制，在生成过程中利用黑箱EM仿真器的反馈迭代精修候选版图，无需伴随灵敏度或可微模型；框架同时支持由指定S参数响应合成，以及直接由RF性能约束合成。

Result: 在多层RFIC结构上的实验表明，模拟器引导的生成能提升与目标响应的吻合度，并能发现满足电路级设计要求的、结构上互异的多种版图方案。

Conclusion: 该方法为生成式、验证感知（verification-aware）的RF电路设计提供了实用路径，同时保留了对多样化版图拓扑的探索能力。

Abstract: Inverse design of RF and electromagnetic (EM) circuits is challenging because the relationship between circuit layout and electrical response is non-unique, and full-wave simulation is computationally expensive. This paper presents K-TRAIL, a simulator-guided generative framework for automated EM/RF circuit synthesis. K-TRAIL combines diffusion-based layout generation with derivative-free ensemble Kalman guidance, allowing feedback from a black-box EM simulator to refine candidate layouts during generation without requiring adjoint sensitivities or differentiable solver models. The framework supports both synthesis from prescribed S-parameter responses and synthesis directly from RF performance constraints. Experiments on multi-layer RFIC structures show that simulator-guided generation improves agreement with target responses and can identify structurally distinct layouts that satisfy circuit-level design requirements. The proposed approach provides a practical path toward generative, verification-aware RF circuit design while retaining the flexibility to explore diverse layout topologies.

</details>


### [895] [Neural Residual Modeling for Scientific Data Compression under Guaranteed Error Bounds](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23185)
*Surya Majumder,Liangji Zhu,Sanjay Ranka,Anand Rangarajan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种后处理流水线，将基于RVQ的潜空间压缩器与预测像元空间残差的U-Net以及GAE误差保证阶段结合，在科学数据压缩中同时提升压缩质量并保持严格的逐块误差界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: RVQ类学习式潜空间压缩虽有效，但残差建模完全在潜空间进行，重建的像元空间误差结构未被处理；且该误差具有空间结构性，非局部强度或梯度特征可解释，因此需要深层空间模型而非简单统计校正。

Method: 在RVQ压缩器后接一个U-Net，预测并校正原始体数据与RVQ重建之间的像元空间残差；随后将校正后的重建输入Guaranteed Autoencoder（GAE）阶段，将剩余残差投影到逐块PCA基上，以强制满足用户指定的逐块误差界。

Result: 在S3D、JHTDB和E3SM数据集上，相比仅RVQ及标准残差校正基线，NRMSE与压缩比均有稳定提升，同时维持科学数据保真所需的严格误差保证。

Conclusion: 该工作首次将潜空间RVQ、基于深度空间后处理网络的显式像元空间残差校正与GAE误差界保证统一于单一科学数据压缩框架，验证了潜空间量化与像元空间深度校正互补的有效性。

Abstract: Lossy compression of scientific simulation data increasingly relies on learned, latent-space architectures such as Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ), which iteratively quantize a base representation and its residuals to progressively reduce reconstruction error. While effective, RVQ performs this residual modeling entirely in latent space, leaving the pixel-space error structure of the reconstruction largely unaddressed. In this work, we propose a post-processing pipeline that augments an RVQ-based compressor with a U-Net trained to predict and correct pixel-space residuals between the original volume and its RVQ reconstruction. We show that these residuals are spatially structured rather than driven by local intensity or gradient features, motivating the need for a deep spatial model rather than simple statistical correction. The U-Net-corrected reconstruction is then passed through a Guaranteed Autoencoder (GAE) stage, which projects the remaining residual onto a per-block PCA basis to enforce a user-specified block-wise error bound. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first pipeline to combine latent-space RVQ, explicit pixel-space residual correction via a deep spatial post-processing network, and GAE-based error-bound guarantees within a single framework for scientific data compression. We evaluate our approach on S3D, JHTDB and E3SM datasets, demonstrating consistent improvements in NRMSE, compression ratio] over RVQ-only and standard residual-correction baselines, while maintaining strict error guarantees required for scientific data fidelity.

</details>


### [896] [Causal Inference with Unobserved Confounding: A Mixture Learning Perspective](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23219)
*Mansi Sood,Devavrat Shah*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该文提出用混合学习视角处理观测数据因果推断中的未观测混杂：将潜在混杂因子视为导致混合结构的异质性来源，在结构性与可识别性假设下恢复混合分布与分量机制，从而估计干预分布与因果效量，并扩展到高维指数族混合。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 未观测混杂是观测数据因果推断的根本性挑战。传统方法往往难以在存在潜在混杂因子时识别因果效应，因此需要新的建模范式来同时刻画异质性与识别因果量。

Method: 提出混合学习视角，将潜在混杂因子建模为诱导观测数据混合结构的异质性来源；在合适的结构性与可识别性假设下，通过恢复混合分布和分量机制来估计干预分布与因果效量。以Bernoulli混合的变体为贯穿示例，联系面板数据情形下的因果推断，包括潜在因子模型与合成干预；进一步研究具有相依结果轨迹的高维指数族混合，从反事实均值扩展到反事实分布建模。

Result: 以Bernoulli混合变体为例梳理了混合学习技术及其结构假设，并将其与面板数据因果推断、潜在因子模型和合成干预相连接；在高维指数族混合下实现了对反事实分布的建模，突破仅估计反事实均值的限制；将该视角与处理未观测混杂的其他互补方法进行了定位比较。

Conclusion: 该视角在混合学习与因果推断之间建立桥梁，将高维混合学习的最新进展与因果效应的可扩展识别和估计相连接，同时为混合学习提出新的挑战。

Abstract: Unobserved confounding is a fundamental challenge in causal inference from observational data. This article develops a mixture-learning perspective, viewing latent confounders as sources of heterogeneity that induce mixture structure in observed data. Under suitable structural and identifiability assumptions, recovering the mixing distribution and component mechanisms enables estimation of interventional distributions and causal estimands. Using variants of Bernoulli mixtures as a running example, we contextualize mixture-learning techniques and their structural assumptions, and connect them to causal inference in panel-data settings, including latent factor models and synthetic interventions.We then consider high-dimensional exponential-family mixtures with dependent outcome trajectories, moving beyond counterfactual means to model counterfactual distributions. We situate this perspective relative to complementary approaches for unobserved confounding. Together, these ideas provide a bridge between mixture learning and causal inference, connecting recent advances in high-dimensional mixture learning to scalable identification and estimation of causal effects while raising new challenges for mixture learning.

</details>


### [897] [Proximal Residual Value Functions for Consistent Planning and Real-Time Execution](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23242)
*Harrison Waldon,Carson Eisenach,Akhil Bagaria,Daniel Russo,Dominique Perrault-Joncas,Alisha Zachariah,Dean Foster*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文研究一种“规划层周期性提供连续价值函数、实时优化器分配到达资源”的双时间尺度决策系统（以库存配置为动机应用），提出端到端的强化学习方法学习“近端残差价值函数”，并在电商历史数据仿真中将总路由与转运成本较历史生产系统代理降低5.0%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 双时间尺度决策系统中，规划层需要向实时优化器提供延续价值函数，以指导到达资源的实时分配（如库存配置）。核心挑战在于：该价值函数既要支持端到端学习与可微优化，又要在实时执行时保留显式凸目标以保证优化良定义与决策一致性。

Method: 提出端到端强化学习方法，学习“近端残差价值函数”（proximal residual value functions）：由后决策库存的严格凸势函数（potential）与学习的凸残差（convex residual）组合而成。该一般形式产生良定义的优化层，支持端到端微分，同时在实时执行中保持显式凸目标。此外，刻画了光滑价值函数使规划与执行两个时间尺度上决策保持一致性的充要条件。

Result: 在使用某大型电商零售商历史库存到达与需求模式的离线仿真中，所学习的近端残差价值函数使总路由与转运成本相比“历史生产系统代理”（historical-production-system proxy）降低5.0%。

Conclusion: 近端残差价值函数为双时间尺度决策系统提供了一种兼具凸性与可端到端学习的价值函数表示，并可通过一致性充要条件保证跨时间尺度决策一致；在库存配置任务上验证了其相较历史生产系统代理的成本优势。

Abstract: We study two-timescale decision systems in which a planning layer periodically supplies a continuation-value function to a real-time optimizer that allocates arriving resources, with inventory placement as our motivating application. We propose an end-to-end reinforcement learning (RL) method for learning this function using \emph{proximal residual value functions}, which combine a strictly convex potential of post-decision inventory with a learned convex residual. This general form yields a well-posed optimization layer that supports end-to-end differentiation while preserving an explicit convex objective for real-time execution. We characterize the necessary and sufficient conditions under which a smooth value function yields decisions that are consistent across the planning and execution timescales. In an offline simulation using historical inventory arrival and demand patterns from a large e-commerce retailer, learned proximal residual value functions reduce total routing and transfer cost relative to a historical-production-system proxy by 5.0%.

</details>


### [898] [The Price of Self-Calibration: Exact Evidence Budgets and Manufactured Blind Sets in Adaptive Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23254)
*Abdou-Raouf Atarmla*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究自校准监控器（在线分位数跟踪器）为在任意漂移下保证预设长期误报率所付出的代价，给出精确的"代价定律"：保证是记账恒等式；步长δ产生约δ/η的过量报警质量，斜率c的斜坡产生c/η的稳态过量率；窗式报警率标准差为O(1/L)而非二项分布的O(1/√L)；容忍漂移类𝒟的监控器对𝒟−𝒟内的故障在任意时域下均盲，速度有界类的盲集恰为二倍速类。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 自校准监控器通过在线调整阈值来保证长期误报率，但这种保证在任意漂移下的实际"代价"（对检测能力的削弱）缺乏精确刻画。作者旨在以精确、带明确适用域的定律形式，量化该保证的代价，并揭示其固有的盲区结构。

Method: 以在线分位数跟踪器为对象，用记账恒等式与两条证据恒等式精确计算代价；通过窗式报警质量的望远镜求和分析其波动律并给出闭式常数（无需拟合参数）；用两点论证证明容忍漂移类𝒟的监控器对𝒟−𝒟盲，并给出精确高斯投影界刻画域外功效。

Result: ①保证是记账恒等式，与检测目标无关；高度δ的持续阶跃在一个报警内产生δ/η的过量报警质量，当δ为增益η的格点多倍时路径上恰为δ/η；斜率c的斜坡产生恰为c/η的稳态过量率，与累积幅度无关，边界c=η(1−α)与报警率上限一致。②窗式报警率标准差为O(1/L)而非二项分布O(1/√L)，闭式常数经无参数拟合验证；按二项尺度校准的检测器误校准因子为√(ηφ(q₀)L)，正确校准使检测窗口从故障速度倒数的二次变为线性。③容忍漂移类𝒟的监控器对𝒟−𝒟内故障盲；速度有界类的盲集恰为二倍速类；跟踪器吸收由自身增益决定的速度类，在将吸收漂移视为正常的认证体制下监控器"制造"了𝒟。精确高斯投影界比Pinsker更紧且永不空泛。

Conclusion: 自校准的误报率保证本质上是一个记账恒等式，其对检测能力的削弱可用精确恒等式刻画；其波动服从O(1/L)的精确律，正确校准可将检测窗口由二次降为线性；任何容忍漂移类的监控器存在𝒟−𝒟的结构性盲区，速度有界情形的盲集恰为二倍速类，且认证体制可反向"制造"漂移类。

Abstract: Self-calibrating monitors adapt their threshold online to guarantee a prescribed long-run false-alarm rate under arbitrary drift. We compute the price of that guarantee, stating every law with its exact domain of validity. First, the guarantee is an accounting identity, insensitive to what the monitor is meant to detect. Two evidence identities make the cost exact for the online quantile tracker: a persistent step of height $δ$ yields excess alarm mass within one alarm of $δ/η$, and exactly $δ/η$ pathwise when $δ$ is a lattice multiple of the gain $η$; a ramp of slope $c$ yields a stationary excess rate of exactly $c/η$, independent of accumulated size, up to a boundary $c=η(1-α)$ coinciding with the alarm-rate cap. Second, the certificate's own fluctuation obeys an exact law: the windowed alarm rate has standard deviation of order $1/L$, not the binomial $1/\sqrt{L}$, since the windowed mass telescopes to a difference of a tight internal state; the closed-form constant is validated with no fitted parameter. Detectors calibrated on the binomial scale are miscalibrated by $\sqrt{η\varphi(q_0)L}$, and correct calibration turns detection windows from quadratic to linear in the inverse fault speed. Third, any monitor required to tolerate a drift class $\mathcal{D}$ is blind, at any horizon and for any rule, to every fault in $\mathcal{D}-\mathcal{D}$; the proof is a deliberately elementary two-point argument and the contribution is the object it identifies: for speed-bounded classes the blind set is exactly the doubled-speed class, and the tracker absorbs a speed class fixed by its own gain, so that under a certification regime declaring absorbed drift normal, the monitor manufactures $\mathcal{D}$. An exact Gaussian projection bound, sharper than Pinsker and never vacuous, quantifies power outside it.

</details>


### [899] [Optimal No-Regret Learning for Repeated Prophet Inequality](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23265)
*Kun Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究前缀反馈下的重复先知不等式问题，提出高效算法实现 Õ(√T) 期望遗憾，匹配下界（对数因子内），并解决了 Liu et al. (2025) 的开放问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 经典先知不等式多关注单轮或完全反馈设定，而前缀反馈下学习者只能观测到停止盒子之前的前缀信息，且分布未知。该设定下如何设计达到最优遗憾阶的算法，尤其是消除对盒子数 n 的多项式依赖，是一个尚未解决的开放问题。

Method: 算法直接通过近最优策略进行探索：结合经验反向归纳（empirical backward induction）与盒子特定的到达奖励（box-specific reach bonuses）。随后采用相对下降聚合规则（relative-drop aggregation rule），利用观测前缀的嵌套结构来保持探索，从而去除对盒子数 n 的多项式依赖。

Result: 在 T 轮重复博弈中实现 Õ(√T) 期望遗憾，与下界在对数因子内匹配；算法效率高，且遗憾不再多项式依赖于盒子数 n。

Conclusion: 该工作给出了前缀反馈下重复先知不等式的近最优算法，解决了 Liu et al. (2025) 提出的开放问题，表明前缀反馈并不本质性地增加学习难度。

Abstract: We study repeated prophet inequalities under prefix feedback. In each of $T$ rounds, a learner encounters fresh values drawn independently from $n$ boxes with unknown $[0,1]$-supported distributions in a fixed order and must irrevocably accept one, observing only the prefix up to its stopping box. Regret is measured against the optimal stopping policy that knows the distributions. We give an efficient algorithm achieving $\widetilde O(\sqrt{T})$ expected regret, matching the lower bound up to logarithmic factors. Our algorithm explores directly through near-optimal policies, combining empirical backward induction with box-specific reach bonuses. A relative-drop aggregation rule then exploits the nesting structure of observed prefixes to preserve exploration, thereby removing the polynomial dependence on the box number $n$. This resolves an open question posed by Liu et al. (2025).

</details>


### [900] [Optimal Multi-way Decision Trees for Stratified Sampling in Online Controlled Experiments](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23308)
*Tomoka Takei,Shunnosuke Ikeda,Yuichi Takano*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 OMST，一种基于最优多路决策树的分层抽样框架，通过路径选择优化实现方差最小化，在不增加样本量的前提下提升 A/B 实验敏感度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在线对照实验（A/B 测试）中，核心挑战是在不增加样本量的情况下提升实验敏感度（统计功效）。分层抽样是经典方差缩减技术，但其效果高度依赖于分层结构的构建方式，现有方法在分层质量上存在不足。

Method: 将分层问题建模为特征图上的路径选择问题，提出最优多路分层树（OMST）。所选路径构成可解释的分层规则；在连续比例分配与 Neyman 型最优分配下，用精确的方差最小化二元优化形式对路径进行优化。引入监督式最优分箱，为数值特征生成与结果相关的候选切分；并提出冗余候选路径与分配约束的约简方法，显著降低优化问题规模。

Result: 在真实数据集与模拟数据集上，OMST 取得的方差缩减效果与现有方法相当或更优，同时保持分层树浅层且可解释。

Conclusion: OMST 通过优化驱动的多路分层树，在方差缩减与可解释性之间取得良好平衡，为提升在线实验敏感度提供了一种有效且可解释的分层抽样方案。

Abstract: Online controlled experiments, or A/B tests, are widely used to estimate causal effects on digital platforms. A central challenge is to improve experimental sensitivity, or statistical power, without increasing the experimental sample size. Stratified sampling is a classical variance reduction technique; however, its effectiveness depends critically on how the strata are constructed. We thus propose an optimization-based stratification framework for stratified sampling using optimal multi-way decision trees. Our method, called Optimal Multi-way Stratification Trees (OMST), formulates stratification as a path-selection problem over a feature graph. The selected paths define interpretable stratification rules and are optimized using an exact variance-minimizing binary optimization formulation under continuous proportional allocation and a Neyman-type optimal allocation. We incorporate supervised optimal binning to generate outcome-relevant candidate splits for numerical features. Furthermore, we introduce reduction procedures for redundant candidate paths and assignment constraints, substantially reducing the optimization problem size. Experiments on both a real-world and a simulated dataset demonstrate that OMST achieves comparable or superior variance reduction to existing methods while maintaining shallow and interpretable stratification trees.

</details>


### [901] [CSC: Calibrated Simplicity for Conflict-Aware Social Bot Detection in the LLM Era](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23320)
*Yipeng Qian,Pengjie Zhao,Chaoxi Niu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 CSC 框架，主张在 LLM 时代的社会机器人检测中，"校准的简单性"比单纯增加图侧复杂度更可靠。CSC 由简化原型引导图专家、校准单纯形约束融合、轻量跨模态不一致专家三部分组成，在 TwiBot-22/20 与 MGStBot-large 上提升了校准工作点决策质量，并保持外部基准竞争力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM 使文本语义伪装廉价、流畅且可规模化，仅凭文本难以检测社会机器人；由此产生"模态冲突"——账号在语义上像人类，但在图结构、画像属性或跨模态一致性上仍可疑。现有图检测器通过稀疏原型选择、自适应门控等图侧复杂度来应对，但作者实验表明：单纯增加复杂度并非化解冲突最可靠的方式。

Method: 提出 CSC（calibrated-simplicity framework）：(1) 简化的原型引导图专家，保留有用结构偏置、移除不稳定的图侧启发式；(2) 校准的单纯形约束融合，在后期融合前对齐异质置信空间；(3) 轻量的不一致专家，建模跨模态分歧。

Result: 在 TwiBot-22、TwiBot-20、MGStBot-large 上提升校准工作点的决策质量，外部基准保持竞争力。分析显示：校准改善置信可靠性；不一致专家主要在高冲突或近阈值区域提供局部修正；简化图侧控制带来更好的稳定性—成本权衡。语义伪装压力测试中，将部分机器人文本替换为匹配的人类文本使独立文本专家性能急剧下降，而图与融合证据在平衡挑战集上保持稳定。

Conclusion: 在 LLM 时代的社会机器人检测中，应对模态冲突的关键不在于图侧复杂度堆叠，而在于校准与简化：校准提升置信可靠性，简化图侧控制优化稳定性和成本，轻量不一致专家针对性修补高冲突区域，跨模态融合证据对语义伪装具有鲁棒性。

Abstract: Social bot detection is essential for protecting online platforms from misinformation amplification, coordinated manipulation, and distorted public discourse. However, large language models have made social bots much harder to detect from text alone because semantic camouflage is now cheap, fluent, and scalable. The resulting challenge is modality conflict: an account may look human-like in semantics while remaining suspicious in graph structure, profile attributes, or cross-modal consistency. Recent graph-based detectors tackle this limitation by adding graph-side complexity, such as sparse prototype selection, adaptive gating, or architecture-specific control logic, yet our experiments suggest that complexity alone is not the most reliable way to resolve such conflict.
  We therefore propose CSC, a calibrated-simplicity framework for conflict-aware LLM-era social bot detection. The framework combines three design choices: a simplified prototype-guided graph expert that retains useful structural biases while removing unstable graph-side heuristics, calibrated simplex-constrained fusion that aligns heterogeneous confidence spaces before late fusion, and a lightweight inconsistency expert that models cross-modal disagreement. Experiments on TwiBot-22, TwiBot-20, and MGStBot-large show that \textsc{CSC} improves calibrated operating-point decision quality while remaining competitive across external benchmarks. Further analyses show that calibration improves confidence reliability, the inconsistency expert mainly provides localized corrections in high-conflict or near-threshold regions, and simplified graph-side control yields a better stability-cost trade-off. A targeted semantic-camouflage stress test further shows that replacing selected bot text with matched human text sharply degrades the standalone text expert while leaving graph and fused evidence stable on a balanced challenge set.

</details>


### [902] [Rethinking Class Imbalance for Single-Cell Foundation Models: A Systematic Benchmark Across Architectures and Long-Tail Loss Functions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23325)
*Zeyu Dong,Jiahui Zhong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 单细胞基础模型虽整体准确率高，但在稀有细胞类型上系统性失败；本文对六种长尾损失函数在三种架构和三个数据集上进行了162次受控训练，揭示了两种失败机制并给出实用建议。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单细胞基础模型（scGPT、scBERT、Geneformer）在细胞类型分类上可达97.5%准确率，但这种总体准确率可能掩盖了在稀有、常与疾病相关的细胞群体上的系统性失败。长尾损失函数被广泛认为能解决该问题，但缺乏系统评估。

Method: 系统基准测试六种长尾损失函数（交叉熵、加权CE、类别平衡损失、focal loss、LDAM、logit-adjusted softmax），覆盖三种架构和三个数据集（多发性硬化、Zheng68K、人类胰腺），共162次受控训练（3骨干×3数据集×6损失×3随机种子）。

Result: 在所有九个（架构,数据集）设置中，普通交叉熵下总体准确率、Macro-F1与稀有类召回之间存在一致差距，由数据集结构而非预训练驱动。稀有类失败分为两种机制，具有不同的嵌入几何特征，且在选损失前即可见：部分类可通过正确损失恢复，另一些类保留线性可分性却被吸收进无关类的邻域。在可恢复类中，重加权效果由类的绝对训练集大小预测，而非其占比或数据集整体不平衡比。类别平衡损失和LDAM在九种设置中最稳定；logit adjustment以牺牲稀有类精确率换取召回率。

Conclusion: 研究提供了可复用的基准测试及机制驱动的实用指南，用于将基础模型与不平衡生物数据结合。

Abstract: Single-cell foundation models (scGPT, scBERT, Geneformer) achieve cell-type classification accuracy up to 97.5% in our experiments, yet this aggregate accuracy can mask systematic failure on rare, often disease-relevant cell populations that long-tail loss functions are widely assumed to address. We present a systematic benchmark of six long-tail loss functions (cross-entropy, weighted CE, class-balanced loss, focal loss, LDAM, logit-adjusted softmax) across three architectures and three datasets (Multiple Sclerosis, Zheng68K, human Pancreas), totaling 162 controlled training runs (3 backbones x 3 datasets x 6 losses x 3 seeds). The gap between overall accuracy, Macro-F1, and rare-class recall under plain cross-entropy is consistent across all nine (architecture, dataset) settings, driven by dataset structure rather than pretraining. Rare-class failure itself splits into two regimes with distinct embedding-geometry signatures, visible before any loss is chosen: some classes are recoverable by the right loss, while others retain linear separability yet are absorbed into unrelated classes' neighborhoods under every evaluated loss and architecture. Among the recoverable classes, the efficacy of reweighting is predicted by a class's absolute training-set size, rather than its share of the dataset or the dataset's overall imbalance ratio. Class-balanced loss and LDAM are the most consistent choices across all nine settings, while logit adjustment trades rare-class precision for recall rather than improving both. Our results give both a reusable benchmark and mechanism-grounded practical guidelines for combining foundation models with imbalanced biological data.

</details>


### [903] [What Can a Recurrent State Safely Forget?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23366)
*Linzhe Zhang,Changming Xu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文通过"预测商"(predictive quotient)刻画循环模型记忆与收缩的本质冲突，给出语义保持纠正的离散-连续边界，并提出可审计有限未来框架，用有限随机rollout获得分离裕度的高概率证书，证明探测代价下界为O(M·Ω^{-(k+2)})且最优。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 循环模型需同时保留影响未来行为的信息并抑制隐状态误差，二者存在冲突：收缩提升稳定性，但沿"区分未来"方向的收缩会破坏记忆。作者希望形式化这一边界，并将理论转化为可审计、可部署的纠正/探测方法。

Method: 1) 定义预测商：隐状态若诱导相同条件未来则等价，等价类构成预测纤维；证明语义保持纠正器在该商上为恒等映射，正则点处最多消除d−k个独立方向。2) 构造可审计有限未来框架：紧凑部署库W对独立审计库A（W⊆A）在声明的纠正域上评估，通过生成式探测与审计度量覆盖，用有限随机rollout给出分离裕度Ω_{W|A}(δ)的高概率证书。3) 用完整性模数(completeness modulus)将保证扩展到连续未来。

Result: 给出离散-连续边界：有限预测状态存在正半径精确纠正盆地，而不可数连续的未来可区分状态在有限维欧氏空间中经任意正半径扰动后不可解码。理论上：维持W-预测在认证裕度内即保证审计语义失真受限；固有审计维度为k时探测结果数按O(M·Ω^{-(k+2)})缩放，且匹配的极小极大下界证明该指数最优。实验验证了认证裕度、缩放律与自动探测精化在安全优先评估范式下的有效性。

Conclusion: 论文将循环模型的记忆-稳定性冲突提炼为预测维数与隐维数之间的维度边界，并建立从理论证书到可审计部署的桥梁：认证分离裕度可保证有界语义失真，探测复杂度指数最优，为安全关键场景下的循环模型评估与纠正提供可操作范式。

Abstract: Recurrent models must preserve information that changes future behavior while suppressing hidden-state error. These objectives conflict: contraction improves stability, but contraction along a future-distinguishing direction destroys memory. We formalize this boundary through the predictive quotient of a recurrent state space. Two hidden states are equivalent when they induce the same conditional future; their equivalence classes form predictive fibers. Every exact semantics-preserving corrector acts as the identity on this quotient. At a regular point with hidden dimension d and predictive dimension k, it can eliminate at most d - k independent directions. This establishes a discrete-continuous boundary: finite predictive states admit positive-radius exact correction basins, whereas an uncountable continuum of future-distinguishable states cannot be decoded after arbitrary positive-radius perturbations in finite-dimensional Euclidean space.
  To operationalize this principle, we develop an auditable finite-future framework. A compact deployment bank W is evaluated against an independent audit bank A (W subseteq A) on a declared correction domain. Under generative probe access and audit-metric coverage, finite stochastic rollouts furnish a high-probability certificate for the separation margin Omega_{W|A}(delta). Preserving learned W-predictions within this certified margin guarantees bounded audit-semantic distortion. For intrinsic audit dimension k, the required probe outcomes scale as O(M * Omega^{-(k+2)}), where M = |A|; a matching minimax lower bound proves this exponent is optimal. Extending guarantees to continuous futures is achieved via an explicit completeness modulus. Controlled experiments validate the certified margins, scaling laws, and automated probe refinement under a safety-first evaluation paradigm.

</details>


### [904] [The Evidence Ladder for Reinforcement Learning in Healthcare: From Retrospective Policies to Trusted Interventions](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23374)
*Yunfan Zhao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该综述提出用"证据阶梯"（问题建模→回顾性识别→策略估计→压力测试→前瞻性评估→生命周期监测）重构医疗强化学习研究，强调历史数据高分不等于临床改善。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 医疗决策后果随时间展开，强化学习天然适用，但多数进展仍远离常规临床干预。既有综述按算法或临床应用分类，缺乏对证据强度的纵向组织视角。

Method: 采用证据阶梯式综述框架，逐级梳理问题建模、回顾性识别、策略估计、压力测试、前瞻性评估与生命周期监测；在每个层级综合其假设与失效模式，分析证据的可迁移性，并提出累积评估的报告规范；将 restless bandits 作为特例而非组织框架。

Result: 揭示了一个反复出现的缺口：策略在历史数据集上得分高，并不构成其能改善医疗的证据；同时明确了各层级假设、失效模式及跨场景可迁移与不可迁移的证据类型。

Conclusion: 医疗强化学习应被视为嵌入不断变化的社会技术系统中的干预措施来评估，而非仅作为回顾性奖励的优化器。

Abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) offers a natural language for healthcare decisions whose conse- quences unfold over time, yet most reported progress remains far from routine intervention. Ex- isting surveys organize the field by algorithm or clinical application. We instead review healthcare RL through an evidence ladder: problem formulation, retrospective identification, policy estima- tion, stress testing, prospective evaluation, and lifecycle monitoring. This view connects clinical treatment, patient engagement, and health-system operations while exposing a recurring gap: evi- dence that a policy scores well in a historical dataset is not evidence that it will improve care. We synthesize the assumptions and failure modes at each rung, identify what evidence can and can- not transfer across settings, and propose reporting practices for cumulative evaluation. Restless bandits are included as one special case, not as the organizing framework. The central lesson is that healthcare RL should be evaluated as an intervention embedded in a changing sociotechnical system, rather than only as an optimizer of a retrospective reward.

</details>


### [905] [TRACE: Tractable Routing Autoencoder for Clinical ECG](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23460)
*Shunbo Jia,Runze Ma,Haonan Lyu,Haijin Zhang,Qiang Yang,Caizhi Liao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出TRACE——一种基于领域知识预先定义32维临床潜空间的可追踪路由自编码器，在ECG诊断中兼顾高精度与决策路径可审计性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 深度学习ECG诊断精度虽高，但精度最高的基础模型缺乏决策路径可审计性：临床医生无法将诊断追溯到某一生理通路，也无法对该通路进行干预。作者希望在不牺牲精度的前提下，实现可追溯到生理机制、可干预的诊断。

Method: TRACE采用由领域知识预先指定（而非优化发现）的32维临床潜空间，划分为灌注（perfusion）、结构（structure）、传导（conduction）三个子空间；按设计将每个子空间路由至各自诊断头，并用正交性惩罚正则化分区；通过允许潜变量扰动的解码器重建ECG。在CPSC2018上，仅重新指定路由表为灌注/节律/传导分区即可迁移。

Result: 在PTB-XL与Georgia上，TRACE超过无约束分类器，并在参数约为八分之一的情况下，以冻结特征线性探针评估仍领先于在千万级记录上预训练的ECG基础模型。探针、擦除与扰动分析验证了路由契约；扰动去极化与复极化通路可调制重建波形。移除指定分区及正交惩罚在PTB-XL上损失1.70 AUC和11.30 macro-F1，在Georgia上损失2.76 AUC和16.92 macro-F1。容量匹配的置换对照中，任意分配与本体路由的AUC差距在0.34以内，macro-F1统计上持平（p=0.619）。

Conclusion: 本体路由以极小的AUC代价（≤0.34）提供了决策路径可审计性，且不损失macro-F1，实现了高精度与可解释性、可干预性的统一。

Abstract: Deep learning has advanced automated electrocardiogram (ECG) diagnosis, but the field's most accurate models, foundation models pretrained on millions of recordings, are not decision-pathway auditable: a clinician cannot trace a diagnosis to a physiological pathway or intervene on one. We propose TRACE, a Tractable Routing Autoencoder for Clinical ECG, whose 32-dimensional clinical latent space is specified in advance from domain knowledge rather than discovered by optimization. TRACE partitions this space into perfusion, structure, and conduction subspaces, routes each to its own diagnostic head by design, regularizes the partition with an orthogonality penalty, and reconstructs the ECG through a decoder that permits latent perturbation. On PTB-XL and Georgia, TRACE exceeds unconstrained classifiers and stays ahead of an ECG foundation model pretrained on ten million recordings, evaluated by linear probe on frozen features, at roughly an eighth of the parameter count. On the nine-label CPSC2018 cohort, which carries no structural class, the framework transfers with only the routing table re-specified to a perfusion/rhythm/conduction partition. Joint probe, erasure, and perturbation analyses verify the routing contract, and perturbing the depolarization and repolarization pathways modulates the reconstructed waveform. Removing the specified partition and its orthogonality penalty costs 1.70 AUC and 11.30 macro-F1 points on PTB-XL, and 2.76 AUC and 16.92 macro-F1 points on Georgia. A capacity-matched permutation control places arbitrary assignments within 0.34 AUC points of the ontology routing and leaves macro-F1 statistically level (p=0.619): the ontology supplies decision-pathway auditability at no macro-F1 cost.

</details>


### [906] [ITSY: Causal Discovery From Irregular Time-Series Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23516)
*Wenbo Xu,Yue He,Yunhai Wang,Yueguo Chen,Kun Kuang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ITSY是首个针对不规则时间序列的连续优化因果发现方法，通过重构结构方程并对缺失值联合插补，在线性模型下恢复同期与滞后效应。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 结构因果模型（SCM）虽能从时间序列中恢复同期和滞后效应，但多数方法要求完整观测窗口，当样本缺失时会产生模型误设（misspecification）。

Method: ITSY重构结构方程，使预测使用最近可得的历史而非可能缺失的当前切片，并联合插补缺失值与学习两个图；同时采用加权重构目标以校正该重构引入的噪声变换。

Result: 在变化缺失率、规模、图密度和噪声的合成场景及一个真实基准上，ITSY在图恢复方面持续优于代表性SCM基线。

Conclusion: 结果确立了针对不规则线性一阶动态的聚焦解决方案，并阐明了向非线性或高阶扩展所需的假设。

Abstract: Structural causal models for time series recover contemporaneous and lagged effects, but most methods require complete observation windows and become misspecified when samples are missing. We introduce ITSY, the first continuous-optimization method for causal discovery from irregular time series under a linear model. ITSY reformulates the structural equation so that prediction uses the nearest available history rather than the possibly missing current slice, and jointly imputes missing values while learning both graphs. A weighted reconstruction objective corrects the noise transformation induced by this reformulation. Across synthetic regimes varying missingness, scale, graph density, and noise, and on a real world benchmark, ITSY consistently improves graph recovery over representative SCM-based baselines, demonstrating the effectiveness of the proposed method. The results establish a focused solution for irregular linear first-order dynamics and clarify the assumptions required for nonlinear or higher-order extensions.

</details>


### [907] [Feature Suppression and Differential Privacy for Residential Traffic Classification: A Two-Home Federated Study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23521)
*Márton Pál Lipcsey-Magyar,Adrian Pekar*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 在双客户端联邦学习模拟中比较全特征基线、特征抑制（FS）与DP-SGD：FS在宏F1与最差组F1上优于所测DP-SGD，但无形式化隐私保证，仅可作为输入最小化基线而非隐私替代方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 住宅流量分类服务于服务管理，但跨家庭学习需同时应对流量异构与隐私约束；隐私感知训练可能对不同流量类别产生不均衡代价，故需研究该权衡。

Method: 基于162万条网关采集的预处理流、6个类别，构建双客户端联邦学习模拟；对比全特征基线、特征抑制（FS-mild：16个输入中剔除4个时序特征）与差分隐私随机梯度下降（固定记录级隐私预算），采用规模比例聚合，并在分层切分与时间切分下、两种模型容量、5个随机种子重复实验。

Result: 规模比例聚合下，FS-mild在所有5个种子、两种容量、两种切分中，组合宏F1与最差组F1（各家庭每类F1最小值）均高于DP-SGD；所测DP-SGD配置造成显著的少数类性能损失，在较小家庭尤为明显；FS-mild相对全特征基线并非一致提升。基于损失与影子模型的成员推断探测在分层切分模型上仅接近随机水平，且探测间排序不一致，不足以证明隐私等价。

Conclusion: 特征抑制可作为输入最小化基线使用，但不能替代形式化隐私保护；成员推断探测的近随机结果不构成等价隐私的证据。

Abstract: Residential traffic classification supports service management, but learning across homes must account for heterogeneous traffic and privacy constraints. Privacy-aware training may impose uneven costs across traffic categories. We study this tradeoff in simulated two-client federated learning using 1.62 million preprocessed gateway-collected flows across six categories. We compare a full-feature baseline, feature suppression (FS), and differentially private stochastic gradient descent (DP-SGD) under one fixed record-level privacy setting. FS-mild excludes four timing features from 16 model inputs; it provides no formal privacy guarantee. With size-proportional aggregation, FS-mild achieves higher combined macro-F1 and worst-group F1 (the minimum per-class F1 across homes) than DP-SGD in all five seeds at both model capacities under stratified and temporal splits. The tested DP-SGD configuration incurs pronounced minority-category losses, especially in the smaller home, but FS-mild does not uniformly improve on the full-feature baseline. On stratified-split models, loss-based and shadow-model membership probes show near-chance aggregate discrimination without a consistent ranking across probes; this does not establish equivalent privacy.
