These findings support FS as an input-minimization baseline, not a substitute for formal privacy.

</details>


### [908] [Preserving Geometric Integrity in Graph Prompting via Measure-Constrained Optimal Transport](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23547)
*Xiangyu Wang,Shuo Wang,Ruiyi Fang,Zhao Kang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 MINT，用熵正则化最优传输将节点-提示适配建模为全局耦合分配问题，通过规定提示侧边际控制图级提示利用率，并给出方差分解与稳定性界。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 图提示学习中路由日益节点自适应，但独立优化的局部决策会在有限共享提示库上集中分配质量于少数提示，即使单节点-提示匹配在局部仍合理，造成图级提示利用不均衡。

Method: MINT（Measure-INtegrity Transport）：熵正则化最优传输框架，将节点到提示的适配形式化为全局耦合分配；传输代价偏好局部几何相容性，同时用预设的提示侧边际显式控制全图提示利用率；并推导精确方差分解，将提示侧几何方差拆分为保留的提示更新变异与节点内重心离散度，附带冻结编码器前向映射的条件稳定性界。

Result: 在标准引文网络及额外异质图上，MINT 在少样本适配中保持竞争力；受控与端到端实验区分路由与拓扑作用——固定边际路由控制全图提示利用率，并在引文网络上产生可测的端到端效应，拓扑增强则提供互补且依赖图结构的机制来应对结构失配。

Conclusion: MINT 通过全局耦合的边际约束路由解决了提示利用率集中于少数提示的问题，理论刻画了方差与稳定性，实证表明固定边际路由与拓扑增强在图提示适配中扮演互补角色。代码已开源。

Abstract: Graph prompt learning enables parameter-efficient adaptation of frozen Graph Neural Networks to downstream tasks through lightweight prompt parameters. As routing becomes increasingly node-adaptive, however, independently optimized local decisions can collectively concentrate assignment mass on a small subset of a finite shared prompt bank, even when individual node--prompt matches remain locally meaningful. We propose MINT (Measure-INtegrity Transport), an entropically regularized optimal transport framework that formulates node-to-prompt adaptation as a globally coupled allocation problem. The transport cost favors local geometric compatibility, while a prescribed prompt-side marginal explicitly controls graph-wide prompt utilization. We further derive an exact variance decomposition that separates prompt-side geometric variance into retained prompt-update variation and within-node barycentric dispersion, together with a conditional stability bound for the frozen-encoder forward map. Across standard citation networks and additional heterophilic graphs, MINT remains competitive in few-shot adaptation. Controlled and end-to-end experiments further distinguish the roles of routing and topology: fixed-marginal routing controls graph-wide prompt utilization and has measurable end-to-end effects on citation networks, while topology augmentation provides a complementary, graph-dependent mechanism for addressing structural mismatch. Code is available at https://github.com/Ga1axy0051/MINT.

</details>


### [909] [Bilinear Optimization Divergence: Diagnosing Factor-Constrained LoRA Continual Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23594)
*YongShun Wang,JianLin Su,Yong Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出 Bilinear Optimization Divergence (BOD) 诊断框架，揭示 LoRA 因子正交性本身不能决定组合更新保护的对象，并提出 SFOR 与 WRP 方法实现架构条件化的正交约束。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LoRA 微调中，因子正交性被广泛用于防止灾难性遗忘，但论文指出：正交性本身并不能说明组合更新保护了什么——答案取决于任务起始状态、参数化方式以及优化器实际位移。作者希望形式化这一问题，明确在不同架构（共享适配器 vs. 零输出新块）下应当保护何种约束以及如何保护。

Method: 论文提出 Bilinear Optimization Divergence (BOD)，一种锚点相对的有效更新响应诊断量，作用于选定的历史特征上。有限步分析区分两种情况：(1) 共享适配器中，保护路由位移会因伴随因子变化而留下学习锚点残差；(2) 在零输出新块中，可行路由状态可同时保护组合更新并保持两个当前因子可训练。基于此提出 SFOR（用于共享适配器）与累积 O-LoRA 的当前块硬保护，并用 Weight Residual Projection (WRP) 在优化器步后强制所需位移。

Result: 控制性双任务实验验证了预测的残差路径：共享族的历史归一化响应从 19.12% 降至 0.005%，累积族从 7.72% 降至 0.002%。在 Qwen3-8B 上的四任务实验中，SFOR 将 BWT 从 -2.47 提升至 -0.86 且平均准确率几乎不变；O-LoRA 硬保护将三阶平均 AA 从 80.27% 提升至 81.30%，FM 从 2.20 降至 0.43。组件消融显示更严格的可行性不一定改善最终任务性能。

Conclusion: 论文提供了架构条件化的分析视角，说明在 LoRA 正交约束中应施加哪种约束、如何施加，以及如何解释其经验价值，强调正交性本身不足以决定组合更新所保护的内容。

Abstract: Orthogonality in a LoRA factor does not by itself specify what the composed update protects: the answer depends on the task-start state, the parameterization, and the realized optimizer displacement. We formalize this question through Bilinear Optimization Divergence (BOD), an anchor-relative diagnostic of effective-update response on selected historical features. The finite-step analysis distinguishes two cases. In a shared adapter, protecting the routing displacement leaves a learned-anchor residual through the changing companion factor. In a fresh zero-output block, a feasible routing state can protect the composed update while both current factors remain trainable. These conditions yield Semi-Frozen Orthogonal Routing (SFOR) for shared adapters and current-block hard protection for cumulative O-LoRA; Weight Residual Projection (WRP) enforces the required displacement after the optimizer step. Controlled two-task traces verify the predicted residual paths, reducing normalized historical response from 19.12% to 0.005% in the shared family and from 7.72% to 0.002% in the cumulative family. Four-task experiments on Qwen3-8B characterize the resulting trade-offs: SFOR improves backward transfer (BWT) from -2.47 to -0.86 with nearly unchanged average accuracy (AA), while O-LoRA hard protection improves three-order mean AA from 80.27% to 81.30% and forgetting measure (FM) from 2.20 to 0.43. Component controls also show that stricter feasibility need not improve final task performance. Together, the analysis and evidence provide an architecture-conditioned account of which constraint to enforce, how to enforce it, and how to interpret its empirical value.

</details>


### [910] [ETH-TraceBench: A Large-Scale Event-Stream Benchmark for Ethereum DeFi under Temporal, Protocol, and Contract Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23659)
*Kemal Kirtac,Carsten Maple*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 ETH-TraceBench，一个用于评估以太坊 DeFi 表征在时间、协议、池/基础设施与符号偏移下表现的数据基准。模型在聚合时间测试集上表现优异（macro-F1 达 0.95+），但在协议新颖性与符号遮蔽条件下显著下降，且标准 Transformer 相对确定性乱序无稳定优势，表明高聚合分数未必源于复杂时序建模。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 以太坊 DeFi 提供公开、带时间戳的交易级事件流，但公开符号易诱导机器学习捷径（shortcut），导致模型依赖表面符号而非真实时序/协议结构。现有评估多依赖单一聚合分数，难以揭示模型在分布偏移下的泛化能力，因此需要构建强调迁移与受控输入条件的基准。

Method: 构建 ETH-TraceBench：原始事件域覆盖 2021 年 1 月至 2025 年 12 月，含 13.5 亿笔交易及 50.1 亿条原始日志行。评估采用固定 911,267 条监督样本，按时间划分为训练集（2021–2024）、模型选择集（2025H1）与测试集（2025H2）。设置时间、协议、池/基础设施、符号四类偏移，并引入 emitter/topic 联合遮蔽、去池化（unseen-pool）测试，以及日志索引排序 Transformer 与确定性乱序的对照实验；同时开展自然流行度审计与确定性 400 笔交易审计。

Result: 聚合时间测试上简单模型表现强劲：TraceStats-GB 达 0.953 macro-F1，TopicEmitterHashMLP 在标准 DEX 测试集达 0.959。协议新颖性下性能骤降，三者 macro-F1 分别为 0.794、0.743、0.766；严格未见池得分仍维持 0.927、0.897、0.935。未参与监督训练的 Uniswap v4 与 Ekubo v1 显著更难。联合遮蔽 emitter 与 topic 后，TopicEmitterTrace-SGD 的 DEX macro-F1 降至 0.916、清算 macro-F1 降至 0.774。标准 Transformer 相对同事件的确定性乱序无一致优势。审计估计 2025H2 DEX 在带日志以太坊交易中流行度约 22.5%，400 笔交易审计与任务标签来源及独立重查的原始日志计数完全一致。

Conclusion: ETH-TraceBench 主张将困难迁移与受控输入条件而非单一聚合分数作为主要评估目标。高聚合分数可在缺乏复杂时序建模的情况下产生，说明现有评测存在捷径风险；基准通过协议、池与符号层面的偏移设计，为 DeFi 表征的泛化能力提供更严格的检验。

Abstract: Ethereum decentralized finance (DeFi) provides a public, time-stamped record of transaction-level event streams, but the same public symbols can create strong machine-learning shortcuts. We introduce ETH-TraceBench, a benchmark for evaluating Ethereum DeFi representations under temporal, protocol, pool/infrastructure, and symbolic shift. The raw event universe covers January 2021-December 2025 and contains 1.35 billion transactions with logs and 5.01 billion raw log rows. Model evaluation uses a fixed 911,267-instance supervised sample, training on 2021-2024, selecting models on 2025H1, and testing on 2025H2. Simple models perform strongly on the aggregate temporal test: TraceStats-GB reaches 0.953 macro-F1 and TopicEmitterHashMLP 0.959 on the canonical DEX test set. Performance drops sharply under protocol novelty, with macro-F1 of 0.794, 0.743, and 0.766 for TraceStats-GB, TopicEmitterTrace-SGD, and TopicEmitterHashMLP, while strict unseen-pool scores remain 0.927, 0.897, and 0.935. Uniswap v4 and Ekubo v1, both absent from supervised training, are materially harder than the full test. Jointly masking emitter and topic identity reduces DEX macro-F1 to 0.916 and liquidation macro-F1 to 0.774 for TopicEmitterTrace-SGD. A standard Transformer over log-index-ordered events provides no consistent advantage over a deterministic shuffle of the same events, indicating that high aggregate scores can arise without sophisticated chronological modeling. A natural-prevalence audit estimates 2025H2 DEX prevalence among logged Ethereum transactions at about 22.5%, and a deterministic 400-transaction audit finds complete agreement with task label sources and independently re-queried raw-log counts. ETH-TraceBench therefore treats difficult transfer and controlled-input conditions, rather than a single aggregate score, as the main evaluation target.

</details>


### [911] [One Patch, Three Roles: What Is Actually Coupled in Autoregressive Time-Series Forecasting?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23686)
*Ziang Li,Yue Huang,Guoxu Zhou,Na Han,Jie Wen,Lunke Fei,Xiaozhao Fang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文将patch自回归时间序列预测中的表示、转移、执行三个角色解耦为独立设计轴，提出ATD蒸馏方法实现可选的1/2/4/8步执行，并提出Spectrum Tangent无参数校正，在720步预测上兼顾速度与精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有patch-based自回归预测将输入表示、学习到的状态转移与递归执行绑定在同一patch长度上，无法分别调节；作者希望明确三者中哪些角色可以独立调整，并解决递归推理速度慢、轨迹可拟合但预测精度不匹配的问题。

Method: 以原子编码研究考察宽度与原子分组的影响；提出自回归轨迹蒸馏（ATD），用轻量并行出口拟合冻结父模型的递归轨迹，支持ATD-1/2/4/8执行（ATD-1精确恢复父模型）；进一步发现沿训练选定的周期历史方向存在可校正残差投影，提出Spectrum Tangent，在不增加神经参数与Transformer调用的情况下施加该校正。

Result: 原子编码研究显示在评测网格上对模型宽度的敏感度高于原子分组；四数据集配对比较中ATD-8取得5.54倍端到端加速且跨宽度质量稳定；21次种子运行中ATD均提升轨迹保真度，但相比干净未来监督仅15次提升预测精度；在720步预测、七个数据集与两种输出宽度上，Spectrum Tangent将MSE与MAE分别降低2.54%和2.33%，同时比递归推理快3.24倍。

Conclusion: 轨迹可压缩性、保真度—精度失配及该校正现象在三个公开AR父模型上均重复出现，说明表示、转移、执行可作为自回归预测的独立设计轴；更少的调用并不自动消除父模型已有的预测误差。

Abstract: Patch-based autoregressive time-series forecasting often ties input representation, learned transitions, and recursive execution to one patch length. We ask which of these roles can be adjusted separately. A supporting atomic-encoding study finds greater sensitivity to model width than to atom grouping on the evaluated grid. Our main finding is that a frozen parent's recursive trajectory is easier to fit than the observed future with lightweight parallel exits. Autoregressive Trajectory Distillation (ATD) turns this into selectable ATD-1/2/4/8 execution, with ATD-1 exactly recovering the parent. On a paired four-data-set comparison, ATD-8 reaches $5.54\times$ end-to-end speedup with stable quality across widths. Fewer calls do not automatically remove the parent's existing forecast error: ATD improves trajectory fidelity in all 21 seed runs but forecast accuracy in only 15 against matched clean-future supervision. We further find a correctable residual projection along a train-selected periodic history direction. Spectrum Tangent applies this correction without adding neural parameters or Transformer calls. At horizon 720, it reduces mean squared error (MSE) and mean absolute error (MAE) by 2.54% and 2.33% over seven data sets and two output widths, while remaining $3.24\times$ faster than recursive inference. Level and shape projections sometimes disagree. Trajectory compressibility, the fidelity-accuracy mismatch, and the correction recur across three public AR parents. Together these results separate representation, transition, and execution as AR design axes. Code is available at https://github.com/RowanFFF/ATD-Spectrum-Tangent.

</details>


### [912] [GenVoid: Uncertainty-Aware Learning of Subsurface Material Defects with an Experimentally Validated Physics-Informed Generative Model](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23761)
*Trishit Mondal,Prajwal Bharadwaj,Nikhil Karanjgaokar,Ameya D. Jagtap*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出物理信息生成模型框架 GenVoid，仅凭表面位移测量即可识别二维/三维固体内部空洞，并提供可观测性度量以量化推断极限与传感器配置关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 内部空洞是制造结构中的普遍缺陷，但其几何不可见，只能通过可及测量间接推断，传统表征方法面临挑战；同时需要量化此类推断的根本极限及测量策略设计依据。

Method: 将控制力学方程嵌入生成式推断框架（物理信息生成模型），支持线弹性、超弹性与塑性行为及复杂二维/三维几何；显式建模位移测量的不确定性与噪声，输出内部空洞几何的概率重建；并引入可观测性度量，表征边界测量对内部局部刚度扰动的敏感性随载荷集合的变化。

Result: 在高保真合成数据集与现场力学实验测得的位移场上验证了方法有效性，能够从真实位移测量中推断隐藏空洞；可观测性度量建立了缺陷位置、传感器配置与重建保真度之间的直接联系，实现对边界测量数量与空间分布如何影响识别精度的系统评估。

Conclusion: 该工作建立了物理信息且不确定性感知的隐蔽缺陷无损表征方法，并为固体力学反问题的测量策略设计提供了定量基础。

Abstract: Internal voids are ubiquitous defects in manufactured structures, yet their characterization remains challenging because their geometry is hidden and can only be inferred indirectly from accessible measurements. Here we introduce \textit{GenVoid}, a physics-informed generative model-based framework for identifying internal voids in complex two- and three-dimensional solids from surface displacement measurements alone. By incorporating the governing mechanics into a generative inference framework, \textit{GenVoid} enables void identification across linear elastic, hyperelastic and plastic material behaviours and accommodates complex two- and three-dimensional structural geometries. Importantly, the framework explicitly accounts for uncertainty and noise in displacement measurements, producing probabilistic reconstructions of internal void geometry rather than a single deterministic estimate. We demonstrate the approach using high-fidelity synthetic datasets and experimentally measured displacement fields obtained from in-situ mechanical experiments, establishing its ability to infer hidden voids from realistic displacement measurements. To quantify the fundamental limits of such inference, we further introduce an observability measure that characterizes the sensitivity of boundary measurements to localized stiffness perturbations within the interior under an ensemble of applied loads. This framework provides a direct connection between defect location, sensor configuration and reconstruction fidelity, enabling systematic assessment of how the number and spatial distribution of boundary measurements govern void-identification accuracy. To this end, these results establish a physics-informed and uncertainty-aware approach for non-invasive characterization of hidden defects and provide a quantitative basis for designing measurement strategies for inverse problems in solid mechanics.

</details>


### [913] [Statistical Convergence of Transformer Encoder-Accelerated Robust Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23775)
*Suman Banerjee,Hiroyasu Tsukamoto*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究大规模状态-动作空间中马尔可夫决策过程最优动作价值函数的求解问题，提出一种由基于Transformer的动作价值函数预测进行热启动的鲁棒强化学习算法，并利用R-污染模型与保形预测给出统计严格的收敛保证。数值实验表明Transformer热启动能降低初始误差并加速收敛，所提保形界比现有保证更紧地追踪真实误差轨迹。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在状态-动作空间很大时，求解马尔可夫决策过程的最优动作价值函数计算代价高昂。同时，真实状态转移核往往存在不确定性，既有收敛保证通常依赖对真实转移核的较多知识，且界较松。因此需要一种既能利用先验知识加速收敛、又能在转移核不确定性下提供统计严格且紧致认证的鲁棒强化学习方法。

Method: 采用R-污染模型刻画状态转移核中的不确定性；使用Transformer基于自然语言提示编码任务规范，预测动作价值函数以实现热启动；采用保形预测，基于收缩Bellman残差构造轨迹级非一致性分数；由此得到保形分位数界，对所有迭代同时约束运行动作价值函数与最优动作价值函数之间的差距，并据此导出几乎不需要真实转移核知识的预认证停止规则；在规模和污染程度不同的扰动迷宫环境中进行数值验证。

Result: 在规模和污染程度各异的扰动迷宫环境中的数值案例研究表明：基于Transformer的热启动可明显降低初始误差并加速收敛；所提出的保形界相比现有收敛保证能更紧地追踪真实误差轨迹。

Conclusion: 该研究为Transformer热启动的鲁棒强化学习提供了统计严格的收敛结果，并通过保形预测构造了同时覆盖所有迭代的误差认证界与预认证停止规则。实验验证了热启动的有效性与所提界的紧致性，表明该方法在大规模状态-动作空间和转移核不确定性下具有实用价值。

Abstract: Obtaining the optimal action-value function in Markov decision processes is computationally intensive in large state--action spaces. In this study, we present statistically rigorous convergence results for a robust reinforcement learning algorithm warm-started by a transformer-based action-value function prediction, where natural language prompts encode task specifications. Our framework adopts the R-contamination model to characterize uncertainty in the state transition kernel, and employs conformal prediction to certify convergence via trajectory-level nonconformity scores constructed from the contracting Bellman residual. The resulting conformal quantile bounds the gap between the running and optimal action-value functions simultaneously over all iterations, thereby yielding a pre-certified stopping rule that requires little knowledge of the true transition kernel. Numerical case studies on perturbed maze environments of varying size and contamination level confirm that the transformer-based warm start measurably reduces the initial error and accelerates convergence, while the proposed conformal bounds track the true error trajectory more tightly than existing guarantees.

</details>


### [914] [Falling Trees: A Model Class for Interpretable Risk Prioritization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23780)
*Varun Babbar,Zachery Boner,Margo Seltzer,Cynthia Rudin*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出 falling trees——一种在保持风险单调递减约束的同时允许树状分支的可解释模型族，并给出 GRAVITree 算法用于学习其 Rashomon 集。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现实决策常需对高风险样本优先排序（如临床中优先处理高危患者）。已有的 falling rule lists (FRLs) 虽可解释，但其单路径结构导致模型类受限，表达能力不足。

Method: 提出 falling trees，强制与 FRLs 相同的单调风险约束，但允许树结构分支；设计 GRAVITree，一种带界的动态规划算法，在深度与分支约束下学习 falling trees 的 Rashomon 集；该建模可在规则列表与完整决策树之间插值，以调节模型表达力。

Result: 在一个新的临床数据集及多个公开分类基准上，falling trees 匹配或优于 FRLs 及其他可解释基线，且常为高风险样本产生更稀疏的判定路径。

Conclusion: falling trees 在高风险场景中于可解释性、表达力与风险优先排序之间取得了实用平衡。

Abstract: Many real-world decisions require prioritizing high-risk cases, such as clinicians prioritizing high-risk patients before lower-risk ones. Falling rule lists (FRLs), which are ordered if--then rules with monotonically decreasing risks, provide an interpretable framework for such tasks; however, their single-path structure yields a highly restricted model class. We introduce falling trees, a new family of interpretable models that enforces the same monotonic risk constraint while permitting tree-structured branching. We present GRAVITree, a novel dynamic-programming-with-bounds algorithm for learning the Rashomon set of falling trees under depth and branching constraints. Our formulation can interpolate between rule lists and full decision trees, enabling user-desired model expressivity. In a new clinical dataset and in many public classification benchmarks, falling trees match or outperform FRLs and other interpretable baselines, often producing more sparse decisions for high-risk instances. Our results show that falling trees strike a practical balance between interpretability, expressiveness, and risk prioritization for high-stakes settings.

</details>


### [915] [Real-time Generalizable Heart Valve Mechanics for Clinical Disease Assessment via a Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23826)
*Shawn Koohy,Wensi Wu,Matthew A Jolley,Paris Perdikaris*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出物理条件神经算子（PCNO），一种基于Transformer的代理模型，可在心脏瓣膜几何上预测叶片位移、应变与应力场，训练覆盖功能性、反流性与病理性瓣膜，在精度可比前提下实现最高15260倍于细网格有限元仿真的加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 二尖瓣反流是全球最常见的心脏瓣膜疾病，影响超2%人口、75岁以上成人至少10%，并造成约15%的瓣膜性心脏病相关死亡；但重度患者中仅少数接受矫正手术。快速评估瓣膜力学有助于更早期、更精准的干预，而传统有限元模拟对临床时间尺度与参数扫描而言过慢。

Method: 提出物理条件神经算子（PCNO）：基于Transformer的代理模型，以收缩期血压与组织属性为条件，预测二尖瓣与三尖瓣几何上的叶片位移、应变与应力场；训练数据涵盖功能性、反流性及病理性瓣膜，包括拴系（tethering）、P2脱垂与瓣环扩张。

Result: 相较细网格有限元仿真最高实现15260倍加速且精度相当；可识别病理类别；在分布外外推条件下，诊断指标的求解误差在3.5%以内。

Conclusion: PCNO在保持与细网格有限元仿真相当精度的同时大幅提升计算效率，并具备病理分类与分布外诊断指标求解能力，有望支持瓣膜力学的快速评估，从而推动更早期、更精准的临床干预。

Abstract: Mitral regurgitation is the most common heart valve disorder worldwide, affecting over 2% of the global population, rising to at least 10% in adults over 75, and causing approximately 15% of valvular heart disease-related deaths. Yet only a minority of patients with severe disease undergo corrective surgery. Rapid assessment of valve mechanics could enable earlier, more precise intervention, but traditional finite element simulations remain too slow for clinical timelines and parameter sweeps. We introduce the Physics-Conditioned Neural Operator (PCNO), a transformer-based surrogate that predicts leaflet displacement, strain, and stress fields across mitral and tricuspid geometries, conditioned on systolic blood pressure and tissue properties. Trained on functional, regurgitated, and pathological valves, including tethering, P2 prolapse, and annular dilation, PCNO achieves up to a 15,260x speedup over fine mesh finite element simulations with comparable accuracy, identifies pathology class, and resolves diagnostic metrics within 3.5% error under out-of-distribution extrapolation.

</details>


### [916] [Actionable Insights from Observational Data: The Case of Advanced Classes in K-12 Education](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23836)
*Nabit Bajwa,Seth B. Hunter,Sanmay Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文利用美国某公立学区引入选课式高级初中课程的数据，在存在自选择偏误的观测数据中分析修读高级课程的效果，发现高级英语课对成绩有温和正向影响，但收益分布不均，"中等成绩"学生及部分群体入学率偏低。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: K-12教育中长期存在一个难以回答的问题：修读更高阶/更具挑战性的课程究竟有何影响。复杂性在于学生（及家长）自主决定是否选课，导致因果推断困难。

Method: 利用某美国公立学区的新数据，记录学生的选课决策、既往学业历史、人口学特征及后续结果，并借助学区范围内引入可选公开选课制（open-enrollment）高级初中课程这一变化。核心识别挑战在于：影响选课的因素同样预测学业结果，因此直接比较选课与未选课学生存在混淆。

Result: 修读高级英语课程对学生成绩有净正向但温和的效应；收益分布不均：预测增益较大的"中等成绩"学生反而选课概率更低；部分群体（如黑人和低社经地位学生）选课倾向也显著偏低。

Conclusion: 预测收益与实际选课之间存在缺口，说明严谨的数据分析可从大规模观测数据中提取可操作洞见，识别出本应受益却未选择高级课程的学生。

Abstract: A fundamentally challenging question in K-12 education is about the effects of taking more advanced or challenging classes. It is particularly complex because students (and/or their parents) choose whether to enroll in these classes, making causal analysis challenging. In this paper, we begin to tackle this question by taking advantage of a novel dataset from a public school system in the US. This dataset records students' course enrollment decisions, prior academic histories, demographics, and subsequent outcomes around the time of a district-wide change that introduced optional open-enrollment advanced middle-school courses in subject areas. This is a rich observational dataset, but enrollment in advanced classes is driven by student characteristics and choices rather than random assignment. This creates a core identification challenge: the same factors that influence enrollment in advanced courses are also predictive of academic outcomes. As a result, simple comparisons between enrolled and non-enrolled students are confounded, and naive estimates may reflect underlying differences in student ability, motivation, or support rather than the impact of coursework itself. Our analysis shows that enrolling in advanced English courses has a net positive but modest effect on student achievement outcomes. However, these benefits are unevenly distributed: some students with relatively large predicted gains ("middle achievers" in prior years) are less likely to enroll than others. Some other groups (e.g. Black students and those with lower socio-economic status) also demonstrate significantly lower propensity to enroll. This gap between predicted benefit and observed enrollment illustrates how careful data analysis can extract actionable insights from large observational datasets, including identifying students who appear well-positioned to benefit but do not select into advanced options.

</details>


### [917] [From Regional to Global: Transfer Learning for Atmospheric Transport Emulators](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23838)
*Jeff Clark,Elena Fillola,Nawid Keshtmand,Raul Santos-Rodriguez,Matthew Rigby*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文评估大气传输模拟器在四个世界区域（南美、东亚、南亚、北非）间的空间可迁移性，通过区域专属模型、多区域模型及留一区域实验，结合输入变量与足迹分布特征分析跨区域泛化与迁移学习能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 温室气体排放估算依赖逆方法，需结合大气浓度观测与化学传输模型。传统物理驱动的拉格朗日粒子扩散模型（LPDM）运行成本高、难以适配现代卫星高分辨率数据。此前已开发出比英国气象局LPDM快约1000倍的大气传输模拟器，但因其刻画的大气传输具有区域异质性，向全球范围扩展并非易事，因此需研究模型的跨区域迁移能力。

Method: 构建区域专属模型与多区域模型，并设计留一区域交叉验证实验，在南美、东亚、南亚、北非四个区域上评估空间可迁移性；同时结合输入变量分布与输出足迹（footprint）分布特征刻画区域间差异。

Result: 通过区域专属、多区域及留一区域实验，量化了模型在四区域间的迁移表现，并从输入变量与输出足迹分布的角度揭示了区域异质性对跨区域泛化的影响（摘要未给出具体数值结果）。

Conclusion: 该工作为跨区域泛化与迁移学习提供了直观认识，有助于提升各区域性能，从而支撑高效、低成本的全球尺度温室气体排放估算。

Abstract: Greenhouse gas emissions estimates can be derived using inverse methods by combining atmospheric concentration observations with chemical transport models. The latter traditionally use physics-driven simulators such as Lagrangian Particle Dispersion Models (LPDMs), which are expensive to run and do not scale well to modern satellites' high resolution data. Previously we developed a performant atmospheric transport emulator that approximates LPDM outputs ("footprints") over South America ~1,000X faster than the UK Met Office's LPDM. Expanding towards global emulation is not straightforward, as atmospheric transport is regionally heterogeneous. This paper evaluates spatial transferability capabilities of models across four world regions: South America, East Asia, South Asia, North Africa using both region-specific and multi-region models, and leave-one-region-out experiments. Regional differences are characterised in the context of input variable and output footprint distributions. This work builds intuition in cross-region generalisation and transfer learning, aiding regional performance towards efficient global emissions estimates.

</details>


### [918] [Adaptive Determinantal Client Scheduling in Federated Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23843)
*Wen Xu,Ben Liang,Gary Boudreau,Hamza Sokun*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出使用行列式点过程（DPP）建模并增强联邦学习客户端调度中的多样性，设计了基于梯度信息与质量分数的DPP核矩阵，并据此提出自适应行列式客户端调度算法ADCS，量化了梯度近似误差，给出非凸损失下通用有偏客户端选择的收敛分析，实验表明ADCS优于现有的基于质量和基于多样性的调度算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 联邦学习中数据异构与系统异构使客户端调度至关重要。既有工作多关注被调度客户端的质量，以加速收敛、缩短墙钟收敛时间或提升平均模型性能，却很少考虑客户端多样性；而多样性对抵抗异构性、改善最差客户端（worst-off clients）的性能十分重要。

Method: 采用行列式点过程（DPP）对客户端调度中的多样性进行建模与增强：首先利用梯度信息与质量分数设计DPP核矩阵，从而内在地支持质量-多样性之间的灵活权衡；随后在DPP上执行快速MAP推断，提出联邦学习中的自适应行列式客户端调度（ADCS）；并量化ADCS的梯度近似误差，针对非凸损失函数下的一般有偏客户端选择给出收敛性分析。

Result: 对比数值实验显示，ADCS优于当前最先进的客户端调度算法，包括基于质量的方法和基于多样性的方法。

Conclusion: 将DPP引入联邦学习客户端调度可有效兼顾质量与多样性，ADCS在保证收敛性理论支撑的同时，在性能上超越现有主流调度算法，说明多样性建模是应对异构性、提升最差客户端表现的有效途径。

Abstract: Scheduling clients for model training is critical in federated learning due to both data and system heterogeneity. Most previous works focus on the quality of the scheduled clients to achieve faster convergence, shorter wall-clock convergence time, or better average model performance. They rarely consider the diversity of clients, which is important to counter heterogeneity and improve performance for the worst-off clients. In this work, we advocate the use of determinantal point processes (DPPs) to model and enhance the diversity in client scheduling. We first design the kernel matrices of DPPs using gradient information and quality scores, which inherently enables a flexible quality-diversity trade-off. Applying fast MAP inference over DPPs, we propose Adaptive Determinantal Client Scheduling (ADCS) in FL. We further quantify the gradient approximation error of ADCS and develop convergence analysis for general biased client selection in FL with non-convex loss functions. We conduct comparative numerical experiments showing that ADCS outperforms state-of-the-art client scheduling algorithms, including both quality-based and diversity-based ones.

</details>


### [919] [PROSE: A Theory of Optimal Stopping with Perishable Evidence for Peer Selection in Intermittently Connected Decentralised Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23845)
*Christos Anagnostopoulos*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文为去中心化联邦学习中的对等节点选择问题建立了"易逝证据"最优停止理论，并实例化为轻量本地策略PROSE。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 去中心化联邦学习去除了聚合服务器，协作依赖临时在线的对等节点。在移动/间歇连接系统中，评估节点会消耗接触时间，甚至使交换机会本身消失；学到的证据会因链路过期与节点模型漂移而衰减，因此需要一套关于何时停止评估、何时交换的选择理论。

Method: 将接收方在单次接触内的决策形式化为有限时域马尔可夫最优停止问题，包含有成本的信息获取与未来到达的外部选项；证明存在由保留价值刻画的最优策略（Snell包络结构）。围绕该形式化证明四组结论：(i) 阶段一致、漂移感知的集中不等式与高概率正确的maximin认证规则及有限样本辨识界；(ii) 移动感知的信息价值停止规则与比较静态，即更高的链路风险降低继续探测的价值并扩大停止区域；(iii) 标记泊松接触到达下的等待价值闭式解与搜索论保留值及其比较静态；(iv) 近视最优性定理，说明在足够易变的（单调）移动性区间中，单步置信安全规则是最优策略的可靠替代且不会过早停止。实例化为PROSE。

Result: 证明最优策略具保留值（Snell包络）结构；给出高概率正确的maximin认证规则与有限样本辨识界；得出链路风险升高会降低探测价值、扩大停止区域的比较静态；给出标记泊松到达下等待价值闭式解与保留值比较静态；证明近视最优性定理（单步置信安全规则在易变移动性区间内不会过早停止且可靠）。明确刻画了静态接触与无漂移极限，在此极限下可退回经典序贯决策问题。全文为解析性结果，未含实验。

Conclusion: PROSE为完全本地的轻量策略，理论自洽并统一了易逝证据下的对等选择；其静态接触/无漂移极限可恢复经典序贯决策问题，为去中心化联邦学习节点选择提供了可证明的最优停止框架。

Abstract: Decentralised federated learning removes the aggregation server but makes collaboration dependent on transient peer availability. In mobile and intermittently connected systems, evaluating a promising peer consumes contact time and may cause the exchange opportunity itself to vanish, so that the evidence a learner gathers about a peer is perishable: it decays because links expire and because peer models drift while old measurements age. This paper develops a self-contained theory of optimal stopping for the resulting peer-selection problem. We formalise a receiver's within-contact decision as a finite-horizon Markov optimal-stopping problem with costly information acquisition and a future-arrival outside option, and prove that it admits an optimal policy characterised by a reservation value (Snell-envelope structure). Around this formulation we prove: (i) stage-uniform, drift-aware concentration and a maximin certification rule that is correct with high probability together with a finite-sample identification bound; (ii) a mobility-aware value of-information stopping rule and comparative statics showing that higher link hazard lowers the value of continued probing and enlarges the stopping region; (iii) a closed-form value of waiting under marked-Poisson contact arrivals, together with a search-theoretic reservation value whose comparative statics we characterise; and (iv) a myopic-optimality theorem establishing that, in sufficiently volatile (monotone) mobility regimes, the one-step confidence-safe rule is a sound surrogate for the optimal policy and never stops prematurely. We instantiate the theory as PROSE (Perishable-evidence Reservation-value Optimal Stopping for Exchange), a lightweight, fully local policy, and delineate the static contact and drift-free limits in which classical sequential decision problems are recovered. The development is entirely analytical.

</details>


### [920] [Collaborative Streaming Anomaly Detection with Interactive Explanations and Ensemble Consensus](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23883)
*Diogo Risca,Afonso Lourenço,Ricardo Martins,Goreti Marreiros*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一个将人类分析师纳入决策回路的协作式流式异常检测系统，融合异构检测器并通过归一化加权共识聚合输出，同时生成可解释的代理模型，支持分析师干预与规则优化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高速数据流中的异常检测面临检测稳定性、可解释性与人工干预需求等挑战，需要将人类分析师整合进决策过程以提升实用性与可信度。

Method: 系统集成异构检测器，采用基于归一化的加权共识进行输出聚合，并辅以artifact-aware规则在部署环境下稳定异常评分；同时推导代理模型近似集成共识，暴露与异常行为相关的可读传感器条件，允许分析师审阅异常片段、调整共识行为并精炼代理规则，形成人机调整后的集成。

Result: 在一个包含260,000个事件和3个异常片段的工业数据流上进行评估，显示出稳健的检测性能与可操作的人机交互能力。

Conclusion: 将人类分析师显式纳入决策回路的协作式异常检测系统能够在高速数据流中实现稳健检测并支持有效的人机交互，具备实际部署价值。

Abstract: We present a collaborative streaming anomaly detection system for high-speed data streams that explicitly integrates human analysts into the decision loop. The system combines heterogeneous detectors and aggregates their outputs through a normalization-based weighted consensus, complemented by artifact-aware rules to stabilize anomaly scoring under deployment. To improve interpretability, it derives surrogate models that approximate the ensemble consensus and expose human-readable sensor conditions associated with anomalous behavior. Analysts can actively intervene by reviewing anomaly episodes, adjusting consensus behavior, and refining surrogate rules used for anomaly prediction, producing a human-adjusted ensemble. We evaluate the approach on an industrial stream with 260\,000 events and 3 anomalous episodes, showing robust detection and actionable human-AI interaction.

</details>


### [921] [GDN Tree-Scan: Served Tree Verification for Recurrent-Hybrid Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23900)
*Zhiyuan Ma*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 面向 Gated-DeltaNet 混合语言模型，提出 GDN Tree-Scan 树形推测解码验证器，并集成到 vLLM；在 Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 上以六节点根分支树取得 27.0% 的 token 加权解码吞吐提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 注意力-only 的 Transformer 在树形推测解码中，验证器只需祖先掩码即可；但循环混合模型（recurrent-hybrid）打破了这一假设：候选行还必须携带其根到节点路径上原生顺序解码本应产生的循环状态，否则即便注意力掩码正确，仍会条件于一个不可能的循环历史。

Method: GDN Tree-Scan 结合四项技术：FlashAttention-2 树偏置注意力（tree-bias attention）、分支局部的 GDN scan/replay、设备端多重草稿提交（device-side multidraft commitment）、以及仅已接受链的状态发布（accepted-chain-only state publication）；系统集成于 vLLM，作为 Gated-DeltaNet 混合模型的在线服务验证器。

Result: 在公开 Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 检查点上，干净的 batch-one（B=1）SWE/Codex 解码门控（温度 0.6）下：六节点根分支树使每次事件的提交 token 数提升 17.2%，验证前向时间接近原生水平；token 加权解码吞吐达 23.88 tokens/s，对比原生五步 MTP（E5）的 18.80 tokens/s，提升 27.0%。按请求等价的延迟视角为 +4.0%，端到端任务墙钟时间仍以预填充为主。经验性等价证据限定于循环 oracle 概率重打分（p-rescore）在观测到的原生翻转下限内闭合，而非完整的分布距离证明。

Conclusion: 该工作表明树形推测解码可扩展到循环混合语言模型，关键在于候选行必须携带与路径一致的循环状态；所提系统在服务化场景下获得显著 token 加权吞吐收益，但等价性仅为 p-rescore 层面的经验证据，尚不等同于严格的分布等价证明。

Abstract: Tree speculative decoding verifies multiple candidate continuations in one target forward pass. For attention-only transformers, the verifier mainly needs an ancestry mask. Recurrent-hybrid language models break this assumption: a candidate row must also carry the recurrent state that native sequential decode would have produced along its root-to-node path. Otherwise, a verifier can use a correct attention mask while still conditioning on an impossible recurrent history.
  We present GDN Tree-Scan, a served verifier for Gated-DeltaNet hybrid language models integrated into vLLM. The system combines FlashAttention-2 tree-bias attention, branch-local GDN scan/replay, device-side multidraft commitment, and accepted-chain-only state publication. On the public Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 checkpoint, in a clean batch-one (B=1) SWE/Codex decode gate at temperature 0.6, a six-node root-branch tree increases committed tokens/event by 17.2% at near-native verify-forward time and reaches 23.88 token-weighted decode tokens/s versus 18.80 for native five-step MTP (E5), a 27.0% token-weighted decode-throughput gain. The per-request-equal latency view is +4.0%, and end-to-end task wall time remains prefill-heavy. Empirical equivalence evidence is scoped to recurrent-oracle probability-rescore (p-rescore) closure within the observed native flip floor, not a full distribution-distance proof.

</details>


### [922] [Multivariate quantile regression via Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23906)
*Andrew Polar,Michael Poluektov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种预测随机系统中向量值目标条件联合分布的新算法，利用KANs集成进行识别，并引入新的联合分布差异度量及基于该度量的拟合优度检验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 针对随机性为系统内在而非源于观测误差或加性噪声的随机系统，需要预测向量值目标的条件联合分布；相比多元分位数回归这一相对简单的任务，该问题更具挑战性。

Method: 采用Kolmogorov–Arnold网络（KANs）集成作为灵活的函数逼近器进行识别；方法在理论上不限于KANs，但KANs特别适合该构造，因此贯穿全文使用；同时提出新的联合分布差异度量及基于该度量的拟合优度（GoF）检验。

Result: 所提出的识别技术通过新差异度量与GoF检验进行验证与校准；GoF检验最初为此目的开发，此处以ad hoc方式使用，并可更广泛地适用，但本文未进行制表推广。

Conclusion: 该工作为内在随机系统下向量值目标的条件联合分布预测提供了基于KANs集成的识别方法，并配套提出联合分布差异度量与GoF检验，具备更广泛应用潜力。

Abstract: This paper introduces a novel algorithm for predicting conditional joint distributions of vector-valued targets in stochastic systems whose randomness is intrinsic rather than arising from observation errors or additive noise. Multivariate quantile regression also involves modeling conditional joint distributions but represents a less challenging task. It predicts the probability that vector-valued targets fall within predefined regions, identifies regions corresponding to predefined probability levels, or performs both tasks simultaneously. The proposed identification technique employs ensembles of Kolmogorov--Arnold networks (KANs) as flexible function approximators. Although the suggested technique is not theoretically restricted to KANs, KANs are particularly well suited to the proposed construction and are therefore used throughout this study. In addition to the training procedure, this work introduces a new discrepancy measure for joint distributions and a goodness-of-fit (GoF) test based on it. This GoF test was initially developed to validate and calibrate the proposed identification technique and is used here in an ad hoc manner. Although the test could be tabulated for broader use, such a tabulation is not pursued in this work. The test is also applicable more generally.

</details>


### [923] [A discrete generative model of neuronal spiking activity on microelectrode arrays](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23907)
*Md Sayed Tanveer,Mohammed A. Mostajo-Radji,Ge Wang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种基于共享时空motif词表的离散生成模型，用残差VQ自编码器学习motif词表、分解式掩码Transformer预测活动位置与motif类型，在31组人脑类器官与离体海马组织数据上实现可复用的阵列级脉冲活动生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经活动的生成模型可用于刻画组织动态、比较实验条件、模拟群体活动（疾病与药物响应、闭环实验等）。但现有方法通常假设固定的、已排序的神经元集合，而高密度微电极阵列产生的是极为稀疏、覆盖整个阵列的二进制脉冲体数据，其被观测到的电极子集在不同实验中会发生变化，因此需要一种不依赖固定神经元排序、能适应稀疏阵列级活动的生成建模范式。

Method: 1) 采用共享的时空motif词表表示稀疏的阵列级脉冲活动；(2) 用残差向量量化（residual vector-quantized）自编码器学习该motif词表；(3) 用分解式（factorized）掩码Transformer分别预测活动出现的位置以及每个活跃位置上的motif类型；(4) 在31组涵盖人脑类器官与急性离体人海马组织的实验上进行评估，并与匹配的平坦tokenizer及匹配的生成基线对比。

Result: motif被广泛复用：实验身份仅解释motif使用熵的9%，且跨组织类型的motif重叠度与同一组织类型内部相当。在独立于生成先验评估表示质量时，该方法体素级重建平均精度达到匹配平坦tokenizer的5.2倍。在掩码补全与自由生成任务中，完整模型达到匹配生成基线站点级平均精度的1.4–2.6倍，并在全部四类生成指标上均优于基线。

Conclusion: 该工作为阵列级脉冲活动建立了紧凑且可复用的表示，无需学习实验特异性参数，为跨多种神经制备的生成建模提供了可扩展的基础。

Abstract: Generative models of neural activity could help characterize tissue dynamics, compare experimental conditions, and simulate population activity for applications ranging from disease and drug-response studies to closed-loop experimentation. Existing approaches, however, typically assume a fixed set of sorted neurons, whereas high-density microelectrode arrays produce extremely sparse, array-wide binary spike volumes in which the observed subset of electrodes varies across assays. We introduce a discrete generative model that represents this activity using a shared vocabulary of spatiotemporal motifs. A residual vector-quantized autoencoder learns the motif vocabulary, while a factorized masked transformer predicts where activity occurs and which motif appears at each active location. We evaluate the model on 31 assays spanning human brain organoids and acute \emph{ex vivo} human hippocampal tissue. The learned motifs are broadly reused: assay identity explains only $9%$ of the entropy in motif use, and motif overlap across tissue types is comparable to overlap within them. When representation quality is evaluated independently of the generative prior, our approach achieves $5.2\times$ the voxel-level reconstruction average precision of a matched flat tokenizer. For masked completion and free generation, the full model achieves $1.4$--$2.6\times$ the site-level average precision of the matched generative baseline and outperforms it across all four families of generation metrics. These results establish a compact, reusable representation for array-wide spiking activity without learned assay-specific parameters, providing a scalable foundation for generative modeling across diverse neural preparations.

</details>


### [924] [Matched-Input Estimates Differ in Sign Across Architectures: Auditing EEG Foundation Models on Motor Imagery](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23924)
*Kevin Zhou,Sparsh Roy*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文在验证集锁定的严格协议下审计LaBraM与CBraMod两个EEG基础模型，发现其在四分类运动想象任务上不及所有监督基线，并指出输入管线差异等混淆因素使"基础模型vs监督模型"的差距难以被单一比较器一致地分解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 预训练EEG基础模型被日益宣称为脑机接口的通用编码器，但近期基准测试对其表征何时能迁移到下游任务存在分歧，因此需要一次严格、无信息泄漏的审计来厘清争议。

Method: 在验证集锁定的协议下审计LaBraM和CBraMod：预处理、架构、优化、冻结深度、检查点、温度与方法选择全部仅用训练会话数据确定；在BCI Competition IV-2a四分类任务上比较监督基线与基础模型配置；将三个监督架构在基础模型所用的宽带阵列输入上重训练以匹配输入管线；在二分类BNCI2014-004上检验结论的泛化性；并采用验证集拟合的温度缩放考察校准。

Result: 四分类BCI IV-2a上，所有监督比较器均优于所有基础模型配置（含验证集选择的微调）；匹配输入后，宽带输入使ATCNet准确率提升0.078，却使EEG Conformer降低0.088，符号相反，但n=9下经多重比较校正后三个匹配输入项均不显著；二分类BNCI2014-004上未能检测到微调CBraMod与监督比较器之间同样的分离；温度缩放可将基础模型的校准误差拉回监督模型范围，尽管其四分类准确率明显更低。

Conclusion: 所观察到的符号差异表明单一比较器可能无法提供对"预训练—监督"性能差距的架构不变分解；四分类劣势也并非在所有运动想象数据集上一致复现；因此对EEG基础模型的迁移能力应作更谨慎、条件化的评价。

Abstract: Pretrained EEG foundation models are increasingly proposed as general-purpose encoders for brain-computer interfaces, yet recent benchmarks disagree about when their representations transfer to downstream tasks. We audit LaBraM and CBraMod on motor imagery under a validation-locked protocol in which preprocessing, architecture, optimization, freeze depth, checkpoint, temperature, and method selection are determined using training-session data only. On four-class BCI Competition IV-2a, every supervised comparator evaluated here outperforms every foundation-model configuration, including validation-selected fine-tuning. We then examine a key confound: foundation models and task-specific decoders are normally evaluated using different input pipelines. Retraining three supervised architectures on the broadband arrays consumed by the foundation models produces matched-input accuracy differences of opposite sign across architectures: broadband input improves ATCNet by 0.078 accuracy while reducing EEG Conformer accuracy by 0.088. None of the three individual matched-input terms is significant after multiple-comparison correction at n = 9, so we treat the sign variation descriptively rather than as a formal architecture-by-pipeline interaction. These observed sign differences suggest that a single comparator may not provide an architecture-invariant decomposition of a pretrained-versus-supervised performance gap. The four-class deficit also does not reproduce uniformly across motor-imagery datasets: on two-class BNCI2014-004 we cannot detect the same separation between fine-tuned CBraMod and the supervised comparators. Finally, validation-fitted temperature scaling returns foundation-model calibration error to the supervised range despite substantially lower four-class accuracy.

</details>


### [925] [The Neural Forcing for Three-Dimensional Incompressible Navier-Stokes finite time blowup](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23934)
*Beibei Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一个两部分神经网络框架，用于受迫三维不可压缩Navier–Stokes流动：第一部分构建计算型外力系统，第二部分提供数学认证层。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 为受迫三维不可压缩Navier–Stokes问题建立从神经外力生成到连续介质层面数学认证的系统框架，弥合神经候选发现与严格数学证明之间的鸿沟。

Method: 第一部分：物理信息神经模型生成结构化外力轨迹，通过可微PDE rollout或PPO-Clip优化候选，冻结所选外力并用独立固定外力回放校验。第二部分：将神经候选发现与连续介质分析分离，推导可导出Riccati型增长及有限时间光滑性丧失的积分互反涡度判据，发展经校验的计算到连续介质转移策略。

Result: 推导出蕴含Riccati型增长和有限时间失去光滑延续的积分互反涡度判据，建立计算到连续介质的转移策略，并对非退化神经输出律给出条件性正概率封闭结果；证明在连续介质层面完整。

Conclusion: 该两部分框架实现了神经外力生成与连续介质数学认证的结合，连续介质层面的证明已完成。

Abstract: We present a two-part neural framework for forced three-dimensional incompressible Navier--Stokes flow. Part~I develops the computational forcing system. A physics-informed neural model generates structured external-force trajectories, candidates are optimized through differentiable PDE rollouts or PPO-Clip, and selected forcings are frozen and checked by independent fixed-force replay. Part~II provides the mathematical certification layer. It separates neural candidate discovery from continuum analysis, derives integrated reciprocal-vorticity criteria that imply Riccati-type growth and finite-time loss of smooth continuation, develops a validated computational-to-continuum transfer strategy, and establishes a conditional positive-probability closure for a nondegenerate neural output law. The proof is complete at the continuum level.

</details>


### [926] [MGRD: Compact morphology-gated residual diffusion for variance-aware cross-domain neurite forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23990)
*Tsung Yeh Hsieh,Cosmin Anitescu,Chunghwan Kim,Victoria A. Webster-Wood,Yongjie Jessica Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MGRD是一种紧凑的随机代理模型，能从10帧观测预测20帧未来神经突形态，在仿真与显微数据集上优于gSTA，参数与训练开销极低，并可为预测难度排序。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 长期延时成像资源消耗大、难以规模化，预测未来形态可减轻负担；但现有神经突数字孪生模型（如gSTA）仅给出单一确定性预测，无法表征多种可能未来的变异性。

Method: 提出Morphology-Gated Residual Diffusion（MGRD）：以最新观测导出的形态特征为条件，联合预测未来20帧神经突形态；结合形态门控与残差扩散结构；重复采样得到病例级方差分数用于排序预测难度；可缓存形态特征以加速DDIM采样。

Result: 相场轨迹上轨迹级平均MAE较匹配对照降低9.7%，更新参数少4.46倍；人iPSC神经元显微数据上四项指标均优于gSTA，轨迹级平均MAE降低39.6%、骨架F1提升45.3%；无需小鼠域重训练即在鼠皮层神经球显微数据上改善MAE与骨架F1（采样间隔10-40分钟、预测超13小时）；保留约60%低方差病例使iPSC显微MAE降低17.6%、仿真降低16.8%；参数仅占gSTA的1.01%，训练更新耗时不足其十分之一，缓存形态特征后50步DDIM轨迹生成快7.9%。

Conclusion: MGRD是适用于仿真与显微数据集的紧凑随机代理模型，可实现神经突形态预测与病例优先级排序。

Abstract: Tracking neurite morphology over time helps characterize structural changes during neuronal development and deterioration, but long-term time-lapse imaging is resource-intensive and difficult to scale. Forecasting future morphology could reduce this burden. Existing neurite digital-twin models such as gated spatiotemporal attention (gSTA) produce a single deterministic forecast without representing variability among plausible futures. We introduce Morphology-Gated Residual Diffusion (MGRD), a compact stochastic surrogate that jointly forecasts twenty future neurite-morphology frames from ten observed frames while conditioning on morphology features derived from the latest observation. On controlled phase-field trajectories, MGRD reduces trajectory-wise mean MAE by 9.7% relative to a matched control while updating 4.46 times fewer parameters. On human iPSC-derived neuron microscopy, MGRD improves all four reported metrics over gSTA, including a 39.6% reduction in trajectory-wise mean MAE and a 45.3% increase in skeleton F1. Without mouse-domain retraining or fine-tuning, MGRD also improves MAE and skeleton F1 on mouse cortical-neurosphere microscopy across 10-40-min sampling intervals and forecast horizons beyond 13 hours. Repeated sampling provides a case-level variance score for ranking forecast difficulty. Retaining approximately 60% of the lowest-variance cases reduces mean MAE by 17.6% on iPSC microscopy and 16.8% on simulation data. MGRD uses 1.01% of gSTA's parameters, requires less than one tenth of its training-update time, and generates a 50-step DDIM trajectory 7.9% faster when morphology features are cached. These results establish MGRD as a compact stochastic surrogate for neurite-morphology forecasting and case prioritization across simulation and microscopy datasets.

</details>


### [927] [Simpler Methods Work Better for L1 Penalized Logistic Models and Large Datasets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23995)
*Edward Raff,James Holt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文系统评测了文献中多种所谓"最先进"的 $L_1$-范数正则化线性模型求解器，发现在高维（$d>1,000,000$）工业场景下，较老的方法反而普遍优于新方法；并提出一个基于次梯度与 LBFGS 的简单基线，尽管文献因理论不收敛性而弃用，但在实践中经小幅调优后表现优异，更易支持与扩展。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高维（$d>1,000,000$）工业任务中，带 $L_1$-范数惩罚的线性模型仍是主流方法，但其求解器普遍存在通用性差、速度慢、并行化困难等问题，难以在 MLOps 流水线中训练大规模工业语料。作者希望厘清现有求解器的真实可用性，并指出学术界评测中导致"过度自信结论"的常见问题。

Method: 对文献中若干被宣称"最先进"的 $L_1$ 求解方案进行复现与对比评测，并与较老的经典方法在通用性与性能上做基准比较；同时提出并评估一个新基线——在次梯度（sub-gradient）上使用 LBFGS 优化，并进行小幅调参。

Result: 实验发现较老的求解方法在当前通用场景下明显优于文献中的新方法；新提出的"次梯度 + LBFGS"简单基线经少量调优后效果显著，虽然在理论上面临不收敛的批评，但在实践中是更易支持、更易扩展的生产级方法。此外，作者归纳出若干评测建议，用于避免学术研究中出现错误的高置信度结论。

Conclusion: $L_1$ 线性模型求解器的选型不应仅依据文献宣称的先进性；老方法在通用工业场景中往往更实用，而理论上"不合规"的简单基线（次梯度 + LBFGS）在实践中可能更具生产价值。学术界需改进评测规范，减少误导性结论，以促进研究成果向生产转化。

Abstract: Linear models with an $L_1$-norm penalty remain state-of-the-art for high-dimensional ($d > 1,000,000$) tasks, offering a straightforward method for solving real-world industry problems. Despite their widespread use in industry and utility, many $L_1$ solvers are not effective for general use, are prohibitively slow, and are ineffective in parallelization. This makes them difficult to train in an MLOps pipeline on large industry-scale corpora. In this work, we test several proposed ``state-of-the-art'' solutions from the literature and find that older methods are currently far superior for general use. We also identify several recommendations for academics to perform research that avoids erroneously overconfident results, which can prevent the transition to production use. Equally surprising, we find that a new and simple baseline, using LBFGS on a sub-gradient, is highly effective with minor tweaks, despite being dismissed in the literature for theoretical non-convergence. In practice, we find it is an easier-to-support and easier-to-scale method for production use.

</details>


### [928] [ShapeLex: Decoupling Local Shape Symbolization and Global Scale Modeling for Text-Controlled Time Series Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24003)
*Subo Wei,Jianqi Gao,Mingyan Fan,Shaorong Xie,Xinzhi Wang,Yongpeng Dong*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: ShapeLex 将文本控制的时间序列生成解耦为局部形状的离散符号化与全局属性的连续建模，在12个公开数据集上生成质量优于现有方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有文本控制时间序列生成方法将语义理解与序列建模耦合于单一连续隐空间，缺乏显式的局部语义锚点，且未区分全局连续属性与局部离散形状，导致关键局部结构被平滑、遗漏或错位。

Method: ShapeLex 首先从训练数据中归纳出可复用的离散形状单元词汇表（如上升、尖峰、骤降），构成可解释的符号空间；随后用自回归生成器依据文本描述选择形状，并调整位置、时长等属性，按时间顺序组合为形状骨架；最后由混合密度尺度头建模并采样整体水平与波动率，恢复真实的全局尺度。

Result: 在12个公开数据集、真实用户撰写文本以及下游预测任务上的实验表明，ShapeLex 生成的时间序列比现有方法更吻合真实数据分布；同时可基于所学词汇表自动合成配对监督，避免随数据集规模增长的标注成本，提升可扩展性。

Conclusion: 通过离散形状符号与连续全局属性的解耦建模，ShapeLex 在保持可解释性的同时提升了文本控制时间序列生成的分布一致性与可扩展性。

Abstract: Text-controlled time series generation aims to synthesize sequences that follow natural-language descriptions while remaining faithful to real data distributions. Existing paradigms often couple semantic understanding and sequence modeling in a single continuous latent space, lacking explicit local semantic anchors and separation between global continuous attributes and local discrete shapes. As a result, key local structures may be smoothed, missed, or misplaced. We propose Shape Lexicon (ShapeLex), which decouples text-to-sequence generation into discrete symbolization of local shapes and continuous modeling of global attributes. ShapeLex first induces a reusable vocabulary of discrete shape units, such as rises, spikes, and sharp drops, from training data, forming an interpretable symbolic space. An autoregressive generator then selects shapes according to the textual description, adjusts attributes such as position and duration, and composes them in temporal order into a shape skeleton. Finally, a mixture-density scale head models and samples the overall level and volatility to restore realistic global scale. Experiments on twelve public datasets, real user-written text, and downstream forecasting tasks show that ShapeLex generates series that better match real data distributions than existing methods. In addition, paired supervision is automatically synthesized from the learned vocabulary, avoiding annotation costs that grow with dataset size and improving scalability.

</details>


### [929] [Q-DEQ: Discrete Solving and Quantization for Deep Equilibrium Models in Time Series Forecasting under Edge Deployment Coding Constraints](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24042)
*Ruotong Yang,Hongdong Zhu,Qi Gao,Yin Ma,Hai Wei,Kai Wen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出Q-DEQ，将DEQ前向求解的局部更新建模为QUBO离散优化问题，用SA或CIM求解，并结合W8A8伪量化，实现时间序列预测的紧凑部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 边缘部署要求预测模型参数存储紧凑、低比特表示。DEQ通过重复应用共享层获得隐式深度，降低参数成本，但其常用Anderson求解器在连续实数域搜索更新系数，未利用离散/组合优化硬件，也缺乏低比特量化视角。

Method: 将DEQ前向求解中的局部更新形式化为离散优化问题：由当前状态与迭代历史构造候选方向，用局部二次残差模型评估其组合；对方向系数进行二进制编码，得到QUBO问题，由模拟退火（SA）或相干伊辛机（CIM）求解。定点求解后，通过re-forward pass对共享层的权重和激活施加W8A8伪量化。

Result: 在iTransformer骨干与五个多变量时间序列预测数据集上评估：相对显式多层基线的MSE差异为-1.16%至+2.90%，其中两个数据集MSE更低。参数共享使参数量减少1.80×–3.82×；结合W8A8后静态权重存储减少4.3×–12.8×。CPU SA与Kaiwu CIM物理后端求解的局部QUBO产生高度一致的下游预测。

Conclusion: 局部离散求解是DEQ时间序列预测的可行组件，并为通过不同组合优化后端执行定点更新提供了路径。

Abstract: Edge deployment motivates forecasting models with compact parameter storage and low-bit representations. Deep equilibrium models (DEQs) obtain implicit depth by repeatedly applying a shared layer, reducing the parameter cost of explicit layer stacking. Their usual Anderson solver, however, searches for update coefficients in the continuous real domain. We propose Q-DEQ, which formulates local updates in DEQ forward solving as discrete optimization problems. Candidate directions are constructed from the current state and iteration history, and a local quadratic residual model is used to evaluate their combinations. Binary encoding of the direction coefficients yields a quadratic unconstrained binary optimization (QUBO) problem that can be solved by simulated annealing (SA) or a coherent Ising machine (CIM). After fixed-point solving, a re-forward pass applies W8A8 fake quantization to the shared layer's weights and activations. We evaluate Q-DEQ with an iTransformer backbone on five multivariate time series forecasting datasets. Relative MSE differences from the explicit multi-layer baseline range from $-1.16\%$ to $+2.90\%$, with lower MSE on two datasets. DEQ parameter sharing reduces parameter counts by factors of $1.80\times$--$3.82\times$; combined with W8A8, static weight storage is reduced by factors of $4.3\times$--$12.8\times$. Local QUBO problems solved using CPU-based SA and the Kaiwu CIM physical backend produce closely matching downstream forecasts. These results establish local discrete solving as a viable component of DEQ time series forecasting and provide a route for executing fixed-point updates through different combinatorial optimization backends.

</details>


### [930] [PAC-Bayesian Meta-Learning for Few-Shot Identification of Linear Dynamical Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24117)
*Chenfeng Huang,George Michailidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出PBML-LTI，一个基于PAC-Bayes的元学习框架，用于少样本线性时不变（LTI）系统辨识。通过鞅PAC-Bayes分析处理轨迹的时间依赖性，学习可迁移的任务先验并实现贝叶斯自适应，提供准确的估计和不确定性量化。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当轨迹短、噪声大或维度高时，LTI系统辨识困难；传统系统辨识将各系统独立处理，无法利用相关系统间的共享结构。此外，LTI轨迹违反大多数PAC-Bayes元学习分析的i.i.d.假设，时间依赖性构成核心挑战。

Method: 提出PBML-LTI框架：每个任务对应一个未知LTI系统，元学习器利用训练轨迹学习转移矩阵的数据依赖先验；对新系统进行贝叶斯自适应得到任务特定后验。针对时间依赖问题，采用鞅PAC-Bayes分析处理依赖轨迹损失，推导支持-查询预测风险界，并据此构建fit-KL元训练目标，进一步给出转移矩阵恢复与多步轨迹预测的推论。

Result: 推导出依赖轨迹下的支持-查询预测风险界，明确经验拟合、后验复杂度和先验质量在序列依赖下少样本自适应中的作用；并得到转移矩阵恢复与多步轨迹预测的有限样本保证，实现不确定性感知的元辨识。

Conclusion: PBML-LTI为少样本LTI系统辨识提供了具有原则性不确定性量化和有限样本保证的元学习方法，桥接了不确定性感知元辨识与依赖动态数据的理论分析。

Abstract: Identifying linear time-invariant (LTI) dynamical systems is challenging when trajectories are short, noisy, or high-dimensional. Traditional system identification typically treats each system independently and cannot exploit shared structure across related systems. We propose PBML-LTI, a PAC-Bayesian meta-learning framework for few-shot LTI system identification that learns a transferable prior over task-specific dynamics while preserving task heterogeneity. Each task corresponds to an unknown LTI system, and the meta-learner uses training trajectories to learn a data-dependent prior over transition matrices. For a new system with limited data, PBML-LTI performs Bayesian adaptation under this prior to obtain a task-specific posterior, providing accurate estimates and principled uncertainty quantification.
  A key challenge is temporal dependence, since LTI trajectories violate the i.i.d. assumptions underlying most PAC-Bayes meta-learning analyses. We address this with a martingale PAC-Bayes analysis for dependent trajectory losses and derive a support-query predictive-risk bound that motivates a fit-KL meta-training objective. The bound clarifies the roles of empirical fit, posterior complexity, and prior quality in few-shot adaptation under sequential dependence. We further derive corollaries for transition-matrix recovery and multi-step trajectory prediction, connecting uncertainty-aware meta-identification with finite-sample guarantees for dependent dynamical data.

</details>


### [931] [CLOOPD: Closing the Learner Loop in On-Policy Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24141)
*Keye Zheng,Hanyu Li,Zhan Cheng,Yuan Gao*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: CLOOPD 提出一种闭环框架，将教师信号获取与学生侧实现分离，在同一批已评分数据上多次执行 actor 更新，并按独立 token 预算分配计算，从而在教师评分 token 规模相当的情况下显著提升学生性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 on-policy distillation（OPD）中，每个新批次需支付两次成本：学生生成轨迹、更强的教师对轨迹评分。已有方法多聚焦于改进"哪些轨迹被评分"以及"教师信号如何构建"，但通常只用一次 actor 更新来消费该信号，导致昂贵的教师评分信号未被充分利用。作者希望解决"如何在 token 预算下更充分地让学生从教师评分 token 中学习"这一问题。

Method: 提出 CLOOPD 闭环框架：（1）在 KL 包络内选择一个自适应的 α 路径点；（2）冻结已评分的批次及其优势值；（3）每次 actor 更新后重新前向学生模型；（4）度量实现程度（realization），并在独立的 token 预算下分配 actor 计算。框架包含确定性的两遍与三遍策略、按 token 计价的 CLOOPD-TPMR，以及预算匹配的对照组。

Result: 在 8×H20 节点上运行六个 300 步实验：所有 CLOOPD 策略在教师 token 规模相当的情况下均优于单遍的 TOP-D 基线。宏平均准确率从 15.41 提升至 CLOOPD-Fixed2 的 17.78 与 CLOOPD-Fixed3 的 19.36。在第 100 步时，CLOOPD-Fixed3 达到 15.35，几乎匹配 TOP-D 第 300 步的水平，同时减少 67.2% 的教师评分 token 和 28.0% 的 GPU 小时。早期 8×A100 消融实验显示，自适应 α 可消除观测到的信任域违规，第三次 pass 则带来额外余量。

Conclusion: CLOOPD 将"学生能从教师评分 token 中学习到何种程度"作为可预算的资源进行管理，为 on-policy distillation 中教师信号的高效利用提供了新的框架性视角。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) pays twice for each fresh batch: the student generates trajectories and a stronger teacher scores them. Existing methods improve which trajectories are scored and how the teacher signal is constructed, but usually consume it with one actor update. We introduce CLOOPD, a closed-loop framework separating teacher-signal acquisition from student-side realization. CLOOPD selects an adaptive $α$ waypoint inside a KL envelope, freezes the scored batch and its advantages, re-forwards the student after each actor pass, measures realization, and allocates actor work under a separate token budget. The framework includes deterministic two- and three-pass policies, token-priced CLOOPD-TPMR, and a budget-matched control. Across six 300-step runs on an 8-H20 node, every CLOOPD policy improves the one-pass TOP-D anchor at comparable teacher-token scale: macro accuracy rises from 15.41 to 17.78 with CLOOPD-Fixed2 and 19.36 with CLOOPD-Fixed3. At step 100, CLOOPD-Fixed3 reaches 15.35, nearly matching TOP-D at step 300 while using 67.2% fewer teacher-scored tokens and 28.0% fewer GPU-hours. Earlier 8-A100 ablations show adaptive $α$ eliminates observed trust-envelope violations; a third pass adds headroom. These results position CLOOPD as a framework for budgeting how fully students learn from teacher-scored tokens.

</details>


### [932] [Luck Is Not Skill: When Do Paired Rollouts Help Group-Relative RL of LLM Agents?](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24144)
*Nazmus Sakib*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 研究配对轨迹（paired rollouts）在组相对强化学习中的作用：配对共享事件键控噪声日程，可消除奖励对比的噪声分量，但不必然降低梯度方差；实验显示工具故障下成功率提升但未达到注册的学习曲线标准。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 组相对强化学习依赖同一提示下轨迹之间的比较，但独立环境噪声会遮蔽这种比较，因此需要考察配对采样能否通过共享噪声日程改善比较质量与学习效果。

Method: 理论分析配对轨迹的奖励对比方差与梯度方差，针对单边评分器噪声给出精确的方差降低条件及反例（奖励对比改善但梯度方差升高）；开展受控实验，在工具故障与评分器翻转下训练 2B 工具使用智能体，每种设计 3 个随机种子，并采用预先注册协议（含已完成的前导试验），另在两个故障训练轨迹的 8 个不同检查点上做梯度探测。

Result: 工具故障下，配对使最终含噪测试成功率平均提升 +5.1 个百分点，三个种子差异均为正，但未达到注册的学习曲线标准；评分器翻转下该标准同样未达到，验证集 AUC 差异为 +0.003（95% 区间 [-0.029, +0.033]）。梯度探测显示两类噪声下均方中心化协方差迹更低：评分器翻转为 21%–30%，工具故障为 40%–63%。

Conclusion: 有限样本测量支持配对降低估计器方差的机制，但不足以确立普遍的学习加速收益；研究区分了改善奖励比较、降低估计器方差与提升学习效果三者之间的差别。

Abstract: Group-relative reinforcement learning compares rollouts of the same prompt, but independent environment noise can obscure these comparisons. We study paired rollouts, which share an event-keyed noise schedule within each group while preserving each rollout's marginal distribution. Pairing removes the between-schedule component of reward-contrast variance, but need not reduce gradient variance. For one-sided grader noise, we derive an exact condition for reduction and give a counterexample in which reward contrasts improve while gradient variance increases. A controlled study trains a 2B tool-use agent under tool faults and grader flips, with three seeds per design. The protocol was registered with a disclosed, previously completed pilot. Under tool faults, pairing improves final noisy-test success by +5.1 percentage points on average, with all three seed differences positive, but misses the registered learning-curve criterion. The criterion is also missed under grader flips: the validation-AUC difference is +0.003 (95% interval [-0.029, +0.033]). A gradient probe on eight distinct checkpoints from two fault-trained trajectories finds lower mean-centered covariance traces under both noise types: 21 to 30% for grader flips and 40 to 63% for tool faults. These finite-sample measurements support the variance mechanism without establishing a general learning-speed benefit. The results distinguish improving reward comparisons, reducing estimator variance, and improving learning.

</details>


### [933] [Mind or Message? Auditing Theory of Mind in Multi-Agent Social Simulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24146)
*Cong Li,Cheng Chen,Thomas Fung,Alex Rossi,Yi Li*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 通过40个多议题谈判、160个谈判对与2880次反事实探针，研究发现语言模型智能体在社交对话中表现流利，但经济理性严重缺失：96.2%达成协议却仅0.7%落在帕累托前沿，且其"理解"主要来自自我中心投射而非对伙伴心理的推断。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语言模型智能体日益用于模拟社会互动，其对话记录看似表明智能体彼此理解，但作者要检验这种表象究竟依赖对伙伴心理的建模，还是仅依赖伙伴话语的表面记录。

Method: 构建可精确求解的社会模拟框架：40个多议题谈判，隐藏偏好权重与完整帕累托前沿均由构造已知；两个模型家族在160个谈判对中谈判；所有记录在测量前冻结；随后用2880次反事实探针，在保持证据字节完全一致的前提下，逐一改变读者自身收益、伙伴语气、身份标签与递归顺序。

Result: 智能体社交流利但经济低效：96.2%的谈判对达成协议、0协议失败，但仅0.7%的交易落在帕累托前沿，未获取20.5%的联合价值，76.6%的交易错过利益完全一致的议题；在前沿与一致议题上，随机抽取双方均可接受的方案表现同样好。探针显示：仅替换读者自身收益表、保持伙伴话语与报价不变，即可使推断的首要优先项移动15.0个百分点（属自我中心投射而非推断），语气改写移动5.3个百分点，身份标签移动0.0。最具说明性的是，智能体预测伙伴如何看待自己的准确率为72.5%，而该伙伴信念本身正确率仅51.2%——智能体跟踪对话远好于跟踪对话背后的心智。

Conclusion: 语言模型智能体的社会理解主要建立在表面话语记录与自我中心投射之上，而非对伙伴心理状态的建模；其社交流畅性与经济理性之间存在显著脱节，智能体追踪对话的能力远超其追踪心智的能力。

Abstract: Language model agents are increasingly used to simulate social interaction, and the resulting transcripts read as though the agents understand one another. We ask whether that appearance rests on a model of the partner's mind or on the surface record of what the partner said. We build a social simulation in which both questions have exact answers: 40 multi-issue negotiations whose hidden preference weights and whose full Pareto frontier are known by construction. Two model families negotiate across 160 dyads, every transcript is frozen before any measurement, and 2880 counterfactual probes then hold the evidence byte identical while moving one factor at a time: the reader's own stake, the partner's tone, an identity label, and the order of recursion. The agents are socially fluent and economically poor. They reach agreement in 96.2% of dyads with 0 protocol failures, yet only 0.7% of deals land on the Pareto frontier, they leave 20.5% of the available joint value unclaimed, and they miss the one issue on which their interests are perfectly aligned in 76.6% of deals; on the frontier and on that aligned issue, a package drawn at random from the set both sides would accept does as well. The probes locate the failure. Swapping only the reader's own payoff sheet, while the partner's words and offers stay identical, moves the inferred top priority by 15.0 percentage points, which is egocentric projection rather than inference, while a tone rewrite moves it by 5.3 percentage points and an identity label by 0.0. Most tellingly, an agent predicts what its partner believes about it 72.5% of the time while that partner's belief is itself correct only 51.2% of the time: the agents track the conversation far better than they track the mind behind it.

</details>


### [934] [Acceptance-Aware Draft Model Training for Speculative Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24150)
*Tianhua Xia,Mugilan Ganesan,Yifei Feng,Haiyu Wang,Maximilian Egger,Sai Qian Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出面向接受长度的投机解码草稿模型训练损失：贪心验证下用EAL直接最大化期望接受长度，采样解码下用WTV优化温度缩放分布重叠并刻画序列接受依赖，可进一步结合GRPO强化学习阶段；实验表明其接受长度一致优于KL类目标。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码的加速比主要由接受长度决定，但现有草稿模型训练主要以交叉熵或KL散度为代理目标，仅鼓励分布匹配，并不直接优化接受长度；且贪心验证与采样解码的接受机制不同，需要针对性设计。

Method: 提出接受长度感知训练损失：针对贪心验证推导期望接受长度（EAL）损失，显式最大化期望接受长度；针对采样解码提出窗口全变差（WTV）损失，优化温度缩放后草稿与目标分布的重叠并考虑序列接受的依赖关系；两种目标均可与以模拟接受长度为奖励的组相对强化学习阶段（GRPO）结合。

Result: 在不同目标模型与草稿模型、任务及解码设置的实验中，所提损失相对KL类训练一致提升接受长度；WTV在采样解码下增益尤为显著，EAL与贪心验证更匹配。

Conclusion: 直接优化接受目标、并按解码模式定制损失，比传统分布匹配目标更有效。

Abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model (LLM) inference by using a lightweight draft model to generate multiple candidate tokens that are verified by the target model in a single forward pass. Its speedup is largely determined by the acceptance length, yet existing draft-model training methods mainly optimize cross-entropy or Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence as proxies. These objectives encourage distribution matching but do not directly optimize acceptance length, and the acceptance mechanism also differs between greedy and sampling-based decoding.
  In this work, we propose acceptance-length-aware training losses that directly optimize the expected number of accepted tokens within a speculative window. For greedy verification, we derive an expected accepted length (EAL) loss that explicitly maximizes expected acceptance length. For sampling-based decoding, we introduce a window total variation (WTV) loss that optimizes the overlap between temperature-scaled draft and target distributions while accounting for sequential acceptance dependencies. Both objectives can be further combined with a group-relative reinforcement learning stage (GRPO) using simulated acceptance length as the reward.
  Experiments across different target and draft models, tasks, and decoding settings show that our losses consistently improve acceptance length over KL-based training. WTV provides particularly strong gains under sampling-based decoding, while EAL better matches greedy verification. These results show that directly optimizing the acceptance objective, with losses tailored to the decoding mode, is more effective than conventional distribution-matching objectives.

</details>


### [935] [H-Spec: Parallel Speculative Decoding Without a Drafter-Side KV Cache](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24197)
*Weifan Jiang,Krishna Teja Chitty-Venkata,Megan Flynn,Reed Meyerson,Zhenting Qi,Tianyu Wu,Eldar Kurtic,Minlan Yu,Alexandre Marques*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 H-Spec：一种混合 Mamba-注意力并行草稿模型，以“直接复用目标 KV + 仅在末输入位置注入目标隐状态”的混合目标上下文注入方式，避免草稿侧独立 KV 缓存，在保持并行的同时提升投机解码的接受长度与推理速度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 投机解码可无损加速大模型推理，近期块扩散草稿器通过并行预测多 token 降低草稿延迟。但现有块草稿器需将每个输入位置的目标隐状态投影到独立的草稿侧 KV 缓存，带来随并发增长的请求级内存与 KV 写入开销；而直接在原地复用目标 KV 虽可消除该缓存，却无法在整块范围内维持草稿质量。因此需在“省内存”与“保质量”之间找到兼顾方案。

Method: 提出混合目标上下文注入：以直接复用目标 KV 为主，仅在最后一个输入位置补充目标隐状态，从而无需独立草稿侧 KV 缓存。基于此设计构建 H-Spec——混合 Mamba-注意力并行草稿器，由互补模块消费两类目标上下文：Mamba 模块以投影后的末 token 目标隐状态初始化，注意力模块原地复用目标 KV。尽管 Mamba 具有递归形式，其并行扫描特性使 H-Spec 仍保持块级并行草稿。

Result: 在三个目标模型与多样任务上，H-Spec 相比最优基线平均接受长度提升 5.0–13.3%，batch-size-1 的 token 间延迟加速比提升 5.3–12.6%。在并发服务场景下，各评估并发水平上 H-Spec 均取得更高吞吐，同时保持低于基线的 KV 缓存占用。

Conclusion: 通过混合目标上下文注入与 Mamba-注意力并行草稿架构，H-Spec 在不引入草稿侧 KV 缓存的前提下，同时改善草稿质量与推理效率，并在并发服务下实现更高吞吐与更低 KV 占用，验证了该混合设计在投机解码中的有效性。

Abstract: Speculative decoding losslessly accelerates large language model inference by having a lightweight draft model predict future tokens for verification by the target model. Recent block diffusion drafters further reduce drafting latency by predicting multiple tokens in parallel. However, existing block drafters project target hidden states at every input position into a separate drafter-side KV cache, incurring per-request memory and KV-write overhead that grow with concurrency; directly reusing target KVs in place removes this cache but fails to sustain draft quality throughout the block. We propose a hybrid target-context injection method that complements direct target KV reuse with target hidden states only at the last input position, requiring no separate drafter-side KV cache. Building on this design, we propose H-Spec, a hybrid Mamba-attention parallel drafter that consumes the two target-context sources through complementary modules. Mamba modules are initialized with projected last-token target hidden states, while attention modules reuse target KVs in place. Despite its recurrent formulation, Mamba's parallel scan allows H-Spec to preserve block-parallel drafting. Across three target models and diverse tasks, H-Spec improves over the best baseline by 5.0--13.3% in mean accepted length and 5.3--12.6% in batch-size-1 inter-token latency speedup. Under concurrent serving, H-Spec consistently achieves higher throughput while maintaining lower KV cache utilization than baselines across evaluated concurrency levels.

</details>


### [936] [Displacement Geometry Captures Platonic Shared Reality Across Models and Modalities](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24209)
*Chenming Shang,Yujin Tang,Jun Jie Ou Yang,Ruize Xu,Adam Breuer,Nikhil Singh*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 模型共享的不是表征空间中样本的绝对位置，而是样本间的位移方向；语义可线性对齐、能力不可对齐，据此提出 Shadow Casting 以单次缓存前向传播实现能力迁移。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Platonic Representation Hypothesis（PRH）主张独立训练的模型会收敛到共享的现实统计模型，但近期工作只发现模型间存在微弱的逐点相似性。本文旨在调和这一矛盾：解释模型究竟共享什么、不共享什么，并给出可证伪的几何刻画。

Method: 在仅允许旋转与反射的单一正交对齐下，检验 44 个独立训练的视觉与语言编码器（涵盖不同模态与能力不对称的模型对）中位移向量（样本间 displacement vectors）与绝对位置的保持情况。提出分解：表征 = 线性可对齐的共享语义分量 + 不可对齐的私有能力分量。并追溯其概念级结构：模型内父概念与其子变化向量正交，跨模型概念位移平行。通过微调与关系蒸馏实验验证预测。基于该分解提出 Shadow Casting：利用源模型的单次缓存前向传播（cache）将能力导入目标模型，并以 SHADOWCLIP 作为概念验证。

Result: 在单一正交对齐下，位移向量在 44 个跨模态、能力不对称的独立训练编码器间被显著保持，与 PRH 证据一致；而样本绝对位置不被保持，与近期反证一致。实验证实：微调保持逐点相似性但使位移坍缩，关系蒸馏则相反。SHADOWCLIP 实例在计算量低数个数量级的条件下优于强微调基线。

Conclusion: 模型间共享的是位移几何而非样本位置，其根源在于语义分量线性可对齐、能力分量不可对齐。因此能力可通过源模型的单次缓存前向传播被导入任意多个其他模型而无需微调；缓存可与开放模型权重一同发布，实现能力的可下载与即插即用。

Abstract: The Platonic Representation Hypothesis (PRH) claims that independently trained models converge on a shared statistical model of reality, yet recent work finds only weak pointwise similarity between models. In this paper, we show that what models share is not the location of samples in representation space, but the directions (displacement vectors) between them. Under a single orthogonal alignment--rotation and reflection only--these displacement vectors are substantially preserved across 44 independently trained vision and language encoders spanning modalities and asymmetric capability pairs, consistent with the PRH evidence. The samples' absolute positions are not, consistent with recent counter-evidence. Both arise from a single decomposition: representations split into a shared semantic component that is linearly aligned across models, and a private capability component that is not. We trace this geometry to concept-level structure: within a model, parent concepts are orthogonal to their child variation vectors; across models, concept displacements are parallel. Our theory falsifiably predicts (and experiments confirm) that fine-tuning preserves pointwise similarity but collapses displacement, and that relational distillation does the opposite.
  A major implication is that, because semantics align linearly but capabilities do not, capabilities can be imported from one model to another using a single cached forward pass through the source. We call this Shadow Casting. As a proof of concept, our SHADOWCLIP instantiation outperforms strong fine-tuned baselines at orders of magnitude less compute. A cache can be released alongside open model weights, letting one model's capabilities be downloaded and imported into any number of other models without fine-tuning.

</details>


### [937] [Adaptive Forgetting for Nonstationary Optimization: Towards Robust EEG Decoding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24233)
*Hongyu Zhu,Lin Chen,Jing Chen,Yuting Zhou,Mingsheng Shang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出AFOR——一种张量级自适应优化器，将固定的二阶矩衰减系数改为由局部梯度状态在线估计的动态系数，通过RASS信号评分器与AFC自适应遗忘控制器实现，在三个EEG跨被试基准上平均测试准确率较Adam分别提升3.00%、2.07%和4.38%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: EEG跨被试解码面临低信噪比、被试差异大、梯度非平稳等挑战，而现有解码器普遍采用Adam/AdamW并固定二阶矩衰减系数，隐含假设梯度统计在层间与时间上同质，限制了模型对跨被试EEG信号的适应性与泛化能力。

Method: 提出张量级自适应优化器AFOR，包含两个组件：残差对齐信号评分器（RASS）将局部梯度残差与方向一致性汇总为信号质量分数；自适应遗忘控制器（AFC）通过自参照归一化将该分数映射为有界的逐步衰减系数，并采用累积乘积初始化校正以在时变衰减下保持一致性。

Result: 在覆盖三个代表性领域的三个EEG基准上采用严格跨被试协议，AFOR在对比优化器中取得最佳平均性能，平均测试准确率较Adam分别提升3.00%、2.07%和4.38%。

Conclusion: AFOR通过将固定二阶矩衰减系数动态化，有效提升跨被试EEG解码的泛化性能，表明优化器层面的自适应设计对处理EEG的低信噪比与梯度非平稳性问题具有实际价值。

Abstract: Electroencephalography (EEG) provides non-invasive monitoring of brain activity and is widely used in emotion recognition, motor imagery and sleep staging. Although within-subject decoding has achieved considerable progress, cross-subject generalization remains a central challenge in practical applications. EEG decoders are typically trained with Adam/AdamW under a fixed second-moment decay coefficient, even though cross-subject learning involves low signal-to-noise ratios, subject variability, and gradient nonstationarity. A fixed coefficient implicitly assumes that gradient statistics are homogeneous across layers and time, which can limit model's adaptability to cross-subject EEG signals and degrade generalization. To address these issues, we propose AFOR, a tensor-wise adaptive optimizer that converts the fixed second-moment decay coefficient into a dynamic coefficient estimated online from local gradient state. AFOR combines a Residual-Alignment Signal Scorer (RASS) and an Adaptive Forgetting Controller (AFC). RASS summarizes local gradient residuals and directional agreement into a signal-quality score, and AFC maps this score through self-referential normalization to a bounded per-step decay coefficient, with cumulative-product initialization correction maintaining consistency under time-varying decay.
  Under a strict cross-subject protocol on three EEG benchmarks that cover three representative fields, AFOR achieves the best average performance among the compared optimizers, improving the mean test accuracy over Adam by 3.00%, 2.07%, and 4.38%, respectively.

</details>


### [938] [Explainable Predictive Condition-based Maintenance of Naval-Propulsion Systems using Fuzzy Logic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24250)
*Dionisis Kalogeropoulos,Georgia Sovatzidi,Panagiotis G. Kalozoumis,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于模糊决策树与深度残差神经网络的可解释预测性维护框架，用于舰船设备故障预测，在公开数据集上达到99.24%的准确率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 航运业对全球经济影响重大，需通过有效维护技术保障运营可用性与安全。预测性维护（PdM）相较传统维护系统具有故障预测、减少停机、延长机械寿命及提升航行安全等优势，但现有PdM方法无法向用户解释其结果，导致用户难以理解潜在故障、难以建立信任。

Method: 提出一种融合模糊决策树与深度残差神经网络的新型框架，面向海军舰艇执行可解释预测性维护。该框架能基于所用数据集生成模糊局部规则，并利用因果关系对输出结果进行解释，使解释对用户可理解。

Result: 在公开数据集上的实验验证了框架的有效性，准确率达到99.24%。

Conclusion: 该框架在保持高预测精度的同时，实现了结果的可解释性，通过因果关系向用户提供可理解的解释，从而增强用户信任，为舰船预测性维护提供了可行方案。

Abstract: The shipping industry has a significant impact on the global economy, emphasizing the need for operational availability and safety through the use of effective maintenance techniques. During the last decades, predictive maintenance (PdM) has emerged as a promising solution compared to the existing conventional maintenance systems. This is because it offers several advantageous functions, such as damage predictions for vessel components, reduced downtime, improved and extended life of machinery, as well as higher safety during voyages. However, existing methodologies developed for performing PdM do not provide explanations of their results to users, so that they can understand the failures that may occur. To address this limitation, this paper proposes a novel framework based on a fuzzy decision tree and a deep residual neural network, aiming to perform explainable PdM on naval vessels. The proposed framework is able to generate fuzzy local rules based on the dataset used, and can provide explanations of its outcomes, using cause-and-effect relationships, in a way that are understandable to users, thereby gaining their trust. Experiments using a publicly available dataset demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed framework, as it achieves an accuracy of 99.24%.

</details>


### [939] [High-Dimensional Online Change Point Detection with Adaptive Thresholding and Interpretability](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24278)
*Sven Jacob,Bardh Prenkaj,Weijia Shao,Gjergji Kasneci*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出基于切片 Wasserstein 距离（SW）的变化点检测（CPD）框架，提升高维场景下的可扩展性与可解释性，并实现自适应在线检测与对比解释生成。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统 CPD 方法在高维数据下计算代价高，且对检测到的变化缺乏解释，限制了实际部署与可用性，尤其在高风险应用中难以被信任和采用。

Method: 利用 SW 距离将多变量序列数据转化为一维得分，使其兼容现有 CPD 方法；分析 SW 随机切片的分布行为，在合理假设下用 Gamma 分布近似，为阈值校准提供理论依据；提出结合 SW 得分与自适应分位数阈值的自适应该在线 CPD 算法；并引入面向模型的对比解释框架，为标注变化点生成解释。

Result: 与常用在线和离线 CPD 基线相比，该方法平均至少降低 48% 的假阳性，同时保持竞争性或更优的检测性能，并能产生可解释的变化点标注。

Conclusion: 基于 SW 的 CPD 框架在提升可扩展性的同时增强了可解释性，并通过自适应阈值和对比解释提高了实际部署价值，适用于高风险应用。

Abstract: Change point detection (CPD) identifies abrupt and significant changes in sequential data, with applications in human activity recognition, financial markets, cybersecurity, manufacturing, and autonomous systems. Traditional CPD methods often face computational challenges in high-dimensional settings and typically provide limited explanations for detected changes, which can restrict their practical usability. This paper introduces a CPD framework that improves scalability and interpretability by leveraging the Sliced Wasserstein (SW) distance. Our contributions are fourfold: (1) we transform multivariate sequential data into one-dimensional scores using the SW distance, making the resulting representation compatible with existing CPD methods; (2) we analyze the distributional behavior of random slices of the SW distance and show that, under suitable assumptions, they can be approximated by a Gamma distribution, providing a principled basis for threshold calibration; (3) we propose a self-adapting online CPD algorithm that combines this SW-based score with an adaptive quantile-based threshold; (4) we introduce a model-specific framework for generating contrastive explanations for annotated change points. Empirically, our method reduces false positives by at least $48\%$ on average compared with popular online and offline CPD baselines, while maintaining competitive or superior detection performance. Code is available at https://github.com/jsve96/SWCPD_Code. At the same time, it produces interpretable change-point annotations, making it practical for deployment in high-stakes applications.

</details>


### [940] [Pharmacokinetic State Space Models for Unbiased Prediction of Haemodynamic Collapse](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24338)
*Rithin Nagaraj,Sudiksha Chindula,Bhaskarjyoti Das*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种基于Mamba架构的术中低血压（IOH）预测模型，首次将药物输注史（丙泊酚与瑞芬太尼效应室浓度）纳入预测信号，AUROC达0.7360、AUPRC达0.1794，并证明去lead-gap滤波会破坏预测性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 术中低血压是全麻常见并发症且后果严重，但临床管理仍是被动反应式的，缺乏预测能力。现有预测模型忽略了药物输注史这一具有直接药理相关性的重要信号，同时未区分"预测未来事件"与"检测正在发生的事件"。

Method: 构建基于Mamba架构的序列预测模型，将丙泊酚和瑞芬太尼的效应室浓度等药代动力学轨迹作为输入特征；采用lead-gap滤波进行训练以对齐预测目标；通过与去除药物特征的消融模型、无lead-gap滤波的训练设置以及vanilla Transformer的内存开销进行对比实验验证。

Result: 模型AUROC为0.7360，AUPRC为0.1794，相对随机猜测基线（AUPRC 0.0657）提升2.73倍；移除丙泊酚与瑞芬太尼效应室浓度导致AUPRC相对全模型下降13.9%；不使用lead-gap滤波训练使AUROC下降16.7%；Mamba在序列长度变化时保持恒定内存占用，而vanilla Transformer呈二次方VRAM增长。

Conclusion: 药代动力学轨迹可在平均动脉压（MAP）显现之前编码即将发生血流动力学变化的信息，支持药物输注史作为有效预测信号；lead-gap滤波是保证模型真正具备预测性而非检测性的关键；Mamba架构因恒定内存占用更适合术中连续部署。

Abstract: An Intraoperative Hypotension (IOH) event is a frequent complication during administration of general anaesthesia with serious downstream consequences, yet clinical management remains reactive and not predictive. Existing predictive models, however, ignore drug infusion history as a valuable signal for prediction despite its direct pharmacological relevance. Our model achieves an Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.7360 and an Area Under the Precision-Recall Curve (AUPRC) of 0.1794, representing a 2.73-fold lift over the random guessing AUPRC baseline (0.0657), with the removal of propofol and remifentanil effect-site concentrations resulting in a 13.9% AUPRC drop compared to the full model. This is consistent with the hypothesis that pharmacokinetic trajectories encode impending haemodynamic changes before they manifest in the Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP). Additionally, this paper shows that training without lead-gap filtering degraded AUROC by 16.7%, empirically confirming that unfiltered models learn to detect ongoing hypotension rather than predict future events. Finally, a Mamba-based architecture achieves the aforementioned high prediction performance while maintaining a constant memory footprint across a range of sequence lengths, unlike the quadratic VRAM overhead typical of vanilla Transformers, making it the more practical choice for continuous intraoperative deployment.

</details>


### [941] [Explainable Neuro-Fuzzy Prediction for Trustworthy Decision-Making in Maritime](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24358)
*Dionisis Kalogeropoulos,Georgia Sovatzidi,Dimitris K. Iakovidis*

Main category: cs.LG
