TL;DR: 本文提出一种可解释决策框架，将神经模糊预测模型与两阶段可解释组件结合：第一阶段用梯度显著性图生成特征归因解释，第二阶段用模糊决策树提取局部规则；该框架通用、可嵌入任意深度学习模型，在通用基准与海军推进系统早期故障检测数据集上平均AUC-ROC最高达99%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海事系统维护时机预测至关重要，可避免危险与高昂代价；同时黑箱深度模型缺乏可解释性，难以支撑可信决策，因此需要兼顾高预测性能与用户可理解解释的方法。

Method: 提出集成神经模糊预测模型与两阶段可解释组件的可解释决策框架。第一阶段基于梯度的显著性图产生特征归因解释；第二阶段利用模糊决策树抽取局部规则。框架具有通用性，可集成到任意基于深度学习的方法中，并以深度残差网络为骨干实现。

Result: 在多个通用公开基准数据集上评估，并在海军推进系统数据集的早期故障检测场景中验证实用性。结果显示预测性能优于相关最新方法，平均AUC-ROC最高可达99%，同时具备可解释性优势。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个基于模糊逻辑、可同时提供特征级与局部规则级解释的黑箱模型框架，能通过用户可理解的机器推断提升决策可信度。

Abstract: Predicting when maritime systems require maintenance can be critical, avoiding hazards and costly consequences. To address this problem, this paper proposes an explainable decision-making framework that integrates a neuro-fuzzy prediction model with a two-stage explainable component. The first stage of this component produces feature-attribution explanations, using gradient-based saliency maps, and the second stage extracts local rules using a fuzzy decision tree. The proposed framework is generic and can be integrated into any deep learning-based approach, rendering it explainable. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first fuzzy logic-based framework enabling both feature-level and local rule-based explanations of black box models. This approach aims to foster trustworthiness in decision making through user-understandable machine inferences. The performance of the proposed framework using a deep residual-based neural backbone is evaluated on various general-purpose public benchmark datasets, and its utility in maritime is demonstrated in the context of early fault detection in a naval propulsion system dataset. The results indicate that it can provide predictions outperforming relevant state-of-the-art approaches, with an average AUC-ROC (Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve) value, reaching up to 99%, while offering the advantage of explainability.

</details>


### [942] [Credit Access is Associated with Improved Food Security in the Horn of Africa](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24382)
*Jordi Cerdà-Bautista,Vasileios Sitokonstantinou,José Manuel Veiga López-Peña,Duccio Piovani,José María Tárraga,Gustau Camps-Valls*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究采用观测性机器学习框架，结合2015—2022年环境、社会经济与冲突因素的统一数据集，估计信贷可得性与索马里及非洲之角急性粮食不安全之间的因果关联，发现信贷可得性提高与急性粮食不安全下降2%相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变化加剧对粮食安全的威胁，脆弱社区尤为严重；在数据稀缺、受危机影响的地区，随机试验不可行，亟需可靠的因果推断框架。

Method: 采用观测性机器学习框架，构建覆盖2015—2022年关键环境、社会经济与冲突因素的统一数据集，在明确的识别假设下估计信贷可得性与急性粮食不安全的因果关联，并进行稳健性与反驳检验。

Result: 信贷可得性提高与研究期内人口层面急性粮食不安全下降2%相关；鉴于平均16%人口处于危机状态，该效应在风险群体中具有实质意义。

Conclusion: 研究提供了金融可得性与粮食安全结果在数据稀缺、危机环境中相关联的情境化证据，并为随机评估不可行时整合异质数据源提供了透明框架。

Abstract: The intensification of climate change poses a growing threat to food security, especially in vulnerable communities. This study employs an observational machine-learning framework to estimate the causal association between access to credit and acute food insecurity in Somalia and across the Horn of Africa, drawing on a harmonized dataset spanning key environmental, socioeconomic, and conflict-related factors from 2015 to 2022. Results indicate that greater credit access is associated with a 2% reduction in acute food insecurity at the population level over the study period. Given that, on average, 16% of the population is in crisis, this effect represents a meaningful shift within the at-risk group. We interpret these estimates under explicit identification assumptions and complement them with robustness and refutation tests. The results provide context-specific evidence on how financial access correlates with food security outcomes in data-scarce, crisis-affected settings, and offer a transparent framework for integrating heterogeneous data sources when randomized evaluations are infeasible.

</details>


### [943] [Machine Learning-Based Prediction of Childhood Stunting in Bangladesh: Fairness and Temporal Robustness Assessment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24386)
*Md Ahshanul Haque,Muhammad Ashad Kabir*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究利用2007–2022年孟加拉国人口与健康调查(DHS)数据，构建机器学习模型进行儿童生长迟缓的人群级预测，并评估时间稳健性与亚组公平性。2007/2011/2014年数据用于建模，2018/2022年作为时间外部测试集；比较11种模型（10种常规算法+TabPFN）。最终样本18,844名0–59月龄儿童，迟缓率35.05%。内部测试中TabPFN平衡准确率最高(67.58%)，AdaBoost在常规模型中最高(67.51%)；时间测试中2018年Gradient Boosting、2022年XGBoost表现最佳，且性能随调查轮次与亚组波动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 儿童生长迟缓是孟加拉国重大公共卫生问题，受儿童、母亲、家庭、社会经济与卫生服务等多层面因素长期影响。既有预测研究多缺乏时间外部验证与亚组公平性评估，难以判断模型在人群变迁与不同子群体中的可靠性。该研究旨在构建人群级预测模型，并系统考察其时间稳健性与亚组公平性，以支撑公共卫生决策。

Method: 采用全国代表性BDHS 2007–2022数据，纳入0–59月龄且人体测量与预测变量完整的儿童。2007、2011、2014年数据用于模型开发，2018、2022年作为时间测试集。评估12种特征选择方法，最终采用KNN置换重要性筛选的变量集。比较11种模型：10种常规算法与1种预训练表格基础模型TabPFN。性能指标包括平衡准确率、AUROC、F1、Brier分数与期望校准误差；按儿童性别、居住地与社会经济地位进行亚组公平性分析。

Result: 最终分析样本18,844名儿童，其中35.05%为生长迟缓。开发集留出测试中，TabPFN总体平衡准确率最高(67.58%)，常规模型中AdaBoost最高(67.51%)。时间测试中，BDHS 2018以Gradient Boosting、BDHS 2022以XGBoost的平衡准确率最高。模型性能在不同调查轮次与亚组间存在差异。

Conclusion: 机器学习可支持儿童生长迟缓的人群级预测，但模型性能随时间和亚组变化，凸显时间外部验证、亚组公平性评估与透明可解释性在公共卫生预测建模中的必要性。TabPFN等基础模型在内部测试中具竞争力，但未显示跨年份的稳定优势。

Abstract: Childhood stunting remains a major public health concern in Bangladesh and reflects long-term growth failure influenced by child, maternal, household, socioeconomic, and health-service factors. This study used nationally representative Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey data from 2007 to 2022 to develop machine learning models for population-level prediction of childhood stunting and to assess temporal robustness and subgroup fairness. Children aged 0-59 months with complete anthropometric and predictor data were included. Data from the 2007, 2011, and 2014 survey rounds were used for model development, while the 2018 and 2022 rounds were retained as temporal test datasets. Twelve feature-selection approaches were assessed, and the KNN permutation importance-selected predictor set was used for final model evaluation. Eleven machine learning models were evaluated: ten conventional algorithms and one pretrained tabular foundation model, TabPFN. Performance was assessed using balanced accuracy, AUROC, F1-score, Brier score, and expected calibration error. Subgroup fairness was examined by child sex, place of residence, and socioeconomic status. The final analytic sample included 18,844 children, of whom 35.05% were stunted. In the development hold-out test dataset, TabPFN showed the highest observed balanced accuracy overall at 67.58%, while AdaBoost showed the highest observed balanced accuracy among conventional models at 67.51%. In temporal testing, the highest observed balanced accuracy was found for Gradient Boosting in BDHS 2018 and XGBoost in BDHS 2022. Model performance varied across survey rounds and subgroups, highlighting the importance of temporal validation, subgroup fairness assessment, and transparent interpretation in public health prediction modeling.

</details>


### [944] [NAVIR: Neuromorphic Audio-Visual Speech Recognition for Robust Human-Robot Interaction on Edge Hardware](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24391)
*Leonidas Delimpasis,Panagiota Moraiti,Antonis Porichis,Panos Chatzakos,Michail Karamousadakis*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: NAVIR是首个在BrainChip Akida神经形态处理器上运行的完整音视频语音识别流水线，通过将时空编码分解为多个AkidaNet模块实现，在GRID基准和工业指令语料上取得优于纯音频基线的精度，并具备显著能效优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 工业场景中的噪声严重破坏纯音频语音识别，音视频语音识别（AVSR）虽可利用唇动线索补偿，但现有先进方法依赖三维卷积、循环单元和注意力机制，超出典型边缘设备的算力预算；同时Akida神经形态处理器仅原生支持顺序二维卷积推理，缺乏适配方案。

Method: 将空间与时间编码分解为独立的基于AkidaNet的模块：逐帧视觉编码器、时间视频编码器和频谱音频编码器，经轻量预测头融合，并用受限束搜索解码；采用CTC损失在噪声增强音频上训练，再以量化感知训练微调。

Result: 在GRID基准上，量化音视频模型在噪声下未见过说话人划分达到14.0% WER、重叠说话人划分3.3% WER，优于纯音频基线的22.5%和11.8%；任务特定工业指令语料上达到98.6%命令准确率与1.5% WER。运算量分析显示脉冲方案在27.6%平均放电率下相对ANN有约13倍能效优势；板载测量显示唇读模型每次推理能耗约为Raspberry Pi CPU的1/5、笔记本电脑GPU的1/100以下，同时保持14.5次/秒推理速度。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个在该类神经形态硬件上运行的完整多模态AVSR流水线，验证了神经形态边缘设备上部署AVSR的可行性与能效潜力。

Abstract: Voice-controlled interaction in industrial settings is hampered by acoustic noise, which severely degrades audio-only speech recognition. Audio-visual speech recognition (AVSR) addresses this by fusing lip-motion cues with the audio stream, but state-of-the-art pipelines rely on three-dimensional convolutions, recurrent units, and attention modules that exceed the budget of typical edge devices. We present NAVIR, an end-to-end AVSR system targeting the BrainChip Akida neuromorphic processor, which natively supports only sequential two-dimensional convolutional inference. The pipeline factorises spatial and temporal encoding into separate AkidaNet-based modules: a per-frame visual encoder, a temporal video encoder, and a spectrogram audio encoder, fused by a lightweight predictor head and decoded by constrained beam search. Models are trained with connectionist temporal classification on noise-augmented audio and then fine-tuned with quantization-aware training. On the GRID benchmark, the quantized audio-visual model reaches 14.0% word error rate (WER) under noise on the unseen-speaker split and 3.3% WER on the overlapped-speaker split, against 22.5% and 11.8% for audio-only baselines, and it attains 98.6% command accuracy at 1.5% WER on a task-specific industrial-command corpus. Operation-count analysis indicates a 13-fold energy advantage of the spiking formulation over its artificial neural network counterpart at 27.6% mean firing rate. On-board measurements show roughly 5-fold lower energy per inference than a Raspberry Pi central processing unit on the lip-reading model, and over 100-fold lower than a laptop graphics processing unit, while sustaining 14.5 inferences per second. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first complete multimodal AVSR pipeline running on neuromorphic hardware of this class.

</details>


### [945] [Climate Variability Modulates the Impact of Price Spikes on Food Insecurity](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24394)
*Jordi Cerdà-Bautista,Vasileios Sitokonstantinou,Homer Durand,Gherardo Varando,Michele Ronco,Gustau Camps-Valls*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究提出“敏感性分区（sensitivity regimes）”，按植被对ENSO响应的方向与强度对区域分层，并结合遥感、社会经济数据与因果机器学习，估计粮价飙升对撒哈拉以南非洲急性粮食不安全的影响。结果显示，在ENSO系统性抑制植被的区域，粮价飙升使下月急性风险人口比例上升5.4个百分点；而在植被不受影响或正向关联的区域，效应较小（约2个百分点）且不显著。ENSO状态可提前数月标示脆弱区域，与价格飙升触发机制结合可支持预期性行动。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 气候变率决定市场扰动是否会升级为粮食危机，但像厄尔尼诺这类可在数月前被追踪的大尺度气候模式，尚未被纳入粮食安全响应的预警组件。论文旨在填补这一空白，将气候背景纳入粮食不安全脆弱性评估与预警。

Method: 提出“敏感性分区”概念：依据植被对ENSO响应的方向与强度对区域进行分层；整合遥感数据、社会经济数据与因果机器学习，估计粮价飙升如何影响撒哈拉以南非洲的急性粮食不安全，并比较不同ENSO敏感性区域的异质性效应。

Result: 在ENSO系统性抑制植被的区域，粮价飙升使随后一个月处于急性风险的人口比例上升5.4个百分点；在植被不受ENSO影响或与其正相关的区域，估计效应较小（约2个百分点）且统计上不显著。

Conclusion: 气候背景对理解粮食安全脆弱性至关重要。敏感性分区可与业务化价格飙升触发机制结合，用于分阶段预期性行动：ENSO状态提前数月标示脆弱区域，在这些区域对价格飙升进行预先部署响应，可避免急性粮食不安全的最大跃升。

Abstract: Climate variability influences whether a market disruption escalates into a food crisis, yet broad climate patterns like El Niño, tracked months before they alter hydro-climatic conditions, are still not incorporated as an early-warning component in food-security responses. We address this gap by introducing sensitivity regimes, a stratification of regions by the direction and strength of their vegetation response to the El Niño Southern Oscillation, and using them to estimate how food price spikes affect acute food insecurity across sub-Saharan Africa. Integrating remote sensing, socioeconomic data, and causal machine learning, we find that in regions where ENSO systematically suppresses vegetation, a price spike raises the share of the population at acute risk by 5.4 percentage points in the following month. In regions where vegetation is unaffected by or positively linked to ENSO, the estimated effect is smaller (around 2 percentage points) and statistically insignificant. These results demonstrate that climate context is critical for understanding food security vulnerabilities. Sensitivity regimes can be combined with operational price-spike triggers to stage anticipatory action: the ENSO state flags vulnerable regions months ahead, and a pre-positioned response in those regions to a price spike would avert the largest jump in acute food insecurity.

</details>


### [946] [Probabilistic Modelling of Operational Design Domains, A New Approach for Testing AI Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24397)
*Hans-Werner Wiesbrock*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出概率扩展本体（PEON），通过在描述运行设计域（ODD）的本体上附加概率分布，并借助耦合与最优传输算法补全为贝叶斯网络，实现代表性测试用例采样、严格测试终止准则及训练数据平衡评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统测试与缺陷修复流程难以应用于基于机器学习的系统（如车辆障碍物检测）：若某测试未检测到障碍物，经典调试无法解决，AI系统会长期保留缺陷。因此测试结果只能以统计方式解释，这要求测试集不仅相对ODD完备，还要具有代表性。现有条件概率表难以维护，亟需一种可维护的ODD概率建模方法。

Method: 提出概率扩展本体（PEON）：用本体描述ODD，并在其诱导的划分上附加概率分布。无需维护条件概率表，只需指定边缘分布和函数式描述的依赖关系；再通过基于耦合（couplings）与最优传输（optimal transport）的算法，将该部分指定补全为完整贝叶斯网络。基于PEON可推导：代表性测试用例采样、给定质量目标与显著性水平下的严格测试终止准则、已有测试结果重评估方法，以及训练数据平衡性评估方法。

Result: 以自动列车运行（automatic train operation）为例，展示了对复杂ODD的实用化建模，验证了PEON在采样、终止准则、结果重评估与数据平衡评估方面的可用性。

Conclusion: PEON为ML系统提供了一种可维护、可扩展的ODD概率建模框架，将本体与贝叶斯网络结合，支撑统计意义上的代表性测试、测试终止判定及数据质量评估。

Abstract: The conventional testing process quickly fails when applied to ML-based systems such as obstacle detection in vehicles: if an obstacle is not detected in a test, classical bug fixing is impossible and an AI system will always retain shortcomings. Test results can therefore only be interpreted statistically, which in turn requires test sets that are not only complete with respect to the operational design domain (ODD) of the system, but also representative of it. To this end, we introduce probabilistically extended ontologies (PEONs): ontologies describing the ODD, augmented with a probability distribution over the partitioning they induce. Instead of unmaintainable conditional probability tables, only marginal distributions and functionally described dependencies need to be specified; algorithms based on couplings and optimal transport complete this specification to a Bayesian network. From a PEON we derive the sampling of representative test cases, rigorous end-of-test criteria for given quality targets and significance levels, and methods for re-evaluating existing test results and for assessing the balance of training data. We demonstrate the practical modelling of a complex ODD using the example of automatic train operation.

</details>


### [947] [Comparing Latent Concept Formation in State Space Models and Transformers via Sparse Autoencoders](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24440)
*Rithin Nagaraj,Rupa Laalasa Oruganti,Prerna Subhashchandra Kunder,Ashwini M Joshi*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该研究用稀疏自编码器（SAE）在1000万token语料上对Mamba-130m与Pythia-70m进行大规模特征级对应分析，发现99.98%的Mamba特征聚集在对齐上界，不支持架构间系统性表征分歧；仅0.02%的分歧特征与循环瓶颈对刚性语法的选择性限制相关。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: Transformer自注意力的二次复杂度推动了Mamba等次二次选择性状态空间模型的采用，而SSM将历史上下文压缩进固定大小的循环隐状态，形成严格的信息瓶颈。这引出一个机制可解释性的基础问题：SSM与Transformer是否学习到本质不同的潜在表征？

Method: 采用稀疏自编码器（SAE）对Mamba-130m与Pythia-70m进行大规模、特征级对应分析，语料规模为1000万token；通过Jaccard分布度量特征对齐程度，并对分歧特征进行定性刻画。

Result: 未发现架构间系统性表征分歧的证据：在观测到的Jaccard分布中，99.98%的Mamba特征聚集于对齐上界，为通用性假说提供了初步的特征级支持。仅0.02%的特征出现分歧，其模式与"循环瓶颈选择性限制刚性语法解析、而非广泛语义本体"的假设一致：Pythia的无约束注意力可对不同的格式边缘情形进行单义分解，而Mamba被迫将无关的句法异常压缩为多义的"杂物抽屉"神经元以保持状态容量。

Conclusion: 架构路由机制对核心语义理解的影响可能可忽略不计，表征分歧仅限于极端结构边缘情形。

Abstract: The quadratic scaling of Transformer self-attention has driven the adoption of sub-quadratic Selective State Space Models (SSMs) like Mamba, which compress past context into a fixed-size recurrent hidden state. This strict informational bottleneck raises a foundational question for mechanistic interpretability: do SSMs and Transformers learn fundamentally distinct latent representations? In this work, we employ Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) to conduct a large-scale, feature-level correspondence analysis between Mamba-130m and Pythia-70m over a 10-million token corpus. Contrary to hypotheses predicting widespread architectural divergence, we find no evidence of systematic representational divergence between architectures: across the observed Jaccard distribution, 99.98% of Mamba features cluster toward the upper alignment boundary, providing preliminary feature-level support for the Universality Hypothesis. We further identify and qualitatively characterize this microscopic fraction (0.02%) of diverging features, finding patterns consistent with the hypothesis that the recurrent bottleneck selectively limits the parsing of rigid syntax rather than broad semantic ontology. We demonstrate that while Pythia's unconstrained attention permits the monosemantic decomposition of distinct formatting edge-cases, Mamba is forced to compress unrelated syntactical anomalies into polysemantic "junk drawer" neurons to preserve state capacity. Collectively, these results suggest that architectural routing mechanisms may have negligible impact on core semantic understanding, with representational divergence confined to extreme structural margins.

</details>


### [948] [MUSE: Dependency-Aware Adaptation of a Frozen Vision Backbone for Multivariate Time Series Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24441)
*Xinying Cai,Junkai Lu,Yuhan Zhu,Xiaoyun Yu,Xiangfei Qiu,Jilin Hu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: MUSE：基于完全冻结MAE的多变量时间序列预测框架，通过VCR与TPR两模块实现依赖感知适配，10个数据集上达到SOTA。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多变量时间序列预测应用广泛。近期大视觉模型（LVM）可将跨域视觉先验迁移至时间序列预测，但现有LVM方法存在两大挑战：(1)难以平衡独立视觉表征空间与跨变量依赖建模；(2)自然图像预训练视觉骨干难以适配时间序列图像特有的时间语义。

Method: 提出MUSE框架，构建于完全冻结的预训练MAE之上。包含两个模块：变量上下文精炼模块（VCR）在每个变量内聚合共享时间信息并建模跨变量上下文依赖，同时保留独立视觉空间；时序-周期精炼模块（TPR）在不同编码器深度进行轻量级精炼，显式建模跨周期间时序依赖与周期内周期性依赖。两模块独立产出预测，并通过可学习的预测级门控进行融合。

Result: 在10个真实世界数据集上的实验表明，MUSE取得了SOTA性能。

Conclusion: MUSE通过依赖感知的适配策略，在冻结MAE的前提下有效解决了视觉先验迁移中的跨变量依赖与时间语义适配问题，验证了该框架的有效性。

Abstract: Multivariate time-series forecasting is essential to many real-world applications. Recent large vision models (LVMs) offer a promising paradigm by transferring cross-domain visual priors to time-series forecasting. However, existing LVM-based methods face two key challenges: balancing independent visual representation spaces with cross-variable dependency modeling, and adapting vision backbones pretrained on natural images to the distinct temporal semantics of time-series images. To address these challenges, we propose MUSE, a dependency-aware adaptation framework built on a fully frozen pretrained MAE. First, the Variable Context Refinement Module (VCR) aggregates shared temporal information within each variable and models cross-variable contextual dependencies while preserving independent visual spaces. Second, the Temporal-Periodic Refinement Module (TPR) performs lightweight refinement at different encoder depths and explicitly models across-period temporal dependencies and within-period periodic dependencies. The two modules independently produce forecasts, which are fused through a learnable prediction-level gate. Experiments on 10 real-world datasets demonstrate that MUSE achieves state-of-the-art performance.

</details>


### [949] [RAILS: Retrieval-Augmented Incremental LLM Clustering at Scale](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24464)
*Armin Oliya,Aleksandra Sawczuk,Radosław Białobrzeski*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: RAILS：检索增强的增量式LLM聚类器，通过不断生长的标签池循环与文档批处理+有界并发实现生产级扩展，六个基准上超越最强LLM聚类方法，并在SaaS工单主题发现中替代HDBSCAN。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在产规模下用LLM做聚类器面临两大障碍：提示无法容纳整个标签空间；逐文档串行处理无法满足真实工作负载所需的吞吐。

Method: RAILS将聚类转化为对不断增长标签池的简单循环，采用检索增强的增量式LLM聚类，并通过文档批处理与有界并发实现扩展。

Result: 六个公开基准上平均超过最强已有LLM聚类方法：准确率51.2%→59.3%，NMI 67.2%→74.8%，ARI 45.4%→54.7%；并在SaaS工单主题发现流水线中取代传统HDBSCAN阶段，聚类质量更高、具备可解释的提示驱动控制与有状态增量运行能力。

Conclusion: RAILS证明检索增强+增量标签池+批处理并发的设计可让LLM聚类达到生产可用规模，兼顾质量、可控性与增量能力。

Abstract: Using a Large Language Model (LLM) as the clusterer at production scale is hard: prompts cannot hold the entire label space, and per-document serial processing does not deliver the throughput real workloads require. We present RAILS, a retrieval-augmented incremental LLM clusterer that turns clustering into a simple loop over a growing label pool and scales through document batching with bounded concurrency. On six public benchmarks RAILS exceeds the strongest prior LLM-clustering method on average, lifting accuracy from 51.2% to 59.3%, NMI from 67.2% to 74.8%, and ARI from 45.4% to 54.7%. We further report production-deployment evidence from a SaaS ticket-topic-discovery pipeline, where RAILS has replaced a traditional HDBSCAN stage with higher clustering quality, transparent prompt-driven control, and stateful incremental operation.

</details>


### [950] [A Temporal Knowledge Graph for Music Festival Lineup Forecasting](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24467)
*Julia Gastinger,Thilo Dieing,Christian Meilicke,Heiner Stuckenschmidt*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文构建了一个覆盖380个音乐节、跨度55年的时序知识图谱（TKG），包含超9万条演出四元组，将音乐节阵容预测形式化为未来时间戳上的时序链接预测，并评测了6个TKG预测模型与零样本LLM。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音乐节阵容由艺术家、流派、发行作品、厂牌及历史演出之间的复杂关系决定，天然适合时序知识图谱预测；但现有TKG基准缺乏具体真实应用场景的落地评估。

Method: 构建并发布一个TKG资源，涵盖380个音乐节、55年、9万余条演出四元组，并附带音乐节、艺术家巡演与艺术家元数据；将阵容预测定义为艺术家与音乐节在未来时间戳之间的时序链接预测任务；在该任务上评估6个TKG预测模型并与零样本大语言模型对比。

Result: 在阵容预测任务上系统评测了6个TKG预测模型，分析了其能力与局限，并与零样本LLM进行对比。

Conclusion: 该资源以具体真实应用领域为评估基础，补充了现有TKG基准，为时序知识图谱预测评估提供了新的应用导向数据集。

Abstract: Music festival lineups emerge from complex relationships among artists, genres, releases, labels, and past performances, making the prediction of future lineups a natural fit for temporal knowledge graph (TKG) forecasting. In this work, we present a TKG covering 380 festivals over 55 years, comprising more than 90K festival performance quadruples along with information on festivals, artist tours, and artist metadata, and release it as a resource for TKG forecasting evaluation. We formalize festival lineup forecasting as temporal link prediction between artists and festivals at future timestamps. We evaluate six TKG forecasting models on this task, analyze their capabilities and limitations, and compare them against Large Language Models applied zero-shot. Our resource complements existing TKG benchmarks by grounding evaluation in a concrete, real-world application domain.

</details>


### [951] [Universal Multi-Modal Traceformer: Integrating Heterogeneous Context for Process Event Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24579)
*Fabian Spaeh,Jingxing Fang,Shandian Zhe,Bin Shen*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: UMT：基于Transformer的统一框架，将异构多模态过程上下文（数值、类别、文本、元数据）编码进共享空间，通过Perceiver动态加权融合，并多时间尺度建模重尾间隔时间，在13个真实事件日志上提升下一事件的活动与时间预测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有事件序列模型（含多数时间点过程方法）主要建模事件活动与时间戳，忽略了个体事件及整条轨迹上丰富的异构上下文（数值测量、类别属性、文本描述、元数据）。

Method: UMT 以 Transformer 为主干：1）通用特征编码器将不同特征类型映射到共享表示空间，并在事件级与轨迹级处理上下文；2）逐事件 Perceiver 模块动态加权上下文特征并自适应集成到事件 token 表示中；3）针对重尾且可能多模态的间隔时间分布，在多时间尺度上表示区间并联合预测各尺度对应的量。

Result: 在13个真实事件日志上的实验表明，UMT 在下一事件活动预测与时间预测两方面均优于现有方法。

Conclusion: 将异构多模态上下文统一纳入下一事件预测是有效的，UMT 为事件日志建模提供了可推广的框架。

Abstract: Event logs arise in a wide range of real-world processes, capturing not only event activities and timestamps but also multi-modal contextual information. Existing event-sequence models, including many temporal point process approaches, primarily model event activities and timestamps while overlooking heterogeneous context, such as numerical measurements, categorical attributes, textual descriptions, and metadata associated with individual events and entire traces. In this paper, we propose Universal Multi-Modal Traceformer (UMT), a unified framework for incorporating heterogeneous process context into next-event prediction. Built on a Transformer backbone, UMT introduces a universal feature encoder that maps diverse feature types into a shared representation space and handles contextual information at both the event and trace levels. UMT further develops a per-event Perceiver module that dynamically weights contextual features and adaptively integrates them into event-token representations. To accommodate the heavy-tailed and potentially multi-modal distribution of inter-arrival times, UMT represents each interval at multiple temporal scales and jointly predicts the corresponding scale-specific quantities. Experiments on 13 real-world event logs show that UMT improves both next-event activity and time prediction over existing approaches.

</details>


### [952] [Taking a Second Look: Correcting Sea Ice Forecasts with Sparse Observations](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24591)
*Tianshuo Zhang,Xianglei Xing,Aowen Yang,Jia Gao,Wenzhe Zhai,ShanShan Liu*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 论文提出ECHO（证据引导的异质传播校正）方法，针对海冰浓度（SIC）预报误差随观测时间积累的问题，指出固定传播距离的误差校正不合理，应按状态自适应调整传播距离，并给出ECHO-Scale与ECHO-Delta两种变体，在96种标准评估设置下均优于固定传播方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 海冰预报需提前数天发布，期间误差不断累积，而新获得的SIC观测往往稀疏。现有校正方法采用固定传播方式，但作者发现固定传播误差集中在结构化、高梯度的海冰边缘，而均质内部所需传播有限，说明传播距离应与状态相关，故需设计状态依赖的自适应传播策略。

Method: 提出ECHO（Evidence-guided Correction with Heterogeneous prOpagation，证据引导的异质传播校正）。其中ECHO-Scale在保持校正几何不变的前提下自适应调整传播距离；ECHO-Delta在固定传播基础上学习一个有界残差。

Result: 在涵盖多种先验、观测时间、稀疏度、几何结构与噪声条件的全部96种标准评估设置中，ECHO-Scale与ECHO-Delta均优于固定传播方法。ECHO-Delta获得最佳平均精度，ECHO-Scale对几何变化更具鲁棒性。代码已开源。

Conclusion: 海冰浓度误差校正应采用状态依赖的异质传播而非固定传播；ECHO框架通过尺度自适应与残差学习两种途径实现该思想，兼顾精度与鲁棒性，验证了传播距离随状态变化的必要性。

Abstract: Sea ice forecasts are issued several days ahead, allowing errors to accumulate while new, often sparse sea ice concentration (SIC) observations become available. We find that fixed-propagation errors concentrate near structured, high-gradient ice edges, whereas homogeneous interiors require limited propagation, suggesting that propagation distance should be state dependent. We therefore introduce ECHO (Evidence-guided Correction with Heterogeneous prOpagation), where ECHO-Scale adapts propagation distance while preserving correction geometry, and ECHO-Delta learns a bounded residual around fixed propagation. Across all 96 standard evaluation settings spanning diverse priors, observation times, sparsity levels, geometries, and noise conditions, both outperform fixed propagation. ECHO-Delta achieves the best average accuracy, while ECHO-Scale is more robust to geometry shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/yingtian22/TAKING-A-SECOND-LOOK.

</details>


### [953] [Guaranteed Low-Rank Tensor Recovery from Modewise Measurements via Normalized Block-Weighted Riemannian Gradient Descent](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24679)
*Yushi Zhou,Feng Zhang*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出一种自适应分块加权模式黎曼梯度下降方法，用于从线性测量中恢复低多重线性秩张量，结合内存高效的模式测量与归一化自适应加权策略，实现局部线性收敛并降低迭代次数和计算时间。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 低多重线性秩张量恢复中，现有方法在收敛速度与计算效率方面存在不足，尤其需要内存高效的测量方式并改善收敛性能，同时不增加搜索方向的多重线性秩界或缩减核的规模。

Method: 将内存高效的模式测量与针对黎曼梯度核心分量和因子分量的归一化自适应加权策略相结合；在张量受限等距性质与合适初始化下，分析其收敛性；并对亚高斯测量和带随机符号的子采样正交（SORS）测量推导采样保证。

Result: 在张量受限等距性质与合适初始化下建立了局部线性收敛，并给出亚高斯和SORS测量的采样保证；在合成低Tucker秩张量上的数值实验表明，该方法减少了迭代次数和计算时间，同时保持可靠的恢复性能，尤其在恢复阈值附近和结构化SORS测量下表现更优。

Conclusion: 所提自适应分块加权模式黎曼梯度下降方法在保证恢复可靠性的同时提升了收敛效率，特别适用于恢复阈值附近及结构化SORS测量场景。

Abstract: We consider the recovery of low-multilinear-rank tensors from linear measurements and propose an adaptive block-weighted modewise Riemannian gradient descent method. The method combines memory-efficient modewise measurements with a normalized adaptive weighting strategy for the core and factor components of the Riemannian gradient. The weighting improves convergence without increasing the multilinear-rank bound of the search direction or the size of the reduced core used for retraction. Under the tensor restricted isometry property and a suitable initialization, we establish local linear convergence and derive sampling guarantees for sub-Gaussian and subsampled orthogonal with random sign (SORS) measurements. Numerical experiments on synthetic low-Tucker-rank tensors show that the proposed method reduces iteration counts and computational time while maintaining reliable recovery performance, especially near the recovery threshold and for structured SORS measurements.

</details>


### [954] [A Federated Artificial Intelligence Framework for Optimizing Pancreatic Cancer Treatment - Strategy Update](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24718)
*Anne-Christin Hauschild,Amirreza Aleyasin,Nils H. Beyer,Lisa Fricke,Jonas Hügel,Maryam Moradpour,Anh-Tien Nguyen,Youngjun Park,Sophia Rheinländer,Tim Beissbarth,Elisabeth Hessmann,Martin Middeke,Matthias Lauth,Maximilian Reichert,Ulrich Sax*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文更新了胰腺癌亚型识别与治疗方案评估的联邦学习（FL）实践报告，介绍了本地FL枢纽部署、数据标注、算法与阶段性成果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 集中式数据收集虽理论上数据质量与预测性能最佳，但受隐私法规（如GDPR）与实操限制难以实现，需探索在合规边界内利用分布式医疗数据的可行方案。

Method: 在参与站点本地FL枢纽（集中开发、分布式部署的Docker容器，内含生成局部模型的FL脚本）中对提取转换后的可访问数据进行识别与标注；采用新开发的FL算法，利用所有本地特征，包括站点特有的部分重叠特征；尝试以德国肿瘤学核心数据集（oBDS）支撑癌种标注。

Result: 解决了基础设施运营概念、新型架构的伦理审批及站点支持等主要障碍；FL算法在公开数据集上对部分重叠特征具有稳健性；展示了实际联邦学习AI流水线的初步结果。

Conclusion: 该FL方法在合规前提下具可行性并取得初步成效，但未来规模化仍面临挑战：纳入更广泛的多模态数据尚可行，而向更多站点的大规模部署依然困难。

Abstract: While a centralized approach involving patient consent to collect and analyze data centrally would theoretically offer the best data quality and predictive performance, it is not always feasible in practice. Federated Learning (FL) architectures have shown to be a very promising approach to use and access distributed disease related resources within the GDPR boundaries. In a previous case report, we described the preconditions at the participating sites and necessary administrative and process related steps to prepare data, people and infrastructure for improving subtype identification and assessing treatment options in pancreatic cancer. We update this report sharing our experience in tackling the challenges and show preliminary results of the actual federated learning AI pipelines. At the participating sites, we have to identify and annotate the data being accessible after extraction and transformation in a local FL hub - in our case a centrally developed and distributively deployed Docker container. This container comprises the FL scripts generating local models. We apply a newly developed FL algorithm considering all local features, including partial overlapping features specific to the local sites. Theoretically, an annotation in a cancer setting should succeed using the German oncology core data set (oBDS), which is already utilized for mandatory reporting to cancer registries, and can be sustained in the FL setting. The FL algorithms deal robustly with partially overlapping features as we showed with public data sets. Major roadblocks including straightening operational concepts for the infrastructures, ethics approval for such novel architectures and support for every site have been addressed. However, scaling up this approach in the future faces hurdles; while including broader multi-modal data sets should be feasible, large-scale deployment to more sites remains challenging.

</details>


### [955] [An Exact Junction-Tree Extended Formulation for Optimal Classification Trees](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24741)
*Jiancheng TU,WenqiFan*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文基于联结树表示，为带二值特征的有界深度分类树建立了精确线性规划（LP）公式，该公式具有整性并支持递归子树优化；通过精确约简缩小模型规模后，提出列生成与消息传递两种求解方法，实验表明其在认证最优性与运行时间上均优于现有精确方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精确求解最优分类树通常依赖混合整数规划（MIP），但在给定计算预算内往往难以认证最优性。作者希望构造具有整性的精确LP公式，并提供可扩展的求解算法，以在更短时间内认证更多算例。

Method: 1) 采用联结树（junction-tree）表示，构建带二值特征的有界深度分类树的精确LP公式，公式为整数多面体，并支持递归子树优化；2) 设计精确约简，在保持最优值与最优树可恢复性的前提下缩小模型；3) 在约简模型上提出两种求解方法：列生成（求解整数受限LP，并用全可行域上的界验证最优性）与消息传递（递归合并最优子树代价）；4) 两种方法均可对固定前序树决策后的公共子树问题独立并行求解。

Result: 实验显示精确约简显著缩减了联结树公式的规模；所得LP公式能认证在相同计算预算下测试的MIP公式无法认证最优性的算例；列生成与消息传递方法能认证更多算例，且相对现有最优分类树精确方法，几何平均运行时间降低一个数量级。

Conclusion: 基于联结树的精确LP公式结合精确约简与列生成/消息传递求解，可有效提升最优分类树精确求解的最优性认证能力与计算效率，是优于现有精确方法的方案。

Abstract: We develop an exact linear programming (LP) formulation for bounded-depth classification trees with binary features, using a junction-tree representation. The formulation is integral and supports recursive subtree optimization. Exact reductions make the model smaller while preserving the optimal value and recovery of an optimal tree. The reduced model supports two solution methods: column generation and message passing. Column generation solves integral restricted LPs and uses bounds over the full feasible domain to certify optimality. Message passing recursively combines optimal subtree costs. Both methods solve common subtree problems that, once the preceding tree decisions are fixed, can be evaluated independently and in parallel. Computational experiments show that the exact reductions substantially reduce the size of the junction-tree formulation. The resulting linear programming formulation certifies instances for which the tested mixed-integer formulation does not establish optimality within the same computational budget, while the column-generation and message-passing methods certify more instances and achieve an order-of-magnitude reduction in geometric-mean runtime relative to an existing state-of-the-art exact method for optimal classification trees.

</details>


### [956] [Inference of Unknown Dynamical Components Using Next Generation Reservoir Computing: From Chaotic Systems to Climate Data](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24754)
*Jule Budnick,Andrew Keane,Serhiy Yanchuk*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文研究下一代储备池计算（NGRC）作为数据驱动方法推断动力系统中未观测分量的能力，并与传统储备池计算（RC）进行比较，最后应用于ENSO气候观测数据。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统储备池计算（RC）在推断动力系统未见分量时通常需要较多训练数据和较长计算时间；作者希望验证NGRC能否以更高数据效率和计算效率完成此类推断任务，并探索其对真实含噪数据的适用性。

Method: 以Lorenz和Rössler系统为基准，在仅给定一个分量的条件下推断另外两个未知分量，对比NGRC与RC的表现；分析NGRC所需时间延迟步数与时间分辨率之间的关系；并将NGRC应用于ENSO（El Niño--Southern Oscillation）观测气候数据，由其余变量推断一个可观测变量。

Result: 在Lorenz和Rössler系统中，NGRC均取得准确结果，且所需训练数据更少、计算时间短于RC；发现NGRC所需时间延迟步数与时间分辨率呈反比关系，说明延迟间隔所覆盖的物理时间跨度是决定所需延迟步数的重要因素；在含噪且复杂的ENSO真实观测数据上，NGRC仍显示出有前景的推断效果。

Conclusion: NGRC在受控动力系统和真实世界数据中均展现出高效推断未观测分量的潜力，是一种数据与计算效率较高的数据驱动推断方法。

Abstract: We investigate next generation reservoir computing (NGRC) as a data-driven approach for inferring unseen components of dynamical systems. We compare NGRC with traditional reservoir computing (RC) using the Lorenz and Rössler system, where two unknown components are inferred from one given component. For both systems, NGRC achieves accurate results while requiring fewer training data and less computational time than RC. We identified an inverse proportional behavior between the number of time-delayed steps needed for NGRC and the temporal resolution, indicating that the physical time span covered by the delay interval is an important factor in determining the required number of delayed steps. Finally, we apply NGRC to the observational climate data of ENSO (El Niño--Southern Oscillation) and infer one observable from the remaining variables. Despite the noise and complexity of the real-world data, the NGRC shows promising results. Our findings demonstrate the potential of NGRC for efficient inference of unseen components in both controlled dynamical systems and real-world data.

</details>


### [957] [Complex KDA: Understanding and Enhancing the Expressivity of Kimi Delta Attention](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24797)
*Julien Siems,Riccardo Grazzi,Korbinian Pöppel,Jaisidh Singh,Arber Zela,Timur Carstensen,Jenia Jitsev,Frank Hutter,Volkan Cevher,Antonio Orvieto,Aaron Klein*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 提出 Complex KDA（CKDA），通过将单个 delta-rule 变换与通道门控提供的反射相结合，在保持对角加秩一、非扩张结构的同时实现 2D 旋转，达到 DeltaProduct₂ 的状态跟踪表达能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于 delta-rule 的线性 RNN 虽高效，但低秩修正的线性更新限制了表达能力；此前需在单次循环更新中组合两个 delta-rule 转移才能建模 2D 旋转，代价是更新秩与计算成本上升。作者希望以更低成本获得同等表达力。

Method: 将 delta-rule 变换与由通道门控（channel-wise gate）提供的第二次反射组合，实现 2D 旋转；为此扩展参数范围：门控取 [-1,1]，delta-rule 系数 β 取 [0,2]，即融合两种已有的范围扩展，形成 CKDA。理论分析刻画其表达能力，并证明每个正交的对角加秩一矩阵恰为 CKDA 转移矩阵。

Result: CKDA 保持 KDA 的稳定性与效率（转移仍为对角加秩一且非扩张），同时达到 DeltaProduct₂ 的状态跟踪表达能力。单层 CKDA 可跟踪所有与 SO(3) 子群同构的有限群；多数状态跟踪任务比其它对角加秩一线性 RNN 少用一层。在 S₃、S₄ 与周期音频续接任务上，双重范围扩展取得最强长度外推；语言建模中优于 Transformer 及其他线性 RNN，与 KDA 基线相当并显示出有希望的扩展行为。

Conclusion: 通过门控反射与扩大参数范围的组合，CKDA 以单次 delta-rule 更新的成本获得更强的状态跟踪与长度外推能力，兼顾效率与表达力，代码与模型已开源。

Abstract: Linear RNNs based on the delta-rule enable efficient sequence modeling, but their linear updates with a low-rank correction constrain their expressivity. Prior work has shown that composing two delta-rule transitions in a single recurrent update can model a 2D rotation, but this increases the rank and the cost of the updates compared to a single transition. We show that Kimi Delta Attention (KDA) can realize 2D rotations by combining a single delta-rule transformation with a second reflection supplied by its channel-wise gate. This requires extending the parameter ranges of KDA by combining two existing range extensions: allowing gates in $[-1,1]$ and the delta-rule coefficient $β$ in $[0,2]$. We call the resulting model Complex KDA (CKDA). It preserves KDA's stability and efficiency, with transitions that remain diagonal-plus-rank-one and non-expansive, while reaching the state-tracking expressivity of DeltaProduct$_2$. We characterize the expressivity of CKDA and prove that every orthogonal diagonal-plus-rank-one matrix is exactly a CKDA transition matrix. A single CKDA layer can track every finite group isomorphic to a subgroup of $\mathrm{SO}(3)$, and many state-tracking results use one fewer layer for CKDA compared to other diagonal-plus-rank-one Linear RNNs. Empirically, combining both extensions yields the strongest length extrapolation among tested KDA range settings on $S_3$, $S_4$, and periodic audio continuation. In language modeling, CKDA outperforms Transformers and other linear RNNs, obtains similar results to a KDA baseline, and shows promising scaling behavior. Our code is open source at https://github.com/OpenEuroLLM/ComplexKDA and our models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/openeurollm/complexkda.

</details>


### [958] [G-NAC: Graph Neural Automata Clustering via Emergent Domain Formation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24823)
*Keith Miller,Tristan Crawford*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出无监督聚类方法G-NAC，将观测视为固定邻域图上的细胞，由共享的循环图神经细胞规则通过局部交互演化潜在域状态，并转化为基于秩的谱亲和度进行划分。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 面向无监督聚类任务，探索一种以循环图神经细胞自动机为核心、通过局部交互驱动状态演化，并适用于大规模图的聚类新范式。

Method: G-NAC在固定邻域图上进行局部交互，使用共享的循环图神经细胞规则演化潜在域状态，并将演化结果转换为基于秩的谱亲和度用于聚类划分；实验在57个基准数据集的73个聚类任务上评估，并与Genie等基线比较，同时考察训练时间、GPU显存随节点规模（5,000至100,000）的缩放特性及规则迁移能力。

Result: 在57个基准数据集的73个聚类任务上，G-NAC平均调整兰德指数（ARI）为0.7951，与Genie的0.7941相当，且高于其他评测基线；训练时间与GPU显存从5,000到100,000节点近似线性增长；学习到的转移规则可从较小源图迁移到相同条件下生成的独立100,000节点样本。

Conclusion: 结果验证了循环图聚类表述的有效性，同时指出其性能依赖于图质量、读出设计以及源图与目标图的相似性。

Abstract: We introduce Graph Neural Automata Clustering (G-NAC), an unsupervised clustering method in which observations interact as cells on a fixed neighborhood graph. A shared recurrent graph-neural cellular rule evolves latent domain states through local interactions, which are converted into a rank-based spectral affinity for partitioning. Across 73 clustering tasks from 57 benchmark datasets, G-NAC achieved a mean adjusted Rand index (ARI) of 0.7951, comparable to Genie at 0.7941 and higher than the other evaluated baselines. Empirical training time and GPU memory scaled approximately linearly from 5,000 to 100,000 nodes. Learned transition rules also transferred from smaller source graphs to independent 100,000-node samples generated under matched conditions. These results demonstrate a recurrent graph-clustering formulation while identifying dependencies on graph quality, readout design, and source-target similarity.

</details>


### [959] [Learning Prognostic Variables for AI Convective Parameterizations via Symbolic Distillation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24882)
*Jurij Schönfeld,Tom Beucler,Julien Savre,Steven Sherwood,Veronika Eyring*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出为混合AI-物理气候建模引入"预报性记忆变量"：先将历史信息压缩到低维隐空间（自编码器），再将其替换为符号方程以刻画隐变量的时间演化，从而弥补传统诊断式参数化缺乏时间记忆的缺陷。在Lorenz-96（在线）与高分辨率降水（离线）两个实验中，该方法优于无记忆的诊断参数化，改善了气候统计量与时间结构（如热带陆地降水的日循环）。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统混合AI-物理气候建模多采用"局部时间、诊断式"参数化，即次网格状态仅依赖当前粗网格状态、不记忆历史状态。这对具有内在持续性的过程（如对流）并不真实，因此需要引入记忆机制。

Method: 1) 用自编码器将过去信息压缩为低维隐空间，据此训练神经网络参数化目标次网格过程；2) 用符号方程（symbolic equations）替换自编码器，刻画隐变量的时间演化，得到可与解析大气状态同步积分的额外预报性记忆变量；3) 在两个系统上评估：Lorenz-96（在线）与高分辨率大气模拟的地表降水（离线）；4) 与无记忆的诊断参数化进行基准对比。

Result: 一个带强迫的多元线性常微分方程（forced multivariate linear ODE）在两个实验中均恢复了基于自编码器方法的大部分增益；相比无记忆的诊断参数化，记忆增强方法改善了气候统计量和时间结构，包括再现热带陆地降水的真实日循环。

Conclusion: 为粗分辨率地球系统模型的次网格参数化引入紧凑的预报性记忆变量是可行且有效的；简单的线性ODE即可替代复杂的自编码器承载大部分记忆信息，从而提升气候模拟的统计与时间特性。

Abstract: Hybrid AI-physics climate modeling aims to improve coarse (~100km-resolution) Earth system models by learning to parameterize subgrid processes from high-fidelity data. However, this so far mostly involves local-in-time, diagnostic parameterizations, in which the subgrid state depends only on the current coarse state with no memory of previous states, which is unrealistic for processes such as convection that have intrinsic persistence. To address this, we enhance local-in-time parameterizations by learning prognostic variables that compactly carry important, additional past information where no explicit sub-grid information is available. First we compress past information into a low-dimensional latent space using an autoencoder, which then informs a neural network trained to parameterize targeted subgrid-scale processes. We then replace the autoencoder with symbolic equations that govern the time evolution of the latent variables, yielding additional prognostic memory variables that can be integrated alongside the resolved atmospheric state. We evaluate this approach on two systems: the Lorenz-96 model (online) and surface precipitation from high-resolution atmospheric simulations (offline). A forced multivariate linear ordinary differential equation recovers most of the added value achieved by the autoencoder-based approach in both experiments. Benchmarked against diagnostic parameterizations without memory, our memory-informed approach improves climate statistics and temporal structure, including a realistic diurnal cycle of tropical land precipitation.

</details>


### [960] [Learning Physics from an Imperfect Ancestor](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24947)
*S. Mohammad Mousavi,Teeratorn Kadeethum,Nikolaos Bouklas,Somdatta Goswami*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个三阶段框架：冻结物理信息神经算子（NO）的空间基，用多项式延拓将其解分支外推到分布外参数，再蒸馏为一个新的PINN，从而让不精确的NO提供正确解盆先验、PINN精化解，联合解决NO分布外退化与PINN优化盆地脆弱的双重问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 神经算子虽能廉价求解参数化偏微分方程，但在训练分布之外精度急剧下降；物理信息神经网络（PINN）虽不依赖标注数据，但优化过程对解盆地脆弱——当控制残差存在多解时，从零训练的PINN可能收敛到物理上错误的状态，尽管残差很小。

Method: 提出三阶段框架：（1）冻结物理信息神经算子的空间基；（2）用多项式延拓先验将解分支外推到分布外参数；（3）将所得场蒸馏进一个全新的PINN。其中NO无需在目标参数处准确，仅传递解分支信息，而收敛由PINN中的PDE残差最小化主导。

Result: 在三个非线性偏微分方程上评估：一维粘性Burgers、接近pitchfork分岔的二维稳态Allen-Cahn、二维稳态盖驱动方腔流。对Allen-Cahn，标准PINN坍缩到平凡的零解分支，而从粗糙外推算子蒸馏可恢复与有限差分解一致的非平凡分支；对盖驱动方腔流，外推到Re=3200加速收敛到正确物理状态，以更少参数和优化步数达到与近期文献基线相当的精度。

Conclusion: 建立一个简单原则：神经算子无需准确预测解才有用，它只需识别出PINN优化能够恢复正确解的盆地。

Abstract: Neural operators evaluate parametric partial differential equations cheaply but degrade sharply outside their training distribution. Physics-informed neural networks avoid dependence on labeled data, yet their optimization can be basin-fragile: when the governing residual admits multiple solutions, a PINN trained from scratch may converge to a physically incorrect state despite achieving a small residual. We show that these failure modes can be addressed jointly: an imperfect NO provides the structural prior needed to place a PINN in the correct solution basin, while the PDE residual refines the solution beyond the operator's accuracy. We introduce a three-stage framework that freezes the spatial basis of a physics-informed NO, extrapolates its solution branch to an out-of-distribution parameter using a polynomial continuation prior, and distills the resulting field into a fresh PINN. The NO need not be accurate at the target; it transfers solution-branch information, while PDE residual minimization in the PINN governs convergence. We evaluate the framework on three nonlinear PDEs: 1D viscous Burgers, 2D steady Allen-Cahn near a pitchfork bifurcation, and 2D steady lid-driven cavity flow. For Allen-Cahn, where the trivial solution satisfies the PDE residual exactly, a standard PINN collapses to the trivial zero branch, whereas distillation from the crude extrapolated operator recovers the non-trivial branch that matches the finite-difference reference. For the lid-driven cavity, extrapolating to a Reynolds number of Re = 3200 accelerates convergence to the correct physical state, achieving competitive accuracy using fewer parameters and optimization steps than recent literature baselines. These results establish a simple principle: an NO need not accurately predict the solution to be useful; it only needs to identify the correct basin from which PINN optimization can recover it.

</details>


### [961] [LoRA-generating hypernetworks for efficient on-device LLM generative personalization](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24979)
*Sean Augenstein,Li Ding,Jihwan Lee,Keith Rush,Andrey Zhmoginov*

Main category: cs.LG

TL;DR: 本文提出一种面向端侧大语言模型的个性化方法：训练超网络将用户上下文token映射为低秩适配（LoRA），设备端仅需前向计算即可合成个性化LoRA，兼顾ICL的可行性与PEFT的权重修改优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端侧LLM受限于算力，模型规模与质量受限，任何可实现的性能提升都极具价值；同时端侧LLM与特定用户紧密耦合，长期使用模式相似且可预测，具备个性化潜力。现有ICL与PEFT两条定制路线各有缺陷：ICL扩展输入序列带来延迟增加，PEFT在设备端计算不可行。

Method: 训练一个超网络，将用户上下文token映射为适合该用户的LoRA。部署时仅将训练好的通用产物下发到用户设备，各用户在设备端完全本地地用超网络合成个性化LoRA。架构上部分复用目标LLM自身的权重，以减少额外存储。

Result: 在多个代表性个性化数据集上与ICL、PEFT等基线进行对比，验证了LoRA生成式超网络的有效性；个性化实验聚焦于更具挑战性且研究较少的长文本生成任务。

Conclusion: 该方法融合了ICL与PEFT的优点并规避其缺陷：设备端阶段仅需前向传播，计算可行；通过LoRA修改基座LLM权重，避免扩展输入序列带来的延迟等问题；额外存储需求极小，特别适配移动端场景。

Abstract: On-device large language models (`LLMs'), e.g. running on mobile phones, are ripe for improvement via personalization. The limited compute resources of mobile devices impose limits on model scale and thus model quality, making any realizable quality gains highly impactful. At the same time, their personal nature (i.e., the close coupling to a particular user) means that a given on-device LLM tends to be used in similar, predictable patterns over the course of time. This paper presents a novel method for personalizing on-device LLMs. It trains a hypernetwork to map a user's context tokens to a low-rank adaptation (`LoRA') well-suited to that user. Once the trained common artifacts are deployed to users' devices, each user uses the hypernetwork to synthesize (entirely on device) a personalized LoRA. This approach blends the benefits while avoiding the drawbacks of two existing approaches to LLM customization: in-context learning (`ICL') and parameter-efficient fine-tuning (`PEFT'). Like ICL (and unlike PEFT), the on-device phase of our approach is computationally feasible, requiring only forward passes through neural networks. Like PEFT (and unlike ICL), our approach modifies the `target' base LLM via weights (the LoRA), avoiding negative consequences (e.g. increased latency) associated with extending the input sequence. Our approach is particularly well-suited to the mobile device regime. Apart from the on-device compute and latency benefits mentioned, it also requires minimal additional storage, as internally its architecture partly leverages the same LLM weights as belong to the target LLM to be personalized. We demonstrate the benefits of LoRA-generating hypernetworks on several representative personalization datasets, comparing against baselines like ICL and PEFT. Of note, our personalization experiments focus on more challenging and less studied long-form text generation tasks.

</details>


<div id='cs.SD'></div>

# cs.SD [[Back]](#toc)

### [962] [MuLA-Bench: A Multilingual Long-Form Audio Understanding Benchmark via Multi-Tier Auditing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23416)
*Zeyu Yang,Xinyu Zhang,Zibo Bi,Pei Zhang,Xize Cheng,Jin Xu,Baosong Yang,Satoshi Nakamura*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出 MuLA-Bench 长音频理解基准，含 5,038 道开放式问题、1,769 段真实录音（1,377.9 小时）、16 种语言与 8 个领域，揭示语言、证据与任务交互下的条件性失效模式。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有长音频评测多以上下文长度和聚合准确率概括模型能力，掩盖了语言、证据类型与任务操作如何共同影响难度，缺乏可控且可审计的评测手段。

Method: 构建 MuLA-Bench：设置平衡的"语言×领域"语义赛道以支持受控比较，另设声学赛道保留自然发生的非语音证据；采用证据锚定的生成流程、捷径检验与语言专家审核，避免翻译共享源集或注入目标声音；评测十种音频-语言模型，并在固定的八模型队列上做汇总诊断。

Result: 语言排序随领域与任务变化；声学-语义性能差距随所要求的操作不同而不同；时间误差可在正确事件已被识别后依然持续；长程检索相对较强，而精确定时对齐与自然声学事件的事实性锚定仍然脆弱。

Conclusion: 单一长上下文分数无法刻画上述条件性失效模式，MuLA-Bench 提供了更细粒度、可审计的长音频能力诊断视角。

Abstract: Long-form audio performance is often summarized by context length and aggregate accuracy, obscuring how language, evidence, and task jointly shape difficulty. We introduce MuLA-Bench: 5,038 open-ended questions over 1,769 in-the-wild recordings totaling 1,377.9 hours, covering 16 languages and eight domains. A balanced Language x Domain semantic track supports controlled comparisons, while a complementary acoustic track preserves naturally occurring non-speech evidence. Evidence-grounded generation, shortcut checks, and language-expert review provide auditable questions without translating a shared source set or injecting target sounds. We evaluate ten audio-language models and conduct pooled diagnostics on a fixed eight-model cohort. Language rankings change across domains and tasks; acoustic-semantic performance gaps vary with the requested operation; and temporal errors can persist after the correct event is identified. Long-range retrieval is comparatively strong, while precise clock alignment and factual grounding of natural acoustic events remain fragile. MuLA-Bench thus exposes conditional failure patterns that a single long-context score does not capture.

</details>


### [963] [SEABED: SouthEast Asian Benchmark for Evaluating Audio Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22586)
*Harshit Rajgarhia,Asif Shaik,Rachuri Lokesh,Sushanta Kumar Pani,Abhishek Mukherji*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该论文提出SEABED，一个面向东南亚（SEA）语音的音频优先问答基准，包含六类音频推理任务、5,404个问答对，用于评测语言与音频推理模型的语音推理能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有音频推理基准几乎全部面向英语及通用领域音频；而东南亚地区现有基准沿用英语的识别、翻译、副语言分类任务体系，只能测试模型"是否听到"SEA语音，而非"能否据此推理"。因此需要面向SEA语音、以推理为核心的基准。

Method: 构建SEABED数据集：完全基于真实、公开可得的SEA语音语料，设计六类音频推理任务，生成5,404个问答对；评测六个前沿及区域性音频大语言模型；除答案准确率外，还考察模型给出的推理是否以音频证据为依据。

Result: 即使最先进模型Gemini 3.5 Flash的加权平均准确率也仅为50.3%。

Conclusion: SEABED填补了SEA语音推理评测的空白，表明当前音频LLM在该区域语音推理任务上表现有限，并强调推理需以音频证据为支撑；基准样例已在Hugging Face公开。

Abstract: Modern audio-language models are no longer judged only on what words they can transcribe, but on whether they can reason over what they hear: recovering meaning that lives in tone and prosody, telling dialects and regional languages apart, and resolving ambiguity that the written form leaves open. This capability is now measured by a growing family of audio-reasoning benchmarks, but almost entirely in English and on general-domain audio. Southeast Asia (SEA) is served instead by benchmarks that inherit an English task taxonomy of recognition, translation, and paralinguistic classification, and therefore test whether a model hears SEA speech rather than whether it can reason from it. We introduce SEABED, an audio-first question answering dataset designed to benchmark language and audio reasoning models on SEA speech. SEABED comprises a suite of six audio-reasoning tasks built entirely from real, openly available SEA speech corpora, yielding 5,404 question-answer pairs. We evaluate six frontier and region-specific audio LLMs: even the state-of-the-art model Gemini 3.5 Flash achieves only 50.3% weighted average accuracy. SEABED evaluates not only answer accuracy, but also whether models' stated reasoning is grounded in the audio evidence. A sample of the benchmark data is available here: https://huggingface.co/datasets/CentificAIResearch/SEABED.

</details>


### [964] [ParA-LLM: A Unified Approach to Paralinguistic and Acoustic Speech Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22771)
*Nishit Anand,Jiaqi Su,Ke Chen,Yunyun Wang,Dinesh Manocha,Ramani Duraiswami,Rithesh Kumar,Zeyu Jin*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出副语言理解框架（22类特征、120万+音频问答数据），训练ParA-LLM并发布ParA-Bench基准，其在副语言任务上超越GPT-4o-Audio 7.5%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有Audio LLM虽在语音识别上达到人类水平，但难以捕捉说话人特质、表达变化和环境声学条件等副语言信息。

Method: 设计包含22类副语言特征的框架，构建超120万Audio-QA对数据集；采用两阶段课程学习训练ParA-LLM，先单属性问题构建基础知识，再多属性问题实现说话人与声学特征的联合推理；发布含6000道多选题的ParA-Bench基准（涵盖说话人-语音、声学及混合类别）。

Result: 前沿模型如GPT-4o-Audio在ParA-Bench上仅达36%准确率；ParA-LLM较GPT-4o-Audio提升7.5%，并在MMAU-Pro Speech上提升1.13%、MMAR Speech上提升7.49%。

Conclusion: 通过系统的副语言特征框架、大规模数据与课程学习，可显著提升Audio LLM的副语言理解能力，并提供了相应评测基准。

Abstract: Recent advances in Audio LLMs have achieved human-level speech recognition, yet existing systems struggle to capture paralinguistic aspects such as speaker traits, expressive variations, and environmental acoustic conditions. To address this, we design a framework of 22 paralinguistic characteristics and create a dataset of over 1.2M Audio-QA pairs. We develop ParA-LLM, trained with a two-stage curriculum: first on single-attribute questions to build foundational knowledge, then on multi-attribute questions for joint reasoning over speaker and acoustic characteristics. We also release ParA-Bench, a benchmark of 6,000 multiple-choice questions across speaker-speech, acoustic, and mixed categories, where frontier models like GPT-4o-Audio achieve only 36% accuracy. ParA-LLM surpasses state-of-the-art Audio LLMs like GPT-4o-Audio by 7.5% on ParA-Bench, with additional gains of 1.13% on MMAU-Pro Speech and 7.49% on MMAR Speech.

</details>


### [965] [Discrete vs. Continuous: A Comprehensive Study of Unified Audio Understanding in LALMs](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22851)
*Jing Peng,Zichao Nie,Zhisheng Zhang,Jingran Xie,Zhiyong Wu ID*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 系统评测连续特征与离散token两类音频表示在语音、音效、音乐通用理解中的表现，发现tokenization的语义约束关键，且仅靠放大主干模型无法弥补音频表示的信息损失。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 大音频语言模型（LALMs）可采用连续特征或离散token，但哪种表示范式更优尚无定论；现有基准多局限于窄领域，或脱离LALM语境单独评测编码器，缺乏对统一理解任务的系统比较。

Method: 提出UniARC框架，采用双评测策略，在语音、音效、音乐三类任务上对比连续与离散表示；跨模型规模（SmolLM2-135M至Llama-3-8B）实验，分析数据量、模型容量与计算效率之间的动态关系。

Result: tokenization中的语义约束对音频理解起关键作用；扩大backbone规模无法补偿音频表示的信息损失，在数据受限任务中尤为明显。

Conclusion: 为未来LALMs在语义密度、保真度与效率之间的权衡提供实践指导，强调音频表示质量优先于单纯扩大语言模型规模。

Abstract: Large Audio Language Models (LALMs) utilize either continuous features or discrete tokens, yet the optimal representation paradigm for general audio understanding remains debated. Existing benchmarks often focus on narrow domains or evaluate encoders outside LALM contexts. To address these gaps, we systematically evaluate continuous and discrete representations across speech, sound and music. Utilizing our UniARC framework with dual evaluation strategies across model scales from SmolLM2-135M to Llama-3-8B, we analyze the dynamic relationships of data volume, model capacity, and computational efficiency. Our results reveal the pivotal role of semantic constraints in tokenization for audio understanding and demonstrate that scaling backbones fail to compensate for information loss in audio representation, especially in data-limited tasks. These findings offer practical guidance for balancing semantic density, fidelity, and efficiency in future LALMs.

</details>


### [966] [Bearings: Self-Supervised Soundfield Embeddings from First-Order Ambisonics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23152)
*Goksenin Yuksel,Marcel van Gerven,Kiki van der Heijden*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出 Bearings，一个自监督声场编码器，从无标签一阶 Ambisonics 中学习可复用的声场嵌入，弥补现有自监督音频编码器"空间盲"的问题。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 近期自监督音频编码器虽能学到强大的通用声音场景表示，但缺乏空间信息（spatially blind），无法支持声源定位等空间相关任务，因此需要一种补充空间表征的声场编码方法。

Method: Bearings 采用自监督框架，以无标签一阶 Ambisonics 为输入，预训练一个掩码自编码器（masked auto-encoder），其解码器以现成单通道音频编码器（冻结）产生的声学嵌入为条件；所得声场嵌入可通过轻量可训练融合头（fusion head）接入冻结的声学编码器，无需重训练任一模型。

Result: 在声事件定位与检测（SELD）任务上，将 Bearings 声场嵌入与声学表征拼接，补足空间信息并实现联合检测与定位，使依赖位置的 F-score 在 TAU-NIGENS 2021 上从低于 4 提升至 50，在 STARSS23 上达 39。

Conclusion: 据作者所知，Bearings 是首个自监督声场编码器，其嵌入可直接接入冻结的声学编码器而无需重训练任一模型，验证了其作为可复用空间表征流的有效性。

Abstract: Recently proposed self-supervised audio encoders learn powerful general-purpose representations of sound scenes, yet they are spatially blind. To supply the missing spatial representation of sound scenes, we introduce Bearings. Bearings is a self-supervised framework that learns soundfield embeddings from unlabeled first-order Ambisonics. We pre-train a masked auto-encoder paired with a decoder conditioned on frozen acoustic embeddings from an off-the-shelf single-channel audio encoder. Our results show that the resulting soundfield embeddings form a reusable stream that can be attached to frozen acoustic encoders with a lightweight trainable fusion head. On sound event localization and detection, concatenating our soundfield embeddings with acoustic representations provides the missing spatial information and enables joint detection and localization, raising the location-dependent F-score from below 4 to 50 on TAU-NIGENS 2021 and 39 on STARSS23. To our knowledge, Bearings is the first self-supervised soundfield encoder whose embeddings plug into frozen acoustic encoders without retraining either model.

</details>


### [967] [EquiSELD: Efficient training of equivariant sound event localization and detection networks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23156)
*Goksenin Yuksel,Marcel van Gerven,Kiki van der Heijden*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出 EquiSELD，一种基于 O(3) 等变注意力网络的声事件检测与定位（SELD）方法，将一阶 Ambisonics 表示为不变标量与等变强度向量双流输入，并以 Multi-ACCDOA 读出，在更低训练成本下优于既有等变网络与非等变同类网络。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 一阶 Ambisonics（FOA）信号具有精确的 O(3) 对称性：旋转或反射仅改变声源到达方向而不改变声源本身。利用该空间对称性可提升 SELD 的效率与鲁棒性，但既有方法要么仅通过基于旋转的数据增强学习对称性的近似，要么依赖计算昂贵的方式引入等变性；且先前工作仅关注 SO(3) 等变，O(3) 等变对 SELD 的潜力尚不明确。

Method: 提出 EquiSELD：等变注意力网络，将 FOA 处理为 O(3) 不变标量与等变强度向量的成对双流；输出不变的活动幅度与等变的 DOA，采用 Multi-ACCDOA 读出。并设计仅 SO(3) 等变的匹配变体，以对比 O(3) 与 SO(3) 等变的影响。

Result: EquiSELD 在含实测 RIR 的仿真场景与真实世界声音场景录音上均优于先前的等变网络，且训练成本仅为其中一小部分；在仿真真实世界声音场景上超过规模相近的非等变 SELD 网络，在真实世界声音场景上达到有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 将 O(3) 等变性完整引入 SELD 是可行且有效的，相较 SO(3) 等变与旋转增强近似能带来更优性能与更低训练成本，为利用 FOA 空间对称性提供了新范式。

Abstract: First-order Ambisonics (FOA) signals exhibit exact O(3) symmetry: The rotation or reflection of the FOA signal modifies the direction of arrival of the sound sources, while preserving the sound sources themselves. Prior attempts to utilize this spatial symmetry of FOA to improve the efficiency and robustness of sound event detection and localization (SELD) systems either learned only an approximation of the symmetry through rotation-based augmentation or relied on computationally expensive methods to integrate equivariance. Furthermore, prior work focused exclusively on SO(3) equivariance , leaving the potential of incorporating O(3) equivariance for SELD tasks unclear. To address these limitations, we developed EquiSELD. This equivariant attention network processes first-order Ambisonics as paired streams of O(3)-invariant scalars and equivariant intensity vectors, producing an invariant activity magnitude and an equivariant DOA with a Multi-ACCDOA readout. To compare the impact of O(3) versus SO(3)-equivariance, we designed a matched SO(3)-only variant. EquiSELD outperforms prior equivariant networks on both simulated scenes with measured RIRs and recordings of real-world sound scenes at a fraction of the training cost. EquiSELD additionally surpasses the performance of non-equivariant SELD networks of a similar size on the simulated real-world sound scenes and achieves competitive performance on the real-world sound scenes.

</details>


### [968] [OmniEcho: Spatial Audio Understanding for Embodied Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23407)
*Ruixun Liu,Yuxuan Wang,Jiacheng Xie,Yuhuan You,Donghua Cai,Junming Lin,Xiong-Hui Chen,Zhifang Guo,Yunfei Chu,Qize Yang,Xize Cheng,Jin Xu,Yiwu Zhong*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出统一基准 OmniEchoBench 与空间感知全模态模型 OmniEcho，用于具身场景下的空间音频-视觉感知与音频-视觉-语言导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类能轻松定位声源方向并整合视觉线索进行推理，但具身智能体仍难以做到；当前缺乏在具身设定下有效评估与建模空间音频理解的方法与基准。

Method: 构建 OmniEchoBench：含 6 类任务、197 个真实空间音视频场景、2972 组问答对、900 个导航样本，音频为来自30个真实环境的一阶 Ambisonics（FOA）。提出可控空间音频渲染管线以保证声源、视觉观测与智能体轨迹的几何一致性，用于可扩展训练监督。提出 OmniEcho 模型：引入 FOA 空间编码器与预训练语义音频通路。

Result: OmniEcho 在空间音视频感知任务上达到 SOTA；在声音引导导航任务中性能接近传统视觉-语言导航水平。

Conclusion: 空间音频可作为具身场景推理与导航的有效信号；细粒度空间定位与距离估计仍是重要开放挑战。

Abstract: Humans can effortlessly localize the direction of a sound source and integrate it with visual cues for reasoning, yet this remains challenging for embodied agents. In particular, it is still unclear how to effectively evaluate and model spatial audio understanding in embodied settings. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{OmniEchoBench}, a unified benchmark for spatial audio-visual perception and audio-vision-language navigation. OmniEchoBench comprises six tasks over 197 real-world spatial audio-visual scenes, 2,972 question-answer pairs, and 900 navigation samples with first-order ambisonics (FOA) audio collected from 30 real-world environments. To enable scalable training supervision, we develop a controllable rendering pipeline for spatial audio. It preserves geometric consistency among sound sources, visual observations, and agent trajectories. Building on this, we propose \textbf{OmniEcho}, a spatially aware omni-modal model. It introduces an FOA spatial encoder alongside a pretrained semantic audio pathway. Extensive experiments show that OmniEcho achieves state-of-the-art performance on spatial audio-visual perception. For our sound-guided navigation, OmniEcho reaches a performance level close to that of traditional vision-language navigation. These results demonstrate that spatial audio can serve as a valuable signal for embodied scene reasoning and navigation, while also highlighting fine-grained spatial localization and distance estimation as important open challenges.

</details>


### [969] [Listen Then Reason: Perception-Grounded Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Large Audio-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23589)
*Jiaheng Dong,Xiaofeng Yu,Jean Honorio,Abhirup Ghosh,Hong Jia,Ting Dang*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文分析了大音频语言模型（LALMs）推理过程中音频信息的整合与利用方式，提出以感知为锚点的测试时强化学习（PG-TTRL），在多个模型与基准上稳定提升音频推理性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LALMs与测试时强化学习（TTRL）研究主要关注LLM推理能力，忽视了模型的感知能力，尤其是推理过程中声学证据被整合和依赖的程度，以及其对任务性能的贡献，这限制了面向音频推理的后训练方法的发展。

Method: 首先分析音频信息在推理过程中的整合与利用方式，量化逐层的感知依赖度（layer-wise perceptual reliance）；基于"更强声学依赖与更高准确率及更大音频增益相关"的发现，提出PG-TTRL，将无标签的测试时优化与感知锚定的推理对齐，促使模型在推理中更强地结构化依赖于音频输入。

Result: 逐层感知依赖分析显示，更强的声学依赖对应更高准确率以及更大的音频输入带来的性能增益；在多种LALMs与基准上的实验表明，PG-TTRL相较基座模型和标准TTRL均能持续提升推理性能。

Conclusion: 感知锚定优化对测试时音频推理具有重要价值，为LALMs的测试时后训练提供了新的方向。

Abstract: Large audio-language models (LALMs) are increasingly used for a broader range of audio reasoning tasks. These models typically incorporate audio representations into a large language model (LLM) backbone to enable multimodal reasoning. Recent test-time reinforcement learning (TTRL) methods further improve LLM reasoning capability by leveraging unlabelled test data after pre-training. However, the importance of the perceptual capability of LALMs remains underexplored, particularly how much acoustic evidence is integrated and relied upon during reasoning, and how this contributes to final task performance. This gap limits the development of effective post-training methods like TTRL for audio reasoning. In this work, we first analyse how audio information is integrated and utilised during reasoning process. We quantify layer-wise perceptual reliance and show that stronger acoustic reliance is associated with higher accuracy and a larger performance gain attributable to the audio input. Building on this, we propose Perception-Grounded TTRL (PG-TTRL), which aligns label-free test-time optimisation with perceptually grounded reasoning, encouraging the model to structure its reasoning more strongly on the audio input. Experiments across LALMs and benchmarks show that PG-TTRL consistently improves reasoning performance over both the base models and standard TTRL, showing the value of perceptual-grounding optimisation for test-time audio reasoning.

</details>


### [970] [Which Constraints Are Missing? Ask the Verifier: Graded Rewards for Constraint-Following Music Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23665)
*Haoyue Liu,Ye Chen,Zhichao Wang,Xiaoyu Ma,Haoran Shou,Xiaoying Tang*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该论文提出约束遵循音乐生成基准 MusicConstraintBench（8类约束、2180项），并针对二元奖励信号稀疏的问题提出 MusicRLVR：在硬性验证门控之后给予逐属性分级奖励，并加联合满足奖励，无需人工标注或奖励模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 音乐生成需同时满足多个可由程序检验的约束（调式、拍号、长度、音域、终止音、节奏、进行与曲式），但现有基准未单独隔离这一能力；同时当前模型在约束组合下表现不佳，而直接用验证器作二元奖励会导致大量训练组无梯度信号。

Method: 构建 MusicConstraintBench 基准；分析二元奖励的缺陷（前50次更新中0.550的 rollout 组得分相同、无梯度）；提出 MusicRLVR，采用硬验证门控拒绝畸形输出，并在此基础上提供逐属性分级信用与联合满足奖励，无需人工标注、习得奖励模型或音乐领域微调。

Result: 在 MusicConstraintBench 上，MusicRLVR 将 Qwen3-4B-Instruct 在混合约束上的表现从0.160提升至0.807，并超过所有零样本基线，包括 Llama-3.1-70B 的0.380；方法还能泛化到训练中未见过的属性组合及超范围参数值。

Conclusion: 可验证奖励并不需要预设目标输出；通过硬门控加分级逐属性奖励可有效缓解稀疏奖励问题，显著提升多约束音乐生成能力并具备良好泛化性。

Abstract: Constraint-following music generation asks a score to satisfy several user-specified properties at once, each checkable programmatically (key, meter, length, range, final note, rhythm, motion and form), yet no existing benchmark isolates this capability. We construct MusicConstraintBench, 2,180 items over eight constraint families, on which current models fail once a few constraints are combined. The natural remedy is reinforcement learning with these verifiers as reward, yet we observe that a reward paid only when every property holds leaves most training groups without a learning signal: over the first 50 updates, 0.550 of rollout groups score identically and receive no gradient, even though a failing score typically misses only one requested property. Under the joint criterion, rollouts for a prompt tend to fail together, so a binary reward cannot separate a nearly correct score from a malformed one. We therefore introduce MusicRLVR, which pays graded per-property credit behind a hard validation gate that rejects malformed outputs, plus a joint-satisfaction bonus, requiring no human annotation, learned reward model, or music-domain fine-tuning. On MusicConstraintBench, MusicRLVR lifts Qwen3-4B-Instruct from 0.160 to 0.807 on mixed constraints and leads every zero-shot baseline including Llama-3.1-70B at 0.380. It also generalises to property combinations unseen in training and to out-of-range parameter values, showing that verifiable rewards need not presuppose a target output.

</details>


### [971] [MECT: Mixture of Experts with CNN-Transformer Network for Speaker verification](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24061)
*Yu Zheng,Jinghan Peng,ChangHao Zhang,Jian Liu,Weiqiang Wang*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出MECT，将混合专家(MoE)机制集成到CNN-Transformer骨干网络中的说话人验证模型，并优化了块结构与堆叠方案。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在说话人验证任务中，需要在保持紧凑参数与低计算复杂度的同时提升模型性能，因此引入MoE机制以在参数小幅增加的情况下增强建模能力。

Method: 在CNN-Transformer骨干网络上集成MoE，探索四种MoE变体，覆盖语句级与帧级两种粒度，以及稠密与稀疏两种路由策略；并进一步扩展为一系列不同规模的MECT模型。此外通过因果重训练建立流式推理范式。

Result: MoE机制在参数仅小幅增加的情况下优于无MoE基线；扩展的各规模MECT模型均保持紧凑参数与低计算复杂度。其中MECT-B2在VoxCeleb1上取得当前最优性能，并在CN-Celeb上表现强劲。流式推理在100ms块大小下仍保持强性能。

Conclusion: MECT通过MoE与CNN-Transformer的结合，在紧凑参数与低复杂度条件下实现跨数据集的有效说话人验证，并支持低延迟流式推理。

Abstract: In this paper, we propose MECT, a speaker verification model that integrates the Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) mechanism into a CNN-Transformer backbone with optimized block structure and stacking scheme. Specifically, we investigated four MoE variants that span utterance-level and frame-level granularity with dense and sparse routing strategies. The MoE mechanism proves to be effective over the baseline without MoE with only a small increase in parameters. We further scale MECT to a series of model sizes, all maintaining compact parameters and low computational complexity. In particular, MECT-B2 achieves state-of-the-art performance on VoxCeleb1 and delivers strong results on CN-Celeb, demonstrating its effectiveness across diverse datasets. In addition, we establish a streaming inference paradigm through causal retraining, which maintains strong performance at a chunk size of 100ms.

</details>


### [972] [Understanding Hyperspherical Geometry of ECAPA-TDNN Embedding and Its Impact on Zero-Shot Voice Conversion](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.24688)
*Mathilde Abrassart,Nicolas Obin,Axel Roebel*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 该论文分析了ECAPA-TDNN说话人编码器分类器原型在单位超球面上的几何结构，发现标准训练会导致角度集中与有效维度下降，并提出两种几何正则化策略以改善原型的超球面均匀覆盖，从而提升零样本语音转换的鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 角度边界（angular-margin）说话人编码器广泛用于语音转换，但其分类器原型的几何结构尚不清楚，缺乏对其在超球面上组织方式的理解，限制了对模型表征质量与泛化能力的改进。

Method: 将ECAPA-TDNN分类器原型视为单位超球面上的点，使用旋转不变的角度统计量以及全局与局部有效维度（effective dimensionality）度量来刻画其组织方式；在此基础上引入两种几何正则化策略——铰链Riesz对数能量（hinged Riesz log-energy）和有效维度最大化（effective-dimension maximization），作用于分类器原型以促进更均匀的超球面覆盖。

Result: 标准训练会导致角度集中与有效维度显著下降；经正则化后的原型集合具有更高的有效维度和更好的各向同性（isotropy），对说话人识别性能的影响依赖于配置；当把相应ECAPA-TDNN模型用作Fast-VGAN的说话人编码器时，正则化系统在零样本语音转换中表现出更好的鲁棒性，尤其对未见说话人。

Conclusion: 分类器原型的超球面几何结构可通过角度统计与有效维度有效刻画，几何正则化能改善原型的均匀分布与各向同性，并在零样本语音转换中提升对未见说话人的鲁棒性，为角度边界说话人编码器的表征优化提供了几何视角。

Abstract: Angular-margin speaker encoders are widely used in voice conversion, yet the geometry of their classifier prototypes remains poorly understood. We analyze ECAPA-TDNN classifier prototypes as points on the unit hypersphere and characterize their organization using rotation-invariant angular statistics together with global and local effective dimensionality measures. Our analysis shows that standard training can induce angular concentration and a substantial reduction in effective dimensionality. To address this, we investigate two geometric regularization strategies (hinged Riesz log-energy and effective-dimension maximization) applied to classifier prototypes to encourage more uniform hyperspherical coverage. The resulting prototype sets exhibit higher effective dimensionality and improved isotropy, with configuration-dependent effects on speaker-recognition performance. When the corresponding ECAPA-TDNN models are used as speaker encoders for Fast-VGAN, the regularized systems also exhibit improved robustness in zero-shot voice conversion, particularly for previously unseen speakers.

</details>


### [973] [Causal limits and optimal allocation for passive frequency-selective hearing protection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.22395)
*Geonhwi Hwang,Jaewoo Lee,Hyunjun Kim,Hyeonwoo Na*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 论文将入耳式亥姆霍兹共振耳塞的有限腔体空气体积视为设计资源，针对零频透明的带侧支谐振器通孔推导出传输损耗的守恒积分（预算），并加入黏性与侧向（flanking）约束，用危害加权注水法并按连续语音代价定价分配该预算；音频频段预算 B_ad=(20/ln10)π²V/(2cS) 由腔体体积V与通孔截面积S之比决定，全堵塞耳塞不受此限。严格的"透明"改为语音代价定价后，模型的交换率约为每分贝语音代价换取1.3 dB 防护，预算在其饱和点确定。三类外形中，低频选择性设计约为1 dB，危害匹配的中/高频设计可达12 dB；约束变量是通孔面积与语音容限，而非共振器数量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 被动亥姆霍兹共振耳塞需要在衰减危险噪声的同时保持语音可听，但耳道尺寸的壳体空气体积有限；作者将这一体积视为设计所消耗的资源，希望量化"防护—语音可懂度"之间的根本权衡，为设计提供预算上界与分配准则。

Method: 对零频透明、带反应式侧支负载的通孔，利用因果性导出传输损耗的守恒积分，并改写为器件变量形式；引入黏性损耗与侧向传声约束；用危害加权注水法（hazard-weighted water-filling）配合连续语音代价价格来分配预算，得到音频频段预算表达式。

Result: 音频频段预算 B_ad=(20/ln10)·π²V/(2cS)，由腔体总体积V与通孔面积S之比决定，全堵塞式耳塞不受该约束；f²价格信号使资源倾向于远高于声源峰值的频率。用语音代价价格替代严格透明后，在现有模型下交换率约为1.3 dB 防护/1 dB 语音代价，预算在饱和点确定。三类外形对比：低频选择性设计约1 dB，危害匹配的中/高频设计达12 dB。

Conclusion: 被动亥姆霍兹耳塞的性能上限由腔体体积与通孔面积之比（及语音容限）决定，而非共振器数量；解析预算与注水式分配为"降噪—保语音"设计提供了可计算的定量框架，指明通孔面积与语音许用代价是关键设计变量。

Abstract: Passive Helmholtz-resonator earplugs aim to attenuate hazardous noise while keeping speech audible; the air volume of an ear-sized shell is finite, and we treat it as the resource a design spends. For a vented bore transparent at zero frequency and loaded by reactive side branches, causality fixes a conserved integral of transmission loss. We derive it in device variables, add viscous and flanking constraints, and allocate the budget by hazard-weighted water-filling with a continuous speech-cost price. The audio-band budget B_ad = (20/ln10) pi^2 V / 2cS is set by the ratio of total cavity volume V to bore area S; occluding plugs are exempt. The f^2 price signal favours frequencies well above the source peak. Replacing strict transparency by a speech-cost price gives an exchange rate of about 1.3 dB of protection per decibel of speech cost under the present model, with the budget setting where it saturates. Across three form factors, low-frequency-selective designs stay near a decibel while hazard-matched mid/high-frequency designs reach twelve. The binding variables are bore area and speech allowance, not resonator count.

</details>


### [974] [Misrecognition or Abstraction? Rethinking Outputs of Sound Event Recognition](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23411)
*Naoya Tomida,Yuki Okamoto,Keisuke Imoto*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出一种用于声音事件识别的输出表示，将声音事件类别、置信度分数与拟声描述三者结合。实验表明该方法在识别性能上与传统系统相当，且在不确定性下更具信息性与交流性，更受LLM评判与主观听测偏好。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统声音识别系统输出确定性类别标签，隐含假设目标声音类别可被正确识别。但真实听音场景中声音事件类别并非总能明确辨识，而人类听众仍能借助模糊声音理解环境。因此需要重新设计不确定性下声音识别系统的输出方式。

Method: 提出一种输出表示，将声音事件类别、其置信度分数以及声音的拟声描述相结合。该表示在保留传统基于类别的识别的同时，额外提供对声学特征的拟声描述，从而在类别预测不确定时仍具信息量。使用ESC-50与ESC-50-Onomatopoeia数据集进行实验，并采用LLM-as-a-judge评估与主观听测实验。

Result: 在ESC-50与ESC-50-Onomatopoeia上，所提方法达到与仅识别的传统系统相当的识别性能。LLM-as-a-judge评估与主观听测实验显示，所提输出优于基于声音事件标签的传统确定性输出，尤其在辅助理解周边环境时更受偏好。

Conclusion: 此类输出表示可使声音事件识别在不确定性下更具信息性与交流性，为声音识别系统在模糊场景中的输出设计提供了新方向。

Abstract: Conventional general sound recognition systems typically output deterministic sound event labels, implicitly assuming that the target sound class can be correctly identified from the input audio. However, in real listening situations, the sound event class is not always clearly identifiable. Human listeners may nevertheless understand their surroundings from an ambiguous sound without identifying its exact sound event class. This motivates a discussion of how the outputs of sound recognition systems should be redesigned under such uncertainty. As a basis for this discussion, this paper proposes an output representation for sound event recognition that combines a sound event class, its confidence score, and an onomatopoeic description of the sound. The proposed representation preserves conventional class-based recognition while providing an additional onomatopoeic description of acoustic characteristics that can remain informative even when the class prediction is uncertain. Experiments using ESC-50 and ESC-50-Onomatopoeia show that the proposed method achieves sound recognition performance comparable to that of a conventional recognition-only system. In addition, an LLM-as-a-judge evaluation and subjective listening experiments indicate that the proposed output is preferred over conventional deterministic outputs based on the sound event label, particularly when used to support understanding of the surrounding environment. These results suggest that such output representations can make sound event recognition more informative and communicative under uncertainty.

</details>


### [975] [LiteCASS: A Lightweight End-to-End Network for Real-Time Stereo Cinematic Audio Source Separation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23453)
*Yuanxin Guo,Qiang Ji,Mengmei Liu,Yuhan Lv,Ningning Pan,Gongping Huang*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: LiteCASS是首个面向实时立体声电影音频源分离的轻量级端到端网络，通过STFT子带重排与两个联合训练的紧凑U-Net实现对话、音乐与音效的分离，仅用1.06M参数和0.72G MACs/秒即取得对比基线中最高的平均SI-SDR。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有电影音频源分离（CASS）方法存在两大关键局限：一是依赖参数量庞大的网络架构和GPU级硬件，难以用于实时和资源受限场景；二是绝大多数方法针对单声道信号设计，立体声场景基本未被探索。

Method: LiteCASS采用确定性的STFT子带重排，并结合两个联合训练的紧凑U-Net：第一个U-Net提取对话成分，第二个U-Net从预测的非语音成分中分离音乐与音效（SFX）。所有声部由多任务波形域L1损失进行监督。

Result: 在DnR v3的空间化立体声扩展数据集上，LiteCASS-K8仅使用1.06M参数和每秒0.72G MACs，同时在所比较的CASS基线中取得最高的平均SI-SDR。

Conclusion: LiteCASS验证了轻量级端到端网络在实时立体声电影音频源分离上的可行性，在极低计算与参数量下仍能达到优于现有基线的分离性能。

Abstract: Cinematic audio source separation (CASS) decomposes a soundtrack into dialogue, music, and sound-effects (SFX) stems. Existing CASS methods, however, suffer from two critical limitations: they rely on heavily parameterized network architectures and GPU-class hardware, limiting their use in real-time and resource-constrained scenarios, and they are overwhelmingly designed for monaural signals, leaving the stereo scenario largely unexplored. We present LiteCASS, to our knowledge the first lightweight end-to-end network for real-time stereo CASS. LiteCASS combines deterministic STFT subband rearrangement with two jointly trained compact U-Nets: the first extracts dialogue, and the second separates music and SFX from the predicted non-speech component. A multi-task waveform-domain L1 loss supervises all stems. On a spatialized stereo extension of DnR v3, LiteCASS-K8 uses only 1.06M parameters and 0.72G MACs per second, while achieving the highest averaged SI-SDR among the compared CASS baselines.

</details>


### [976] [Beyond Encoder Fusion: Multi-View Discrete Token Augmentation for LLM-Based ASR](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23525)
*Paul Moïse Gangbadja,Mickael Rouvier,Fabrice Lefèvre*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 提出多视图离散语音token增强策略：用固定SSL编码器（HuBERT、WavLM、MMS-300M）为同一训练语料生成多种离散token序列，作为共享LLM解码器的互补训练视图，测试时仅需单编码器。LibriSpeech上WavLM达test-clean 3.30%、test-other 8.13% WER，多视图ROVER进一步降至3.03%和7.38%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 离散语音token为语音编码器与大语言模型之间提供了紧凑接口，但单token化ASR系统对所选编码器高度敏感，性能受限于单一编码器的表示偏差。作者希望在不增加多编码器推理开销的前提下提升系统鲁棒性与识别精度。

Method: 多视图离散token增强：对每条训练语音，用多个固定的自监督SSL编码器（如HuBERT、WavLM、MMS-300M）分别生成替代token序列，将这些不同token化视为共享LLM解码器的互补训练视图，从而在训练中接触更多样的离散语音表示。测试阶段模型只使用单一编码器，并可选地对多视图假设做ROVER融合。

Result: 在LibriSpeech上，该方法相比各自独立训练的基线均有一致提升，其中WavLM达到test-clean 3.30% WER、test-other 8.13% WER。预算匹配的对照实验表明增益来源于编码器多样性而非数据量增加。对多视图假设进行ROVER后，WER进一步降至3.03%和7.38%。

Conclusion: 多视图离散token增强是一种简单有效的训练策略，通过引入编码器多样性缓解单token化ASR对特定编码器的敏感性，在保持单编码器推理成本的同时稳定提升识别性能，且增益可归因于表示多样性而非数据规模。

Abstract: Discrete speech tokens provide a compact interface between speech encoders and large language models for automatic speech recognition, but single-tokenization systems remain sensitive to the chosen encoder. We propose multi-view discrete token augmentation, a simple strategy that augments each training utterance by generating alternative token sequences from fixed SSL encoders, such as HuBERT, WavLM, and MMS-300M. These tokenizations are treated as complementary training views for a shared LLM decoder, exposing it to more diverse discrete speech representations without requiring multi-encoder inference. At test time, the model can operate with a single encoder. On LibriSpeech, the approach consistently improves all encoders over independently trained baselines, with WavLM reaching 3.30% WER on test-clean and 8.13% on test-other. Budget-matched controls show that the gains come from encoder diversity rather than data volume. ROVER over multi-view hypotheses further improves WER to 3.03% and 7.38%.

</details>


### [977] [ArtifactBench: Lineage-Aware Evaluation of AI-Generated Music Detectors under Distribution Shift](https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.23550)
*Heewon Oh*

Main category: cs.SD

TL;DR: 本文提出 ArtifactBench，一个考虑生成谱系、数据泄漏与推断覆盖的 AI 音乐检测基准，用于揭示聚合指标掩盖的性能差异，并对多个公开检测器在统一协议下评测。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 生成音乐检测器的评测主要依赖基准上的聚合分数，而这些基准的训练重叠、生成器谱系、来源出处与音频变换历史仅部分可观测，导致被评测的性能与模型排名可能被泄漏、队列可用性、阈值策略及模型特定缺失性所扭曲。

Method: 提出 ArtifactBench：按内容身份对源录音及其衍生变体进行分组；将校准集与最终测试集分离；将推断失败与分类错误独立记录；除聚合指标外，报告带不确定性的源级性能。在版本固定的统一协议下，对多个公开检测器进行评测，分析泄漏控制、队列可用性、阈值策略与模型特定缺失性对测得性能和模型排名的影响。

Result: 在 562 首曲目的 common-success 测试交集上，ArtifactNet 取得 0.982 AUROC 与 0.918 平衡准确率；公开 Deezer 检测器为 0.761/0.776；SpecTTTra 与 CLAM 在该偏移队列下 AUROC 低于 0.30。结果还暴露出聚合分数单独无法体现的显著生成器域偏移与真实音乐域偏移。

Conclusion: AI 生成音乐检测的评测需要谱系感知与泄漏控制，并应区分推断失败与分类错误、报告源级不确定性；否则聚合分数会掩盖生成器与真实域偏移，进而影响性能评估与模型排名。

Abstract: AI-generated music detectors are commonly compared using aggregate scores on benchmarks whose training overlap, generator lineage, source provenance, and audio-transformation history are only partially observable.
